—ོ——dad —lhana.ad —/ /rna dathu — —buzha guldagarga rtsosga py-iogasga bulhagarga/ /(smad cha)blo bzang dpal ldan gyis brtsams/krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang /

shā〉 ༵ ༄byephi zlophe94 ༷tshu ༅ rsha྾4tram̐ rdospre7ṭaṃ 4 ༷ dzi jini lko sde 4༄8 tsha3〉 blolja tsho ṭwāṃjutrī rdzo7lha tsho ne7 mo ཿspyodziya rgyu 〉 rnye dku sko rsha : ṭwāṃ caphro ri rtsa( ṅka zi4 9'iji ‘ lte kresmi 1 chi snye rtsi7 dngharke 9 rke 7tshorke/ // beedzorṣa47 ske dku tsho ) ri tho rdzopha st+waṃ shā3ོmi rte ༄ /9ji dku4tīpy-i zi phrostsoti tsha bhe sne shā 9 khu4 tshu dīsnacablo tyā rsharwa / stso rmirdzodzālce )spyowasna lke sna pho 4 bhe sto lke9 tshodzā 4 rtswakhri sduyi thozi rto rīphro sto spro zanerasnyi 6 ri sna the sdirmesne stoskrurdzisto༄stotram̐ 7tho ryātsu lhokha dku nee dziḥzlo ra nga ri sna tsho ‘rṣa ktordorha gyi sko rmo ne wa stsorwa 4 snye shlau sna rna ri —— tsā bhe7 dzha snerdzo rngo rwa4tsho snye ne ro — cho sha hūṃ ༷ chi kṣitre4 ge bhe —khritsho sdu 44 rdzi rdzo sna skre ༈ snyelha wa ciwa— 4 rmi ༵bye

ki dpe skun gsal bshad/rtsom pa po gis steng blo bzang dpal ldan ni mdo smad re skong tsho 'du zhes pa'e sder yab chos mdzad dang yum sgron ma gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bco lnga ba'i lcags sbrul spyi lo 1881 la sku bltams/ dgung lo bcu pa la rab tu byung ste gis steng shega' ldan chos 'phel gyi sgrub grwar zhugs/ der klog gi slob dpon zhig bsten te phral sbyor gyi klog dang skyabs 'gro sogs bslabs/ rong bo bde chen chos 'khor gling gi dus zhabs pa mtsho byung dgyes pa'i dpal las sum rtags dag gsum dang snyan ngag rgya rtsis/ nag rtsis/ sdeb sbyor/ ka tsān dbyangs gsum sogs la mkhas par sbyangs/dgung lo nyer bzhi pa la gis steng dgon par gnang ba zhus te sde'u rtsa bkra shis chos sdings kyi chos grwar zhugs te zhwa dmar partsi ta dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang dge bshes chen mo hor chen ye shes rgya mtsho rnam gnyis kyi mdun nas bsdus grwa dang tshad ma rnam 'grel/ phar phyin/ dbu ma/mngon pa mdzod/ 'dul ba bcas gzhung bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags—kyi rgyud sde sogs la zhib tu sbyangs pas mkhas pa'i go 'phang brnyes/dgung lo zhe bdun par shar skal ldan blo bzang 'phrin las lung rtogs rgya mtshos yongs 'dzin du bkur/ de dang chabs mtshungs rong chen kiti sku phreng bcu ba ngag dbang blo bzang bstan pa tshe ring dang 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho sogs slob ma'i tshogs kyung mang du bskyangs/ de ltar

/rdordo ma ma mkhas chen blo bzang dpal ldan mchog ni rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhas grags rgyas pa tsam ma yin par/ gzhung de dang de'i dka' gnad la sgro 'dogs chod pa'i sgo nas 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rnam thar sku tshe dang snyoms par mdzad pa lags shing / de nas dgung lo re bzhi pa shing sprel spyi lo1944 ba'i zla bcu gcig tshes nyer gnyis kyi mtshan mor sku 'das/ /spyir khong gis mdzad pa'i gsung rtsom mang du mchis par bshad mod/yul dus rgyu rkyen sna tshogs pa'i dbang gis phal che ba zhig rnyed dka' bar gyur/ da lta bzhugs pa ni mkhas dbang tshe tan zhabs/ drung mchog gis gtsang bshu bskyon te thugs bsrel gnang ba'ici pod gnyes bzhugs pa de dang / lung yon dgon pa'i e waṃ dpe mdzod kyi phyag dpe'i khrod nas rnyed pa ci rigs yin la/ de dag gi nang nas thu ba dgon dang stag tshang lha mo sogs kyi par ma 'ga' zhig las gzhan dag ma yig rtsom gdan dang bu yig gang rung dbu med du bris pa rnams phyogs bsgrigs byas nas par du bskrun pa yin/spyang go'i pod kyi shes rig dbe skun khang nas/spyi lo 1990zla 1 tshes 5la/

1 dkar chagatho/nga sa skyabs mgon mchog nas sems bskyed mchod pa gnang skabs kyi maṇḍal bshad pa/ ( 3 )gong sa skyabs mgon mchog nas dus 'khor dbang chen gsar gnang skabs kyi maṇḍal bshad pa/ (18)gong sa skyabs mgon bdun pa chen po khrir gsar bzhugs kyi bshad pa/ — (32)gser ljo ngas yul gyi skyabs mgon skal ldan bdun pa chen po gser gyi khri la gsar phebs kyi lo dang po'i tshogs gtam/ (5 1〉gong sa mchog gse ra khri'i skabs su bsgrigs pa'i tshogs gtam/ (66〉rdzogs ldan dpyid kyi rol mo zhes bya ba'i tshig gi spu wang / (83)skyabs mgon mchog gser khrir gsar bzhengs kyi kha dar 'bul skabs bstan pa spyi'i rnam gzhag bshad pa gzhan gyis 'thus pa byas te gsham du 'dogs rgyur gnang ba/ (1 13)rab rgyal lcags rta lor skyabs mgon bdun nga/ra gser khri'i kha dar phul ba'i skabs kyi bshad lan/ (1 23)khri rgan rdo rje 'chang nas rong bo sha bi nar du dus 'khor dbang chen

— 2gzuṭar ṅgebasazhurgyuraspel ba/ (132)dang po'i sangs rgyas 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal bo kun mkhyen bla ma 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas chu bya lor seng ge gshong du shrī ka la tsakra'i a hi ñtsaganang skabs kyi bshad par spel ba/ (146)rdzongs dkar zhal snga nas blo bzang chos 'phel rgya mtsho rong bo'i gser khrir gsar bzhugs skabs khri bshad du thugs bzhed ltar spel ba/ (157)dus dbang skabs kyi maṇḍal bshad pa/ (178)rdo rje 'chang khri chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi yang sprul rin po che gdan sar phebs skabs kyi bshad lan ngo mtshar ring mo (184)bis mdo'i sems bskyed yar zhus kyis 'thus par byas te rong bo'i lam rim skabs yar zhus kha snon/ (20 1)kun mkhyen 'jigs med parnyi ta skyabs mgon bdun pa'i rigs bdag tu phebs skabs 'bul bshad du spel ba/ (206)seng ge gshong ya 'go'i 'du khang rab gnas skabs sku phyogs rnam gnyis la zhu byar spel ba/ (214)yab gcig chos kyi rgyal bo pha rgod bla ma rdo rje 'chang nas yig sgar du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor skabs kyi bshad par spel ba/ (217)yab rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i sras kyi thu bo yu ngogs mkhan chen sku phreng drug pa blo bzang lung stogs chos kyi rgyu mtshos gnyan thog rtswa nga/bad

3da 'ga' gnang skabs zhu rgyur spel ba/ (232)gong sa mchog rka sar la gser zhal bsgyur skabs zhu rgyur spel ba (240)shel dgon nas skyabs mgon la yar zhus/ (24ba)bis mdo'i mchod rten kun phan mthong grol chen mo gsar bzhengs skabs bshad pa spyi chu dmar sprul sku'i khri zhus kyis 'thus pa la kha 'gengs su khri rga/ser kha ba'i ngor spel ba/ (252 mtshan sgrog sprul sku 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal mtshan gdan sar gsar bkod skabs zhus lan du spel ba/ (256)chu dmar sgom sprul sku phreng lnga ba bis mdo'i gdan sar gsar phebs kyi skabs khri las thog pa gser kha sprul pa'i sku'i ngor spel ba/ (264〉bis mdo'i lha zhis pa khrir bkod skabs khri las thog pa blo bzang grags pa rgya mtsho'i ngor spe smu ba/ (272)sgar so ma'i skyabs mgon la yar zhus/ ( 277) khyung mgon sku phreng gsum pa khrir phebs bshad lan du sngags 'chang padma rgya mtsho'i mos 'dod bzhin spel ba/ (281)seng ge rku/shong nas chos bka'i mjug tu bshad byar stsal ba/ (293〉rong bo bde chen chos 'alor gling gi cho 'phrul smon lam skabs kyi rten bshad/ ngu (304〉dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi sa sa/cod bzhugs so/ / (32rmye)brgyud sto nga don bsdus kyi sa bcad/ (353)

4dris lan skal bzang lam yig (358)ma cig thes rab lha mo la bsnyen cing bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa shes ra be pad mo rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ (372〉gober zeng drisi lan/ (375〉mngon pa las byung ba'i thob pa'i rnam gzhag gsal bar brjod pa mngon pa mdzos pa'i 'phra tshom/ (394todane tig tu rje 'jigs med zhal snga nas dus dbang gnang skabs kyi maṇa bshad du spel ba/ (410)lta ba'i myong byang / (429)snying bo don gsum gyi nyams khrid skyong tshul bklag chog gi tshul du bkod pa dag zhing bgrod pa'i them skas/ (469)rje sgo'i phar phyin yig chas bzhed tshul gyi tho 'god/ (483)rtsa ba shese rab kyi rigs pa'i de nyid snang bar byed pa don sbyor ngag gi sgron me zhe sa bya ba/ (493)sher phyin dbyangs can ma dkar mo la yon tan rjes su dran pa'i sgo nosi dngos rgyub zhu tshul zhes bya ba/ (576)'jam dbyangs dkar po la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ (578)rgyal yum sgrol ma'i 'dod gsol/ (579)sgrol ma'i g.yang 'gugs/ (580)dpang bstod/ (584)yang rgya rin po ches dris lan/ (597)

ri༅༅ / / rde ske nee mme spruska lpukon skaska lhan budun pu chen kkozhe ldid zhinin puṭaṃ ta zhadan da/py-ideska bla na gluo 2zwad dpulu ldan nu lhagarga sbyo/na:py-igs 2sgrigaska nee haṃg ntun bro zheni/ py-i 2/2zhugaska sro/ /(smad cha/tsho

3 sneo/ /gong sa skyabs mgon mchog nas bems bskyed mchod pa gnang skabs kyi maṇḍal bshad pa/༄ / /oṃ bde legs su gyur cig gang zhig ma lus 'gro ba'i snying la brtse ba'i grib bsil 'pho ba can/ /spyod pa rgya chen yal ga'i khyon yangs tshogs gnyis me tog dkar bu dag /rab rgyas dri bzhon phyogs kyi chu thar 'gro 'bras bu mi dman kun dga'i shing / /sa gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma mnyam med dpag bsam ljon pas dge legs stsol/ /ces bkra shis pa dang dge legs su byed pa'i bden tshig tshangs pa chen po'i ngag gi rnam 'gyur cir yang 'char ba/ kun du dge ba'i mtshan ma phun sum tshogs pa'i me tog char du bsnyil te/ 7 gong na skyabs mgon chos kyi rgyal bo nyi ma dang zla ba bzhin du lham mer bzhugs pa/ bar na bstan 'dzin skyes chen gyi dbang bo bgrang yas dpag bsam gyi ljon pa bzhin du mtshar du dngar ba/ bar na bya btang sgom chen gyi rigs rnams gangs seng dkar mo bzhin du lhun chags pa/ bka' rab 'byams rme ba'i bshes gnyen mang po 'khoro lo'i sgyur ba'i dgongs blon bzhin nee+o 'gying bags kyis 'khod pa/ bslab gsum lung rtsogs kyis phyug pa'i dge 'dun khri phrag du ma gur kum snye rna

4 tshal du ltem pa bzhin du gral du bsgrigs pa/ zur na lta sgom tshad du 'khyol ba'i sngags 'chang dang gathe/na rabs dpag med gangs dkar gyi ri bo byin du chags pa bzhin du bajid bags kyis rol 'a/ gong gi lungaltes kyis mtho zhing stobs 'byor mkhas dregs kyis che ba sa skyong mi'i dbang bo rnams ci yang bsnyems pa/ gsham na dad gtong ngo mtshar gyi lang tsho ci yang mdzes pa'i khyim bdag oṃ mo bgrang gis mi lango ba sgyuciskar gyi phung bo mkha' la dkrigs pa/ 'bras dkar gyi tshom bu sa la bkram pa bzhin du tshogs pa'i dasmyul 'khori rab tu yangs pa 'arda snyed du/ mdo las/ gang tshe skyes po mne po'i dbus su son gyur ba/ /der ni mkhas pas chos kyi gtam la 'jug par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar skabasri su babs pa'i chosmo kyi gtam la 'jug par bya ba lags la/de ya nga gong sa skyabs mgone thams cad mkhyen pa chen po rnam 'dren phyag na padmo 'od zer kun 'phags dadzil brtsegs rgyal bo gang gis da lami theg pa chen po'i cho sa kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor ba 'di nyid ngo mtshar pa'i daripal phun sum tshogs pa du mas khyad par du 'iphagasi pa'i sgo nas 'a ga rten mtha' dag dge legs su byed pa'i chosmo kyi snango ba yug gcig gis rkun rdu khyab pa yin pas/ dang po gnas phun sum tshogs pa ni/ lha yul mi tog gling / rgya gar 'a phags pa'i gling / stag ga zi gas nor gyi gling / o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling / rgya nag ngo mtshar gling / glu yul rino chen gling / bod yul chos kyi gling / zhes gling chen po bdun du grags pa'i nang tshan bod yu la chos kyi gling / de la dbus gtsang rtos kyi chol kha/ rmado

ma bye ////stod mi'i chol kha/ mdo smad rta'i chol kha gsum du grags pa'i phyi ma mdo khams g.yar mo thang / de la rma chu'i klung rgyun gyis lho byang gnyis su phye ba'i lho rgyud/ dam chos kyi nyi ma shar ba/ bde skyid kyi pad tshal rgyas pa/ dga' ston gyi yo lang dar ba/ lha yu la las skyid che ba/ klu yul las dpal ngom pa / lugs sa/nyis kyi mnga' thang dgung la reg pa/ ji skad du/ rtosgo/ri 4 brjod gser gyi me tog las/ lho rgyud dpal ldan nor gyi blo gros gang / / dag pa'i 'jig rten mngon par dga' ba'e bcude/ /khyab 'jug sba ra mo'i 'a phrul gyis mngon phyung ba'i/ /grags pa srid zhir snyan gong rgyan du mched/ /ces bsngags pa ltar la/de'i snying por gyur ba reb gong gser mo ljongs 'dir/ klub pa brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rong chen lha rje de nyid lha dang bla mas lung bstan te thugs bskyed kyis sa 'dir byon/ rgya bza' dang bod bza' gnyis khashā tu bsus te rgyarṣa thang dang blon chos la kha sa/nyis su gzhi bzung /lha'i sras po rong mdo sde 'bum 'khrungs/ de la sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam sprul rigs sras dgu 'khrungs pa rnams/ nyi zla bzhin du lngang tsho mdzes pa/ tshangs pa bzhin du thugs dgongs zab pa/ lha dbang bzhin du gzi brjid che ba/ dbang phyug bzhin du kha dreg btsan pa/ khyab 'jug bzhin du dpa' rtsal che ba/ lugs gnyis kyi 'phrin las che ba sha stag yin pas reb gong yar nang mar nang / reb lag rdo sbis rnams su mnga' 'bangs chos bzhin skyong ba'i srid bzung / sras che ba rong bo'i bla ma bsam gtan rin chenacigyis/ sa rno rje 'dra ba'i rked pa nas/ /mi khyod kyis smub

6brgyud bstan pa spel/ /zhes lung gis zin pa'i sa gzhi rgyal thang gi lte bar bde chen chos 'khor gling 'di ga/sar 'debs mdzad/ sras gsum pa blo gros seng ge lung rtogs kyi yon tan che zhing 'phrin las rgyas te/ rgya nag gosmem tā mang rgyal bos dbu blar bkur/ reb gong gi rong 'brog sde khri phrag mang po mnga' zhabs su btsud/ de dus snod la bkra shis kyi byin chags pa/ bcud la dge mtshan gyi dpal 'bar ba/ mi mthun pa'i 'thab rtsod med pa/ mi 'byor ba'i dbul phongs bral ba/ gnen la rigs rgyud kyi 'phelaji kha che ba/ rgan la tshe thag gi chu rgyun ring ba/ srid 'byor gyi rgya mtsho g.yas su 'khyil ba/ chos 'byor gyi dpag bsam dgung la reg pa byung / de lta bu'i rgyud la 'jam dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul rje btsun chos pa rin po che dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam sprul gyi yab rje bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho rnam gnyis sku mched kyi tshul du 'khrungs/ lho rgyud kyi ljongs 'dir bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa nyi zla ltar gsal bar mdzad/ 'gro khams chos la bsgyur/ bde skyid dgung du spel bas rdzogs ldan gyi dga' ston myong / dag chi/nga gi snang ba 'char ba sogs ngo mtshar brjod kyis mi lang / lhag par du gser ljongs yangs pa'i rgyan gcig grwa tshang thos bsam rnam par rgyal ba'i gling 'di phyag 'debs mdzad/ bka' pod chen po lnga'i sachad nyan gyi rgyal mtshan btsugs pas/ skyes chen dam pa dang ma khas pa dang grub pa'i dbang phyug dpag tu med pa bar ma chad par byung / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nam yang mi nub pa'i sgo gcig pu dang / sems can la bde skyid bar ma chad par yong ba'i 'byung khungs su gyur/ sku preng po/nyis pa

ṭwāṃ —bde chos kyi rgyal bos sma0/ rgyud gsang sngags gling btab/ sku phreng gsum pa 7 skyabs mgon 'phrin las rab rgyas kyis du sa 'khor e waṃ gling btab/thugs sras rim byon gyis sgrub pa'i sde so so btab pa la brten nas ljongs 'di dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing khams gnyis pa lta bur yod pa 'di yin/ /de'i phyir/ paṇa chen ngag gi dbang phyug mi pham zla bas/ mdo smad tsong kha'i lho ngos reb gong gi yul de/ /mtha' khob yang khob smag rum thibs pa zhig min no/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar sa/sal bas/ /dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing khams gnyis pa rang yin no/ /zhes don la gnas pa'i bsngags brjod rmad du byung ba 'di gnang ste/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa'i rang bzhin ni de lta bu lags na/ 'di ni ngo mtshar ba'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa dang po las/sa//sa/nyis pa ston pa phun sum tshogs pa ni/ ji skad du/ khyod zhabs thugs rje zla ba ni/ skaka bzang bde 'byung ral ba la/ /bkod pas sa gsum mtha' dag gi /snying gi mun sel bla ma rgyal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ zhabs sen zla ba'i dkyil 'khor skal bzang gdul bya'i gtsug tu bkod pa tsam nas/ nang ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal te/ shes bya'i gnas lugs phra rags mthong ba'i ye shes kyi spyan sbyin pa'i yab rje bla ma mchog ni/don dngos po gnas tshod ni/ phyogs bcu'i bde bar gathe/gas pa mtha' dag gi spyi gzugs/ gru 'dzin zhing gi mgon po 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i zlos gar rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho'i skye ba sprul ba'e sku yin pa ni/ dpal bde gshegs kun gyi spyi gzugs che/ /lha 'phagablu

lha —mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang dngos/ /pha skal ldan rgya ma tsho sprul ba'i sku/ / rje 'phrin las lung rtogs rgya mtsho'i sde/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lags la/ dpal mi pham zla bas/ nam mkha'i dbyings na zla ba sa/cig nyid kyang / /sa yi steng na chu snod ji snyed par/ /grangs bzhin 'char ba'i ya mtshan 'dir ltos dang / /bsam yas rgyal ba'i rol ba yid la 'bab/ /ces gsungs pa ltar chu zla ltar sprul ba'i bkod pa 'byams klas pa las/ 'brom ston rgyal badza 'byung gnas/ de sprul khye'u dkar po/rong bo'i bla ma bsam gtan rin chen/ rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho sku phreng rim byon gyi rnam pas bod khams spyi dang / bye brag tu yul 'di'i gdul bya rnams rjes su bzung / sku tshe 'dir yang / khri chen dang po'i sangs rgyas 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho/ a rol spyan ras gzigs dbang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ 'jigs med rgyal ba'i snying bo 'jigs byāl dam chos rgya mtsho sogs thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i rma nga' bdag du ma 'i zhabs pad gzhon dus nas bsten te/ smin byed spyi bka' dang zur bka'i dbang chen/ byin rlabs rjes gnang dang rigs gtad gang mchis/ grol byed dmar khrid bshad lung brgya phrag rgyab brten lung gi tshogs mtha' dang grangs mang mchis pa bzhes te/ dam pa'i chos kyi bang mdzod chen po gcig pur gyur/ khyad par du/ lung las/ khyod kyi mkhyen pa'i spyan zur g.yos tsam gyis/ /shes bya'i spu/nas kun rang tshugs brjen par ston/ /yon tan nam mkha'i mdzod kyi grwa gcig na/ rab 'byams rgya'/ ba'i gsang gsum ngal bsor yib/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ lhan cig

sa sdi— /)steskyes pa'i mkhyen rab nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo rang grol du yod pas shes bya rig pa'i gnas phra rags mtha' dag gzigs pa tsam gyis dgongs pa'i— khar/ sa'i steng na ches pas che ba dang mkhas pas mkhas nga/ra gyur pa/bsngags pa dorno ldan gyi paṇḍi ta chen po yongs 'dzin 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i zhabs pad 'bral med du bsten te/ sgra tshad bzo gso sogs rig gnas bcu phrag phyogs gtogs dang bcas pa/ bka' pod chen po rnam lnga/ byams pa'i chos sde nyi shu/ dbu ma rigs tshogs sde drug bka' gdams gzhung chen rnam drug lam rim blo sbyong brgya phras/ rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i spyi don/ pha rgyud ma rgyud kyi rgyud 'grel/ bskyed rdzogs man ngag gi rim pa/ zhal shes snyan brgyud kyi yig chung / chos skyong sohoso'i sgrub 'phrin/ gar thigabyudabyangs gsum gyi phyag len/ 'bud dkrol rdung gsum gyi rim pa/ mdor na lha sku'i thig tshad dang lag pa'i phyag rgya bca' tshul na sa gsang 'dus kyi rim lnga dang / dus 'khor gyi sbyor drug gi bar mdzub khrid phyag mjil gyi rdzas bzhin zhus/ grogs seng ge srab med du 'phyo ba lta bu sha stag dang dpung sdebs kyis lung rigs dgaspu sgrub/ 'bel gtam spyi 'phros sogs sgo sna tshogs nas dus khor yug tu sbyangs pas mdo sngags rig gnas man ngag bzhi char la 'jigs pa med pa khyu mchog rlabs po che mngon du mdzad de/ dus 'dir shar chu bo gaṅgā tshun chad na bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bur grags pa/ bla sprul che khag gis 'gying ba/ mtshan snyan gyi ba dan g.yo ba su 'dra la ltos na'ang rgyu skar gyi khrod na zla ba/ rkang 'thung gi tshal na dpag bsam bzhin du lham mer lhang nger bzhugs pa ni/ gser ljongs yangs

1() ———————pa'i paṇḍi ta ngag gi dbang bos/ nyi ma'i gnyen yang btang snyoms mdzad pa yi/ /snyigs dus sngo sangs mtha' 'khob mun pa'i gling / /bshad sgrub chos kyis dkar por bgyid pa la/ smra ba'i zla ba khyod las lhag pa su/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bsngags pa'i rol mo 'jig rten gyi rgyan du son/mdor na ji skad du/ rgya chen thos pa'i pha rol phyin/ /skyon bral sdom pa gsum gyis btsun/ /gnas lugs mngon gyur grub pa'i rje/ /'di lta'i mgon bcas skal ba bzang / /zhes pa ltar/ mkhas btsun grub pa'i rnam thar mtha' dag gru bzhi lam mer mnga' ba/ dpal ldan mthong ba don ldan/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid lta bu'i mgon dang bcas pa ni bdag cag e ma ho rmad byung skal ba bzang / ston pa phun sum tshogs pa'i gsang gsum rgyan gyi 'khor lo de lta bu lags na/ 'di ni ngo mtshar pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa gnyis pa lags/ /zhu ba po phun sum tshogs pa ni/ gser ljongs rig pa 'byung ba'i zhing gi mdzes rgyan dam pa/ dpal na lend+ra dang rgyal byed tshal gyi zla bor yongs su snyems pa/ rong bo thos bsam rnam par rgyal ba'i gling zhes grags pa dkar bo'i do shal nor 'dzin gyi khyon la brdal ba/ bshad sgrub kyi rtsal dang ldan pa'i skyes chen dam pa shing rta chen po rnam gnyis kyi rjes/ su 'gro ba/lung rtogs yon tan gyis mngon par mdzes pa'i sprul sku thogs med sku mched kyi tshul la 'gran pa/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyis brgyan pa'i bshes gnyen zhi ba 'tsho yab sras kyi ngang tshul 'edzin pa/ rtsod ngag sa/nam lcags kyi 'khor lo thogs pa/ med pa phyogs glang chor/ grags kyi zla bor snyems

11pa/ 'chad pa legs bshad kyi gru char 'dod dgur 'jo ba zla grags dpon slob kyi rnam thar ngoms pa/ rtsom pa snyan tshig gi rol mo ci dgar 'khrol ba dpa' bo dge dbang gi yon tan 'dzin pa lta bu'i mkhas grub bye ba'i 'byung gnas dam par gyur pa/ khyad par du lung chos sde snod gsum gyi 'chad nyan gyi sa bon dus bzhi kun du spel bas lung rtogs mi zad pa'i bstan pa'i dpag bsam ches cher 'phel te phan bde 'bras bu'i dpal la ljongs 'di'i 'gro ba rnams ci 'dod du spyod nga mig mthong lag zin du yod pa dang / rtsod ngag seṅge nga ro'i sgra rnam par bsgrags pas phas kyi rgol ba ma lus pa spa bkong ste chos min smra ba'i lce rtse g.yo rma gul med par nag po'i phyogs thams cad rnam par bsnyal/ chos dang dkar po'i phyogs yar zla bzhin du 'phel bzhin yod pa 'di nyid ni/ ji skad du/ rong ston chos kyi rgyal bo'i 'phrin las kyis/ /sa/ser ljongs dkyil 'khor rnam par dkar ba 'di/ /stong phrag zla ba'i spu long rab g.yos pas/ /smag rum lhag med byas pa'i mthu 'am ci/ /zhes sa/sungs pa ltar te/ de ni zhu ba po rnams kyi ngang tshul zur tsam thol ba lags na/ 'di ni ngo mtshar ba'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa gsum pa lags/ / chos phun sum tshogs pa ni/ rgyan 'grel nyi shu rtsa gcig tu grags pa las rab dang phul dang gya nom pa/ gtso bo'i khyad chos gnyis kyi sgo nas rgya 'grel gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa/ rgya bod gnyi kar nyi zla ltar yongs su gragayopa/ nam mkha' ltar khyab gdal che ba/ paṇḍi ta mtha' dag gis sbyang bya gzhung gi gtso bo/ grwa sru chos kyi tshong brdal mtha'

12dag gi legs bshad kyi tshong khang chen po/ rgyal blo'i gsung rab la lta ba'i mig gcig pu 'grel chung don gsal gyi bshad lung dang / theg chen lam gyi 'jug sgo/ rgyal sras spyod pa'i gzhi rten/ theg chen chos kyijigazhung shing / byang chen 'bras bu'i sa bon/ tshogs gnyis kun la gser 'gyur gyi rtsi lta bu/ sdig sgrib sregs la dus mtha'i me lta bu/ bsod nams 'phel la dpag bsam gyi shing lta bu/ dgos 'dod stsol la gter chen po'i bum pa lta bu/ ji skad du/ spyod 'jug las/ bskal ba du mar rab dgongs mdzad pa yi/ /thub dbang rnams kyis 'di nyid phan par sa/zigs/ /zhes bsngags pa byang chub kyi sems rin po che ni gnang bya'i chos phun sum ji tshogs pa lags na/ 'di ni ngo mtshar ba'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa bzhi ba lags/ /nyan pa po phun sum tshogs pa ni/ bshad sgrub gser gyi 'khor los thub bstan chos kyi rgyal srid la dbang bsgyur ba'i bstan 'dzin chen po sprul ba'i sku rnams dang / lta sgom spyod gsum gyi rtogs pa klong du gyur ba'i bya btang sgom chen pa dang / bslab gsum lung rtogs kyi yon tan mngon du gyur ba'i bka' rab 'byams dge ba'i thoshes gnyen/ rim gnyis ting 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor thugs la 'byongs pa'i dpal ldan rgyud chen dbang bo/sde snod rab 'byams kyi sgra dbyangs phyogs bcur sgrogs pa'i blo gsal lung rigs smra ba/ rig grol yon tan gyi mdzes rgyan kun nas ngom pa dge 'dun khri phrag du ma/ ka dag kun du bzang bo'i rang zhal rjen par mthong ba'i rdzoṭa chen rig 'dzin dbang bo/ gshen dbyings gdod ma'i mgon po gcer

13mthong gshen rig mnga' ba'i gshen rab g.yung drung rig 'dzin/ bstan srid lugs kyi mnga' bdag phyag mdzod chos rje gsar rnying / bka' tham gser gyi mnga' bdag spyi dpon nang so gsar rnying / don chen gros kyi mnga' bdag dpon chen zhabs pad bcu gsum/ ru 'dren dmag gi mnga' bdag mda' dpon dpa' po 'bum sde/ bsod nams stobs 'byor dge ba'i pho mo bye ba khrag khrig dad gus rlung gis drangs pa'i phyogs 'grul rgya mtsho'i sprin ltar dkrigs pa ni sngon de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra'i dbyangs kyi rgyal bo'i mdun du 'khor los sgyur ba nam mkha' rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying bo'i drung du 'khor sgyur rtsibs kyi mu khyud 'khor bcas sems bskyed la tshogs pa ji lta ba de ltar du snang ba nyan pa po'i bkod pa phun su ma tshogs pa lags na/ 'di ni ngo mtshar ba'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa lnga ba lags/ /de ltar phun sum tshogs pa lngas khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rin po che 'di nyid bskor tshul ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa bla na med pa/ skyabs mgon rgyal ba'i dbang bo nyid nas sku rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul gyis gdul bya ma dad pa rnams dad par mdzad/ thugs rjes brjod kyi cho 'phrul gyis sa/dul bya ma smin pa rnams smin par mdzad/ gsung rjes bstan kyi cho 'phrul gyis gdul bya smin pa rnams grol bar mdzad pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa sngon du btang ste thun mong ba'i gdul bya rnams la dung gi tshems bar nas 'phrul gyi ljags bskyangs te/ nges pa bskyed pa'i yan lag tu chos byung gis sdun bsus/ spro ba bskyed pa'i yan lag tu

14 — phan yon gyi 'bras bu bstan/ spyi khog 'char ba'i yan lag tu bsdus kyi sa bcad/ tshig don nges pa'i yan lag tu tshig 'bru zhib tu bkral/ gnad don bde blag tu nges pa'i yan lag tu don sbyor re re bkod/ dpyad pa 'jug pa'i yan lag tu bzhed mtshams so sos zur brgyan/ rtsod grwa 'phel ba'i yan lag tu dogs slong dang rtsod pa'i sgo bstan/ rgyud la sbyor ba'i yan lag tu lam bsgrigs kyi man ngag gsung ba sogs legs bshad thang mar brdal te brag thog nas chu 'phyo ba bzhin du gnang / sems bskyed la yang spyi bshad dang sger bshad re re'i thad du yang lam yongs rdzogs dang 'brel ba'i lung rigs man ngag sa/sum 'phral kha sbyar te go ba bogs chod du sbyin par mdzad/ thad ka thad ka'i dmigs rnams sha thoge la me btsa' bzhag pa ltar ngo 'phrod par mdzad de gdul bya'i rgyud dang chos 'dres nges su mdzad/thog mtha' bar gsum gyi phyag len ngos dag zhib gtsang jo 'brom yab sras dang / rje yab sras kyi bka' srol phyag rgyun ji lta ba bzhin gnang bas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi dang / bye brag tu theg pa chen po'i bstan pa nyi ma ltar gsal bar mdzad/ 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs las/ la 'kho theg chen las phyir mi ldog pa'i sa mngon du mdzad/ la las theg chen gyi sgor chud de rgyal ba'i sras dam par gyur/ la las theg chen du rigs nges pa'i skal ba can du gyur/ tha ma rnams kyang / gyi skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang / chen po nyid de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer kun 'phags dpal brtsegs rgyal bor sangs rgyas pa'i dus na 'khor gyi thog mar gyur nas theg pa chen po'i chos kyis 'tsho ba'e rten 'brel slu med du 'grig song bas budag cag

15thams cad de ring bsod nams dang skal ba ldan pa yin no//de lta bu'i bka' drin gathugs can du grub na/ srid rtse las dpangs mtho ba/ nam mkha' las zheng che ba/ sa gsum las khyon yangs pa dang / /mgon po gang gi sku tshod dang bstun na/ stong gsum gser gyi maṇḍal la/ rin chen sna tshogs kyi tshom bu bkod kyang / nam mkha' dbang sngon gyi khang bzang la/ nyi zla skar gsum gyi bla re bres rung / nags tshal dpag bsam gyi ljon pa la lha ma'i rin chen gyi me tog bzhad kyang / rgya mtsho'i lan la chu thigs bsab lan/ nam mkha'i lan la lag mthil gyi brdab lan/ ri rab kyi lan la rdul phran gyi dpe las ma mchis kyang / me tog chung rung lha rdzas/ gur kum nyung rung bum rdzas kyi dpe ltar/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal mtshon byed tsam du ྾ ces 'bul lam zhu ba lags la/slad kyi don du gsol ba 'debs pa'i snying bo ni/ mgon po gang gi 'dul byang 'di nyid du/ bsod nams kyi stobs 'phel ba mnga' thang gi mtha' rgyas pa/ dpal 'byor gyi mtsho rdol ba/ lugs gnyis kyi dpal 'phel ba/ snyan grags kyi sgra che ba dang / skye rgyud rigs kyis mtho ba/kha drag gtam gyis btsan pa/ dpung shed stobs kyis dpa' ba/ mdzad med nor gyis phyug pa/ nye 'brel rtsa lag gis bajid pa/ bsod nams chos 'byor gyis mdzes pa sogs grong khyer gzhan dang lha/zhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i skyabs 'jug ljongs 'di'i bshad sgrub kyi sde spyi dang /khyad par du dpal ldan phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i gling mchorga/ grwa tshang chen mo thos bsam gling 'dir/ nyi ma dang zla ba ltar rab tu gsasmyoya ba'i

16 bstan pa'i sgron me/ gser gyi lhun po ltar gzi byin che ba'i skyes chen dam pa/ rgya mtsho sa la 'khyil ba lta bu'i mdo sngags yongs rdzogs kyi bshes gnyen/ seṅge mkha' la mchongs pa 'dra ba'i dpal ldan rigs pa smra ba/don rme thun gser gling la chas pa lta bu'i blo gsal chos don gnyer ba/'ja' tshon mkha' la bkram pa lta bu'i lnga rig mkhyen pa'i mkhas pa/ pad dkar chun po gtsang ba lta bu'i sdom gsum dag pa'i btsun pa/ zla shel dkyil 'khor rgyas pa lta bu'i lhag bsam bzang ba sogs thos bsam sgom gsum/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum/ lta sgom spyod gsu ma gang thad nas gru bzhi lam ma ra 'dzoms pa'i mkhas mang 'dus pa'i tshogs yar rgyas byung ba la brten nas ljongs 'dir phan bde dpag bsam gyi ljon pa rdzogs ldan bzhin du rgyas pa'i skyabs 'jug da lam skyabs mgon phyag na padmo gang gi mdzad chen gser gyi 'khor lo 'di la mthong thos dran reg (dang / rgyu nor zas gsum gyi 'brel ba che bzhag chung bzhag gi gdul bya yod do cog ni/ theg lam gyi bgrod pa bde blag tu rdzogs nas/ kun mkhyen rgyasnyer ba'i pho brang dam par ring min myur du phyin pa'i skyabs 'jugalhag par du bdag cag thams cad 'dun pa rtse gcig pas gsol ba 'bul ba'i yang snying ni/ ji skad du/ zhabs pad mi 'gyu ra bskal brgyar cimyun chags shing / /'phrin las lung rtogs skye dgu'i dbus na mtho / /chos kyi dung 'bud chos kyi rnga yang brdungs/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur 'dzugs par mdzod/ /ces gsungasru pa ltar/ lha

1ṅgādang mi'i ston pa chen po/ bdag cag gi skyabs mgon dam pa/ dge ldan bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chen po/ byang phyogs bstan pa'i sgron me rga/cig pu/ ris med skye dgu'i 'drenacipa chen po nyid ni/ zhabs da mi 'gyur ri—bskal ba rgya mtsho'i zer du lhun chags pa dang / 'phrin las lung rtogs kyi gzi byin mtha' dbus rtsol med shugs 'byung gis rgyas shing bajid che ba 'di nyid nam yang mi nyams gong 'phel du bzhugs pa dang / mdo sngags legs bshad kyi chos dung dkar bo'i sgra dbyangs phyogs bcur sgrogs shing /chos kyi rnga chen phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i dadzil rdu ci dgar rdung zhing / bstan pa mi nub pa'i chos kyi rgyal mtshan chen po phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i khyon thams cad du 'dzugs shing sgreng ba'e bka' drin snying gi nor bu dang gtsug gi cod pan du stsol ba mkhyen mkhyen/ zhes zhu ba lags na / gang zhus dag pa thugs kyi klong yangs por 'degs dzi thugs rje tshe ba zhu zhu zhu// // — —

18)༅/ /gong sa skyabs mgon mchog nas dus 'khor dbang chen gsar gnang skabs kyi maṇḍal bshad pa/li / /'o lags so/ de yang ji skad du/ rma khas grub smra ba'i nyi ma'i gser zhal bum bzang las/ /bde chen lha yi ri dbang an da rnyil//gsar du rgod pa'i 'od tshogs 'bar ba yis/ /nyi zla'i ral ba mthon rma thing nyid byed pa/ /thugs gsung sku yi mgon des rnam par skyongs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i bden tshig kun du bzang bo'i me tog gi phreng ba sngon du btang ste/ ji skad du/ rdul bral gur kum dog pa yi/ /do shal rab rgod bcom ldan 'das/ /sngo bsangs mdzes sdug lang tsho can/ /dkyil 'khor dbang bo'i mdun sa la/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rdul bral stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo gur kum gyi dog pa'i mdangs can/ do shal gsar ba'i rgyan phreng rab tu rgod pas mdzes par brgyan pa/ bcom ldan 'das dang po'i sangs rgyas mchog mi 'gyur gyi bde ba chen po nas de nyid rnam pa bcu drug gi rang bzhin rma ngon du byas pas sngo sangs mdzes sdug gi lang tsho ci yang 'bar ba'i 'od tshogs kyis phyogs kun du ya mtshan gyi ri mo kun du 'bri ba/ dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bzhengaṭashaṃ

19pa/ 7 gong sa skyabs cha/gon thams cad mkhyen cing sa/zigs pajichen po'i mdun sa phun tshogs sde bzhi'i rgya mtsho rga/yas su 'khyil ba'i 'juswā ngogs ga la bar/ 'di skad du/ thod kyi me tog sa gzhi la/ /grangs su brtsegs nas rgyan bkod de/ /ngag gi zhu chung tasbru ra/ /dga' ba'i dga' ston ci yang spel/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sgo gsum gus pa'i lha phyag gi me tog sa chen po la rgyan du bkod/ zhum pa dang bcas pa'i zhu chung taspu ra'i rgyud du drangs te rnam par dga' ba'i dga' ston gyi tshul du spel gang zhu bar bya na/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid nas phun sum tshogs pa lnga dang ldan pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa sprudi nyid kyi dbang du byas na/ de yang dang po gnas phun sum tshogs pa ni/ rtogs brjod gser gyi me tog las/ lho rgyud dpal ldan nor gyi blo gros gang / /dag pa'i 'jig rten mngon par dga' ba'i bcud/ /khyab 'jug sbar mo'i 'phrul gyis mngon byung pa'i/ /grags pa srid zhir snyan gong rgyan du mched/ /de nas dpal gyi snying po'i thig le la/ /reb gong rig pa 'byung ba'i grong khyer zhes/ /snyan pa don dang bcas pa'i shal ba ring / /phyogs kyi bu mo'i rna bar 'phyang 'phrul nyid/ /ces bsngags pa shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i snod bcud kyi bkod pa sa la bkra ba/ mdo smad lho rgyud kyi dpal mtha' dag gcig tu spungs pa'i snying po'i thig le/ reb gong sdig pa 'byung ba'i grong khyer gyi 'dab ma/ rdzu 'phrul gyi shugs phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan lhun gyis grub pa'i skyo mchog rnam par 'gyi5sa pa lta bu'i ri bo/ bya rgod phung po'i ri bo gnyis pa lta bu'i mjing ba 'di nyid/ rtsa rgyud las/

20 e gsang mkha' khams bha ga'am/ /chos 'byung chu skyes seṅge'i khri/ /zhes pa'i sgras bstan la/ dag pa lhun gyis grub pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen por byin gyis 3rlabs la/ sngon bcom ldan 'das kyis lho phyogs 'bras dkar spungs pa'i mchod rten gyi steng du dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor chen po dang / 'og tu chos dbyings gsung dbang gi dkyil 'khor sprul ba dang tshul mtshungs par sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor/ ma bcos lhun grub rdo rje'i ga'/la yas khari chen po/ brjod du med pa'i yon tan gyi bkod pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyan gyi rnam par 'phrul ba 'byams glas pa/ 'od dang 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'e mtha' mi dpog pa/ sprul ba'i snang ba rgya ma chad pa'i ri mo sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol ba gang 'dod du spro ba'i lte bar/ chos kyi 'byung gnas chu skyes kyi go sar rab tu rgod par zla nyi sgra gcan dus me'i gdan khri phun sum tshogs par/ gnyis pa gnas phun sum tshogs pa ni/ dpal ldan phug pa yab bees ltar na sngon bcom ldan 'das la rgyal bo zla ba bzang pos zhus nas dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud gnang ba'i skru dpa' bo lcags 'brug gi lo yin la/ da lo yang dpa' bo lcags 'brug gi gnam lo'i rang zhal mngon du gyur ba/ me tog ldan gyi zla ba'i gral tshes kyi tshes dge ba/ gza' skar 'phrod sbyor rab tu bzang ba'i dus bzang por gsum pa ston pa phun sum tshogs pa ni/ rigs thams cad kyi bdag po/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gtso bo/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi

21mgon po/ bstan pa thams cad kyi bdag po/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi 'dren pa/ thar 'dod thams cad kyi ded dpon/ gong sa mthong ba don lhan nyid ni/ dngos po'i gnas tshod kyi dbang du byas na/ ji skad du/bka' gdams glegs bam las/ bod byang gi phyogs nas byang phyogs su/ /mi khyod kyi sbrul ba dam pa zhig /'bangs mgon med mang bo 'dul du 'gro /zhes lung bstan pa ltar/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzig/sa mdo khams spyi dang khyad par du reb gong gser mo ljongs kyi 'gro ba rnams 'dul slad yab rje 7ma skagoldan rgya mtsho zhes nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa'i sku'i zlos gar bsgyur/ yab rje de nyid kyis ljongs 'dir thugs rjes gzigs pa ma btang bar/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugasri kyi ze'u 'bru/ da lta'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gi gtsug gi nor bu/ bdag cag rnams kyi mgon dang / skyabs dang / dpung gnyen zla med pa skyabs mchog bdun pa chen po nyid kyi sku'i rnam pas bdag cag rjenu/ su bzung par ma zad/ phyogs dus rgya'/ ba ma lus pa'i gsang ba mi zad pa'i rgyan gyi rol ba gcig pur grub pa 'di ka lags la/ drang don gdul bya'i snang tshod kyi dbang du byas na'ang gzhon nu'i me tog gi 'dzum pa gsar du ston pa nas bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi bdag por gyur ba'i mtshan ldan gyi bla ma du ma rigs kyi cod paṇa du bzhes te smin byed kyi dbang dang rjes gnang / grol byed kyi khrid dang zhal shes rgyab rten gyi lung dang bshad pa rgyun sa/nga bzhugs bum pa gang byo'i tshul du bzhas/ spo'i steng na zla med pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma tshul dang mthun pa sa bsten te mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i snying bar bya ba'i spunas

2phe mtha' dag la mkhas par —sbyasdos te 'dzam gling rgyan gyi paṇḍi ta chen po'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad/bstan 'dzin gyi rnam thar thos bsam sgom gsum/ mkhas pa'i rnam thar 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ dam pa'i rnam thar sdom gsum rnam dgachen po'i rnam thar 'khor lo gsum gyi legs mdzad rnams phan tshun 'gran rī pa bzhin du bdag gir bzhes pas/ deng sang mdo dbus gtsang gsum gang tshon bla sprul ji snyed cig bzhugs pa'i khrod na/ rgyu skar khrod na zla ba/ rkasme'athung tshal na dpag bsam/ gser ri'i dbus na lhun po lta bur bzhugs pa ni rje nyag gcig pur rmongs pa dang phyogs zhen gyi dbang tsam ma yin — par mtha' dbus kun la rtsod med mngon sum du gyur bas/ snyan grags kyis nam mkha' khyab pa/ 'phrin las kyis sa steng khyab pa ni/ dad pa'i zhing dang / bstod bsngags kyi yul dang / ngo mtshar gyi gnas bla na med pa lags/ tshul de dag la dmigs nas rtogs brjod las kyang / grags pa'i me tog gis byas pa'i/ /legs byas 'khor lo gsum gyi mtsho/ skye bo'i bsod nams kyis drangs nas/ /dpal ldan sa steng khyab par 'grem/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mdzad pa'i khur/ /khyod kyi zur phud ngos dag la/ /bcings tshe de de 'dar ba yis/ /rngul chu'i mchod yon lus la bshams//zhes kyang gsungs/ yang sgos su da lam mdzad pa chen po 'di nyid kyi dbang du byas na/ ji skad du/ dpal ldan phyogs kun ya mtsharno gyis 'bri ba/ /sgeg ldan dpa' bo ral ba'i cod paṇa can/ /rnam kun phyag rgya'i mdzes sdug rdzogs pa khyod/ /bdag gi snying la rol rtsed mdzod cig dang / /

23zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skad cig ma sa/cig gis mngon par byang chub pa/ mngon byang rnam pa lnga'i sgo nas/ byang chub pa/ rnam pa nyi shus ma ngon par byang chub pa dang / sgyu 'phrul dra bas mngon par byang chub pa sogs yongs su rdzogs te 'bras dus kyi bden don yan lag bcu gnyis mngon du mdzad/de nyid rnam pa bcu drug rig pa thugs rje bcu gcig gi bdag nyid/ sku dag pa rdul bral stong gathugs phyag rgya chen po/ thugs dag pa mchog mi 'gyur gyi bde ba chen po ba/nyis thung du 'jug pa'i dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag por bzhengs/ shes bcu rnapā/ dag bdag nyid can/ /thes bcu rnam dag 'chang ba po/ /rnam pa bcu bo don bcu'i don/ /thub dbang stobs bcu khyab pa'i bdag /kun gyi don ni ma lus byed/ /rnam bcu dbang ldan che ba po/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyi snod kyis bsdus pa'i srid pa rnam pa bcu dang / nang phung khams skye mched kyis bsdus pa'i srid pa bcu dbang ldan sbyang byar byas/ lam rnam bcas rnam med kyi stong nyid dang dbyer med pa'i gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen sbyong byed lam rnam bcu dbang ldan gong du spel te/ sgrib bral 'bras bu'i rnam bcu dbang ldan mngon du mdzad/ dam chos chos rgyal gsal bar ldan/ /'jig rten snang bar byid pa'i mchog /chos kyi dbang phyug chos kyi rgyal/ /legs pa'i lam ni ston pa po/ /zhis gsungs pa lta bu'i chos ston pa po phun sum tshogs pa dpal ldan bla ma chos kyi rgya la po chen po nyid lags so//bzhi ba chos phun sum tshogs pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ rgyud rnamyas kun

24gyi bla na med/ dang po'i sangs rgyas drag tu ni/ /dngos grub kun tshogs mtshan nyid can/ /ā li kā li legs ldan dpal/ /zhes bsngags pa ltar gyi rjod byed tshig gi dus 'khor rtsa rgyud dang sdus brgyud/ dus 'khor 'di la rnal 'byor ni/ /skad ci ga gcig mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /stong nyid chen po ye shes lnga/ /thig le stong ba yi ge drug /ces gsungs pa ltar/spyir phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi dus 'khor dang / khyad par du/ skad cig ma gcig gis mngon par sangs rgyas pa/ stong yig lnga'i rang bzhin rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo/ thig le yig drug gi bdag nyid mi 'gyur lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes thugs mi zad pa 'od kyi 'khor lo gnyis ro mnyam du gyur ba'i mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas brjod bya 'bras bu'i dus 'khor mngon du bya phyir/ rdo rje nyi ma snang ba che//rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od/ /gsungs pa ltar/ rdo rje nyi ma snang che ba'i rnal 'byor nyi khri chig stong drug brgya/ rdo rje zla ba dri ma med pa'i rnal 'byor nyi khri chig stong drug brgya zung 'brel du sgom pa'i rdzogs rim rnal 'byor yan lag drug sgom pa la dbang bar byed pa gong ma gong chen rdo rje slob dpon thadag po chen po'i dbang dang bcas pa bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi dang thig le rnal 'byor dang phra mo'i rnal 'byor bcas sgom pa la dbang bar byed pa byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun ni bstan bya chos phun su ma tshogs pa lags shing /lnga ba zhu ba po phun sum tshogs pa ni/ sngon ston pa rdo rje 'chang la chos zhu ba po phun su ma tshogs pa chos rgyal zla ba bzang bo dang tshul mtshungs pa/

———— tswani5 sham bha la'i yul du rigs ldan 'jam dbyangs grags pa la chos zhu ba po phun sum tshogs pa/ drang srong nyi ma 'i shing rta dang bdag nyid mthun pa/mi'i dbang bo rdo rje dbang gi rgyal po/ bsngags 'os yon tan gyis brgyan pa sku mched ser skya rnam gnyis/ bsod nams kyi dpal mtho ba rigs sras gzhon nu rnam gnyis/ blo gros kyi dkyel che ba glang tshang gi dgongs blon chen po rnams dang / lha sde 'bangs mi dang bcas pa ste/ de yang sa skyong mi'i dbang bo chen po rdo rje dbang gi rgyal po ni/ skyes pa'i rabs du mar sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pa la bsnyen bkur ba'i rgyal po dang rgyal phran grong bdag dang khyim dpon sogs su srid bzung ste rnam dkar bsod nams kyi phung po rgya mtsho lta bu rgya cher bsags/ bsod nams de dag gi mthus da lam yang shing sa la chen po lta ba'i mthon po'i rigs su ri dmi ༅'khrungs/ gzhon dus nas bsod nams kyi rtags dang mtshan ma mtha' dag mngon du gyur/ lugs sa/nyis mkhyen pa'i blo gros kyi 'jug pa mkha' ltar yangs pas rgyal srid du dbang bskur ba na/ legs bshad rin chen gter las/ dam pa dpon du bskos gyur na/ /don grub pa dang bde skyid thob/ /nor bu rgyal mtshan rtser mchod na/ /yul phyogs dge zhes mkhas rnaryā sa sgrog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bsod nams kyi stobs shugs btsan pos bzhed don thams cad 'bad rtsol chen po mi dgos par rang shugs kyis grub/ mnga' 'bangs thams cad la chos srid bde skyid ma lus pa lha'i dpasmu ltar rgyas/ dam pa rgyang du gnas na yang / /'khor 'dab phan pas/ ring nas skyong / /gsungs pa ltar/ rang gi lha sde dang mi sder ma

1skyi(mi — gtogs pa'i rong 'brog bar gsum gyi grong sde so sor phan 'dogs chen pos ring nas bskyangs pas/ khams gsum dbang du bsdus/ stong gsum bre yis ris/ rlung rta'i dar chen phyar/ snyan grags kyi rnga chen brdungs pa 'di lags la/ mkhyen rabs kyi rtsal 'gran na tshangs pa chen po zil gyis mnon pa/ smra mkhas kyi gtam gleng na brgya byin yang kha 'gog pa/btsan phyug gnod sbyin las lhag pa/ dpal 'byor klu rgyal las bzang ba/gzi byin nyi zla las lhag pa/ snyan grags 'brug sgra las mtho ba/ bltas na gangs dkar las mdangs gsal ba/ nyan na pi wang las sgra snyan pa/chos phyogs la phyag rjes che ba/ srid phyogs la /mtha' rgya che ba sogs/brtsis na mi tshar ba/ brjod na mi lang ba'i yon tan 'byams klas pa dang /de bzhin du sku'i gcung bo rnam gnyis/ rigs sras dgongs blon rnams kyang lhun po'i drung na gser gyi ri bo bzhin du phun sum tshogs pa'i tshul du lham mer lhan rnar lhang nger yod pa 'di bzhin lags//de ltar phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan gyi sgo nas ston pa bla na med pa/ gyiskyabs mgon dang po'i sangs rgyas nyid nas/ 'khor rgyal ba'i sras po sa la gnas pa'i sems dpa' chen po rnams dang / rig grol gyi yon tan rmad du byung bas brgyan pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde dang / snga 'gyur rdzogs chen gyi lta sgom klong du gyur pa'i sngags chen rig 'dzin rnams dang / gsal stong bon dbyings kyi rnal 'byor mngon du gyur pa'i gshen chen bon po'i tshogs dang /dpa' bo dang dpa' mo/ dad ldan gyi pho mo sprin ltar dkrigs pa la/ sa'i cho ga dang / sta gon gyi cho ga rnams sngon du btang / byis pa ltar 'jug

— 1skyiX/rte————pa'i dbang bdun dang / gong ma gong chen gyi 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang gis gzhung bsrings/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang gis zur rgyan/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang rdul tshon chab 'dren sogs kyis mtha' brgyan te legs par gnang pa'i bka' drin ni nam mkha' las khyon yangs pa/ ri rab las khur lci ba/ rgya mtsho las gakhyo/la du med pas/ ji skad du/ mchod 'os bstod 'os phyag gi sa/nas//rtag tu ri mor bya ba'i 'os/ /bkur 'os rjod par bya ba'i mchog /phyag bya 'os pa bla ma'i rab/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ dbang bskur ba'i rdo rje slob dpon ni/ mchod 'os bkur 'os kyi gnas bla ma'i yang bla ma/gong ma'i yang gong mar gsungs shing / rtsa rgyud las lus ngag yid gsum/sems yod med kyi rdzas kyi drug cha 'bul bar gsungs pa cha tsam mtshon byedadu / yon bdag gi 'byor khos dang bstun te/ mo mo ྾bcas dmigs rten du byas te/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dge tshogs las/ /byung ba'i rin chen bye ba phrag brgya'i rigs/ /nam mkha' khyab pa tinga'adzin gyis sprul te/ /dgyes pa bskyed phyir bcom ldan 'das la 'bul/ /zhes gsu ngas pa ltar dngos bshams yid sprul gyi mchod tshogs nam mkha'i khams khyab par spros te 'bul na/— rgyal sras kun tu bzang bo'i mchod sprin ngo bor dgyes bzhes gnang ba dang / ci 'dod thams cad bla ma la//gsol ba btab las 'byung par 'dug /ces gsungs tsa na/'byung 'gyur gyi don la gsol ba 'debs pa'i snying po ni/ phan bde'irtsa ba rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa dang / de 'dzin gyi skyes bu

28 dam pa rnams zhabs pad brtan cing mdzapa/ 'asngirlo/ rgyas pa dang / dge 'dun gyi sde rnams 'phel zhing bshad sgrub kyi bya ba yar rgyas su 'gyur ba dang / yangs pa'i 'jig rten ma lus bde skyid kyi dpal la rol ba'i skyabs 'jug bye brag tu sa skyong mi'i dbang bo rdo rje dbang gi rgyal bo/ gcung sku mched rnam gnyis/ rigs sras dam pa gnyis bcas kyi sku tshe ring ba—chab srid brtan pa/ dpon tshang chen mos gtsa byas 'bangs lha sde rgya bo glang tshang skyid kha gsum sogs kyi mi la na tsha dang phyug la god kha/ zhing la sad ser dang nor la jag rkun/ g.yangs la gang stongs dang mdzod la zad pa nam yang mi 'byung ba'i skyabs 'jug sdang ba'i dgra ngan dpung tshogs/'thab cing rtsod pa'i 'khrug long / kha mchu dkar nag khra gsum/ ngan pa dgrar lang ba/ ba/ drag can gyi gtam gtong ba/ g.yo sgyu can gyi ngan g.yo byed pa/ sdang dgra gdon bgegs/ lan chags bu lon/ za gshed shi 'dre/ byad kha phur kha/ rbad 'dre rbod gtong / mnan gtad 'phangs sreg sogs mi 'dod pa'i rkyen ngan thams cad lhag med du zhi ba'i skyabs 'jug btsan phyug dpal gsum 'joms pa'i bde skyid/ mi nor g.yang gsum 'phel ba'i ca/nga' thang / btsan brjid kha drag che ba'i rgan rabs/dpa' rtsal stobs gsum ldan pa'i dar ma/ blo rig drag gsum tshang ba'i gzhon nu/ rigs rgyud chu bo'i rgyun las 'phel ba/ stobs 'byor dbyar gyi dpal lasu rgyas pa/ bde spyid lha yi dpal las dar ba/ phyi na snyan grags nam mkha'i 'brug sgra las che ba/ bar na btsan brjid dpag bsam sdong po las rgyas pa/ nang na bde dga' rgya na tsho chen po las 'phel ba'i ri

da ————— shākyi9skyabs 'jug snod dang bcud kyi phun tshogs/ srid dang zhi ba'i phywa g.yang /'jig rten gsum gyi dge legs thams cad dbang du 'du ba'i skyabs 'jugalha yi dpal dang klu yi 'byor ba/ gacho/da sbyin gyi stobs dang mi yi rigs rgyud/ rgya gare gyi chos dang rgya nag si/ gos dar sogs dbang du 'du ba'i skyabs 'jug stobs 'byor rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i rlabs phreng / rlung rta'i dar chen g.yo ba'i ba dan/ snyan pa'i dung dkar grag pa'i rang sgra sogs mdor na 'jig rten gyi dge mtshan rma tha' dag dbang du 'du ba'i skyabs 'jug zhwa ser cod paṇa 'dzin pa'i rab byung rnams la/ sdom pa gsum gyi nyams len/ lung rigs kyi 'chad nyan/ bshad sgrub kyi 'khor lo gong 'phel yong ba'i skyabs 'jug gos dkar lcang lo'i rgyan ldan sngags 'chang rig 'dzin dbang bo rnams la bka' gter gyi bstan pa dar zhing / slob dpon padru'i zab chos snyan rgyud rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag ka dag kun du bzang bo'i rang zhal brjen par na jal te/ 'ja' lus 'od sku chen por grol ba'i rang chos khyab brdal du 'phel ba dang / bshen rab bon chen rnams la/phywa bshen sum brgya drug cu 'phrul gshen lha byad rdzu gsum/ snang gshen gyer sgom rnam bzhi/ ye gshen sems lung sde bzhi sogs kyi bstan pa dar zhing /'od gsal stong ba bon sku rang bzhin rnam dag gi zhal mthong / snang ba thams cad bon dbyings su rtogs te 'khor 'das dbyer med ro sa/cig tu gyur ba'i sgo nas 'bras gshen bon sku'i rang sa zin pa'i skyabs 'jug de lta bu'i grub mtha' ris med kyi bstan pa dar ba/ skya ser rma chog dman kun la phan bde rgyas pa ni ljongs 'di'i bstan srid myo/tha' dag si/ bdag po gyi

30gong sa skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa nyid zhabs pad brtan cing 'phrin las rgyas pa kho na la rag las pas bskal ba khri phrag khrig phrag tu brtan par bzhugs pa dang / sa skyong mi'i dbang bo sku tshe brtan cing mchod yon rnam gnyis thugs dgongs gcig 'dres kyis 'phrin las lu gu rgyud du sbrel nas gser ljongs yangs pa'i 'jig rten 'di nyid du bstan srid gser gyi rgyal mtshan g.yo med du sgrong ba khyed mkhyen mkhyen rma khyen zhu lags//༄tsho/ /gong sa mchog nas gdan sar dus 'khor dbang gnang skabs maṇḍal bshad pa snga ma gzhir bzhag la kha bsgyur ni/reb gong rig pa 'byung ba'i grong khyer gyi lte ba/ dpal na lend+ra'i chos srid kyi zla bor kun nas snyems pa'i chos sde chen po/ rong bo dpal gyi dgon chen gyi le lag bkra shis pa'i mtshan rtags mtha' dag rang byung du grub pa'i gnas gzhi khyad par du 'phags pa 'di nyid mo zhes dang / gyi'abras ldan gyi zla ba'i shes rab phyogs kyi gral tshes rnam par dge ba/ nes dang / lnga ba zhu ba po phun sum tshogs pa ni/ ji skad du/ paṇa chen mi pham zla ba'i gser zhal las/ rnam bral bde chen stong gzugs phyag rgya'i gar/ /rnam rol rdor sems bshad sgrub sgron me mchog /rnam dpyod mu men bum par 'dzin pa yi/ rnam sad mang pos gnyis med rang lugs ngom/ /zhes bsngags pa/ nges don mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bude chen stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po'i gar gyis rol ba/ dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' drang don gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo'i bshad sgrub chos kyi sgron me/dri ma med pa'i mkhyen dpyod mu men gyi bum par thos bsam sgom gsum sgyu

31dpung ba brtan pos yang dag par bzung / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi mdzad bzang rmad du byung bas rgya cher spel ba/ sgo kun nas thabs shes gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo'i ring lugs 'dzin pa la phyogs 'dir zla dang bral ba/dpal ldan dus 'khor grwa tshang gi dge 'dun rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs 'di ka lags la/ de ltar ྾ zhes dang / phan bde mtha' dag gi rtsa ba rgyal bstan spyi bye brag gi bshad sgrub gong 'phel 'byung ba dang / khyad par du rong bo bde chen chos 'khor gling gi ྾ zhes gnang //

32)tsho/ / gong sa skyabs mgon bdun pa chen po khrir gsar bzhugs ri kyi bshad pa/'o lags so/ de yang ji skad du/ rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ 'jig rten du ni ji srid sgrol ma'i snying rje dar bab kyis gzigs shing / /grub slad gus ldan dge ba rnams la ma tshang med pa'i 'bras bus sgrub/ /ji srid 'jig rten mchod yon dri med dge ba'i bsam gtan blo ldan pa/ /de srid mkhas pa'i zhal gyi dga' skyed sangs rgyas gtam 'di gnas gyur cig /ces skye rgu rnams la phan nga: dang bde ba ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gzhi dang rten gcig pur gyur ba rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid sgo thams cad nas phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas pa'i bden tshig me tog man da ra'i phreng ba lhag bsam gser gyi srad pu la brgyus te phyogs su bkram pas ngag gi lam yangs por byas nas/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi rtogs nga brjod pa las/ brtan dang mkhas pa'i yon tan kun rdzogs pa'i/ /lhag pa'i bslab gsum ga bur 'dzum rlabs kyis/ /bzhad tshe rtsod dus mtshan mo'i mgon gcig tu/ /grags pa'i don bzang bdud rtsi'i phul du che/ /zhes

33 gsungs pa ltar brtan mkhas kyi yon tan ma lus pa lhun gyis rdzogs pa'i gnas/ brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po/ bslab gsum ga bur gyi 'dzum phreng phyogs su dkrigs pa'i 'phags chen 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor/ dgag sgrub lung rigs kyi rlabs phreng phyogs brgyar spro ba'i dge 'dun rigs pa smra ba rnams kyis gral gyi gzhi bzung / ji skad du/ gzhan yang skal bar ldan pa'i lus can tshogs/ /kun bzod yol kor shong min 'dus de la/ /'chi med grub pa'i bcud len sbyin pa na/ /yid bzhin klu dbang gdengs ka'i zol gyis bros/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tha snyad rig pa'i me tog gi chun po rnam dpyod zur phud kyi rtse la g.yo med du bcings pa 'i dpyod ldan bgrang las 'das pas gral gyi zur brgyan/ dad gsum mi 'gyur ba'i rang mdangs gzugs can du shar ba'i sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams kyis gral gyi mtha' brten te/ gangs dkar lhun gyis grub pa'i ri bor zla zhun khu bas lan brgyar byugs pa lta bu'i rnam dkar dang smon lam rnam par dag pa'i srad pu la/ dam tshig gtsang ma'i dri ngad khor yug tu 'thul ba'i gser gyi me tog lu gu rgyud du 'brel ba rnams 'di ltar lhan gcig tu gdan 'dzoms pa'i dbus su gang zhig gleng bar bya na/ rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri ming las/ ji skad du/ mthong dang ma mthong bde las lam ni legs bshad kyis gsal sgron me tso bur spyod/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi'i ro ni nyams myong ldan pas mu chog tu dga' ba'i char dag 'beb/ /legs bshad don gnyer yul la gnyer bya kun mkhyen dag kyang don gnyer nyid du 'gyurngo/ /de slad dam pa rnams la legs bshad dang mtshungs dga' ba

34 ci yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rmad du byung ba'i chos ldan gyi bya ba dang rjes su 'brel ba'i legs par bshad pa'i gtam gyi phreng ba spel ba las blo gros dang ldan pa rnams la dga' ba skyed pa'i thabs gzhan yod pa ma yin pas skabs su bab pa'i chos ldan gyi gtam nyung ngu tsam zhig zhu ba'i dbang du byas na/chos kyi dbyings mi zad pa rgya rnam par ma chad pa'i dkyil 'khor tha gru yangs pa'i klong na dag pa dang ma dag pa'i 'jig rten bgrang bas mi lang ba'i tshom bu brtsegs ma dang 'dab 'byar/ go rim dang sbrel zhir chags pa las/ gzhi snying me tog gis brgyan pa'i zhing khams me tog gi 'dab ma rnam par gyes pa'i ngang tshul du gnas pa'i dbus na mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nyid ze'u 'bru'i tshul du 'khod par/ slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su rigs chos gnyis char gyis sku mched lu gu rgyud du 'brel ba/ bskal ba bzang bo'i 'dren pa stong phrag chos kyi nyi ma chen por rim byon gyis phan bde'i ljon pa mi zad pa'i dpal —du bskrun pa las 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med zas gtsang gi sras po rgyal ba don kun gru ba pa de nyid ni/ slob dpon dpa' pos/ tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs mkhyen bzhi sku gsum grub/ /rnam rtog mi mnga' ci yang sa ler mkhyen/ /chos sku mkha' 'dra gzugs sku mdzes ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas dpag bsam 'dra/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dus gsum du gshegs zhepa'i thub pa ma lus pas 'gran mi bzod pa'i thugs bskyed go cha bdag gir bzhes/ zhing 'di'i 'gro ba la ched dmigs kyis smon lam chen po lnga brgya btab pa sogs sger chos kyi

35 sems bla na med pa dang po bskyed/ bar du bya dka' ba'i rdzogs smin sbyang gsum sogs rgyal spos kyi spyod pa rgyas la grangs mang ba mnyam du bstar /mthar sku bzhi'i go 'phang dam pa zag med kyi yon tan ma lus pa rang byung du rdol ba'i ngo mtshar gyi phung bo lhun rdzogs su mnga' ba'i sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan gyi 'bras bu bla na med pa mngon du gyur pa na/ gser ljongs yul gyi pazhi ta ngag dbang mi pham zla bas/ nam mkha' dbyings na zla ba gcig nyid kyang / /sa yi steng na chu snod ji snyed par/ /grangs bzhin 'char ba'i ya mtshan 'dir ltos dang / bsam yas rgyal ba'i rol ba yid la 'bab/ /ces gsungs pa ltar chu zla'i rol ba bzhin gang 'dul gyi sprul ba 'gog med mkha' khyab tu spros/ dzam bu'i rkang 'thung gi mdzes pa phul du son pa'i zhing 'dir yang / yab rgya9ra bo zas gtsang dang yum sgyu ma lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su zil gnon me rta la sku bltams shing gzhon nu'i rol rtsed la sogs pa'i legs mdzad gser gyi 'od tshogs kun nas spros pas/ 'jig rten thams cad ngo mtshar bdud rtsi'i char gyis ci yang myos par byas/ de nas bla na med pa'i ye shes bdud rtsi'i go 'phang gsar du brnyes pa'i tshul mdzad de/skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams la rang rang khams dang bsam pa mos pa bag la nyal ji lta ba bzhin gzigs nas/ dman pa la mos pa rnams la chags bral gyi spyod pa ston phyir yul wa ra ṇa sir/ drang srong smra ba ri dwags kyi nags su bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor zhing / rgya chen po la mos pa rnams la sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa ston pa'i phyir du ri dbang bya rgod phung por bka' bar ba mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor dang /

36yangs pa can sogs su bka' tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing / zab mo la mos pa rnams la chags bcas sngags kyi spyod pa ston pa'i phyir dpal ldan 'bras dkar spungs pa'i ri/chod rten dang /u rgyan chos kyi gan mdzod/ ri rab lhun po'i rtse mo sogs gnas nges pa thed par/ zab mo gsang ba sngags kyi chos 'khor bskor bar mdzad pa'i legs gsung dbyangs kyi yan lag mi 'jigs stobs kyi rgyud las drangs pa seng ge nga ro'i sgra dbyangs phyogs bcur bsgrags pas mu stegs phas kyi glang bo skrag par mdzad cing nag phyogs bdud kyi ris ma lus pa pham pa'i rgyal rnga phyogs su brdungs/ mtho ris dang thar ba'i sgo 'phar yangs por phye ba'i grags snyan tshangs pa'i rol mo 'jig rten gyi mtha' dbus kun tu 'khrol ba'i dge mtshan gsar du byung ba'i ston pa thugs rje can de nyid ni phral yun kun du bdag cag rnams la bka' drin che ba mtha' dag gi rtsa ba yin la rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che de nyid/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur sti dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'gro ba thams cad kyi sdug kun gyi rims nad drung nas 'byin pa'i sman gyi ljon pa dang / phan bde dngos po zad pa med par stsol ba'i dpag bsam gyi ljon pa lta bu yin par dgongs nas/ byams 'jam dbyangs sogs sar gnas kyi sems dpa' chen po rnams dang / 'phags pa'i gnas brtan sogs sprul ba'i nyan thos chen po dang / gtad rabs bdun dang shing rta chen po rnam gnyis/ pazhi ta dang grub chen brgyad cu sogs thugs

37bskyed kyi sa bon smin pa/ yon tan gyi kho lag rdzogs pa/ 'phrin las kyi dri bsung yangs pa rnams kyis 'phags yul chos kyi skyed tshal lnga ldan 'og min gyi zhing dang khyad par dbye mi nus pa'i dpal du bsgrubs pa ni ga'/la par dka' ba'i bka' drin gyi gnas su che/ de nas ring mo zhig lon pa na/ 'jam mgon rgyal ba'i dbang bo tsong kha pa chen pos/ rgyal ba'i bka' dang de don 'byed pa dpang du gyur ba'i mkhas pa'i gsung / /sgra don ji bzhin legs par bsgyur bas 'gro ba rnams la thar ba'i lam/ /gsal bar mdzad pa gangs ri'i khrod 'di lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi/ /cod pan thod kyis bkur bas zhing du brtson pa du mas bsgrubs pa gang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar gangs ri'i me tog gi mgo lcog dgung du ldem pa'i sa 'dzin gyi ri bo 'phang mtho la brjid chags pa du ma mu tig phreng dkar tshar du dngar bas bskor ba lta bu'i yul gru bo da yul gdong dmar can du grags pa'i gnas gzhi gru 'dzin zhing gi mgon po'i gdul byang du gyur pa gang la/ bsod nams dang mnga' thang / stobs 'byor dang chos srid ri bo las 'phang mtho ba/ sa gzhi las khyon yangs pa'i sprul ba'i chos rgyal na rim gyi thugs smon dang thabs mkhas kyi mdzad bzang dus bab kyis mngon du gyur pa na/ dang por bsta na pa'i dbu brnyes/ bar du bstan pa'i srol dar/ tha mar bstan pa'i yan lag gyes pa'i ma dag pa'i zhing la dag pa'i 'jig rten/ cher snyigs kyi dus la rdzogs ldan gyi dus ston/gnam gang gi dus su nya gang gi zla ba/ mtshan gung gi dus su rta bdun gyi dbang bo shar ba lta bu'i ya mtshan ma lus gcig rdzogs su song zhing / tshul

38snga phyir skyong ba la sngon dus mkhan slob chos gsum/ ka cog zhang gsum/ rje 'bangs nyer lnga/ lha btsun chen po khu dbon/ lo chen lo chung rnam gnyis/ mnyam med jo 'brom yab sras/ sa chen gong ma rnam lnga/ grub thob mar mi dwags gsum sogs lo paṇa dang skyes chen ris med kyis phan bde'i rtsa lag bstan pa mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan ci yang bsgrings pa ni gangs can spyis lan bsab par mi nus pa'i bka' drin gyi gnas yin/de nas gangs can bstan pa'i chu mtsho ngan rtogs rnyog dzwas ches cher bslad pa na/ zhang zhung gi parnyi ta chos dbang grags pas/ thugs rje che gang byang chub 'od/ /blo gros chen po zhi ba 'od/ /rgyal ba'i zlos gar nyi bzhon ni/ /thub bstan shar ri'i do rar rol/ /de dag dad pa gser gyi ni/ /lcags kyus dpal ldan mar me mdzam /sangs rgyas gnyis pa spyan drangs te/ /ke ri zla ba'i 'od kyis 'bar/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/lha bla ma khu dbon gyis lus srog la mi ltos pa'i dka' ba brgya phrag gi sgo nas lnga brgya ba rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu dpal lha gcig dri paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na zhes grags pa'i utpal kun du bzhad pa de nyid spyan drangs te/ bstan pa rin po che la dag ther dri ma med pa mdzad pas mdo sngags bshad sgrub kyi srol sngar med gsar du 'dzugs pa dang / nyams pa sor chud pa dang /ma nyams pa gong 'phel du gtong ba sogs kyi sgo nas bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pas gangs ljongs dpal gyi khyon yangs khyab par mdzad pas 'brom ston chos kyi rgyal bo dang / sku mched gsum sogs bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gser ri'i phreng ba tshar du dngar ba lta bu rim par

cha ////༷/sna/byon pa rnams kyis bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer ba'i srol bzang 'di nyid mi nyams shing 'phel ba'i thabs cir yang mdzad pa ni bka' gdams kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di la bye brag tu bka' drin che ba yin/ khyad par du 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud sogs rgyud sde chen po/ gdams ngag 'bogs pa'i rgyal bo sogs mdo sde chen po/ bka' gdams glegs bam sogs bstan bcos rtsod med/ padma bka' lung sogs lung bstan 'khrul med rnams las lung bstan cing rgya cher bsngags pa/ sa/ngas rgyas thams cad kyi mes po/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi byed po/ bstan pa thams cad kyi bdag po/ rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying bo/ gangs can tshad ma'i ston pa/ pha gcig blo bzang grags pa de nyid ni/ gnas tshod rgyal ba thams cad kyi yab gcig rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor lo mthon mthing ral ba'i zur phud yongs su btang ste ngur smrig gi zlos gar bsgyur ba yin mod/ snang tshod kyi dbang du byas na/ mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal pos/ mi dman brtul zhugs mchog gis legs bsdams shing / /rnam dpyod ches phra thub pa'i gzhung lugs kun/ /zhib mor 'byed la zla dang bral gyur bas/ /gcig tu sgrub la dgyes pa 'di rmad do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/bskal ba dpag tu med pa'i snga rol tu rgyal ba dbang bo'i tog gi spyan sngar ma dag pa'i zhing rnams su/ mtha' bral dbu ma'i lta ba dang zung du 'brel ba'i rdo rje the / pa'i lam bzang spel ba'i snying stobs kyi go cha bzhes pa nas mkhas/ pa dang grub pa'i rnam par rol ba du mas phyogs dang mtshams rnams

4 0 su bstan pa ci yang rgyas par byas shing / lhag don du bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir kha cig sngags la mos nas mdo ca 'byid pa dang / 'ga' zhig mdo la mos nas sngags ca 'byid pa sogs bstan pa thams cad 'gal med grogs su 'khyer ba'i lugs srol gtan nas med par bstan pa rin po nyache rmangs nas nyams te ming gi lhag ma tsam du 'gyur bar nye ba na shar phyogs tsong kha'i yul du sku bltams shing / chos rje rigs pa'i dpa' bo don grub rin chen pas spyan gyi 'bras bu bzhin gzhon dus nas bskyangs te bslab don dang bcas dbus 'gyur chos kyi zhing du rdzong brda mdzad cing /der yang rje btsun red mda' pa dang / nya dpon kun dga' dpal ba/mkhas grub khyung po lhas pa dang / gung gsum bde chen pa chos kyi dpal ba sogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i mkhas grub chen po bcu phrag sasum lhag gi zhabs la gtugs te rgya bod kyi gzhung lugs rab 'byams la gsan bsam mthar phyin par ma/dzad pa ni/ rtogs brjod las/ de nyid phyir na mi pham chos rje dang / /dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis zhes grags pa'i/ /gzhung la phyogs re ba dang rags pa res/ /tshim par ma byas kun la zhib tu sbyangs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar la/ khyad par du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis zhal mngon sum du bstan te nyin mtshan khor yug tu lam yongs rdzogs kyi ngo bo go rim grangs nges gang gi thad la yang the tshom sogs kyi dri ma phra mo tsam yang med par mdzad/ 'ol kha lhas sdings dang / re sgreng rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas sogs 'bigs byed kyi ri bo gyen du bslangs pa dang / skabs ba/sum gyi skyed tshal sa la 'phos pa lta bu'i dben gnas du

41mar thos pa'i don ma lus pa thugs nyams su bstar bas nyams dang rtags pa'i gter kha klong du rdol ba'i tshul bstan/ de dus bod sa/ngas can gyi ljongs na mkhas pas grub pa rtogs ldan che rgu'i grangs su bgrang ba mtha' dag gisasgozur phud kyi rtse mo la khyo/bas sen zla tshes gsar ba'i dog pa mngon par bkod de/ 'chad pa legs 'doms lha yi rnga chen/ rtsom pa ngo mtshar legs bshad kyi phreng ba spyi dang / bye brag tu/ mdo sngags mtha' dag khyad par rgyud sde'i theg /rgyud sde mtha' dag khyad par bla med theg /bla med mtha' dag khyad par sgyu lus la/ sngon med legs bshad gter chen/ zhes sngags pa'i phreng ba spel ba ltar lta ba dang sgyu lus kyi skor gtso bor gyur ba'i mdo sngags kyi gnad mtha' yas pa zhig sa 'og gi gter bzhin mi mngon zhing / mkhas pa dang grub pa'i mtshan snyan gsar pa'i cod pan ci yang g.yo ba'i skyes mchog dam pa sus kyang ljags rtse g.yo ba ma nus nga 'i gnas de dag lag mthil gyi skyi ru ra rlon pa bzhin dus kyi mthar yang gsal bar mdzad de bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer shes pa/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i 'chad nyan/ bslab pa gsum dang rim pa gnyis kyi nyams len ya ma bral zhing lta sgom spyod pa'i cha gang la 'khrul bral gser sbyangs btso ma'i rang khams bzhin gyur te dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa zhes yongs su grags pa'i lugs srol bla na med pa 'di nyid gsar du btsugs shing / bu slob sdom pa gsum gyi tshul khrims la gnas nas skyes bu gsum dang rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor lhur len cing / sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde ba ni'i rnga bo che bstud mar sgros/sa pa'i mkhas pa nam mkha'i dbyings su

42skar tshogs bkra ba'am/ nor 'dzin gyi gzhi la rkang 'thung 'khrigs pa/dpyid dus kyi shing la me tog shar ba lta bur bsam gyis mi khyab pa dngos slob yang brgyud dang bcas pas 'khor lo gsum gyi legs mdzad bla na med pa'i sgo nas shar rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng gyen du 'phyur ba nas nub phyogs dza ti'i rkang 'thung gi snye ma phyogs su dud pa'i bar gtsug lag khadzo dang dge 'dun gyi sde bskrun pas phyi gtsang nang gtsang padma'i sbubs lta bu'i dkar 'jam yug gcig gis khyab par mdzad pa dang / khyad par du nang thugs kyi sras gcig mkhas/ grub smra ba'i nyi ma slar mi'i sha tshugs bzung ba paṇa chen snang ba mtha' yas sku phreng na rim dang / 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bu chen bzhi'i ya gyal thams cad ma/khyen pa dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang bo slar yang dge slong sdom brtson chos kyi rgyal bo'i rnam par rol ba phyag na/ padmo kun gzigs rgyal ba'i dbang bo sku 'phreng rim byon rje rnams kyis/ grub pa'i mtha' 'di nyid dus kyi mthar yang mi nyams par dbu 'phang dgung du btegs pa dang 'degs bzhin par mdzad rma sa/ ji skad du/ dge legs gzi byin bye bas 'khyud pa yi/ /lugs bzang dri med bai ḍūr dkar po yang / /ma rung snyigs ma'i mi gtsang gis sbags te/ /ri mo'i gzugs brnyan 'dzin par gyur pa na/ /slar yang 'dren mchog mar me mdzad dpal nyid/ /thun mtshams ngur smrig zol la brtenatrepa gang / /blo bzang rgyal ba kun gyi dbang bo zhes/ /grags pas nor 'dzin khyab pa 'jig rten byon/ /mason po mcho ga dang de sras yab sras sogs/ /bgrang du yas pas bstan pa'i dri ma kun/ /bkrus te bshad sgrub rgyal

mo43mtshan rtser mchod pas/ /'gro la 'dod dgu'i char chen ci yang phab/ /mkha' dbyings rgyu skar tshogs la co 'dri ba'i/ /gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde/ /tshar du dngar bas rgya mtsho'i rgo/sa can yang / /lci ba'i khur chen ma bzod 'dar ba snyarna / /zhes gsungs pa ltar lags pas/ 'jam mgon rgyal ba yab sras rang re gseratshumadog cod pan 'dzin pa rnams la tshad med pa'i bka' drin gyi zhing du che/yang sgos su rang cag gser ljongs yangs pa'i 'jig rten 'dir phan bde zad mi shes pa spel ba'i bka' drin gye dbang du byas na/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ de nas yi ge sa dang ka /dang po dag tu brjod pa dang / /zhes ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas khyis tshad ma'i lung gis bsngags pa ltar/ mdo smad dbyig 'dzin yangs pa'i thig ler bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa parnyi ta dang grub pa'i dbang phyug gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu bar snang gi skar tshogs dang sa'i dreg pa lta bu byon pa'i nang na/ sgo gsum brtul zhugs gtsang mas bsdams pa sogs dam pa'i rang rtags lhan skyes su gsal zhing / shes bya mdo sngags rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la sbyangs pas grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol du son pa'i mkhas pa chen po/ gangs khrod rdza khrod sogs dben gsum ri bo'i mgul du sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sbreng ba la zla med pa'i drang srong bsam gtan pa chen rdze/ 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i legs bshad kyi sgra dbyangs nam mkha'i mtha' klas par sgrogs pa'i thub bstan yongs kyi rtsa lag rnam 'dren bla ma 7 skal ldan rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo zhes mtshan snyan gyi dri bsung phra mo

44tsam yang snying la gdung ba sel ba'i bdud rtsir gyur ba de nyid/ nges don du 'phags mchog phyag na padmo rang cag gi skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rnam par rol ba lags mod/ snang tshod kyi dbang du byas na yang dpal 'byor mnga' thang gi rlabs phreng g.yas su 'khyil zhing rigs rus cho 'bring gtsang ma'i ri mo mngon par gsal pa'i rgyud du rab byung bcu ba'i nang tshan me lug sgeg mo'i 'dzum 'od mchog tu gsal ba na 'jig rten yangs pa'i rgyan du sku bltams/ gzhon nu nas grub dbang chos pa rin po che blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis sku drung du blangs nas chos srid zung gi sgo nas spyan gyi 'bras bu bzhin gces par bskyangs te dgung lo bcu gcig gi dus su dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing khams su bskyal/'dzam gling rgyan gyi chos sde chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi chos grwar zhugs te lo bcu phrag gcig gi ring bka' pod chen po lnga la gsan sbyo nga mthar phyin par mdzad pas mkhas pa'i mdun sar legs par bshad pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa la khyu mchog rlabs po che'i gnas thob/rgyal ba gnyis pa'i rgyal tshab dam pa khri chen blo gros rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ gangs can chos kyi dbang bo tshul khrims chos 'phel/ mkhas pa'i dbang bo bstan pa dar rgyas/ dwags po bsod nams nyi ma/ rgyal sras don yod chos kyi rgya mtsho sogs bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi mnga' bdag du ma las tshigs snga phyi'i sdom pa dang dbang khrid man ngag gi rgyun mtha' dgatshobum pa gang byo'i tshul du bzhes par mdzad pa ni/

4byegasung mgur las/ sa khyad 'phags dbus kyi phyogs su song / /gnas khyad 'phags 'brog ri dge ldan du/ /skyabs khyad 'phags blo gros rgyal mtshan drung / /khrims khyad 'phags rab byung sdom pa blangs/ /grogs mkhas mang 'dus pa'i chos kyi grwa/ dpal byang rtse thos bsam gling mchog tu/ /pha 'jam dbyangs tshul khrims chos 'phel dang / /bka' bcu phrag smra ba'i dge ba'i bshes/ /mtshan blo gros rnam rgyal bya ba gnyis/ /lo gsum tsam bsten nas bsdus sbyor la/ /brtson me ltar 'bar bas legs par sbyangs/ /dus de rjes mkhas grub bstan dar ba/ /gzhung sde snod 'chad pa'i bla mar bzung / spyir po ti lnga la cung zad bltas/sgos dbu ma phar phyin zhib tu bslabs/ /zhes dang / blo rno zhing smra lce bde ba'i rgyus/ /khong lung rigs smra ba'i mkhas pa'i tshogs/ /gang 'dus sar ston bzang grags pa thob/ /dpal chos 'khor lha sa'i gnasamachog tu/ /skyabyās kun 'dus paṇa chen sprul ba'i sku/ /tshigs phyi ma'i dge slong mkhan 7 mdzad/ /rgyud yongs rdzogs khrims kyi bdud rtsis gtams/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ de nas nor gyi phudza bo ci dgar thob pa'i ded dpon chen po rang yul du ldog pa ltar dgung lo nyer gcig pa la rang yul gser ljongs yangs pa'i lte bar zhabs sen utpa la'i dog pa dgod par mdzad de/ skyes rabs las/ thos pa'i rjes 'jug sgrub pa snying por byed/ /skyes pa'i rdzong las tshegs chung thar bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don thugs la dgongs nas lho rgyud dang byang rgyud kyi dben pa'i dga' tshal brgya phrag du mar bslab pa sa/sum dang rim pa gnyis kyi ting

46'dzin gzungs kyi sgo mtha' yas pa la 'jug ldang byas pasdosdo sgrub 'bras rtogs pa ma lus pa'i klong rdol/dgung lo nyer bzhi'i steng du bla ma chos pa rin po che'i bka' ltar/rong bo'i bla ma bsam gtan rin chen khu dbon gyis phyag 'debs mdzad pa'i chos kyi chen po 'dir bka' pod lnga'i dgengs don lung dang rigs pa'i lam nas 'dren pa'i bka' srol bstar chags pa thos bsam rnam par rgyal b.ri gling btsugs te/ dad gtong nor bu'i 'phyang 'phrul gyis mngon par sgeg pa'i sbyin bdag so so nas phul ba'i dngos po rnams kyis dge 'dun gyi sde la bsnyen bkur ba dang / gtsug lag khang dang sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa dang / spyi rdzas sbyor 'jags mdzad pa sogs bya ba las kyi 'khor lo nam mkha'i mtha' la reg pa dang / brtsi gzhag gtong ba sogs legs par bshad pa'i rol mo ci dgar dkrol bas gdan sa chen po 'di nyid dbyar gyi dpal mo'i mdzes pa dang 'grogs pa'i chu gter bzhin 'phel/ lung dang rtogs pa'i rtsal yongs su rdzogs thi/nga bshad sgrub zung du 'jug pa'i mdzad bzang dpung ba brtan pos blo bzang rgyal ba'i bsta na pa rin po che'i gdugs dar srid rtser 'degs pa la rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi dpal la co 'dri pa'i mkhas dbang stong phrag du ma'i bsti gnas bskrun pa ni/ rje nyid kyis/ lo nyer bzhi lon tshe grwa tshang btsugs/ /lo de nas lnga bcu rtsa drug bar/ /lo sum cu so gsum grwa tshang bskyangs/ /zhes dang /sgos bdag gi grwa tshang 'di nyid du/ /blo rig pa'i sgo 'byed bsdus sbyor la/ /dus yu na ring sbyong ba'i srol yang btsugs/ /de'i dbang gis rjes

41'jug bu slob rnam/sa/ /gzhung dka' gnas rigs pa'i lam nas 'dren//khong mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis phyogs 'di khyab/ /ces bka' stsal ba ltar dang / gzhan yang phyogs ris med du mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad pa dang rtsod pa dang rtsom pa gsum gyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa spel ba dang / bshad pa dang sgrub pa zung du 'jug pa'i lam bzang la dus khor yug tu gzhol ba'i nyams bzhes dang / sdom pa gsum gyi bcos mtshamus ngo lkog med par srung ba sogs phan tshun ya ma bral bar gcig grogs su gcig 'gro ba'i legs mdzad mtho ris chu bo 'bab pa'i rjes su song ba'i sgo nas 'jam mgon bla ma'i rjes 'jug gi khrod na gser ri'i dbus na lhun po dang / rkang 'thung gi tshal na yongs 'du bzhin shin tu mtho bar gyur pa ni/ ji skad du/mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang / /bstan pa'i snying bo bshad sgrub rnam gnyis dang / dam pa'i rnam thar sdom gsum nyams len la/ /phan tshun 'gran bzhin 'bad/ ces gsungs pa ltar la/ de rjes mkhas pa dang grub pa'i khyu mchog blon chos khri rin po che—blo bzang chos grags sogs mgon po gang gi chos kyi mkhan khri la zhabs pad rag snang bas nye bar 'khyud pa'i khri chen rim byon gyis dzam gling rgyan gyi chos sde chen po dgon bu lag dang bcas pa tshul bzhin bskyangs pas yab sras de rnams ljongs 'di'i gdul bya rnams la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa las kyang bka' drin che ba yin/dgos pa skabs don gyi dbang du byas na/ chos sde chen po'i mkhan khrir 'dug pa la/ rje rol ba'i rdo rjes/ mkhas pas grub pa ma bcom

4skyezhing / /grub pas btsu na pa ma bcom par/ /bstan la phan pa sgrub pa la/ /skyes bu dam pa zhes kyang zer/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar skyes bu dam pa'i mtshan nyid spyir tshang zhing bye brag tu/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po maspru'i zhabs kyi gsung las/ zab rgyas legs bshad rgya mtsho bka' pod lnga/ /skal bzang 'jug ngogs gsang chen rgyud sde bzhi/ /blo gsal bye ba'i dga' ston rig pa'i gnas/ /ji bzhin rtogs nas bstan 'gro'i don chen byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar bka' pod lnga rgyud sde bzhi rig/ gnas lnga'i don phyogs rer ma gyur par sbyangs te mkhas pa'i mthar phyin nas gzhan la ston pa na'ang brag thog nas chu 'phyo ba bzhin du gyur ba zhig ske dgos mod/ bdag la yul dus dang na tshod gang gis kyang de 'dra'i mtshan nyid kyi phyogs tsam yang med pa zhu ma dgos pa lags la/ de lta na yang mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi mas/ dam pa rnams kyi chos kyi khri/ /legs bshad smra ba'i dpal gyis mtho/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ chos kyi mkhan khri 'dir bsdad pa'i dgos pa/ chos 'chad spel dang bslab pa slob gnyer gyi rting bskul yang dag par bgyid pa la byed dgos pa dang / khyed rnams nas kyang grwa tshang thos bsam rnam par rgyal ba'i gling zhes pa'i mtshan don dang ldan par byed pa la thos bsam phu thag chod pa zhig mdzad dgos pa red/thos bsam lam lam du song na/ /thos pas chos rnams shes par 'gyur/ /thos pas sdig las ldog par byed/ /thos pas don ma yin pa spong / /thos pas mya ngan 'das pa 'thob/ /ces pa lta bu'i gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don thams cad bde blag tu thob pa 'byung / thos bsam

krogang la bya ba'i gzhi yang / mgon po byams pas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi 'gyur te/ /de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar bcad rjes gzung dang / /bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson bya/ /zhes bka' stsal ba ltar rig pa'i gnas lnga spyi dang bye brag nang don rig pa la bya dgos pa yin/ de la yang mdo sngags kyi dbye ba'i phyogs gnyis su yod cing /thos bsam bya ba'i rim pa yang rje'i rtogs brjod las 'byung ba ltar go rim du bya ba yin/ thog mar mdo phyogs la thos bsam bya ba'i gzhi tshe ba ni/ji skad du/ dbu tshad zung du 'jug pa'i lta ba dang / /chos mngon mdzod dang pha rol phyin pa'i sgom/ /bstan pa'i nang mdzod 'dul ba'i spyod pa rnams/ /ma tshang bslab gsum ya bral 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /bka' pod lnga la tshang bar sbyongs shig ang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar bka' pod chen po lnga yin pas de dag la phyogs rer ma song bar sbyong dgos/ de las kyang pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzhung man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan bshad bya rtsa ba 'grel ba dang bcas pa la sbyangs na lung gi chos ma lus pa la nges pa rnyed par 'gyur ba ni/ shar phyogs pa rig pa'i dpa' bos/ yum chen rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi/ /rgyan du gyur ba'i mngon rtogs rgyan/ /thog mar bslab cing nan tan bya/ /de la mkhas par gyur pa na/ /lung chos kun la 'phrig tshud 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lags pas/ de lta na de ring rten 'brel gyi sgo nas rgyan gyi 'grel ba mtha' dag gi rab dang phul dang gya nom pa 'grel ba don gsal gyi dbu nas brtsi

bzhag zhig 'bul ba la/ khyed gsan pa po rnams kyis snod kyi skyon gsum spangs/ 'du shes drug bsten pa sogs kun spyod kyi cha gang nas kyang bstan pa rin chen yun ring du sa/nas pa'i dmigs rkyen du 'gyur nges pa zhig gi sgo nas gsan par zhu// //

— 51gser ljongs yul gyi skyabs mgon skal ldan bdun pa chen po gser gyi khri la gsar phebs kyi lo dang po'i tshogs gtam/ 'o/ lus la chos gos gsum gyi bkra shis ldan/ /ngag la sde snod gsum gyi bkra 'i/sa ldan/ /yid la bslab pa gsum gyi bkra shis ldan/ /bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes pa 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lus chos gos kyi rgyal mtshan rnam par bkra ba'i sgo nas phyi 'dul ba'i kun spyod kyi bkra shis g.yang du chags pa/ ngag sde snod kyi lung rigs dbyangs su sgrog pa'i sgo nas bar thos bsam gyi bkra shis phyogs su rgyas pa/thugs bslab gsum gyi nyams len phyag tu bstar ba'i sgo nas nang sgom sgrub gyi bkra shis dgung la reg pa/ bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i 'dus pa mtha' dag gi snyan du zhu rgyu/ rgyug gsar 'jog gi skabs 'dir bslab ston snying bor dril pa'i tshogs gtam re gtong ba khri chen gong ma rim byon gyi phyag srol bla na med par gnas pas/ da lam yang srol bzang bo de nyid dang bstun te mdor zhig 'bul ba la/ de yang tshogs gtam zhes pa'i ngo bo ni gang gi tstshad du dmigs pa de nyid kyi spyir btang dmigs bsal ci rigs kyi kun spyod spangs blang gi rim pa gsal bar brjod pa'i gtam

byo2tshogs pa'i dbus su dbyung ba zhig la ngos 'dzin dgos pas/ chos dang 'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos dang mthun pa bslab ston sha tshar sbyar ba'i gtam zhig dgos kyi/ 'khon sar song ba'i kha 'dzing dang / 'thab sar song ba'i bsdigs mo lta bu zhig yin dgos pa ma red/ 'on kyang ngan pa lang la shor ba/ ban btsun chos la dred pa/ lcang ba gang dran byed pa tsho la mtshang la rgol ba gdams ngag gi mchog gsung tsa na res 'gar dmigs bsal gyi gtam la de 'dra'i skabs kyang yod/tshogs gtam la dbye na dge 'dun spyi la chos 'dul ba'i bcas mtshams mtha' dag gdan du bting / byang sems kyi bslab bya'i gnad la gros bstun/ gsang sngags rig pa 'dzin pa'i dam tshig la phugs bcol te brjod pa dang / sger gyi grwa sa rang rang la bca' yig chen po'i dgongs pa la rgyab brten te dang po tshogs la 'jug pa'i rten sgrub pa/ bar du 'grigs lam gyi rim pas rgyud 'dul ba/ tha mar bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas don gnyis byed tshul brjod pa/ grwa ba slob gnyer ba rnams la dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar la gzhi byas te dang po gzhung lugs la thos bsam byed tshul/ bar du thos don la nyams len mdzad tshul/ tha mar 'gro don du bstan pa skyong tshul las brtsams te brjod pa dang / dmigs bsal skabs bab kyi rim pa mdzub tshugs su brjod pa du ma yo da pa las da lam slob gnyer la hur thag mdzad mkhan/ bstan pa'i mig rgyan dang dgon pa'i la rgya la phan pa de dag gi dbang du byas te brjod 'dun yin/ de yang tshogs gtam la sa bcad kyi sgo nas ma btang na tshig gi tshogs che yang don gyi gnad mi

53da tshang / tshogs gtam sa bcad dang sbrel na tshig gi sna nyung yang don gyi 'gang mi chad ces sngon byon dam pa tsho'i gsung rgyun yin pas/ da thang rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i rtogs brjod kyis gzhi bting / byang chub lam rim chen mo dang bslab bya'i rim pas gzhung bsrings/ yab rje bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar gyis zur brgyan te don gyi gnad ma chad pa zhig zhu ba'i dbang du byas na/ dang po rgya chen thos pa mang du btsal ba'i tshul/ bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar ba'i tshul/ tha mar nyin mtshan kun du nyams su len pa'i tshul/ 'di gsum du khyed rnam pa'i tshe gcig gi chos ldan gyicibya ba thams cad sdud thub pa yin pas/ ji skad du/dang po rgya chen thos pa mang du btsal/ /bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar/ /tha mar nyin mtshan kun tu nyams su blangs/ /kun kyang thub bstan rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos/ / tshul 'di bsams shing 'dun ma legs nas gda'/ /zhes gsungs pa red/de'i dang po de la yon tan gye gzhi rtsa bshes sa/nyen bsten pa'i tshul dang / sa/zhung lugs la thos pa tshol ba'i tshul gnyis yod pa yin/ dang po la yang gnyis las/bshes gnyen bsten dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ byang chub la ma rim las/ slob ma'i rgyud la yon tan sna gcig skyes pa dang skyon sna gcig 'grib pa yan chad bde legs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dmyo/ pa'i bshes gnyen yin pas thog mar de bsten pa'i tshul gal che gsungs pa ltar rang rang la yon tan zhig 'byung mi 'byung bshes gnyen bzang bo zhig dang 'phrad ma
