54rī —'phrad 'di kho na la thug mkhas pa'i bshes la rtag tu legs 'grogs nas/ /de yi gsung la gal bo cher 'dzin pa/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba gang byed kyang / /med mi rung gi 'jug sgor bdag gis 'khums/ /zhes yab rje bla mas gsu ngas pa dang / ma bslab mkhas pa gang na med/ /'jam dpal gyis kyang dang po bslabs/ /zhes pa bzhin du dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang bshes gnyen bzang bo re btsal te sbyangs pa ma gtogs yon tan thams cad rang rdol du song ba su yang med/bsten rgyu'i bshes gnyen de yang dang bo mtshan ldan zhig brtag dbya da rī btang nas 'tshol dgos pa yin pas/ tshad ma rnam 'grel las kyang / mi shes ston par byed pa la/ /'khrul bar dogs pa can rnams kyis/ /de bshad nan tan bya ba'i phyir/ /shes ldan 'ga' zhig 'tshol bar byed/ /ces gsungs pa de red/ des na rang nyid yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ci 'dra zhig bsten par bya snyam na/ kun gzigs lnga ba chen pos/ yun du bsten na dge la ngeng gis sbyor/ /shes bya mtha' dag 'chad la spobs pa can/ /don gyi snying bo thar lam ston mkhas pa/ /gtan gyi skyabs gnas yongs 'dzin bla mar 'os/ /zhes gsungs pa de lta bu zhig dgos kyi/ ming dge rgan/ don sdig rgan/ sbal ba rma can mnyam rul du gtong ma khan/ ci tsam 'grogs kyang yar skyed mi thob pa de 'dra la ma 'phrad pa gal che/gnyis pa ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul ni/ sgo gsum dge la sbyar phyir ming dang don/ /mthun pa'i bshes zhig rang gi dge rgan du/ /bsten nas

dzekrochos kyi bya ba ma lus pa'i/ /rtsa bar mthong ste bka' bzhin sgrub pa yis/ /rten 'brel mgo nas 'grig par gyis shig ang / gsungs pa ltar bsam sbyor gang gi cha nas kyang bsten tshul gyi rten 'brel ma 'chug pa zhig byed dgos/ yul dus ngan pa 'dir sa la bsdad de chos nyan/ yar la la ngas nas 'dzing ya byas/ nga rang bu bzang / kho rang skyon che zer pa yang mtshang du mi brtsi ba/ ngo shes bzang bo re'i sa nas bzhag na bshes gnyen bsten pa ya med du brtsi ba de 'drar ma song bar/ yab rje bla mas/ gtan gyi skyabs su bla ma gcig pu bzung / /rgyun du bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa phal/ /byin rlabs stobs kyis bsan 'gro'i don chen grub/ /dam 2ri zhu /rdo/stopa'i rnam thar 'khyong gsungs pa de la kha mig yar lta byed dgos/gzhung lugs la thos pa tshol ba'i tshul de la'ang gnyis las/ dang po thos pa tshol dgos pa ni/ rje thams cad mkhyen pas/ blang dor gnas la kun nas 'thom pa'i mun/ /yang dag thos pa'i sgron mes ma bsal na/ /lam mi shes na thar ba'i grong mchog tu/ /'jug par 'gyur ba smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ /zhes bka' stsal ba ltar rnam grol zhig don du gnyer phyin chad thos pa mi bya kha med yin/ rgyu ma bsgrubs par 'bras bu la re ba ltog 'tho/nga yin/ mthong ba dang ma mthong ba'i 'bras bu gang yin yang rgyu'i rjes su 'gro dgos pa 'di chos nyid red/ thos bsam byed rgyu 'di mkhas pa shes rab can kho na'i skal ma red/ blun po shes rab chung ba tshos lhag par chos nyan dgos/ skye ba snga mar yang chos ma thos pas da lta blun po gti bhag tu skyes pa red/ da lta yang chos ma nyan na 'di las shā ba khyi phag

56dang lug bong 'dra ba'i blun por skye thag chod yin/ sa skya pazhi tas kyang /shes rab med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ /blun po yon tan mi slob pa/ /brtags na shes rarme med nyid kyis/ /blun pos 'bad pa lhag par dgos//zhes gsungs/ 'di na 'ga' res kho rgas song bas thos pa byed pa'i dus 'dzur song zer nas dpe klog tsam yang mi byed/ nga rgas song bas rgyu gsog pa'i dus 'dzur song mi zer bar nam langs na/ sa rug na heb ki rkya rkya song nas ci 'dra 'bad/ tshe phyi ma'i don du chos re nyan rgyu de 'dra'i heb gang na yod/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis kyang / skra dkar gnyer ma lhag dus su'ang / /thos pa mang du bsag bya ste/ /gang du thos mang 'gro 'gyur pa/ /de ru phung po 'gro mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / yab rje bla mas/ rang dang sazhan la phan pa'i phyir/ /thos pas ngoms pa mi bya ste/ /sa gsum brnyes pa'i 'phags pa yang thos pas ngoms pa med la ltos/ /nes tshad ma'i skyes bu de dag gis lo lon na lhag par chos mnyan dgos rabs gsungs 'dug thos pa 'tshol pa'i gzhung la spyir rig pa'i gan sa lnga yod mod/ gtso bo nang don rig pa yin/ de yang rtogs brjod las/ de nyid phyir na mi pham chos rje dang / /dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis zhes grags pa'i/ /gzhung la phyogs res pa dang rags pa res/ /tshim par ma byas kun la zhib tu sbyangs/ /zhes pa de lta bu'i gzhung rnams rad/gnyis pa gzhung de dag la thos pa 'tshol ba'i tshul ni/ nor bu'i gling du bgrod pa'i lam yig las/ don gyi rgan po tshig gi 'khar ba la/ /brten phyir gzhung tshig blo 'dzin mi byed par/ /dpe klog tsam dang ngag

'ag ba //mirdo/rtesgros than thun gyis/ /nyin re 'gro thabs des kyang mi phan pas/ dpe 'dzin skyor sbyangs yun du gyis shig ang / /zhes pa ltar thog mar 'dzin skyor sbyang la rem dgos/ de'i ched du rgyug 'jog len kyang mang du byed dgos pa red/ rong ston shes bya kun rig gis kyang / na lend+rar skyor sbyang gi sgra ma nyams na nga'i bsam pa rdzogs pa yin zhes zhal chems bzhag pa dang / 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i zhal chems la'ang / 'bras spungs la bgro gleng gi sgra ma nyams par byas na nga'i gdung mchod byas pa yin gsungs pa dang / rnam 'dren bla mas kyang / chos bshad pa'i grwa de tshugs tsa na/ /dus nyin re ba'i/na gyi dge sbyor dang / /'dzin gshar sbyang bgro gleng byed tshul la/ /yid rang dbang med par dad pa skyes/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di tsho sems la bcang dgos/ de nas dge rgan so so'i drung nas spyi don tshang thig gi sgo nas khog phab/ rtsa 'grel zhib sbrags kyi khrid kyis gzhung bzung /༄mtha' dpyod brgal lan gyi sgo nas mtha' bcad/ grwa sa so so'i yig cha mkhas pa'i yan lag tu bzung ste tshig don phra mo nas sgro 'dogs chod nges shig khrid dgos kyi/ rtsa 'grel gang yang mi dgos par mtha' dpyod rkyang ba re'i ngo gdong la 'chad nyan gyi stangs ka byed pa ni bstan pa nyams pa'i rtags red/ rang mtshang la yon tan dang / ltas ngan la rgyan du 'khrul ba mang ba'i dus 'dir/ gnas tshul drang bor bshad pa dang / yin lugs rjen par ston mi rung thang yang / sems dge ba la nyes pa med gsungs yod pa red/ der ma zad rang rang dge rgan rkyang bas tshim ma bsda0/ par ma khas pa'i dbang bo sa/zhan dang gzhan la'ang dpe khrid dri

///rga//sde) smyo ga gtugs dogs gcod rgyun du byed pa gal che/ bzhi brgya ba las/ legs bshad don ni gzhan las kyang / /bdag nyid legs par 'dod pas blang / /nyi ma sa steng mig ldan la/ /kun gyi spyi mthun ma yin nam/ /zhes pa dang / legs bshad rin po che'i gter las kyang / rgya mtsho chu yis mi ngoms shing / /rgyal bo'i bang mdzod nor gyis min/ /'dod yon spyad pas mi ngoms te/ /mkhas pa legs bshad kyis mi ngoms/ /legs bshad byis pa dag las spyang / /mkhas pa rnams kyis yongs su len/ /dri zhim 'byung na ri dwags kyi/ /lte ba las kyang gla rtsi len/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di tsho'i don la yang yang bsam blo gtong dgos/ de nas rang rang gi gshag tu 'ong ba'i dus na 'ang / ji skad du/ las kyis 'brel ba'i pha yul nye du kun/ /bzhag ste chos kyi grwa ru zhugs na yang / /rgyus med yul nas don med mdza' bshes sogs/ /bsdus te rnam g.yeng byed pa snyon pa yin/ /gsungs pa 'di tshos blo sbyangs te rnam g.yeng gi rigs rgyang du bsrings nas/ dam pa gong ma tshos/ gzhan gyi sa mtha' bskor ba las/ /rang gi sems mtha' bskor na bzang / /gsungs pa ltar/stan chung gru bzhi re 'phong gis mnan/ rtsam khug byi long 'dra ba re glo nas bsten/ dpe cha sgron me 'dra ba re kha phyes te dge rgan gyis gsungs pa la cha bzhag nas dngos bstan shugs bstan gyi don zab mo gang yod e ge la bsam blo zhib mor gtong dgos pa yin/ de skad du yang yab rje bla mas/blo rig pa'i sgo 'byed bsdus sbyor dang / /gzhung chen mo'i spyi thal ṭīkka sogs/ /dus 'khor yug lta zhing 'dzin pa dang / /sgos phra zhing mdzangs

dhe —— /ṭīkhyenapa'i rigs lam nas/ /don zab mo 'tshol ba'i thabs la 'bod/ /ces gsungs yod pa de red/de ltar mkhas pa'i drung nas khrid/ rang gis dpe cha la bltas kyang da dung sgro 'dogs lhag med du chod pa dang / tshig don yid la 'jags pa zhig dka' stabs tshig don la bdar sha chod pa dang / rigs lam nas nges pa yang dag rnyed pa'i thabs su chos grwa nas rtsod pa'i srol btsugs pa red/de la dgongs nas rnam 'dren bla ma chen pos kyang / phra zhing mdzangs la zhib pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /thub pa'i gsung gi dka' ba'i gnad dag la/ /rigs pa'i lam nas sgro 'dogs ma bcad na/ /'di don 'di zhes smra ba'ang shab shob yin/ /zhes mgur du bzhes pa red/ rtsod pa'i skabs su'ang gzhung don la mi reg pa'i rigs rkyang / rigs pa'i dpyad pa mi bzod pa'i go rkyang tsam la ma song bar/ lugs rigs so so mjing bsnol/ go rigs rdo rje rgya gram/ tshig don ga'u kha sbyor gyi tshul du sbyang dgos/ rtsod pa'i gang zag dang / dus dang / gnas dang / tshul dang / 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag lnga po tshad ma'i bstan bcos rnams su 'byung ba ltar nges par byas nas/ nam rtsod res kyis/ rtsod pa'i rang bzhin nges pa/ tshig gi lam sbyong ba/ grub pa'i skabs don sems pa gsum gzhir bzung nas/ de'i yan lag tu gdong gi mdangs mi 'gyur bar bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba/ rkang lag gi ral kha spang zhing rnam dpyod kyi rnam 'gyur mdzes pa/ brtab cing sdangs pa'i tshig dang nga ro mi snyan pa sgong ba/ 'brel chagās don dang ldan zhing gsal la grim lhod ran

60 ————pa'i ngag dang ldan pa/ chags sdang g.yo sa/sumyo/ spangs te shes brtson lhag bsam gyi kun sprong mngon du gyur nas/ khyad gzhi/ khyad chos/ sgrub byed gsum rim par dris te/ gnod byed ston pa skabs su bab na/ rtags med pa mtshon cha khri sbyogs lta bu/ khyab pa med pa dpa' bo lag rdum lta bu/ gsal ba med pa rma bya dug 'joms lta bu'i sun 'byin gsum spangs te rtags gsal khyab gsum tshang ba'i thal 'gyur yang dag 'phen pa dang /sgrub byed 'god pa skabs su bab tshe 'gal ma nges ma grub pa'i skyon gsum dang bral zhing chul gsum tshang ba'i rtags yang dag 'god pa dang / gti mug gcod pa 'khor lo lta bu/ sun 'byin gyis mi g.yo ba lhun po lta bu/tshig don la ma rmongs pa thub sras lta bu'i dpe dang don mtshungs pa zhig byas nas rtsod dgos pa red/ dam bca' bas kyang chags sdang g.yo sgyus 'brel med kyi lan gdab pa dor te/ 'dod rtags ma grub khyab pa med/ /khyab pa 'gal dang the tshom zaṭwāṃ /lnga bo lan zhes bya ba yin/ /yang na khyab lan gcig tu bsdus/ /rnam par thar ba'i sgo bzhi gdab/ /ces pa ltar lan yang don dang mthun pa 'debs dgos pa red/ de ltar slob gnyer la 'bad pa lhur thag byas te/ dbang po rab la zhag skyed/ 'bring la zla skyed/ tha ma la lo skyed zer ba'i ngag rgyun bzhin yon tan rin po che la skyed 'don dgos pa yin/ skyed 'don pa la 'gal rkyen spong zhing mthun rkyen sgrub pa gal che bas/ phar phyin bsdus pa las/ le ro snyoms dang grogs ngan bsten pa dang / /gnyid kyi dbang gyur mi rtog ngang tshul dang / /thub pa'i ye shes mchog la mos med

6ji—dang / /log pa'i nga rgyal non pas don 'bri dang / /dma' sems bdag la zhen pas byung ba'i rgyus/ /mkhas pa'i skye bo 'dren par ma dad dang / /log pa'i rnam rtog dug chen log lta dag /gti mug rgyu yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rmongs pa'i rgyu bcu bo spong dgos shing / khyad par du le lo dang sdig grogs dang nga rgyal gsum po 'di med mi rung bar spong dgos/ slob gnyer ba'i lam yig tu/ nyin rer zas kyang mi dran brtso na 'grus rtsom/ /zhugs ma thag nas mkhas pa'i go 'phang 'dod/ /zhag gsum lon tshe rjes med g.yeng bas khyer/ /de 'dra de la ci yang mi 'ong pas/ /brtson pa chu bo'i tshun bzhin sten cig ang / /gsungs pa ltar 'ga' res nyin re gnyis la tshod mi thug pa'i sdug rus drag po byas/ zhag 'ga' nas dpe cha la lta ba'i rjes tsam yang med par g.yeng ba 'ba' zhig gis khyer/ 'di'i tshan pa chung dus shes rab che/ brtson 'grus bzung / dpe cha la cung dga' tshe/ kha ta'i phrug gu bzhin chung la yag gi log nas dpe cha bskyur te grong chog dang khe log la rem gi 'dug pho mi mkho dgu mkho'i 'dod pa can/ /dus dbyar dgun med par khom dus med/ /rgya khe ba'i bong rgan rgyab med po/ /kho kum me kum me 'dug dbang med/ /ces pa 'di de tsho'i lung bstan red / sdog groṭa kyi dbang du song na slob gnyer mi yong ba'i khar/ gtam gyi 'dun ma'i rtsa ba bshig pas bstam/ bshig gi garu bo zhig tu mi 'gro ba'i nges pa'ang mi snang pas/ sdig grogs la sbrul gdug pa ltar skad cig kyang mi 'grogs pa gal che/ 'chal ba dam nyams 'dres khyer bud med dang / /lta spyod mi mabhan tshe 'di don du sa/nyer/ /mi gzhi mi grung blun dang 'dod pa che/ /

62nye 'brel la sogs sdig grogs mtha' dag spongs/ /zhes pa 'di dge bshes gong ma tshos rgyun du zhal nas 'don pa red/ rang gis mi shes bzhin du shes so snyam pa'i nga rgyal 'di yon tan gyi gshed ma mthar thug pa zhig yin/ nga rgyal gyi sgang bu la yon tan gyi chu mi 'gro zhes pa 'di bka' gdams gong ma tsho'i gsung sgros yin/ yab rjes kyang / nga rgyal can la yon tan yar skyed med/ /ha cang skad 'go ma mtho ri khrod pa/ /gsungs pa de red/ thos rtags zhi zhing dul ba yin/ /bsgoms rtags nyon mongs chung ba yin/ /zhes gsung gi yod mod/ skyed 'don pa'i mthun rkyen yang tshur bsdus na/ byang chub lkam rim chen mo las/ dam pa'i bshes dang grogs la brten/ khas blangs pa'i tshul khrims dag pa gzhir bzung / gdams pa yang dang yang du nyan nas dmigs rnamyo/ bskyangs/ lha dang bla ma la gsol ba drag tu btab nas tshogs bsags pa dang sgrib pa sbyong ba'i sgo du ma nas 'jug pa'i rgyu cha tshang re la 'bad na/de nas blo la khyad par gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i nges pa gting tshugs pa skye ba yin no/ /zhes bka' stsal ba 'di la ma 'dus pa med/ rje rang gi rnam thar na yang mthun rkyen sum bsgril la 'bad par gsungs pa rang re rjes 'jug la ma yig bstan pa red/ grwa sa'i kha dpe la yang / slob gnyer phul gang gsog pa la/ sku rim bre gang gsog dgos zer ba de yin/snyigs dus blo dang bsod nams dman pa'i khar/ /lhag pa'i lha dang yi dam chos srung la/ /rtse gcig gsol 'debs phyag mchod maṇḍal sogs/ /tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong 'bad pa drag po yis/ /zhing gi mthu la rgyub

sa sdi (5() brten gyis shig ang / zhes pa'i don 'di grwa sa grwa tshang gang na'ang don dang mthun pa'i dpe cha ba rnams nas phyag len la 'debs ki yod pa red/'o da rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar dgos pa'i tshul ni/ rtogs brjod las/ de ltar 'bad pas klu sgrub thogs med ras/ /rim baji/na brgyud pa'i byang chub lam rim la/ /thun mong min pa'i nges pa rnyed gyur nas/ /zab mo'i gzhung mchog phar phyin gdams par shar/ zhes dang / rin chen gsum gyi gtam sbyo ra las kyang / dri med gzhung mang rnams la sbyangs pa na/ /rgya che'i gtam gyis dang po'i las can rnams/ /da lta nyid nas sa yi bar/ /legs par 'a/khrid pa'i zab mo'i gdams pa la/ /nang byan tshud pas bka' dang dgongs 'grel kun/ /gdams pa'i mchog tu shar la mkhas pa zer/ /lhag ma ne tso'i 'don pa lta bu dang / /chu med khron pa ri mo'i mar me bzhin/ /ci phyir zhe na mkhas pa'i mchog rnams kyis/ /gzhung rnams nyams len shes phyir brtsams phyir ro/ /zhes dang / chus khyer 'ga' zhig skom pas shi ba bzhin/ /mang du thos kyang chos kyis phongs ba ni/ /gzhung lugs gdams par shar ba med pas nongs/ /de phyir gang bslabs gdams par shar ba gces/ /zhes gdams pa ltar bdag kyang khyed rnams la sha thog la me btsa' bzhag pa bzhin gzhung thams cad kyis nyams len ston tshul rang gi sems steng la ngo 'phrod pa zhig cis kyang mdzod ces pa yin/ 'o de nas rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum papre tha mar nyin mtshan kun du

64 ———————nyams su len dgos pa'i tshul kyang / rtogs brjod las/ de ltar gdams pa'i gter du gyur pa na/ /theg chen gnyis ka'i thun mong lam dang ni/ /thun mong min pa'i lam gyi rim pa gnyis/ /gnad bsdus tshang ba'i lam la 'dris par sbyangs/ gsungs pa ltar/ thos don lam gyi rim par bsgrigs pa'i gnad cha tshang zhig rgyun du 'dris su bcug ste nyams su le / dgos pa yin/ de yang rtogs brjod kyi tshig ris la thos bsam sgom gsum dang po bar mthar gsum du bcad pa la 'khrul nas/ rang gi tshe la'ang tshan pa gsum du bcad de thos bsam gyi dus dang nyams len gyi dus zhes so sor gcod pa ga la rung / gzhung gcig la dang po thos/ bar du bsam/ tha mar nyams su len pa'i rim pa yod par bstan kyang / spyir thos bsam sgom gsum ya ma bral bar byed pa 'de rang re bka' gdams gsar rnying gnyi ka'i phyag srol yin/ pha ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis/ nga thos dus tsa na bsam sgom bde/ /nga bsam dus tsa na thos sgom bde/ /nga sgom dus tsa na thos bsam bde/ /nga bka' gdams phyogasasu ma lhung bas / /zhes dang / thams cad mkhyen pa rol ba'i rdo rjes/de ltar thos bsam gnad du legs song na/ /de nyid sgom dang nyams len gci bo yin/ /thos bsam sgom pa cig char 'byung bas na/ /tshogs med lam gyi rtogs pa rnyed par 'gyur/ /rgya bod mkhas pa'i skye bo phal mo ches/ /mtshams dang 'dag sbyar chig dril ma mdzad kyang / 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i mdzad pa mdzad bzhin par/ sa lam rtogs pa phul byung brnyes la ltos/ /zhes gsungs/ tshul de ltar rgyal ba'i bstan pa la slob pa'i rim

6byepa ni rgya bod kyi rma khas grub ji snyed cig byon pa mtha' dag gi bgrod pa gcig gis lam yig yin gyi/ kho bo cag nas sems sgo la gang 'char/ngag sgo nas rgeng thon zhus pa ga la yin/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa la bslab tshul ma nor ba de lta bu zhig gi sgo nas bslabs na/ ji skad du/ skal bzang rnams la legs bshad bdud rtsi ster/ /khrims ldan dam pa'i rnam thar rjes su 'jug /bshad sgrub bstan phan 'phrin las rgya chen mnga'/ /gzhan phan mtsho ltar rgyas/ zhes pa ltar don gnyis phun tshogs risgun gyis grub pa rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho lta bur 'gyur nges pas/ gang zhus thams cad khyed rnam pas phyag len la theb pa re bka' drin skyong bar zhu zhu// //

(1/mi — — — —— )༅/ / gong sa mchog gser khri'i skabs su bsgrigs pa'i tshogs gtam/de yang bka' rab 'byams sde snod ma lus pa'i dgongs don dngos stobs rigs pa dri ma med pas 'byed pa la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhas pa ngang ba'i rgyal bo mtha' dag rnam par rtsen pa'i rol mtsho dam pa/ rong bo thos bsam rnam par rgyal ba'i chos grwa chen po la nges par 'byung ba'i bsam pa rnam dag gis legs par zhugs pa'i dge 'dun grwa gzhon 'dus pa'i snyan du/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' datho/ngas 'grel dri ma med pa dag gi don las phyir phyogs pa'i gtam gyi rim pa du ma zhig ched du zhu ba la/ khyed rnams nas kyang nged kyi kha stabs dang yon tan gyi tshod la dpags nas brnyas pa'i gnas su mi mdzad par/ rang cag gi ston pa'i bka' lung / shing rta chen po'i bzhed gtam/ skyabs mgon mchog gi gsung tshig mkhan khri rim byon gyi legs mdzad/ rang rang gi 'di phyi'i legs tshogs kyi thabs ston par go nas dang bo legs par mnyan pa/ bar du 'grus bsam gnang ba/ tha mar lag len la thebs pa zhig mdzad dgos pa red/ 'o/ de yang dge 'dun spyi'i bya ba'i rim pa dang / grwa ba dpe cha b.ri rnams kyi bye brag gi kun spyod/ bcas pa dang

tshogedage 'dun spyi khrims las sa/yel che ba dag la dmigs phugs pa'i tshogs gtam gsum du byas nas brjod pa la/dang bo ni/ skyes rabs las/ dregs dang nga rgyal gti mug sbrul gyi tshang / /rab tu zhi ba dga' ba'i bde 'jig pa/ /sdug bsngal mi zad rmongs ba'i gnas gyu ra khyim/ /khung dang 'dra bar su zhig gnas par byed/ /ces pa ltar/ khyim la gnas pa ni/ nyon mongs pa'i sbrul gdugalamatha' yas pa'i tshang nang / nye bar zhi ba'i dga' ba dang bde ba 'jig par byed pa/ bya ba ngan pa sna tshogs kyis brel zhing sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis rnam par dkrugs pas bzod dka' ba me 'obs dang mtshungs par mthong nas/ ston pa'i bstan pa la dad pas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba ni/ rtogs brjod las/ skra rnams breg par gyur nas ni/ /phyag dar khrod kyi gos 'chang zhing / /dgen pa yul du 'dod par ni/ /nam zhig de ltar 'gyur zhig gu /zhes smon pa'i steng du slebs pa yin la /de lta na'ang mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal bo las/ sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di la rab byung nas/ /sdig pa'i las rnams shin tu spyod byed pa/ /noro dang 'bru la snying bor 'du shes shing / /bzhon dang ba glang shing rta rnams la chags/ /gang la bsgab pa'i nan tan med pa rnams/ /de dag gis kyang ci phyir mgo jobreg /ces gsungs pa ltar/ rgyu nor la snying bor sems shing bslab pa'i khrims gces spras med pa rnams kyis mgo bo bregs pa'i dgos rpā ston pa red/ des na/ sdom pa ma thob pa len rpā/ thob zin mi nyams par srung ba/ nyams na phyir bcos pa'i thabs gsuyogyi sgo

(8)/sdu/ shā nasardziston pa'i bcas pa dang dge 'dun gyi nang khrims dang 'gal ba'i thom nag rab byung gi gajuzugs can/ lha dang srung ma khrel ba/ bdud sdig can gyi phyogs gtogs de 'drar ma song ba gal che ba yin/ thob zin mi nyams par bsrung ba'i tshul yang phyi'i rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen la dri gtugs dang / rang gi bsam pa phun tshogs bzhi ldan/ bslab pa yongs su sbyong ba bzhi gsum gyi cho ga nyams su myong ba/ mtha' gnyis bral ba'i bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen gsum bsten pa 'dul gzhung rnams las ji ltar ske'abyung ba ba'i/na/ phyag len la 'debs dgos pa yin gyi/ 'dul ba 'khakha phyogs/ spyod pa rtsing la shor ba'i dge bshes de 'dras mi yong de ltar tshul khrims dang ldan pa/ dge krudun gyi spyi khrims dang mthun pa/skebs su bab pa tshogs dang chos grwa legs par 'grim bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ji skad du/ tshe 'dzi ji ltar gyur kyang bla/ /phyi ma'i shul lam thag reng pas/ /zlog med 'chi bdag byung ba'i tshe/ /mi 'gyod tsam zhig cis kyang mdzod/ /ces pa ltar/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das brtse ba chen potshudang ldan pa de nyid kyis/ mtha' gcig tu dge ba bya dka' ba gcig la'adi kho na bya dgos ma gsungs par/ gdul bya rang rang gi blo tshod kyi dge ba re byed du 'jug rgyu gsungs 'dug pas na/ rang gi skal ba dang 'tsham pa'i rnam dkar re la ci nus kyis 'bad de/ skyabs mgon mchog gi gser gyi 'ob thag la 'jus pa dang / grwa tshang rin po che'i chos sgor zhugs pa don yod pa zhig byed dgos kyi/ dud 'gro nor gyis kyang bsgrub thub pa'i dgra 'dul gnyen skyong kha gso rgyab 'geb tsam la mi tshe phud ba ni —

69khyod tsho pho skyes pa ma red/ las kyis/ mnar ba red/ de ltar yang / rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ phyugs kyis bsgrubs na'ang mi dkon pā'i/ /mnog richung gang yin de don du/ /dal 'byor phun tshogs rnyed dka' 'di/ /las kyis mnar ba rnams kyis bcom/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na thams cad kyis bstan pa la rab tu byung ba dgos pa yod pa dang / grwa ba'i rgyan /du 'gyur zhing dam pa rnams thugs mnyes pa dang / mi lus thob pa don dang ldan pa cis kyang thugs rkakyu zungs nes pa spyir zhus pa yin/gnyis pa grwa pa dpe cha ba rnams kyi bye brag gi kun spyod ni/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/ chos kyi rje sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi rjes su legs par gsungarme pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dag gis las su bya ba ni gnyis rtsig bka' stsal te/ 'di ltar klog pa thos bsam dang spong ba bsam gtan gyi rim pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ khyim pa rnams kyi bya ba ni tshe 'di'i so tshis yin pa bzhin du/ rab tu byung ba rnams kyi las kyi skal ba ni bshad sgrub nyid yin la/ tshul de la brtson pa lhur mi byed pa rnams la rab tu byung ba zhes pa'i ming don dang ldan pa ma yin pa ni lhag bsam bskul ba'i mdo las gsungs pas so/ /de skad du yang de nyid las/ gang dag la brtson pa med pa dang / bsam gtan med pa dang / spong ba med pa dang / kha ton bya ba dang / mang du thos pa yongs su 'tshol ba med pa de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ba ma yin no/ /byams pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa ni bsam gtan dang spong bas rab tu phye ba ye shes kyis 'dus ci

10 byas pa/ ye shesakyis mnyam par bzhag pa/ mngon par brtson pas rab tu phye ba yin gyi/ khyim pa'i las kyi mtha' dang / zhal ta byed pas rab tu phye ba ma yin no/ /zhes bka' stsal to//des na thog mar legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshu'//bar du bka' pod lnga la sbyang ba byed tshul/ tha mar gang shes rgyud la sbyar te spong ba la gzhol ba'i tshul dang gsum gyi sgo nas grwa sa 'di ga dang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du 'gro nges shig byed pa'i tshul la/ sha dang me stag 'phrad pa lta bu'i tshogs gtam gnad che ba re gtong dgos mod/ bdag ni bstan pa spyi'i rnam gzhag la 'dris chung zhing khas zhan pas/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dang mthun pa zhu ga la spobs kyang / mdor bsdus gnad 'dril zhig gtam du bya na/ 'o/ rang re'i yul dus 'dir rang gi dge rgan kha 'dzings lag ya ma byas gong dpon tsho las thog mtha' bar gsum gang gi skabs su yang bshes gnyen bsten tshul la rten 'brel sgo du ma nas 'phyug 'dug pa gzhan tshos gleng ba don la gnas pa red mod/ phyin chad de 'dra mi byed par chos 'dul ba sogs las mkhan po dang slob dpon la ston pa'i 'du shes skyed par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar skyon brtags dang ma gus pa spangs nas gus pa dang yon tan gyi ngos nas/ lta ci thub la 'bad de legago tshotshogs kyi rten 'brel mgo nas 'grig pa zhig thog mar gal che/ rje bstan pa'i sgron mes kyang / sgo gsum dge la sbyar phyir ming dang don/ /mthun pa'i bshes shig rang gi dge rgan du/ /bsten pa chos kyi bya ba ma lus pa'i/ /rtsa bar mthong ste bka' bzhin sgrub pa yi/ /rten 'brel

— rdo//༷/ mgo nas 'grigs par gyis shig ang / /zhes dang / rje thams cad mkhyen pas/ de nas 'di phyi'i legs tshogs ji snyed pa'i/ /྾ ྾ ྾bskyang 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mkhas grub chos rjes/ sar bsdad nas bla ma ra bsten/ yar lang nas 'thab mo brgyab pas mi yong zhes bka' rdo rje'i thog phab pa 'di rang gi thog la mi 'bab pa re mdzod/bla ma bsten tshul 'di bka' mdo rgyud thams cad/ bla ma dam pa byon tshad kyis gal bo che la nan tan du gsungs kyang / 'u cag la gong nas skyabs mgon/ bar nas mkhan po/ 'gab nas dge rgan bsten tshul la gzhan tsho'i lad mo cha shas tsam re yang med pa 'di yon tan mi yong ba'i snga ltas/'dun ma gtan brlag la sa/tong ba'i rgyu che shos red/ 'di la re re gzob gzob ces thal mo sbyar nas zhus pa yin/bar du bka' pod lnga la sbyang tshul yang / gzhung don la ci yang mi phan pa'i dpe khrid/ gzhung la cha tsam yang mi 'brel ba'i rtsod pa/ mkhas pa'i dgongs pa dang mi mthun pa'i khas len rnams rgyang du spangs nas/mdo las/ thos pas chos rnams shes par 'gyur/ /thos pas sdig pa ldog par byed/ /thos pas don ma yin pa spong / /thos pas mya ngan 'das pa thob/ /ces sogs phan yon dang / kha reg pas/ rgyal bas gsungs pa'i gdams ngag la// /blo gros legs par sbyangs pa yis mi shes the tshom gnyis dang 'bral/ /gzhon pa'i dus su slo bas shig ang / /zhes pa ltar/ gzhon nu'i dus su sbyang dgos tshul rnams legs par bsam/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ le lo snyom las bsten ngan bsten pa

/rdo/////rdo sang dang / /gnyid kyis dbang gyur mi rtog ngang tshul dang / /thub pa'i ye shes mchog la mos med dang / /log pa'i nga rgyal non pas don 'dri dang //dman sems bdag la zhen pa'i byung ba'i rgyus/ /mākhas pa'i skye bo bsten par ma dad dang / log pa'i rnam rtog dug chen log lta dang / /gti mug rgyu yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ le lo dang snyom las che ba/ sdig grogs bsten pa sogs shes rab nyams pa'i rgyu dang / gti mug 'phel ba'i gzhi rnams dor nas/ dpe 'khrid/ dpe lta/ rtsod pa/ gnad don sems la bcang ba rnams la hur thag byed dgos pa yin/ yab rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ bshad sgrub pa gang gi skabs su yang / /blo the tshom gcod pa'i don bzang gces/ /gsungs pa ltar/ de dag gi skabs kun tu don bzang bo re e go/ e shes/ de kho na la rtsis su byed dgos pa ma gtogs/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas/ rang nyid grags 'dod pha rol sma 'bebs 'dod/ /g.yo sgyu'i tsod pa tshig rtsub ngan sems ldan/ /ngag 'khyal sna tshogs smra zhing gzhan rgyud sreg /de lta'i rtsod pa de yang dmyal ba'i rgyu/ zhes dang / mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi mas/ lto rgyab tsam phyir 'dus pa'i 'khor nang du/ /chags sbrung g.yo sgyu 'thab rtsod lhur blangs nas/ /zhar la sbyor ngag tshirka gsum bzlas brjod kyis/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka 'di phyir 'ariphung bar byed/ /ces pa der ma song ba re la mnyam zhog chos pa'i gzugs kyis chos min bsgrubs na de las gyong che ba dang ngo tsha ba'i gnas ci yod/ bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor 'dzum pa'imadangs dang ldan/ /don ldan ba/ṭari ra la 'jam pa'i ngag dang ldan/ /

73sgyid lug pa dang ngal ba med pa rnamyo/sa/ /rtsod pa mdzes pa'i rgyan gsum yin par sa/sungs/ /pha rol dam 'a bar 'dod pa'i ne sdang dang / /rang nyid mtho bar 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang / /rigs 'a/ma 'dor bar 'dod pa'i g.yo sgyu rnams/ /rtsod pa'i bsam pa tha shal yin par bshad/ /rang gis don de rtogs (sprudod gus pa dang / /gzhan gyi log rtog sel 'dod snying rje dang / /pha rol ba la zab don bstan 'dod pa'i/ /byams pa rnams ni bsam pa phul byung yin/ /zhes pa 'di tsho rnam pa thams cad du ma brjed par dran pa dang lag len la 'debs datho/sa/ rang rang gzhung gi brjod bya dgongs don sogs/ /ma mthong shag 'gyed tshig 'khri skam po dang / /rigs pas dpyad pa mi bzod tho/ thob kyi/ /bam bshad 'dis kyang bdar sha mi chod pas/ /go rigs zung du 'brel bar skyongs shig ang / /gsungs pa ltar/ tshig 'bru zer ba tsam la ma 'khrul ba'i go ba rnam dag tshig 'khri skarma po 'ga' la ma 'khrul ba'i rigs pa yang dag gnyiṭashaṃ zung du 'brel ba'i sgo nas rigs tshan re gnyis kyi thal ka tsam khol 'don byas nas chos thog de ka'i skabs tha thor zhig nges pa las/ rjes nas rang gi nyams len gyi rim pa ci yang mi shes pa'i ming dge bshes/ don sdig bshes de 'dra ma yin par gzhung don yongs rdzogs spyi don ltar lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa zhig tu dril nas shes pa gnyis la bslab don gyi snying bo byed dgos pa red/ 'o/ de lta'i rtsong/ pa dang go rigs 'byung ba'i rgyu phun sum tshogs pa yang / ji ska | du/ṣyo ba'i thob pa'i skunee/ra/ rab che ba dang / /sgra tshad sbyangs shing dpe 'dzin

74skyor sbyang dang / /rang gzhan gzhung mang legs par slob pa rnams/ /rtsod la mkhaṭa/ pa'i rgyu gsum yin par bshad/ /ces gsu ngas pa ltar/dpe 'dzin dang dge rgan las slabs pa dag gal che bas snga sor tshod la'ang rgyug bzhag pa yin/ rgyug sprod legs po byung ba dag la yi rang dang bka' drin che zhu ba las 'osacici yod/ 'ari na re ba gnyis pa rgyug mi 'dzin pa/dpe khrid mi zhu ba/ rtsod pa la hur 'don mi byed pa skor cig 'dug ste yang yang dmigs bsal dang rgyal kha ster mi shes pas/ da gzab gzab byas na dga' mo yong / ngan pa char gcod ma byas na/ /ma rungs sa rdul bzhin du 'phel/ 'e/sa gsungs 'dug 'dul gzhung na yang / chad las chung 'bring che gsum gsungs yod pas/ khyod ma rungs ba rnams tshar gcod dgos pa bdag cag gi ston pas bkas bcad yod pa red/tha mar gang shes rgyud la sbyar te spong ba la gzhol ba'i tshul yang / rang gi gang shes dang po nas kha phyir ltos su ma btang bar nyams len du khyer shes pa de ka nyid kyis rtegs pa 'phel bar 'gyur ba ni/ rje rol ba'i rdo rjes/ de ltar thos bsam gnad du legs song na/ /de nyid sgom dang nyams len gtso bo yin/ /thos bsam sgom gsum gcig char 'byung bas na/ /tshegs med lam gyi rtogs pa skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar red mod/ deng sang gi dge bshes yin zer ba tsho la rang steng du skyabs 'gro tsam nyams su len rgyu yang mi shes pa 'di dag gzhan du 'dzam gling rgyan gyi gzhung lugs la/ /mi tshe hril gyinu/ thos bsam bsags gyur kyang //nyams su len tshe grog mo phug rdug tu/ /phyion ltar ma sbyangs gnas su bluor

75ldog rma / de yang thog mtha' bar gyi kun slong rnams/ /phyi ltas kho nar song bas lan pa lags/ /gsungs pa de de bzhin du gyur pa red lags/ des 'dul gzhung na lus ngag gi kun spyod ji ltar bya tshul tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ phar phyin dnge mdzod na sgom ji ltar bya tshul ting 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ dbu tshad gnyis na lta ba ji ltar bskyed tshul shes rab kyi bslab pa ston pa yin tsa na/ de lta bu'i lta sgom spyod gsum po de nyid lam gyi lus gcig tu dril te rang re 'dra ba las dang po ba gcig gis kyang lag len la chad lhag med par bstan pa'i rim pa tshang ba'i man ngag lam rim che chung gang rigs kyi lde mig re la brten nas gzhung bka' pod lnga gdams ngag tu 'char ba zhig don gyi snying bor thugs la 'jog par mdzod mdzod/ ces thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba yin/gsum pa sangs rgyas kyis bcas pa dang dge 'dun gyi spyi khrims las g.yel che ba dag la dmigs phugs pa'i gtam bya ba la/ khyed 'di na/yar sangs rgyas mi bden// las rgyu 'bras mi bden/ a pho nga rang yin/dbyug pa mdung ring yin zer mkhan/ sangs rgyas grangs med byon pas ma thul zhing / dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal la kha bzed lab/ bzed byed mkhan/nag chang kus gsum gang rung gi mthong thos dogs pa mchis pa'i ya bo 'ga' dang 'ga' mi 'byung ba'i nges pa mi snang ste/ de 'dra yod tshe mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ rnam pa kun tu nor 'jig dang / /ngan song rtsa ba bud med yin/ /mi gang dag gis bud med 'dod/ /de dag bde bar ga la 'gyur/ /bud med phung bar byed pa ste/ /'jig rten 'di

76dang pha rol du/ /zhes sasungs pa dang bden smras mdo las / chang dga' dgos pa thams cad la/ /rtag tu bag med spyod par 'gyur/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis smad 'gyur kṣing / /'di dang gzhan du rnam par rmongs/ /zhes pa'i nyes dmigs rnams 'byung bar ma zad/ bstan bshig dag lung ston skabs/ bstan pa nyams par gyur pa na/ /'tsho ba'i don du rab byung ba/ /tshul 'chos ngo tsha rnam par spangs/ /rnyed pa 'dod cing grags pa 'dod/ /nyin mtshan bre mo'i gtam la rtsen/ /mtshan mo gnyid kyi dbang du 'gro/ /sangs rgyas gsungs pa spangs nas ni/ /bud med sbyor ba spyod par byed/ /ces bstan bathig gi mthar thug ma rungs ba'e skye bo lung bstan yod pa 'di yin pas rang rang bu skyes sam ma skyes bsam blo re thongs dang / da dung 'jigs rgyu dang skrag rgyu mi yong na/ snying rdo rje las byas pa dang khyad ma byung ba red ya/ 'di bzhin nang chen so so na gnyer phyag mdzod/ dbon chos mdzad kyi gral na yang /da lta skyabs mgon mchog sprul sku na phra/ gzhan nged tsho la gnya' gnon gtong mkhan med/ gang dran gyi spyod pa byas chog 'dod yod mkhan mang tha ra/ da de 'dra'i bsam thog la e yong mi shes pa yin/ mngon pa dang mi mngon pa'i 'grigs bdag ba stan don la rgya la gces pa'i rgan ghazhon du ma bka' bgros skabs/ khyed tsho la la yog cig yong nges pa yin pas/gang gzab dang po nas byas na dga' ba yin/ yang 'di no ston pa'i na bza' gon te bre log rgya log khe dang phan tshun 'tshong byed mkhan ji snyed 'dug pa/ blo rgod mdog bu bzang mdog byed kin 'dug mod/ zla ba

1kṇisgron me'i mdo las/ nyo tshong la ni yang dag brtson/ /khyim pa rnams la brten par 'gyur/ /zhing las khyim gyi las la ni/ /rtsod pa la ni dga' bar 'gyur/ zhes bstan pa 'jig pa'i rgyur lung bstan pa de red/ yang grwa ba tshul mthun gnyom chung yon tan can dag la rtsis bkur ci yang mi byed par/ ba/ can rgyu can rnams grwa tshang 'di ka'i la rgya'i gzhi rtsa/ bstan pa'i srog shing / phan pa'i 'byung khungs yin par 'dra ba zhig byed kin 'dug mkhan mang ste/ bstan don gyi la rgya ngos ma zin pa'i skyon red/bstan 'dzin dang bstan bshig gang red chos la zhus dag gyis dang go ye / /yang grwa sa 'di la zhugs nas rang la yon tan spu rtse tsam gyi che chung bshad rgyu med par tshogs kyi mar skal che chung dang rtsam pa'i spar kha mtho dma' bshad mkhan mang ste/ rang tshod la ma bltas pa'i skad cha ngo tsha ba'i gnas red/ khyed tsho la skal ba shin tu che 'dug ste/ dkor zas spyod tshe ldan grol gdeng med na/ /lcags gong 'bar ba 'dra bar rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes pa ha e go gzhan yang yar 'then gyi zhabs 'degs la bong chad gyen la 'ded pa lta bu/ mar 'then gyi zhabs 'dren byed pa la chu bo thur la rgyug pa bzhin du 'gro ba/ gyod kha gdon kha sogs phung sna kun 'dren mkhan de 'dra'i rigs kyang 'gro mkhas sdod mkhas byas na dga'/ ci skyon ci skyon rang byas na/ /'di'i skyon dmyal ba nas bstan yong / /gsungs pa ltar rang byas kyi las ngan 'di dang phyi mar bstan yong /mdor na/ dran pa nyer bzhag las/ gtsug lag khang dang kun das/ra brtson/ /chos kyi spyod yul das/'a med cing / /bad med chang la chags tho — —dzi

1skye — pa'i blo/ /de lta bu ni rab byung min/ /zhes dang / gang zhig bdud kyi 'ching gcod dang / /sdig pa'i las dag gcod byed la/ /dge 'dun spyod yul mi spyod pa/ /de ni rab byung sangs rgyas gsung / /zhes sogs rab byung dang rab byung min pa'i khyad par rgyas par bstan pa bzhin du khyed rnams nas blang dor tshul bzhin byos/ de ltar blang dor tshul bzhin byed mi byed la las sna so so nas brtag gzhig zhib mo byed dgos pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa las/ tshar gcod pa gang zhe na/ bdag la yod pa'i kun nasdo nyon mongs rnams kun tu bsrungs nas/ nyes pa chung ngu byed pa la ni 'khrul ba gleng bar bya'o/ /nyes pa 'bring byed pa la ni bsdigs par bya'o/ /nyes pa chen po byed pa la ni bskrad par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lags pas/ nyes pa'i bab la brtags nas tshar gcod chung 'bring che gsum byed pa ni sa ngas rgyas kyi bstan pa'i byi dor/ dge 'dun nang khrims kyi dag ther/ rang gzhan la phan bde 'byung ba'i rgyu yin pas thams cad kyis rang sa nas rang la khur gang yod de nyid ston pa'i bka' dang mthun par gtsug tu blangs nas gtan gyi 'dun ma 'grub pa'i thabs la de las lhag med pa red/ de ltar bca' yig chen mo'i dgongs pa bka' dang dri ma med pa'i dgongs 'grel dag gis rgyab rten byas te tshogs gtam gyi rim pas gsal bar byas nas/ khyed rnams kyi kun spyod kyi bya ba legs par spyod pa'i tshul rnams phan sems kyis zhus pa yin pas phyag len la thebs pa re cis kyang thugs la 'jags par mdzod mdzod/ra༅ / /'o las/sa so/ lus la chos gos gsum gyi bkra shis ldan/ /

19ngag la sde snod gsum gyi bkra shis ldan/ /yid la bslab pa gsum gyi bkra shis ldan/ bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes pa 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lus chos gos kyi rgyal mtshan rnam par bkra ba'i sgo nas phyi 'dul ba'i kun spyod kyi bkra shis g.yang du chags pa/ ngag sde snod kyi lung rigs dbyangs su sgrog pa'i sgo nas bar thos bsam gyi bkra shis phyogs su rgyas pa/ thugs bslab gsum gyi nyams len phyag tu bstar ba'i sgo nas nang sgom sgrub kyi bkra shis dgung la reg pa/ bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i 'dus pa mtha' dag gi snyan du zhu rgyu/ 'o/ spyir da lo tshogs gtam rgyas pa/ slob gnyer byed tshul gyi bslab bya snying bor dril ba/bca' yig chos khrims kyis khog phib pa/ bya ba lam rim gyis gzhung bsring ba zhig 'bul 'dun yod mod/ bstan srid kyi gegs chag phyi nang gnyis 7/ nas rdol bas/ de tshe zhu 'dun 'dra cang mi skye/ da rgyu mtshan rags rim mdor bsdus 'ig bshad na 'o/ grwa ba dpe cha ba rnams nas/dang bo rgya chen thos pa mang du btsal/ /bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar/ /tha mar nyin mtshan kun du nyams su blangs/ /kun kyang bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos/ /tshul 'di bsams shing 'dun ma cilegs nas gda'/ /gsungs pa ltar/ dang po thos pa btsal tshul la'ang / bshes gnyen bsten dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ bsam sbyor gyis ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul/ bsten nas legs par nyan pa'i tshul/ mnyan bya'i gzhung ngos 'dzin pa'i tshul/ gzhung de tsho la thos bsam hur thag byed pa'i tshul rnams nges nges byas nas phyag len la theb dgos pa red/

80 rang gi dge rgan dang gzhan mkhas pa so so'i drung du dpe khrid rnal ma chos thog chos mtshams kun gyi skabs su zhus/ gzhung chen mo mtha' dag gung bsgrigs te dpyad/ chos grwa chags med du 'grims te rtso da pas brdar sha gcod dgos/ dpe cha ba rgan gzhon su yin yang mdun dpe cha dang ma bral ba byed dgos/ khyed tsho ngag kyal gyis /ba mi khoms/ grong chog gis lus mi khoms/ chags sdang gis sems mi khoms pa 'ga' 'ga' yod a/ nga yin nga yin snyam du bsam blo thongs/ thos rtags zhi zhing dul ba yin/ /sgom rtags nyon mongs chung ba yin/ /zer gi yod mod/ khyed tsho chos kyis zhi dul mi yong na/ ngas shar bla brang gi khrims ra bstan te zhi zhing dul ba zhig bca' ya/ gnyom chung dpe cha la lta ba grwa sa'i rgyan du 'gro ba sayin kyang nga la rang gi snying 'dra ba'i 'dangs rtsis yod/ de 'dra'i rigs la nged nas gzengs bstod bdag rkyen byed ngo ma yin/ /bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar tshul/ tha mar nyin mtshan kun du nyams su len tshul yang rje yab sras sogs dam pa gong mdi rnam thar dang mthun pa mdzad dgos/ de ltar mdzad na/ thams cad mkhyen pa rol ba'i rdo rjes/ de ltar thos bsam gnad du legs song na/ /de nyid sgom dang nyams len gtso bo yin/ /thos bsam sgom pa cig char 'byung bas na/ /tshegs med lam kyi rtogs pa rnyed par 'gyur/ /rgya bod mkhas pa'i skye bo phal mo ches/ /mtshams dang 'dag sbyar chig dril ma mdzad kyang / /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i mdzad pa mdzad bzhin par/ /sa lam rtogs pa phul smrung brnyes la ltos/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu zhig

81'byung rgyu red/'o/ grwa sa so so'i rgan las sde tshos kyang dgon pa 'di'i chos srid nyis ka sa cha che sa re gi 'gro lugs dang bstun pa/ mgo rnga yod pa/nang na zug med pa/ phyi na zed med pa/ bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzomasapa re e yong ltos na nged kyi yang sems zin/ chos skyong gi thugs mnyes pa red/ de ma gtogs rgyu byin na spyon pa/ ngo dga' bshad na glen ba'i log ste tsha tsha phyogs phyogs byas nas chags sdang gi 'byung khungs byas/ mi bde ba'i dkrugs shing byas na ngas dus dus la gto skyi skyi mi byed na dkon mchog gsum po 'di/ 'o/ 'di na ya rabs kyi spyod pa gcig med/rab byung byas pa'i don go grwa sar bsdad no'i dgos pa/ bla mar mjal ba'i 'bras bu 'di yin zhes bstan rgyu khu ri zhig med/ ldog ka rgyag rgyu/do then rgyu/ tshong byed rgyu/ dgos mi dgos gnyis ka bshad rgyu/ nyin gyi myi / mtshan mo'i 'dre bca' rgyu/ bstan bshig dang gshin 'dre bca' dus/ gtso bo byed mkhan skor cig yod snang / khyod tshos sdig tshod bzung ra dga'/ ngas re re la rgyu mtshan blangs te/ ngas dgon pa 'di lta ci sa cha yul phyogs la yang gnas mi chog pa byas gtong nga / nga de 'dra byed na byed no ma red ang / yar gi lha bca' na/ mar gi garto bca' na dgon pa 'di'i bdag po nga min na khyed tsho e red/ 'di phyi gnyis ka la skyid na bde na 'dod na 'grig lam rtsis na bzang / 'dir sdug phyi sdug rang phung gzhan phung byas na 'dod phyin/ dran tshad kha ma/sa shod/— bsam tshad lag la longs dang / ngas nyes can la chad pa/ sdig can la rnam smin/

82ri 'dra mo'i lci mo/ thog 'dra mo'i rtsub mo 'gel/ ltos ra chog 'o/ nang chen so so spyi bde ba gang yin kyang brtsi rgyu bkur rgyu ngo shes pa byas nas dgon pa 'di'i la rgya bzung na bzang / 'o sa cha yul phyogs 'ji na nged kyi 'grig 'og min zhing chos 'og dang khrims 'og min pa med pas sa cha 'di la go chod pa phan thogs pa byed na ma gtogs/ gnod skyel sa gtan nas med/ zhwa ra lham ma nor ba/ mdun ra rgyab ma 'phyug na dga'/ mdor na skya sa ser sa/ bla ma grwa ba mchog dman bar ma/ rgan pa gzhon pa su yin yang nged kyi sems dang mthun pa/ las rgyu 'bras la ran pa zhig byed na ma gtogs bsam log dran log byed log spyod log bya sa gtan nas med/ ngas gang bshad rtsis/ las rgyu 'bras rtsis/ rgyal bo'i khrims lugs rtsis/ dgon pa'i 'grig lam rtsis na/ sa cha la bde skyid 'byung / dgon pa la bkra shis 'byung / rang rang la legs tshogs 'byung bas de tsho thugs la zungs/ 'di tsho la nyan sgo byas btang na rjes nas chos 'jig rten gyi zhu rgyu gang mang mang zhig yod pa yin/ /

83rdzogs ldan dpyid kyi rol mo zhes bya ba'i tshig gi po wang / de yang ji skad du/ 'gyur med nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i bdes/ /tha mal snod bcud 'khrul 'khor kun bshigs nas/ /rab 'byams dag pa'i snang ba mchog stsol ba'i/ /sum cu rtsa drug rnal 'byor ma yis skyongs//zhes dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i lam srol thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang du byas pa'i bkra shis dang dge legs su byed pa'i bden tshig tshangs pa chen po'i ngag gi rang sgra ci dgar 'khrol ba/ chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i klong mi zad pa rgya dang zheng mu ma mchis pa'i 'gram pa la/ kun du dge ba'i mtshan ma phun sum tshogs pa'i char du bsnyil te/ gong na yab rje chos kyi rgyal bo nyi ma dang zla ba bzhin du lham mer bzhugs pa/ bar na bla sprul skye brgyud kyis mtho ba bgrang yas dpag bsam gyi ljon pa tshar du dngar ba bzhin du dul bar gzhes pa/ bya btang sgom chen gyi bong rtsis kyis mi langs pa gangs seng dkar mo ri layan pa lta bu lhun du chags pa/ gzhung lug sa rab 'byams kyi dgongs don lung rigs kyis smra ba'i bshes gnyen du ma 'khor los sgyur ba'i dgongs blon bzhin du 'gying bag gis 'khod pa/ bslab gsum lung rtogs kyis phyug pa'i rab byung khri phrag gur gum gyi snye ma

skye4tshal du stems pa bzhin du gral du bsgrigs pa/ zur na lta sgom gdeng tshad du 'khyol ba'i sngags 'chang dpag med char sprin gyi thor spyi bor blangs pa'i gangs dkar gyi ri bo byin du bstar ba bzhin du brjid bag chags pa/gsham na dad gtong gi lang tsho ci yang mdzes pa'i khyim bdag pho mo bgrang gis mi lang ba rgyu skar gyi phung bo mkha' la dkrigs pa bzhin du shig ger 'tshogs pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu yangs pa 'di nyid du/ gang zhig gtam du gleng ngar bgyid na/de yang 'phags pa'i yul gyi lte ba/ grong khyer chen mo ma ga dha dang nye rang mtshams pa'i yul gru grong khyer ser skya'i shākya gzhi'i rgyal bo mi'i seng ge 'gram gyi sras po tha chung sa skyong chen po sras gtsang ma dang / shākya lhas bstan gyi grong dpon chen po lag na be con gyi sras mo chung ma sgyu 'phrul chen rma gnyis 'dus pa las 'jig rten gyi sgron me chen por bltams pa dpal mnyam med don kun grub pa zhes mi mjed kyi zhing na/ lha dang ston par grags pa sus spyang 'gran du med par rang byung gis bdud bzhi'i dpung las rnam par rgyal te bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa la/ de nyid rnam pa bcu drug gi rig pa ye shes kyi 'jug pa slar gī ldog pa'i tshul du zhugs pa'i stong gzugs gdod ma'i mgon po dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi ngo bor sku lnga lhun grub tu brnyes nas ring bo ma lon pa na/ji skad du/ ston pas bya rgod phung bo ru/ /shes rab pha rol phyin tshul bzhin/ /chos bstan dpal ldan 'bras spungs su/ /de bzhin gsang sngags tshul rab gsu ngas/ /gang la gang gnas ston pa ni/ /su

85da yis rgyud kyang ci zhig ston/ /gnas ni gang du 'jig rten pa'i/ /'alor ni su yis rgyu ci yin/ /bya rgod phung bo'i ri chen por/ /theg pa chen po bla na med/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bstan/ /de nas gcig tu mchod rten cher/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /byang chub sems dpa' sogs rnams kyi/ /thabs gcig de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs/ /nam mkha' beem mig shin tu dwangs/ /go skabs med par rab tu gsal/ /sna tshogs rdo rje khang bar gnas/ /chos kyi dbyings ni yid 'ong bar/ /rgyud bstan skyes bu rnams kyi ni/ /bsod nams ye shes dgongs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po dpyid du rdzogs pa stong gzugs rnam pa thams cad pa'i gzugs sku bla na med pa dang zung du 'jug pa'i rgyal thabs zag pa med pa'i dpal la longs su rol ba de nyid/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa chen po dum bu bcu gnyis kyi snying bo bskal ba bzang bo'i sangs rgyas mtha' dag gis mngon par byang chub pa'i byin phab pa/ lho gling 'dzam bu'i ljon shing gi ral ba'i snye ma dge bar dud pa'i lho phyogs dpal ldan 'bral spungs rgyal ba'i mchod rten chen po'i gnas steng mar dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa/lha grangs stong drug brgya nyi shu'i rten brten pa'i gtso bor batshe/ngas te/'khor phun sum tshogs pa chos kyi rgyal bo zla ba bzang bo 'e/sa rgyu skar gyi dbus na sla pa dang / rkang 'thung gi tshal na dpag baṭaci ma bzhin du mngon par 'phagaca/ pas ba/tsas/ grong bye ba dgu bcu rtsa drug gi ser/sa rnam par

86dag pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa sa'i rdul grangs dang mnyam pa dang / gzhan yang dag pa'i lha dang mi bgrang gis mi langs pa la/ chos phun sum tshogs pa stong gzugs dang po'i mgon po/ lo gsum zla gsum/ phyogs gsum ril lag dus 'khor gtod pa/ shrī kā la tsakra'i 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang rnam pa bcu gcig sngon du btang ste/ gsal la gang dkrogs pa sogs khyad chos du mas khyad par du 'phagasabyu pa/ rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal bo stong phrag bcu gnyis pa gsungs pas/ sngon lha dang mi dang drang srong sus kyang mthun par 'jig rten du ma bskor ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo yang dag par bskor ba ni/ 'jig rten thams cad dge legs su byed pa'i dge mtshan gyi snang ba dang por shar ba yin la/ de nas ma dag pa'i gnas la dag pa'i zhing khams byung ba/ lta na sdug pa'i grong gi dpal phun sum tshogs pa'i mnga' thang yang gnod sbyin gyi gcung bo'i pho brang dang mi gnyis pa'i srid la 'god pa/ lnga ldan 'og min gyi zhing la theg chen gyi bstan pa dang / nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul la gsang sngags kyi lung rtogs dar ba las kyang bstan pa'i snying bo mtha' dag ches cher dar ba/ byang phyogs shasnya la zhes bya ba'i rig 'dzin gyi gnas chen po grong khyer bye ba dgu bcu rtsa drug gis yang dag par gtams pa'i ljongs su/ rigs gsum gyi sgyu 'phrul dra ba dpung dang mtha' ma dmigs pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyi bkod pa 'byams klas pa'i nang na/ phyi sgyu lus kyi rnam pas spyod mi'i bkod pa la 'phrul du rtsen cing / nang yon tan gyi ngo bo spang rtogs mthar phyin pa'i rang bzhin phyi gsal nang gsal gyi tshul du gnas pa/ phyag na rdo rje zlu ba

87bzang bo/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje 'jam dpal grags pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug padma dkar po rnams kyi thugs bskyed kyi thugs rje/ thabs mkhas kyi 'phrul 'degs/ mthu stobs kyi dpung ba/ 'phrin las kyi 'od snang zad mi she5 sdo pa'i mthu las/ dpal dang bo'i sangs rgyas kyi smin byed dbang gi chu bo/ grol byed khrid kyi nye lam/ rgyab rten rgyud kyi lung bka' cha lag dang bcas ba dar rgyas su gyur ba lags la / de skad du'ang / rtsa ba'i rgyud rgyal 'dzin mchog zla ba bzang / /rgyud don rgyud mdzad 'jam dpal grags pa'i zhabs/ /'grel mdzadartsosnying rje'i lha gcig pad dkar sogs//chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams la gus phyag 'tshal// /zhes gsungs pa ltar lags la/ de dag gi skabs nyid na/ 'phags yul rigs pa'i skyed tshal du/ bde par gshegs pa mtha' dag gi gsang ba'i dbyings las skyes pa/tsi li paṇḍi ta dang / dus zhabs chen po sogs kyis rigs ldan gnyis pa padma dkar po dang / rigs ldan bcu gnyis pa sa spyod nyi shu'i dus snga phyir 'phags yul nor 'dzin gyi gzhi la khyab brdal du spyan drangs pas/ lam sbyor ba drug gi thems skas la brten nas grub pa'i mkha' la gshegs pa/bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa bsnyes pa bgrang gis mi lang ba byung bas sgron me'i bskal ba zhes mtshan snyan gyi sgra yang don dang ldan par gyur pa khub/ thugs bskyed lha sngags zo chu'i 'phrul 'khor las//nyer drang rgyud rgyal rtsa 'grel bdud rtsi'i chab//'phags yul rig 'dzin kṣing sar 'grem mkhas pa//

88 tsi li ba dang dus zhabs che de bsngags//zhes bsngags pa'ang don dang ldan pa kho na lags shing / de nas 'bro lo tsā pa shes rab grags kyis kasma ra'i paṇḍi chen po so ma na tha la gtugs te rab byung dang bo'i me yos la gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir dpal ldan gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo'i srol ka thog mar phye/ rwa lo tsā ba chos rab kyis bal bo'i mthil du parnyi ta sa manta shrī la lo lnga zla ba bcu'i bar du dus 'khor gsan te kha ba ri ba'i ljongs su srol rgya cher spel/ shong lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis 'phags yul dbus su rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la sbyangs/sog sde seng ge rgyal na dus 'khor la sbyangs te 'grel chen la 'gyur bcos mdzad nas lugs 'di'i srol gong du spel / gzhan yang khe gad 'khor lo sogs lo tsā ba nyer lnga tsam gyis dus kyi 'khor lo bsgyur zhing gtan la phabs pas/ jo nang / karma/ sa skya/ khro phu bka' rgyud sogs grub mtha' ris med du dar rgyas che ba byung bas/ mdo rgyud bcud bzang snying gi bum par 'dzin/ /ro 'dzin mchog ni legs bshad gtam gyis brel//rtsod dus 'dzin ma'i lto ba rigs ldan gyi//man ngag 'dod rgu'i char gyis ci yang tshim//zhes pa 'di ji lta ba bzhin byung / de lta na'ang / mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal bos/ji ltar gnas pa'i rang bzhin brjod pa ni//mu stegs lam dang hwa shang rang lugs la/ /

——sna :khrin rdo rje rnal 'byor mchog tu ming btags nas//skye bo phal cher log pa'i lam la khrid//ces gsungs pa ltar/ hwa shang rang lugs kyi lta ba la mi 'gyur ba'i bde bar btags pa/ 'khrul snang za zi'i nyams snang la stong gzugs phyag chen du ngos bzang ba/ rlung sbyor phran bu'i 'khrul 'khor la dbu ma'i srog sgro rtsol du bshad pa/ mi rtog 'ded sems kyi cha la rdzogs rim gyi 'dzin par smra ba lta bus rgyud kyi dgongs don/ rigs ldan gyi man ngag gang gi phyogs mthong tsam med pa'i dus nyid na/ ji skad du/ gsang ba'i bdag po'i lung bstan las/ /blo bzang grags pa 'di nyid ni//sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul ba ste// paṇa chen rkyang gi lus bzung nas//mdo dang sngags kyi don bshad cing / / nges pa kho nar sangs rgyas so//'jam pa'i dbyangs ni lhag pa'i lha/ / dbyangs can ma ni las rgya ste// /nges pa kho nar byang chub pas/ / 'phags pa'i slob ma bsdu bar byed/ /ces dang / slob dpon chen po padma ka ras bslu ba med pa'i bden gsung dbyangs su bsgrags pa'i bka' chems las/'jam dbyangs sprul ba gdul bya bstan pa'i bdag / tshomado sngags bstan 'dzin blo bzang grags pa zhes//mi rabs brgyad du gsang sngagaku4 rgyas par ston//de yi rgyud 'dzin tshe gcig sangs rgyas yin/ /zhes gsungs

rten() — — — pa ltar/ nges pa'i don du/ dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad/ lhag don du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang spang rtogs kyi phung bo ma lus pa dang ngo bo gnyis su ma dmigs pa/ drang don du'ang / sngon rgyal ba dbang bokhro tog gi mdun sar thugs bskyed pa'i dus nyid nas rgyal ba'i yab gcig 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi thugs kyi 'od zer gyis blo gros kyi padmo kha phye bas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag la ye shes kyi gzigs pa dag pa'i spyan mnga' ba/ thuṭwā mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i dngos po rgya mtsho chen po bri gang med pa lta bu lhun grub tu gyur ba'i bdag nyid parnyi ta sha stag gi skye ba brgyud cing / rgyal ba'i dam chos/ lhag ma ma lus pa'i bang mdzod bdag gir mdzad cing spel ba'i thugs smon brtan la rtsal rdzogs pas/ chig spyi'i bshad sgrub mo ྾ mo nyin mor mdzad/ ces bsngags pa ltar/ bshad pa dang sgrub pa'i srol ka tshig spyi tsam la ma bzhag par/ thun mong pa rig pa'i gnas phra mo nas/ thun mong ma yin pa gsang sngags kyi sde snod rgya mtsho lta bu'i bar lung rigs dri ma med pa'i lam nas 'chad nyan ma/ tha' chod pa'i bshad ka dang / mdo sngags kyis bsdus pa'i lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa stan thog gcig tu nyams bzhes kyis zung 'jug gi bar gyi lam rnams dus kyi thung tha gcig la tshags su 'dzud pa'i sgrub ka 'dul ba rka/ ri ka nas rgyud kyi rgyal bo gsang ba radus pa dang dus kyi 'khor lo'i bar gyi dam chos ma lus pa'i lam srol gzhi nas gsos te/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rdzogs ldan las kyang ches cher gsal bar mdzad pas rgya la ba'i bstan pa la rgyal ba las lhag pa'i bka'

— — — — — da — sne — —— — dzo /mi)/drin che bas na/ dpal ldan sa gsum 'gro ba'i྾ momachog /zhes don dang mthun pa'i bsngags pa'i me tog gi mchod tshogs kun du bzang bo'i mchod sprin du ngaspros pa de lta lags la/ khyad par du tshal྾rtogs ldan ye shes rgyal ma/tshan dang / bod yul gangs can gyi kun mkhyen chen po bu ston zhabs kyi sras po dpal ldan dus zhabs pa chen po/ gong gsum bde chen pa chos kyi dpal ba la dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos skor rdzogs par gsan// rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi man ngag gis lde mig byas te dus kyi 'khor lo'i bshad rtso srol nyer lnga tsam ma 'dres par sbyangs pas phyi nang gzhan gsum gnad don phra mo tshun chad mtha' chod par dgongs shing / sbyor ba yan lag drug gi gnad don 'khrul ba med pa rnyed de mi 'phrog pa'i gzer thebs pa'i spobs pa brnyes pa'i tshul rdo rje mgur du'ang bzhes pa na/ dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po dngos kyis lung bstan cing dbugs dbyung ba ni/ gyirgyud kyi mthar thug dpal ldan dus 'khor lo'i/ /yan lag drug gi gnad rnams dgongs pa'i tshe/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor los mngon sum du/ / zla ba bzang bo 'dra bar lung bstan pa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar la/ dgung lo re gcig la grub pa'i gnas mchog 'brog ri bo che dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling nas 'phags pa'i 'khor slob nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu la rgyud kyi rgyal bo dang / 'grel chen dri ma med gtsos sems 'grel skor gsum phran dang bcas pa/ sbyor drug gi srog sgrub ga zugs sgrub kyi thog mtha' bar gsum gyi gnad don 'khrul med/ — mi 'gyur ba'i blode bas

//shā /rdo/rti la ma sa nga sa ri drangs pa'i stong gzugs phyag dzha chen po/ tshul des drangs pa'i mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba nyi khri chig stong drug brgya sogs kyi gnad gsang bod yul gyi mkhas grub lung rtogs kyis mtho ba'i grags pa can sus kyang ma thon pa rnams lag mthil gyi rdzas bzhin ston pa'i gsung ngag 'jigs pa med pa'i seṅge'i sgra chen po bsgrags pas mkhas pa snga ma dag gis lan brgya tshar bshad pa pas/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa bstan pa'i bdag po yin pas bshad pa lan gcig pos sa chen po'i khyon 'di khong ba'i gsung rgyun gyi legs bshad yug gcig gis khyab par mkhas pa tshad ldan gyis bsngags pa don la gnas shing grub pas/ dpal zhang zhung gi parnyi ta chos dbang grags pas/nyal 'gro pi ra'i lho phyogs 'dzin ma'i lho//zla bzang gnyis pa'i mngal khur gyis mdzes zhes//dkyil 'khor bdag pos lung bstan de nyid ni//legs par gsar ba'i mdzes sdug ci yang 'byed/ /ces pa ltar/ 'jig rten dge legs su byed pa'i dge mtshan gyi snang ba sa/nyis pa byung ba lags la/ de nas/de lta na yang dus kyi 'khor lo yis//khyod ni zla ba bzang bo ji bzhin zhes//dngos su lung bstan bla ma'i bka' drin las//lam bzang 'di 'dra 'chad la skal ldan gyur// zhes gsungs/ dkyil 'khor gyi bdag pos zla ba bzang bo dang 'dra bar dngos su lung bstan pa'i gangs ljongs chad ma'i ston pa rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying bo'i ske

— 93 bka' drin las lam bzang 'di nyid la bshad sgrub byed pa'i bu chen mtha' yas pa byon pas/ de'i dus na dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing khams 'di nyid kyang byang phyogs tā la ba'i grong khyer dang lci yang mi byed pa'i tshul du yod la/ bu chen de dag gi nang nas kyang / mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal bo ni srol 'di la shing rta po 'gran zla dang bral ba yin pas/ nyid kyi gsung ngag 'jigs med seng ge nga ro'i dbyangs las kyang /rigs ldan grags pa slar yang dus kyi mthar//ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i zlos gar ci yang mdzad// de yi rigs la pad dkar 'dzin pa'i dpal//gnyis pa gzhan zhig 'jig rten 'di na snang //zhes kyang mdzad snang la/ mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal bo las chos 'di'i bka' drin zhu ba paṇa chen grub pa lta bu mtha' yas pa byung yang / lam bzang 'di nyid kyi 'phrin las phyogs 'dir bskyod pa'i dar chen ni/ parnyi ta chen po zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa/ g.yag sde gnas brtan blo gros chos skyong / ba so grub chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan gsum ni 'gran sgra dang bral ba yin zhing / rje blo gros chos skyong las/ gtsang chu chos dbang grags pa/de las mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtshos gsan te/ rje de ni lugs 'di la bshad sgrub gnyis char gyi bka' drin dpag par dka' swā/ de las rgyal ba'i dbang bo dge 'dun rgya mtshos gsan pa nas rim gyis rgyal dbang bdun pa chen po dang / paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes yab sras kyis rje yab sras kyi bka' srol dang mthun par mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan dgung rtswa

94 btegs pa lags la/ — —rang re gser ljongs yul gyi lte ba 'di la yang rong ston rgyal ba'i dbang bo skal ldan rgya mtsho sku phreng rim byon dang / 'asdin las kyi byed rmepo sras kyi thu bo dag gi thugs bskyed thabs mkhas kyis chos 'ji dar rgyas che bsdi muratre khri chen dang bo'i mgon po nas snga phyir dbang gi chu bo rma med pa gdul bya'i 'ing sa la yang dag par drangs/ dus zhabs mtsho byung dgyes pa'i dpal nas phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi lag len dri ma med pa'i srol ka yang dag par bskyangs/ dpal zhang zhung gi palci ta chos dbang grags pa ngur smrig gi blos gar ci yang bsgyur ba yongs 'dzin 'jam pa'i dbyangs blo bzang dpal bas/ phyi dkar rtsis kyi ri mo'i lag len/ nang rtsa rlung gi rim pa'i rnam bzhag gzhan bskyed rdzogs kyi lam dang 'bras bu/ rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i bshad pa/ sgom lam sbyor drug gi khrid dang bshad lung rgya cher spel bas/ mtshan dus la nyi ma shar ba/ dgun dus la me tog rgyas pa/ rtsod dus la rdzogs ldan byung ba lta bu'i dus ngan dus bzang du bsgyur bas yab sras kyi kun dga' ra ba ni cha bsags bde 'byung snazhing gi snying bo ji lta bar mchis pa 'di bzhin lags la/ bye brag tu/ khyod zhabs thugs rje zla ba ni// tshoskal bzang bde 'byung ral ba la bkod pas sa gsum mtha' dag gi / snying gi mun sel bla ma rgyal/ /zhes bsngags pa ltar/ zhabs sen gyi zla tshes gsar ba skal ba bzang bo'i gtsug rtswa bkod pa tsam nas/

95 trenang gi mun pa ma lus pa bsal te/ shes bya'i gnas phra rags la ye shes kyi spyan dri ma med pa sbyin pa'i yab rje bla ma mchog ni/ thog mar dge ba sor sdud dang bsam gtan bar du dge ba srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa/ tha mar dge ba rjes dran dang ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag ste/ lam bzang sbyor ba drug gi them skas rim par bgrod pa las/ stong gzugs dang bo'i mgon po'i go 'phang la ring mo nas gshegs te/ nam mkha'i dbyings na zla ba gcig nyid kyang / /sa yi steng na chu snod ji snyed par/ /grangs bzhin 'char ba'i ya mtshan 'dir ltos dang / /bsam pas rgyal ba'i rol ba yid la 'bab/ /ces pa ltar/ chu zla ltar sprul ba'i bkod pa 'byams klas pa las phyogs gcig gi dbang du btang na/ kun mkhyen thub pa chen po'i drung na sa bcu'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal blo gros rin chen/ shing rta che na po klu sgrub kyi mdun na grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan sha ba ri ba/ mnyam med di baṃ ka ra'i zur na ngag gi dbang phyug paṇa chen sa yi snying bo/paṇa chen shākya shrī'i 'khor dukhro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal ba/ grub pa'i khyu mchog bha ro'i mdun namathu stobs dbang phyug rwa lo rdo rje grags pa/ 'jam mgon blo bzang rgyal ba'i 'khor na

96smra ba'i nyi ma mkhas grub dge legs dpal ba/rong ston phyag na padmo'i mdun sararnal 'byor dbang phyug khu shes rab rgyal mtshan/'gro mgon gser khang rgyal ba'i drung na'ajigs mdzad grub pa'i dbang bo 'jigs med bsam gtan sogs su sprul ba dam pa'i zlos gar bsgyur te rgyal bstan yid bzhin gyi nor bu bshad sgrub zung du sbrel ba'i rgyal rma tshan gyi rtse mo la ci yang mchod de 'jig rten thams cad la ṅkage legs kyi snang ba dpal du byin/sku tshe 'dir yang dgung lo bdun gyi dus nas/ kun mkhyen chen po dbyig gi gnyen po dang / kha che bsod snyoms pa shākya shrī/ bod kyi kun mkhyen rin chen grub pa/ zla med paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa sogs kyi rnam 'phrul/ rgyal ba'i dbang bo bcu gsum pa chen po'i rigs kyi me tog zhwa dmar palci ta dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i zhabs la gtugs te/ sdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin rdzogs par nod cing /lam rim blo sbyong gi skor gtso bor gyur ba'i khrid dang zhal lung gi rigs lnga bcu lhag pa/ 'jigs mdzad dus dgra'i dbang chen snying bor gyur ba'i zur bka'i dbang chen nyi shur nye ba/ rgya rgyam gyi byin rlabs gzhung rsha/nga du byas pa'i spyi zur gyi khyo/ na sum brgya lhag zhus shing / thog tha bar gyi mdzad sgo phra rags thams cad la gsung bkod kyis khyab par mdzad pas legs pa'i mdzad pa ji snyed pa'i gzhi dus dang por tshugs byung /dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i dus nas 'jig rten dbang phyug ngur smrig

ne 9tshogi gar du zlos pa/ rong ston chos kyi rgyal po'i ring lugs pa che na po dus kyi mtha' na 'jam mgon snyan brgyud kyi bstan pa'i bdag por bzhugs pa/khri chen rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho las/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen gyis gtso ba'i zur bka' dang / mi tra dang rdo rje phreng ba'i spyi bka' bcas dbang chen sum brgyar nye ba/ tshom dang thor bur bzhugs pa'i rjes gnang brgya phrag du ma/ bskyed rdzogs dang man ngag rnam gsum sogs khrid dang bshad lung bcu phrag mang ngo / bka' bstan gnyis dang / rje yab sras kyi bka' 'bum gtso bor gyur ba'i gsung 'bum lnga bcu lhag pa/ glegs bam stong la nye ba/ chos tshan bye ba khrag khrig gi tshad dang mnyam pa'i bklag lung banes/dgung lo bcu gsum pa nas/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje dge ba'i bshes su byon pa/ sku'i phreng bar paṇḍi ta sha stag gi rnam thar rol ba/ sku tshe 'dir yang sa steng na 'gran zla med pa'i paṇḍi ta chen por bzhugs pa/ yongs 'dzin chos kyi rgyal bo blo bzang dpal ba 'bral med gtsug gi cod pan zla med par bkur te sgra dngu tshad ma sogs rig gnas bcu phrag phyogs gtogs phra mo tshun chad lhag lus med pa dang / bka' pod chen po lnga / byams pa'i chos sde nyi shu/ dbu ma rigs pa'i tshogs/ bka' gdams gzhung drugalam rim blo sbyong brgya phrag bcas mdo phyogs kyi rigs gang ci mchis pa dang / rgyud sde rnam pa bzhi'i spyi don/ pha rgyud ma rgyud so so dang / thun mong gi bskyed rdzogs/ bde gsang 'jigs dus bzhi'i rgyud dang 'grel ba ste/ sngags kyi bshad pa sa steng na bzhugs byang yod do cog dang /

///////ji rna — byug — mdor na/ yig gzugs kyi thig tshad nas bzung gsang ba 'dus pa'i rim lnga dang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor drug gi bar la mdzub khrid phyag mthil gyi rdzas ston pa lta bu zhus te/ grogs rigs pa'i seṅge srab med du 'phyo ba lta bu sha stag dang mnyam por lo ngo bcu bdun tsam la lung dang rigs pa'i dgag sgrub rnam par dag pas sbyangs pas grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol tu son cing / mdo sngags rig gnas man ngag bzhi char la 'jigs pa med pa'i khyu mchog rlabs po che'i gnas thob pas shar chu bo gaṅgā tshun na 'gran zla med pa'i kun mkhyen chen po gcig bur bzhugs pa 'di lags pas/ dgung lo bcu drug gi dus nas rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i sroshā/ ji lta ba bzhin lam yongs rdzogs kyi nyams bzhes thun dang thun gyis bcad de dus bzhir rgyun chags dang / lhag par du dgun dpyid kyi zla ngo lnga re tsam la lo bzhin chags med mdzad pas/ lam gyi gtso bo gsum dang bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad phra mo tshun chad thugs rgyud la spungs pa bzhin du gyur te dus kyi yang mtha' na rnal 'byor gyi dbang bo dang / grub pa'i gtso bor bsngags pa don dang ldan pa 'di byung / dgung lo bco brgyad kyi dus nas 'phrin las kyi skya rengs dang po shar/ dgung lo nyer bdun gyi steng nas bzung rtsol med kyi mdzad 'phrin jimatha' dbus med par shugs 'byung du rgyas te bstan pa'i bdag po mtshungs pa med pa dang / phan bde'i rtsa lag 'gran spya dang bral bar bzhugs pa'i mur ka ring dgon grong zhes grags pa'i 'dzum 'od sa steng na gsal ba/ phu na nags tshal gyi rtse mo dgung la bsnyegs pa/ mdo na ri

99mkhar gyi rtsa ba brtan la brjid pa/ bar na sa zhing gi sne mo thang la brdal pa/ dpal 'byor longs spyod ldan pa/ mi rnams rang bzhin drang ba/ dpa' zhing rtul phod pa/ mgyogs shing bang skyen pa/ kha gsal la khog yangs pa/ gzhung bzang la khrel yod pa/ dge phyogs la dad gus che ba/mchod sbyin la gtong phod yangs pa/ nag phyogs la pham kha ster ba/ rang phyogs la rgyal kha len pa sogs snod bcud kyi khyad par mtha' dag 'dod rirgu 'byung ba sum rtsen grong khyer dang 'gran bzod pa/ khyad par du pha myes gong ma gong ma'i dus nas bzung phyag na padmo shes rab bkra shis yab sras kyi chab 'bangs su gyur te chos srid kyi 'brel ba rgya mtsho las gting zab pa/nam mkha' las rgya che ba nyid grub pas na/ rdo rje 'chang sku snga phyi la yang skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras las kyang lhag pa'i dad gus dang bkur sti che bas lo snga phyi mang po zhig la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen stsol ba'i gsol 'debs yang yang zhus pa na/ da lo rarsha byung bcu drug gi thog ma/ dge ldan rtsis gsar ltar gyi lo mgo rigs ldan ma 'gags pa shasta la'i khri la bzhugs pa'i dus tshigs dang bstun te/ kun mkhyen chos kyi nyi ma chen po nyid/ srid pa'i yan lag bcu gnyis dang bral ba/ 'pho chen rnam pa bcu gnyis ldog pa'i cha nas bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis kyi ngo bo nyid sku/ dga' chen rnam pa bcu drug ri bdag nyid/ de nyid rnam pa bcu drug rig pa'i ye shes/ beem chos kyi rdul phra rags ma lus pa zad pa'i stong sa/zugs rnam pa thams cad pa'i gzugs sku/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba bri gang med pa'i de kho na nyid kyi sku ste sku bzhi lhun grub bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku—

— 100gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag por bzhings te/byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang bzhi bzhi/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag po po'i daspung dang bcas rdzogs par bka' drin du stsal bas 'jig rten thams cad dge legs su byed pa'i dge mtshan gyi snang ba gsum pa byung ba yin la/ tshul de la bka' drin gyi gtang rag zhu ba dang / dam pa'i chos kyi dbu laphang bstod pa dang / bstan pa'i bya ba la gus pa mtshon pa dang /gdul bya rang rang gi legs pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pa'i ched du/ dngos 'bul mtshon tsam gyi rnam grangs ni/ ྾ ྾ morang gzhan gyi lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge tshogs dang bcas pa snying thag pa nas 'bul lam zhus te/'dod don gyi snying bor gsol ba 'debs pa ni/skye dgu bde skyid bstan pa dang / /de yang bshad sgrub bya ba la/ /rag las de slad khyod gcigajipus/ /nyams pa med pa'i bka' drin mdzad/ /ces pa ltar/ zhabs pad srid zhi'i mchod sdong chen po dus gzhar yang g.yo ba med par rtag brtan g.yung drung gi rang bzhin du lhun chags pa dang / skye dgu mtha' dag gi phan bde ji ltar rgyas pa bshad sgrub kyi bya ba gang ltar rgyas pa kho na'i —jes su spyod cing / rī de yang rtsal dang ldan pa'i dam pa rnams kyi mdzad 'phrin la rag las pa 'ba' zhig rngu sa na/thugs bskyed kyi mthu grub pa/ yon tan gyi rtsal rdzogs pa/ 'phrin las kyi sgo 'phar grol ba/ rdo rje 'chang gcig bus gzhan dang mi mnyam pa med par/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa phyogs mthar spel ba'i bka' drin spyir skyong

rta — ༷/ga/du/༷ kyib dang / bye brag tu dpal dus/ kyi 'khor lo'e dbang dang byin rlabs/bskyed rdzogs dang gdams pa/ rgyud dang 'grel ba/ lung dang rtogs pa'i chos tshul gang ji snyed pa thams cad rgyud kyi rtogs pa'i dgongs pa/rigs ldan rnams kyi man ngag rje yab sras kyi bka' srol ji lta ba bsnyezhin rgya cher spel ba bka' drin du zhu zhing / yang sgos su 'di nas lo bzhi brgya dang lnga bcu tsam song ba na rdzogs ldan phyi ma'i bstan pa rin po che sa chen po dum bu bcu gnyis kyi mtha' dbus med par dar ba'i tshe/ 7mgon po nyid rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal bo'i mdun na rigs ldan gnyis pa ltar gyur ba/ chos srid kyi mdzad pa rlabs rje bas/ skye rgu skyong pa la 'gran zla med cing / nyi ma dang zla ba ltar grags pa/ dpar 'jigs med zil gnon sgra dbyangs zhes mtshan tsam gyis kyang stong sa/zugs mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba zung du chud pha'i go 'phang bde blag tu sbyin pa'i sku'i srid bzung ba'i tshe/bdag cag re zhing ltos pa thams cad gnyen dang rtsa lag 'khor dang slob ma ci dang ci'i skal ba dang 'tsham par rjes su bzung ste smin grol zab chos thugs kyi nying khus ci yang gsos te bcu 3samaskerdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'jog pa mkhyen mkhyen zhes zhu lags/ nyu 'dijilags pas/ ji skad du/ khyod kyi mkhyen pa'i spyan zur g.yos tsam gyis/ /shes bya'i gnas kun rang tshugs rjen par ston/ /yon ton nam mkha' mdzod kyi gra gcig na/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i gsang gsum ngal gsor yib/ /zhes dang / rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i dbang khrid bshad pa'i rgyun/ /mtha' dag thugs kyi yol gor legs bzung nas/ /nges gsang theg pa'i rgyud kyi zab

102gnad kun/ /gsal gzigs dang 'chang ba'i dbang bar grub/ /zhes pa'i ched du brjod pa'i rgyud dang bcas 'di ltar byung la/ dgung lo bcu drug gi dus nas྾ mo ྾'di byung / de yang 'di skad du/ rgya chen thos pa'i pha rol phyin/ /skyon bral sdom pa gsum gyis btsun/ /gnas lugs mngon gyur grub pa'i rje/ /'di lta'i mgon bcas skal ba bzang //zhes spyang zhu la/ dgung lo bcu drug gi dus nas 'phrin las྾ mo mo 'gran zla dang bral bar gyur bas na/ gser ljongs yul gyi paṇḍi ta ngag dbang mi pham zla bas/ nyi ma'i gnyen yang btang snyoms mdzad pa yi/ /snyigs dus sngo bsang mtha' khob mun pa'i gling / /bshad sgrub chos kyis dkar bor bgyid pa la/ /smra ba'i zla ba khyod las lhag pa su/ /zhes gsungs pa ji lta bu'i bsngags pa'i sgra dbyangs dal gyis bzhad pa'i rol mo 'jig rten thams cad kyi rna ba'i dpal du son pa'i mur/ gyichos 'di spyir dar rgyas che la/ lhag par du skyabs mgon phyag na padmo dge 'dun 'phrin las rab rgyas dpal bzang bo'i bka' lung dang / mkhar gong sngags 'chang dge bdun bstan pa rab rgyas kyi legs mdzad zung du 'jug pa'i byed pa las/ shrī kā la tsakra'i bshad sgrub kyi rkang tshugs pa'i phyir/ / dus 'khor e wa gling nes grags pa'i zla 'od khong nas 'dzum pa'i chos grwa chen po nyid 'jig rten 'di'i rgyan du bskrun te/ sgrub mchod rtsis rig sogs kyi phyag len/ rgyud dang 'grel chen sogs kyi 'chad nyan/ bskyed rdzogs man ngag sogs kyi zhal shes kyis mtshon dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i pa lung rtogs kyi bstan pa byang phyogs bde 'byung gling gi dpal ji lta ba bzhinā

— nga —chig rme la — rī—ga — — ༷//////rdo dar la gong du 'phel ba'i mur/ khri chen dang po'i mgon po nas/mo ྾ mo thams cad mkhyen pa skal ldan blo bzang 'phrin las lung rtogs rgya mtsho dpal bzang bos rong bo'i rgyud par gsang bde 'jigs gsum —gyi dbang gnangaska/bas kyi yar zhus/ oṃ bde legs su gyur cig /dag pa rab 'byams brtan dang g.yo ba yis/ /ngo mtshar kun byed lhan cig skyes pa'i gar/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba ma/ngon ba'e/ngas bcom ldan 'das/ /bla ma dang po'i mgon po'i bkra shis shog /ces dag pa rab 'byams/ kyi brtan g.yo ma lus pa'i ngo mtshar kun skyed par byed pa/ dpal ldan lhan skyes kyi zlos pa'i rol gar chen po zung 'jug sgyu 'phrul dra ba kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan longs spyo da rdzogs pa'i skur mngon par bzhengs pa/ bcom ldan 'das bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po dang po'i mgon po gang gi gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bkra shis nye bar 'bebs pa'i bden tshig sngon du btang ste/ ji skad du/ rnam dag dbang bzhi tshul bzhin bskur ba yis/ /zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i dga' ston gyi/ /longs spyod mchog la sbyor mdzad rdo rje 'chang / /'jam dbyangs bla ma'i zhabs kyi padmo la/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ smin byed rgyu'i dbang bzhi tshul bzhin bskur te/ grol byed lam gyi dbang bzhis bsdus pa'i zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i dga' ston gyi longs spyod mchog la legs par sbyor bar mdzad pa/ grol ba 'bras bu'i dbang baji/'i ngo bor gyur ba'i sku bzhi'i go 'phang la bzhugs pa/ rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan rgya mtsho bdun pa zhes mtshan gyi rol cho/ srid zhi'i rgyan du che ba/ dpal

)(/༷/44/ — — nga ldan bla ma dam pa 0/nga gi khyo/bas kyi padmo gsang chen lung rtogs kyi sbrang rtsi mi zad pa'i gter du rdzogs pa'i drung du gus pas zhu bar bya ba'i snying bo ni/de yang rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyis ga/sang ba bla na med pa'i theg pa dang 'brel ba'i byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du phyag rgya srog rtsol du song ba dang / lus la gnad du bsnun pa sogs phyi nang gi thabs kyis drangs pa'i bde stong dbyer med 'od gsal gyi ye shes dam pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te ye shes kyi tshogs rlabs po che bsags/ dam pa rigs brgya sogs kyi lus dbeen sngon du btang ste rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i srog rtsol gyis snying ga'i rtsa mdud lhag med du dkrol/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi rlung gi rgyu ba ma lus pa mi shigs pa'i thig le ga bu kha sbyor gyi dbus su bcug ste thim pa lugs 'byung gi stong bzhi'i bzhon pa'i rlung las/ skye ba lugs ldog gi nyer thob mngon du gyur ba'i dus na/ khyad par bco lngas khyad par byas shing / dpe rnam pa bcu gnyis mtshon par bya ba 'ja' lus rdo rje sku zhes grags pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du byas te bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags/ rgyu phar phyin theg pa dang rgyud sde 'og ma la gtam tsam yang ma grags pa'i thun mong min —pa'i tshogs gnyis de lta bu nyams su bstar ba laru bden gnyis dbyer med zung 'jug zhes grags pa dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du mdzad/ slob pa mtha'i 'od gsal rgyun mtha'i rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin rgyas kun rtog dang / las rlung gi rgyu ba phra mo tshun chad drungs nasaphyungs te/ ji skad du/ rmad byung mtshan dpe gaṭashaṃl 'bar longs spyod rdzogs/ /

105/spa sbyor bde stong ro la rtag rol cing / /dmigs med thugs rjes zhi ba'i mtha' spangs pa/ /rgyal ba yan lag bdun ldan/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rnam kun mchog ldan gyi 'bras bu mthar thug pa zung 'jub/ yan lag bdun ldan gyi go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa na/ zhing khams mtha' yas par gdul bya so so'i khams dang mthun par theg pa sna tshogs kyi chos kyi 'khor lo mtha' yas pa bskor/khyad par du gling 'dir ston pa phun sum tshogs pa/ dbang phyug dang ni sa/zugs bzang dang / /dpal dang grags dang ye shes dang / /brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa ste/ /drug po rnams la skal ces bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi legs pa drug dang ldan zhing / bdud bzhi phra rags sogs bcom nga sa bcom ldan 'das de nyid/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung bugs kyi snying bo bde ba chen bo'i chos kyi dbyings kyi 'byung gnas la bzhugs/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa zung 'jug sgyu ma'i rol gar gyis rtsen pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo brjod kyis mi lang ba/ chos phun sum tshogs pa rgyud sde thams cad kyi rtsa ba/mdo sde thams cad kyi za ma tog mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i rgya rnam bar btab pa/ rgyan bdun gyis legs par dkrol bar bya ba/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa sogs kyi chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/tshul de nyid 'jig rten du dar rgyas su mdzad pa la/ rgyud don snying bo rin chen ke ta kaḥ/ dri bcas sems kyi chu mtshor zhugs pa'i mod/ /ma bcos gnyug ma'i gshis lugs dwangs pa'i 'od/ /gsal rdzogs grub

106pa'i tshogs rnams phyag gi yul/ /zhes pa'i bstod bsngags kyi yul tu gyur pa/ 'phags pa yab sras lnga dang / phyu nag dril gsum/ la li ta badzra sogs grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams bka' drin dang 'phrin las 'gran zla dang bral ba lags la/ rang re bod yul gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir/ ji skad du/ mkhas dang grub pa'i gtam snyan beeḍūr mdangs/ /lus la chags pa'i gangs ljongs wa skyes tshogs/ /ri dwags rgyal bor rdzu yang smra ngan sgra/ /rang tshul brjen par ston pa'i me long bzhin/ /zhes pa ltar gyi mkhas pa grub par rdzu ba du mas/ gsang sngags kyi chos 'chal bar btang ba na/ mdo sngags mtha' dag khyad par rdo rje theg /rgyud sde mtha' dag khyad par bla med theg /bla med mtha' dag khyad par sgyu lus la/ /sngon med legs bshad gter chen khyod la 'dud/ /ces bsngags pa ltar/ /'jam mgon bla ma tsong /ba ba de nyid kyis/ mdo sngags kyi bstan pa mtha' dag gi dri ma bsal/ khyad par rgyud sde bzhi dang / de las kyang bla med/ de'i yang sgyu lus gtso bor byas pa pha rgyud ma rgyud mtha' dag gi gnad la log rtog gi dri ma lhag med du bsal te rgyal ba'i bstan pa mtha' dag nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin ni gangs can pa spyi nas gzhal bar dka' ba'i sa/nas su che ba lags la/ gser ljongs rig pa 'byung ba'i zhing 'di'i dbang du byas na/ rtogs brjod las gtan gyi skyabs su bla ma gcig pu bzung / /rgyun du bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa phul/ /byin rlabs stobs kyis bstan 'gro'i

101don chen bsgrubs/ rī /dam pa'i rnam thar 'khyongs/ zhes pa ltar/ yab rje bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho de nyid nas/ grub chen 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi rnam 'phrul rje btsun chos pa rin po che de nyid gtan gyi skyabs gnas mthar thug dang / 'phral phugs kyi sku don che phra mtha' dag la thugs rtse gtod sa gcig tu bzung / rgyun du bshad sgru ba kyi bya ba gang mdzad bka' bzhin bsgrubs/ bshad sgrub kyi sde chen po gnyis phyag 'a debs gnang / 'chad nyan sgom sgrub kyi me tog chos brgyad kyi shun pas ma gos par yang dag par mchod/ bla ma la bsten nas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs dang 'phrin las khyugs te bshad pa legs bshad kyi sgra dbyangs rgyun mar sgrogs pas// sa ngas rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad/ sgrub pa nyams bzhes kyi ting nge 'dzin dus khor yug tu bskyangs pas/ mdo smad kyi ljongs 'dir sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa'i shing rta'i lam srol yangs por phye/ gzhan phan 'phrin las kyis sa chen kun tu khyab pas bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che grub ste/ phyag rgyas 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba da dung yar rgyas su yod pa 'di bzhin lags la /yab rje bla ma de nyid slar yang sprul ba'i zlos gar bsgyur ba skyabs mchog sku phreng gnyis pa la paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyis rgyud grwa 'dzugs dgos kyi bka' babs/ rje btsun rdo rje phag mos bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi rgyud kyi glegs bam phul te bskul ma mdzad/ dam can chos kyi rgyal bos rgyud tshugs shig gi brda thabs mdzad/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis yun 'gyangs che ba la re 'khang mdzad par brten/ rgyud grwa

— 108sa/sang chen chos kyi bang mdzod 'di nyid phyag 'debs mdzad/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sgrub mchod/ rgyud dang bskyed rdzogs kyi 'chad nyan/las bzhi'i 'phrin las kyi man ngag sogs rje'i bka' srol dri ma med pa/ dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang gi phyag bzhes ji lta ba bzhin btsugs te gsang chen bstan pa'i snying bo ljongs 'dir nam yang mi nub pa'i bka' drin gzugs can du gyur ba 'di lags shing / tshul de la 'di skad kyang gleng bar bya ste/ nye lam gsang chen zab mo'i 'phrul 'khor gyis/ /zla lam zhag gis gcod pa'i rnal 'byor ba/ /dpal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde 'di na/ /mngon sum bzhugs pa'i skal bzang 'di rmad byung / /zhes zhu la/yang sgos su gsol ba 'debs pa'i snying bo dam pa ni/ ji skad du/phyi skal ldan rgya mtsho sprul ba'i sku/ /nang yon tan kun rdzogs 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /chos gsang pa thugs rje che na po dngos/ /pha skyabs ma gon bdun pa zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skyabs mgon mthong ba don ldan nyid ni/phyi drang don gdul bya'i snang ngor yab rje mchog gi skye ba sprul sku'i rnam pa bstan zhing / nang nges don gshis kyi grub tshul la shes bya'i rnacha/ pa rjen char du gzigs pa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang dbyer ma mchis shing / shin du gsang ba mchog gi ngo bo'i gnas tshod du/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi snying bo'i rang gzugs 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po dang sa/nyis su med pa ni lung tshad mas grub pa ltar lags la/ gdul bya thun mong gi snang ngo dang mthun pa'i yang dag pa'i mdzad sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul ji ltar

1skyenyas/nang ba yang / rje mtshan ldan bla ma 'i zhabatrari/ bsten pas/ /dbang rjes gnang lung khrid man ngag gi /gter mi zad dam pa'i chos kyi mdzod/ /pha skyabs mgon bdun pa/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i rnam sprul khri chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi rnam sprul spyan ras gzigs a rol lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ 'jigs mdzad rwa chen rdo rje grags kyi rnam sprul kun mkhyen rdo rje 'chang 'jigs med rgya la ba'i snying bo sogs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i theg pa mchog gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ rgya/la mchog phyag na padmos/ rigs kun ngo bo mi bskyod rdo rje/ /kha bshad rtogs med slob dpon mi na no / /snang ba thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i/ /grub thob brgyud pa'i bla ma lags so/ /a ho ye bla ma lags so/ /zhes pa dang mthun pa du ma'i zhabs pad gus pas mchod de smin byed spyi bka' dang zur bka'i dbang chen/ byin rlabs rjes gnang dang rigs gtad gang mchis/ grol byed dmar khrid dang bshad lung brgya phrag rgyab rten lung gi tshogs mtha' dang grangs ma mchis pa bzhes te/dam pa'i chos kyi gter chen mi zad pa'i bang mdzod gcig pur gyur/khyad par du/ thugs mkhyen rab nam mkha'i sgo phye bas/ /chos mdo sngags rig gnas ma lus pa'i/ /don ji bzhin kun mkhyen parnyi ta//pha skyabs mgon bdun pa zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lhan skyes nas mkhyen rab thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i sgo yangs por phye bas/ mkhas par bya ba'i gnas thams cad gzigs pa tsam gyis legs pa ra mkhyen cing dgongs pa
