༷ sde ༷1/ //)/ la shā ra byu dang / rtsod dus kyi paṇḍi ta chen po yongs 'dzin chos kyi rgya la bo 'jam dbyangs blo bzang dpal ba yongs 'dzin gyi go sar cha/nga' gsol/ tshul dang mthun pa'i bsten tshul ma nor bas yang dag par bsten te/ bslab gsum rgyas par ston pa sde snod rin chen rnam gsum/ zab gsal gnyis med kyi rnal 'byor gsal bar ston pa rgyud sde 'og ma rnam gsum/ rim gnyis rjen par ston pa bla na med pa'i rgyud sde/ sgyu lus rtsal du 'don pa pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/ bde stong rtsal du 'don pa ma rgyud 'khor lo sdom pa/ phas rgol tshar gcod kyi rig gnas sgra dang tshad ma'i rig pa/skal ldan rjes 'dzin gyi rig sa/nas bzo gso ngo mtshar gyi rig byed/ gzhan yid mgu byed kyi rig gnas snyan ngag sdeb sbyor gyi tshig sbyor/ 'jig rten bde skyid kyi rig gnas dus dbyangs 'byung rtsis kyi rig byed sogs thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gzhung lugs yod do cog la sbyangs pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu phyin te kun mkhyen pazlo ta chen po'i mtshan snyan bdag gir mdzad/ thos don nyams banes su thun bzhi thun drug gi rnal 'byor rgyun chags su bskyangs pas mdo sngags kyi rtogs pa thams cad klong du gyur/thos bsam sgom gsum gyis thugs rgyud lung rtogs kyi nor bus yongs su bkang / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis bstan pa mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan dgung la sgrengs/ 'khor lo gsum gyi legs mdzad rgya che bas bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad pas/ don dang mthun pa'i grags pa dang 'phrin las shugs 'byung du rgyas te rgyu skar gyi khrod ma/ zla ba/ rkang 'thung gi tshal na dpag bsam bzhin du lham me lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs pa'i skabs nyid

— — 11)kyin/ dpal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde 'di'i thun mong nas gsol ba'i ngor/ rgyal kum/ snying rje'i rang gzugs 'phags mchog rgya la ba rgya mtsho nyid ni/ 'phags lugs kyi dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha so gnyis pa / snu lugs kyi dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha re gnyis pa/ dge lugs kyi dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gtsa bor bzhengs/ gdul bya'i rgyud la sku bzhi'i sa bon rnam par dag pa 'theb nges kyi dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur/ de yang sngags rim chen mo dang rje bka' brgyud kyi phyag len ji lta ba bzhin gzhir mdzad/ rgyud dang dgongs 'grel dri ma med pa'i gsung bshad 'byams klas pas nges shes mtha' chod pa gnang / )ོna gyi ngo bo 'dril la gsal bas gnad don lag mthil gyi rdzas bzhin bstan/ dbang brda sprod pa sogs dus dang dus su dmigs phigs nas ngo 'phrod par mdzad pa sogs thun mong du'ang mkhas pa dang grub pa'i rnam thar gzugs can bzhin du bstan te brtse bas rjes su bzung ba'i gsung gis re ba bskangs pa'i bka' drin ni stong gsum yid bzhin gyi nor bus bkang ste phul yang cha tsam bsab ga la nus/ 'on kyang dkyil 'khor rdo rje phreng ba las/ rang gi lus dang sa ga/zhi dang / /mdor na rgyal ba de 'dra ba/ /ji ltar bla ma mnyes 'gyur bya/ //bla ma mnyes na dngos grub 'gyur/ /zhes / bla ma'i yon tan dang tshogs 'khor gyis mchod pas mnyes par bya dgos par gsungs pa'i don mtshon byed tsam dumo ྾ ྾bcas 'bul lam zhu kṣi/nga /yid la brnags pa'i 'dod don snying bor zhu ba ni/ 7skyabs mgon

112 — — — rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid nas zung 'jug nyi ma'i sku la skye 'chi'i 'char nub nam yang mi mnga' ba'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad par ma zad/ nged cag gi skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i gzugs sku rags pa'i nyi ma 'di yang rtag brtan g.yung drung gi ngo bor rtag tu 'char ba dang / bstan 'gro'i spyi bye brag gi phan bde mtha' dag yar zla bzhin gong 'phel du 'gyur ba dang /yang sgos su/ tsā yongs 'dzin 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i gser zhal las/ rje khyed kyi sger skal gdul bya'i zhing / /yul reb gong gser mo ljongs chen du/ /dus snyigs ma'i rgud pa kun zhi nas/ /g.yang bde skyid nyi ma 'char bar mdzod/ dpal rong bo bde chen chos 'khor gling / /'di dbus ljongs pad tshal ltar rgyas nas/ /chos bshad sgrub bya ba'i 'khor lo yis/ /lung rtogs pa'i bstan pa 'phel bar mdzod/ ces gsungs pa de ltar du/ phur tshugs su gsol ba snying thag pa nas mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig gis 'debs pa legs na/ re 'bras zhal bzhes me tog spyi bo'i rgyan tu rtsol ba mkhyen mkhyen zhu lags/ /

113skyabs mgon mchog gser khrir gsar bzhengs kyi kha dar 'bul skabs bstan pa sbyi'i rnam gzhag bshad pa gzhan gyis 'thus pa byas te gsham du 'dogs rgyur gnang ba/khyad par du bis ba parnyi ta ngag dbang mi pham zla bas/ rong ston chos kyi rgyal bo'i 'phrin las kyis/ /gser ljongs dkyis 'khor rnam par dkar ba 'di/ /stong phrag zla ba'i spu long rab g.yos pas/ /snag rim lhag med byas pa'i mthu 'am ci/ /zhes bsngags pa ltar/ gser ljongs yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du dam pa'i chos kyi srol yang dag par 'byed pa po ni/ ji skad du/ 'phags mchog rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis/ bdag gi sprul ba dam pa zhig /res 'ga' dge slong nyid du sprul/ gsungs pa bzhin/ gru 'dzin zhing gi thub pa rnam 'dren phyag na padmo bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i parnyi ta dang grub pa'i khyu

—314 — mchog gnam gyis sa gab pa lta bu byon pa dag gi khrod na zla med pa// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i mdo sngags kyi sgra dbyangs nam mkha'i mtha' klas par sgrogs pa'i thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i rtsa lag yab rje bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo lags la/ rnam 'dren bla ma de nyid nas thun mong snang tshod du'ang / ji skad du/ mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang / mo ྾ mo'abad/ ces pa ltar/ sa steng na 'gran zla med pa'i mkhas grub sum cu rtsa gsum spyir bsten/ bye brag tu rgya mtsho'i mtshan can rnam gsum sogs tshul bzhin bsten te/ mdo dbus gnyis char du mdo rgyud man ngag rnam pa gsum char la zhib tu sbyangs/ dus 'khor yug dpe cha mang po la/ /blos dpyad cing zhib tu bltas pa'i mthus/ /sngon dbus su slob gnyer byas pa las/ /don go ba sum 'gyur bas kyang lhag /gsungs pa bzhin rgya bod kyi bstan bcos legs par bshad pa gang yod la nyams len khor yug tu gzigs zhib mdzad pas sgro 'dogs thams cad lhag med du chod/ nga lo re tsam gyis bya btang min/ /lo bco brgyad bcu dgu nyi shu nas/ nga lo grangs drug cu re grangs par/ /gnas dben pa skabs skabs 'grim mkhan yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ lho rgyud dang byang rgyud kyi dben pa'i dga' tshal brgya phrag du mar/ chos brgyad kyi rnam rtog 'og tu mnan/ dka' thub kyi spyod pa nyams su bstar te bslab gsum rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs spobs mngon shes kyi sgo mtha' yas pa la 'jug ldang byas pas / sgrub 'bras kyi rtogs pa ma lus pa klong du bkaul te zudasna 'jug grub pa'i sa mthon po la gshegs pa ni/ nga mi la ras

— — —— ———ci——rsāzhe— —zhe —4— —— —— ———bhe———— — 11byo pa gnyis pa'i bu/ /blo chos song chos kyang lam du song / /rkyen bar chad med par bsam don grub/ /'di bsam na bla ma'i drin du gda'/zhes gsungs pa ltar la/ de lta bu'i mkhas pa la 'os pa 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ bstan 'dzin la 'os pa bshad sgrub rnam gnyis/ dam pa la 'os pa sdom gsum rnam par dag pa sogs mdzad pa'i spyi babs dang cha phra mo re tshun chad mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog pa sha stag tu gyur zhing /khyad par du/ sa rdo rje 'dra ba'i sked pa nas/ /mi khyod kyis sgrub brgyud bstan pa spel/ /zhes lung bstan pa'i 'bras bu smin pa'i dus la babs pa na/ mdo sngags lung rigs kyi sgra dbyangase phyogs bcur sgrogs pa'i mkhas dbeng khri phrag mang po'i 'byung gnas bde chen chos 'khor gling du/ dpal thos bsam rnam par rgyal ba'i sde chen po 'di nyid phyag 'debs mdzad de/ dus dang por mtshan nyid grwa tshang btsugs/ /de mi lo bzhi bcu'i bar du bskyangs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar chos srid gnyis char gyi sgo mas yun ring bskyangs pas/ ljongs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar gyur/ yab rje bla ma de nyid slar yang sprul ba'i zlos gar la brten pa mdo smad kyi 'phags pa nye bar 'khor chen po ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang srid pa gsum gyi rtse mor 'phags pa'i 'phrin la sa kyi gdugs dkar po mtha' dbus kun du sgrong ba dge 'dun 'phrin las rab rgyas/ ngo mtshar byams brtse'i rtogs pa klong du gyur ba'i rnam thar ches cher ngom pa blo bzang chos grags rgya mtsho/ thu na mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i shes bya rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la sprobs

116 pa lhan skyes nas mnga' ba blo bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho sogs skyabs mgon sku phreng rim byon gyis bstan 'gro'i phan bde spyir spel zheng / yang sgos su thos bsam rnam par rgyal ba'i gling spyan gyi 'bras bu dang / thugs kyi ze'u 'bru bzhin du bskyangs te bshad sgrub rlabs kyi phreng ba ljongs 'dir ci yang rgyas par mdzad/ khyad par du luja dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad lhun gyis grub pas thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i srid la dbang sgyur ba/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi skye bo dmu rgod pa rnams thabs mkhas zad mi shes pa'i 'phrul gyis yang dag pa'i lam la 'god pa/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang mtshan brjod par dka' ba/ phyag na padmo blo bzang skal ldan bstan pa'i rgya ra mtshan dpal bzang bo de nyid nas/ chos srid kyi 'phrin las/ zung du 'jug pas gser ljongs yangs pa'i 'jig rten 'di'i phan bde dgung du spel ba ni/ mkhas mchog dpa' bos/ de'i mtshon byams pa'i ru mtshon phra mo'i dpung gi cho ga tsam/ /des ni mi khro tshig rtsub mi smra bar yang legs par srung / /de yi bka' khrims chos min rgyu med nor yang dam pa mchog /de ltar rmad du byung yang ngan pa'i chos srid grags pa med/ /ces gsungs pa mngon sum du babs pa lags shing / da ni ji skad du / legs bshad 'phrul gyi lde mig las/ phyag na padmo'i gsang gsum sa bon mchog /mthon po'i rigs kyi zhing sar btab pa las/ / lus can yongs kyi dbugs 'byin phan bde'i gsos/ /mi dbang dge spyong lo tog 'di ko bltos/ /'e/sa gsungs pa ltar/ 'phags mchog phyag na padmo rnam 'dren bla ma sku phreng rim byon gyis bdag cag thugs jis

117gzigs pa ma btang bas/ skye rgu ma lus pa'i gtsug gi nor bu/ sa gsum gyi sgron me gcig pu/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi dmigs bu dam pa/ rtegs ldan rma tha' yas pa zil gyis gnon pa/ skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa/ gong sa bdun pa chen po 7 skal ldan blo bzang 'phrin las lung rtogs rgya ma tsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam rgyal dpal bzang bo nyid ni/ skyes chen dam pa zam ma chad pa'i rigs phun sum tshogs par sku'i skye ba bzhes/ pha rol mi mthun pa'i dgra sde mtha' dag thugs rje mi zad pa'i dpung gis zil gyis mnan/ rang gi chos srid sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor g.yang du chags pa'i pho brang gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i sa/zhal med khang du zhabs sen bkod/ de na sa bzung mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal bo'i gser zhal las/ lus kyi myu gu dang bor gyur ba yi//gnas skabs der yang yon tan me tog ni/ /dpag med dri bzang rdzogs pa'i snying bo can/ /'di lta'i ngo mtshar su yis bsam mi bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sku na phra mo'i gnas skabs nas/ sku'i gzi/ gsung gi gdangs/ thugs kyi dkyeshāsdo/ gang sa nas sprul ba'i zlos gar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang rtags yongs su rdzogs pa'i gsang gsum gyi phung bo zad mi shes pa'i rang mdangs gzugs can nyid du gyur cing / rigs brgya'i khyab bdag khri chen dang po'i mgon po 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho/ spyan ras gzigs dbang a rol chos kyi rje blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kun mkhyen bla ma chen po 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho ste/ 'gran zla med pa'i bla ma gsu ma/

118 'brom ston rgya‘ra ba'i 'byung gnas kyis mnyam med jo bo bsten pa lta bu'i bsten tshul yang dag pas bsnyen te dbang lung man ngag gi rgyun mtha' dag bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan zin dang gsan bzhin pa'i mus su bzhugs shing / gser ljongs yul gyi gnas lnga gzigs pa'i ma hā partsi ta 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal bo yongs 'dzin rnam pa gnyis las/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig pa'i gnas phyogs med la sbyong ba'i sgo 'phar yangs por grol zhing / bsdus tshad sogs bka' pod chen po'i gzhung don mtha' dag brda phul ba tsam gyis sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes kyi gzigs pa dar la babs te lung dang rigs pa'i legs bshad kyi dga' ston nam mkha' mdzod kyi bang mdzod kha phye bas/ rtsegrags snyan gyi rol mo dbyangs su khrol ba'i nga ro srid zhu'i khams ma lus pa'i rna ba'i rgyan du gyur cing /bdag cag skyabs mgon mchog gi 'phrin las kyi grib bsil snum po la skyabs 'cha' ba'i skye bo dregs zhan thams cad kyis mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig gis/ e ma bdag cag gser ljongs yu la gyi 'gro ba rnams skal ba bzang ngo / /thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen mgon dang bcas so/ /bstan pa la zhugs pa rnams ston pa dang ldan no/ /zhes bsngags brjod kyi bstod dbyangs rang dbang med par ci yang spro zhing / ji skad du/ shes rab me long gtsug lag kun la gsal/ /'phrin las dpal gyis 'gro kun 'bangs su sdudi/ /gzi byin chen pos gzhan phyogs zil gyis gnon/ /thugs bskyed mchog gis bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel/ /zhes gsungs pa ji lha ba bzhin legs ca/dzad kyi bkod pa mtha' dag chad lhag dang bri gang

119mede par gru bzhi lam mer ston pa 'di nyid nged cag gang la re ltos 'cha' ba thams cad kyi yid la bla na med pa'i bdud rtsi kho na lags la/da skabs su babs pa'i don gyi zhu snying ni/ ji skad du/ rnam 'dren bla ma'i mgur gyi bang mdzod las/ /spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i yang snying ni/ /chos bshad dang sgrub pa rnam gnyis yin/ dpal mtshan nyid grwa tshang thams cad du/ /lung rigs par sbyong ba'i phyag srol gnas/ /de sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gzhi mar snang / /zhes dang / chos bshad pa'i grwa de tshugs tsa nari/ /dus nyin re bzhin gyi dge sbyor dang / /'dzin gshar spyang bgro gleng byed tshul la/ /yid dbang med dad pa skye na yang / /lo lon cing thin tu rgas pa 'dis/ /chos 'jig rten gyi khur 'di 'khur ma nus/ /de ma nus grwa tshang gang gis skyong / /bu rjes 'jug kha gzhon dge bshes tshogs/ /rang gang nus grwa tshang 'dzin skyong gyis/ /zhes bka' stsal ba ltar/ /sangs rgyasga kyi bstan pa'i snying bo bshad sgrub 'phel ba'e gzhi ma ni/ lung dang rigs par sbyong ba'i phyag srol bzang bo nyid yin zhing / de lta bu'i lung rigs smra ba'i grwa tshang rin chen 'di nyid 'phel zhing rgyas pa ni/ chos bzhin tshul bzhin skyong ba la rag las pas na/ rje rang gi bu slob dge bshes gnam gyis sa gab pa lta bu dag dang / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu gser gyi ri bo lhun chags pa 'dra ba rnams kyis pha shul bus zin pa byas te/ gzhung chen mo so so'i brtsi bzhag gtong ba/ spyi don mtha' dpyod kyi sgo mas dpe khrid gnang ba/ lung rigs kyi lam nas brdar sha gcod du 'ojug pa/ de dang de la skabs/ skabs su rīzhiṅge tshags ri

120mdzad pa / tshegs 'dzin skyon 'dzin gzengs bstod gang 'os dus las mi yol bar dge rgan dge phrug 'dzin grwa skyor dpon so so sor sor bkod khyab gnang ste rim bzhin bskyangs/bye brag tu/ 7skyabs mgon sku phreng rim byon gyis chos srid kyi 'phrin las thung du 'jug pa'i sgo nas ma mdzangs mas bu gso ba bzhin du bskyangs pa de ltar lags pas na/ da ni kun gzigs skyabs mgon bdun pa chen po nyid mas kyang / thub pa rdo rje 'chang skal ldan rgya mtsho yab sras kyi chos kyi khri la/ 7zhabs sen gyi padmo rnam par bkod de/ rang cag gi kun mkhyen bla ma chen po partsi ta 'jigs med zhabs kyis/ mkhyen pa'i yon tan bye ba'e dpal dang ldan/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi'i thigs pa phyogs su spro/ /nam mkha'i mthar yang gzhan don 'ba' zhig la/ /gzhol bas gang 'tsham mdzad pas 'gro rnams skyong / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mkhyen pa dang brtse ba'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa mtha' dag mngon du mdzad/ bka' pod chen po lngas mtshon pa'i bdud rtsi phyogs su spro zhing /gzhan don 'ba' zhig la gzhol ba'i mdzad pa gang la gang 'tshams kyi thabs mkhas chen po dang bcas pa nam mkha'i mthar yang skyong ba dang /chos 'dul ba'i bca' khrims/ gzhi gsum gyi phyag len/ spyi dang sger gyi nang khrims/ bshad dang sgrub pa'i lam srol sngar yod gong 'phel gyi thabs la bka' khrims btsan la brjid che ba gnang ste gong ma rim byon gyis khrir bskyangs pa bzhin skyong ba dang / khyad par du grwa tshang thos bsam rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du/ rgya bod kyi gzhung chen mo rnams gung bsgrigs te dge

— dzha 11//klo/rdoX rnon rmermes dpe khrid rgernoprergyu/ dgephrug so sos de dag la nyin mtshan khor yug tu tshul bzhin lta rtog byed rgyu/ bsdus tshad kyi rigs pa'i rnam 'gyur 'dra la mi 'dra ba/ rno la mang bas rkang 'dzug sa pa/ tre/ rigs zung du 'brel bas gzhung chen so so'i dgongs pa dpyis phyin par gtan la 'beb tshul/ bka' pod chen po lnga'i don rnams bsla ba pa gsum du dril te nyams len gyis gzhung bsrings/ mkhas pa'i yan lag tu thun mong ba'i rig pa'i gnas la sbyangs pa/ bstan pa'i rgyun la dgongs te dbang khrid lung gsum gyi chos bka' gsan pa/ bstan 'gro'i don la dgongs te bla ma dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen mornams mas dpe khrid dang chos rgyun spel ba sogs kyi lugs srol bzang bo yod pa rnams dus kyi dbang gis nyams che ba 'di dag thugs kyis dgongs te thabs mkhas zhi drag gi mdzad pa sgo sna tshogs kyis nyams pa thams cad gsos te chos sde 'dir thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bstan pa thams cad rgya mtsho chen po sa la bskyil ba bzhin/cha thams cad nas gru bzhi lam mer yod pa mdor na/ yab rje bla ma'i dus na bshad sgrub kyi bya ba ji ltar yod pa de ltar du dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa zhig mgon po nyag gcig pu la re ltos byed na/ re sa dang ltos sa nas nam yang slu ba mi mdzad par ji skad zhus pa'i don thams cad thugs la bsnams nas chos srid kyi mdzad 'phrin phul du byung bas rnam 'dren bla ma ji lta ba bzhin skyong ba zhig khyed mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ zhes bdag cag bla ma khri ga da na zur/ bka' rab 'byams dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ rgan las sne spyi sde ba/ dge 'dun bgres gzhon yod do cog gis snying khung rus pa'i
༷ 1skyitswa/rte —— — rna — gting nas gsol ba 'debs pa lags na zhal bzhesadonayoda'aphrulagyi ci me tog cichi yang stsol ba zhu zhu lags// //

— ri cho—la — — —— la ༷ /shā/kyiX/rab rgyal lcags rta lor skyabs mgon bdun par gser khri'i kha dar phul ba'i skabs kyi bshad lan/ 'o lags so/ phun tshogs bde 'dir bshad sgrub bya ba 'phel/ /phun tshogs lung rtogs bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas/ /phun tshogs phan bdes 'jig rten kun la khyab/ /phun tshogs dpal gyis mdzes pa'i bkra shis shog /ces ngo mtshar ba'i rten 'byung lhun gyis grub pa'i bden tshig kun tu bzang bo'i me tog char du bsnyil te bshad lan gyi rim pa cung zad spro ba'i dbang du btang na/ de yang a lags tshang nas/ ston pa 'jig rten du byon tshul/ bstan pa sa steng la dar tshul/ bstan 'dzin rim byon gyis phebs tshul/ yang sgos rang re'i ljongs 'dir yab rje bla ma byon tshul/ thos bsam rnam par rgya la ba'i gling btab tshul/ de nyid kyi bka' srol dri ma med pa mkhan khri rim byon gyis bskyangs tshul/ phran bu'ang de dag gi phyag srol bzang bo skyong dgos tshul nan tan pos gros rgyab byas pa ngag gcig pa'i tshul du ga/sung ba thams cad nged kyis kyang don rdo rnams yid la nges po byung / de la sangs rgyas gnyis pa mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ mngon cipar mtho ba bde ba ste/ /nges par legs pa thar ba yin/ /zhes

༷////rdo44/ — lke — — sa —— — — gsungs pa ltar/ lha dang bcas pa'i skye dgu mtha' dag gis 'phral yun gyi 'dod bya la gnas skabs su lus mngon mtho/ 'khor ma ngon mtho/longs spyod ma ngon mtho gsum gyis bsdus pa'i bde skyid dang / mthar thug rgyang chub gsum gyis bsdus pa'i nges par legs pa gnyis la sa gzhan yod pa ma red/ de lta bu'i phan pa nges legs dang bde ba mngon mtho gnyis kyang rgyu rkyen gyi thabs khyad par can sngon du ma song bar rkyen med rang byung gi tshul gyis 'byung du med pas na rin po che'i phreng bar/ de yi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus na/ /mdor na dad dang shes rab po/ /zhes sgrub byed kyi thabs de gnyis po gsungs pa red/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yang mngon mtho nges legs gnyis po sgrub par byed pa'i thabs de gnyis las phung gsum pa med par grangs nges pa can yin pas/ slob dpon chen po 'phags pa lhas/ mdor na chos ni mi 'tshe bar//de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis gsungs/ /stong nyid mya ngan 'das pa ste/ /'di ni de gnyis 'ba' zhig go /zhes lung don rigs pa'i rgyab rten can 'di 'dra gsungs byung ba yin/ /de ltar skye rgu'i phan bde thams cad mngon mtho nges legs gnyis su grangs nges/ de sgrub byed thams cad smin byed la las 'bras dang grol byed lta ba'i chos skor gnyis su grangs nges/ deri gnyis po sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i ngo bo las gzhan du ma dmigs pas na/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thugs rje can de nyid kyis ris su ma bcas pa'i 'gro ba 'di dag mngon rma tho nges legs la 'god pa'i rtsis btang / smin grol gyi chos zab mo 'jig rten

— 125 0la khyab brdal du spel ba'i thugs bzhed gnang ste bla na med pa'i byang chub smol dmigs pa'i sems bskyed/ bya dka' la grangs mang ba'i spyo da pa sku nyams su bstar te/ ring mo nas bzhed pa'i don mtha' dag mngon par grub pa na/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'i zhal nas/ 'og min gzhal yas khang du ni/ /yang dag ma ngon sum mdzad par 'dod/ /sangs rgyas rtog pa mi mnga' bas/ /gzugs kyi sku ni yang dag 'byung / /sprul ba'i skus ni sa steng du'ang / /yang dag byang chub ston par mdzad/ /ces pa ltar longs sku dang sprul sku'i ngo bor rim par sangs rgyas/ sangs rgyas nas kyang spyi sger gyi mdzad pa mtha' yas pa mdzad na'ang sa/tso bo ni/ ji skad du/ gling las skyes sogs phal cher ni/ /gzhan gyis gang smras smra bar bgyid/ /khyed kyi thun mong ma yin chos/ /rang gis thugs su chud nas bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phan bde gnyis po 'grub byed kyi chos gsungs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zhes sgra che ba de nyid kyi lam srol 'jig rten 'dir thog mar phyesapate nyi ma dang zla ba bzhin shin tu gsal bar mjad pas rang cag rnams kyis nam yang gzhal dka' ba'i bka' drin yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal bo char du phab pa de red/ de lta ba'i bstan pa rig ri ringarin po che de ka rigs rus stobs 'byor dang mnga' thang btsan brjid kyis 'dzin skyong spel bar byed pa ma yin par/ lung gi bstan pa'i ngo bo 'chad nyan rnam dag dang / rtogs pa'i bstan pa'i ngo bo sgrub pa rnam dag gis 'dzin skyong byed dgos pas/ 'dzam gling mkhas pa 'dus pa'i gtsug rgyan paṇi ta dbyig gi gnyen pos kyang / ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ /

126 lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de 'dzin byed pa smra byed pa/ /sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ /zhes rnam bcad yongs gcod kyi sgra dang bcas nas bka' stsal ba 'di go dgos pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i thabs ma nor ba bshad sgrub kyi bya ba gnyis po de yang / nga dang nga 'dra ba bla ma sprul sku zhes ming snyan la don stong ba/ rgyal bo blon po tshe/sa mtho che la chos chung ba de 'dra la rag ma las par/ lung sde snod gsum la 'chad nyan dang / lam bslab pa gsum la nyams len byed mkhan gyi dge 'dun gyi sde la rag las yin/ de lta bas na/ skye rgu rnams kyi phan bde ni/ /ma lus rgyal ba'i bstan las 'byung / /bstan pa'i chu bo 'phel ba'i gzhi/ /dge 'dun chu gter chen po lags/ zhes mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsu nga tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis bka' stsal 'dug pa de red/de'i gnad kyis rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du'ang paṇḍi ta de snyed cig byon pa dag gis dpal na lend+ra dang / bri ka ma la lta bu'i chos gzhig sum brgya btsugs pa dang / drug brgya btsugs pa lta bu chos 'byung so so na gsal ba ltar la/ bod 'dir yang mkhan slob chos gsum gyi dus na klog pa thos bsam gyi ched du chos grwa zhes pa bshad pa'i sde dang / spong ba bsam gtan gyi ched du sgom grwa zhes pa sgrub pa'i sde mang du btsugs pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dkar 'jam yug gcig gis khyab par mdzad/ bka' gdams gong ma tshos kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i dkar thig la dgon pa bre zhabs re yin rung 'debs dgos zhes gsungs shing gsungs pa lhar

127phyag 'debs kyang mdzad pa red/ khyad par du lha mo dri ma med pas zhus pa las/ byang phyogs gangs ri'i rgyud du ni/ /dge dang ldan pa'i sa phyogs su/ /dam pa'i chos de rgyas par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / gi 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ khyod ni byis pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyur/ /de tshe dgon chen rab dga' ba/ /kha ba can na yod pa yin/ /zhes lung bstan pa ltar rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying bo de nyid kyis dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btabs/ tshul de la brten nas rgya ma tsho chen po las chu bo dang / dpag bsam gyi ljon pa las yal ga gyes pa bzhin du ma bu lag gi dgon sde che phra mang bo 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan dam par ci yang chags/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i gser zhal las/ mdor na yab rje dam pa'i bka'/ /rgyal ba'i rang lugs yongs rdzogs pa/ /nyams pa med pa'i bka' drin mdzad/ /phan mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yab rje chos kyi rgyal bo tsong kha ba chen po'i bka' srol/ rgyal ba'i rang lugs yongs surdzogs tshul bzhin skyong ba la zla dang bral ba/ 'jam dbyangs gtsang pa bdun rgyud sogs dga' ldan gser khri rim byon gyis chos kyi mkhan khri do na dang mthun par yang dag par bskyangs/ tshul de dag dang mthun par rang re'i yul ljongs 'dir yang /bka' gdams glegs bam las/ bdag gi sprul ba dam pa zhig /res 'ga' dge slong nyid du sprul/ /tshe/sa pa ltar/ 'phags mchog phyag na padmo'i sgyu 'phrul rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho de nyid nas/ skye rga'i

—12gi — bde skyid bstan la rag las shing / /de yarnga lung rtogs dam chos rgyas pa la/ /rag la de yi slud du khyod kyis ni/ /rna ma dag bshad dang sgrub pa'i sde gnyis btsugs/ /zhes pa ltar/ lung rigs gnyis kyi 'chad nyan brgyud mar byed pa bshad pa'i chos sde rong ngo thos bsam rnam par rgyal ba'i gling dang / mdo sngags yongs su nyams len brgyud mar byed pa grub pa'i chos sde gnas mchog bkra shis 'khyil phyag 'debs mdzad pas/ chos bshad sgrub sde gnyis lag rjes la/ /khong lung rigs mkhyen pa'i mkhas rtepa dang / /tshe phyi ma don gnyer bya btang gis/ /phyogs 'di na nyi ma shar ltar mdzes/ /ces gsungs pa ltar byung shing / bu slob yang slob dang bcas pas sgrub pa'i sde bcod brgyad sogs dgon ma lag khor yug gang ba bskrun pa de lta red/ tshul de lta bu'i bshad sgrub kyi sde gong du 'phel zhing chos gyusde zhes pa'i mtshan don dang mthun pa 'byung ba yang / mkhas shing bzang bo'i yon tan rgya cher rgyas pa'i mkhan po bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi bdag po zhig la rag las pa yin/ de skod du'ang / gang gi drin las dge 'dun gyi/ /chu mtsho yongs su gang gyur ba/ /lung rtogs nor bu'i gdengs ka can/ /bshes gnyen lag 'gro'i dbang bo lags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar red/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir chos sde 'di ka'i mkhan khri rim byon thams cad /la thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin pa/ 'chad rtsod rtsom shasum la thogs pa med pa/ rtsol med shugs 'byung gi 'phrin las che ba sha stag phebs su bcug pa de red mod/ da skabs dus kyi snyigs ma la slebs pa'i mtha' dbus gang na'ang dam pa'i rnam thar bdag gir bzhes palī

129dam pa spyir dkon/ — rang re'i ljongs kṣi ridir yang tho rangs/ri kyi skar ma bzhin du gyur /nas chos srid kyi chu bo bri gang med pa zhig la gsol ba 'debs pa dkal song bas bla brang chen mo nas mi skyong kha med lta bu dang / phal cher gyi re 'dun dang bstun nas gser gyi khri la nga rang sdod dgos kyi nan tshig 'di bzhin byung ba yin rgyu yin thang /— chos sde chen po'i mkhan po zer ba de spyir na skyes bu dam pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig dgos pa yin/skyes bu dam pa'i mtshan nyid la/ mkhas pas grub pa ma bcom 'ing /grub pas btsun pa ma bcom par/ tsho/—bstan la phan pa sgru ba pa la/ /skyes/ bu dam pa zhes kyang zer/ /gsungs pa ltar/ mkhas grub gnyis 'dzoms/ bshad sgrub gnyis ldan/ spyi sger gyi bstan pa la phan pa yang dag par sgrub thub pa zhig dgos/ nga rang lus kyi na ma rdzo gas/ sems kyi stobs ma rgyas/ yon tan gang yang ma sbyangs pa zhig la de 'dra'i mtshan nyid tshang ba'i re ba sus byed// lhag par du mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi mas/dam pa rnams kyi chos kyi khri/ /legs bshad smra ba'i dpal gyis mtho/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sde snod chen po gsum dang bka' pod po lnga sogs kyi legs bshad bra—ga thog nas chu ri'aphyo barme lta bu zhig bsgragos nas grwa tshang rin po che 'di la gzhon nu— rigs pa smra ba pad mtsho la ngang mo rtsen pa ༷ lta bu/ — dgag sgrub smra ba'i bshes gnyen gangs ri la seng ge 'phyong ba lta bu/ legs ba shad smra ba' mkhas pa— gdan khrijil tshangs pa 'gyings pa lta bu/ —gcig las gcig lhag pa/ gcig las gcig che ba/ sprurgya las stong 'phel ba'i tshul du yong nges shig byed dgos rgyu yin pa gzhir gzha ga

11()() — — — yin tsa nardo bdag la de 'dra'i shes rgya yong thang / ri bong la glang chen gyi khur 'degs/ bong bu la cang shes kyi gom 'phros yong nge ma dmigs kyang / rang ngos nas thub tshod nus tshod lcogs tshod kyis gdung bzung /bla ma rdo rje 'chang rnam pa tsho la chos srid kyi skyong lugs/ 'phral yun gyi don skor thams cad gsung bkod zhus/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal bo yongs 'dzin rnam pa gnyis la rogs tan bcol/ grwa sa rang gi dge bshes gzur gnas rnams la gros bstun te/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi dgongs dang ma thun pa/ byang chub sems6dpa'i sde snod dang mi 'gal ba/bca' yig chen mo'i tshig don la bstun pa/ yab rje bla ma'i phyag gsol la gnas pa'i 'grig lam kun spyod/ chos 'chad nyan/ bshad pa dang sgrub pa'i phyag srol sngar yod gong 'phel gyi thabs la hur thag byed dgos rgyu red/ de la khri ba gcig pu la ma ltos par khyed rnam pa dngos gnas/tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la nici rab tu sbyor/ /gsungs pa ltar/ bstan pa'i gzhi ma tshul khrims rnam par dag pa srung ba gzhir bzung nas/ thams cad sgom pa sum char la rab tu 'bad de/ grwa tshang rin po che'i la rgya zin pa/ bstan pa rin po che'i rgyun la phan pa zhig byid dges/ de yang thog mar thos bsam phu thag chod pa zhig mdzad pa/phyi nas rang don sgom pa byed kyang / gzhan don 'chad spel mdzad kyang sla bas na/ 'o skol gyi ston pa rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen pos kyang dge sems ngang nas gsung rab tshig gi don/ /thog mar thos dang bsam pas sgro 'dogs chod/ /phyi nas thos bsam sgro 'dogs chod bzhin du/ /dbeen

131par song ste bsgoms na don yod do/ /zhes kyang bka' stsal ba red/thos bsam byed pa'i tshul la'ang sgo mang yang / gtsa bor lung rigs kyi lam nas rtsod pas brdar sha gcod pa 'di mchog yin/ de'i phyir 'jams dbyangs kha che paṇa chen gyis kyang / kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob pa la/ /rgya chen shes bya kun la mkhas par 'tshal/ /lung rigs nyan bshad slob gnyer 'gog pa rnams/ /chos spong sdig pa ma gsog snying gtam yin/ /zhes gsungs par snang / de lta bas na/ rgyugs rtsi bzhaga'adzin skyor sbyong / bslab pa slob gnyer la rang khur mdzod dang / nged nas kyang skyabs mgon sku phreng rim byon gyis chos sde 'di ji ltar bskyangs pa/ gser khri rim byon gyis kyang chos 'chad nyan gong spel ji ltar gnang ba de lta bu zhig mi 'byon yang e 'byon lta la/ legs bshad 'od brgya'i snang ba can/ /bshes gnyen nyi ma gcig gis kyang /dzo /thub bstan gling bzhi ma lus pa/ /gcig char nyid du gsal bar nus/ /gsungs pa de lta bu la yid smon 'cha' ba yin pas/ thams cad kyis de don thugs la bsnams par zhu// //

— 1sna 1spras pa/ namyo/ mkha'i mthong las babs pa/ rgya gar paṇa chen ngur smrig gis klubs pa gangs can gyi ljongs la gshegs pa bzhin du/ legs tshogs yon tan gyis brgyan rngapreḍiri bla ma sprul sku/ bslab gsum ngur smrig gis mdzes pa'i dge 'dun brgya phrag rigs rus stobs 'byor gyis dregs pa'i dpon po du ma/ ngo mtshar mdzes 'phyor gyis sgeg pa'i stag shar rgan gzhon/ rta bsus pa dang mchod bsus pa'i bkod pa mkha' la sprin tshogs 'khrigs pa/sa gzhi la me tog dum bur chags pa ltar gyis spyan drangs te/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa ma dang mkha' 'gro mang pos lung gis bsngags pa/ rin chen sa 'dzin gyi ri bo mkha' la snyegs pa/ thang chen dpag tshad kyis gzhal ba mtha' grur yangs pa/ yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu bo gya rgyur bgrod pa/ rtsi bcud dbyar gsum gyi dus na g.yu mdangs rgyas pa/ sna tshogs me tog gi sil ma rgyan du rgod pa/ rtse gzhung dga' ba g.yas su 'khyil ba zhes lha yul sa la 'phos pa/ klu yul mkha' la lhags pa lta bu'i gnas/ gzhi dag pa chos kyi pho brang dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du bsgyur ba nas/ chos stsol ba po phun sum tshogs pa gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po nyid bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis/ snying rje dga' ba bcu drug thugs rje sum cu rtsa gnyis/ zag med brgya dang zhe bzhi sogs yon tan gyi rigs ma lus pa sku bzhi'i ngo bor brnyes pa'i dpal ldan dang po'e sa ngas rgyas stong gzugs mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po mthar thug pa'i ngo bor skur bzhengs te/ slob ma phun sum tshogs pa mgon po nyid kyi nang thugs/ kye sras gcig sogs skyes chen gyi dam pa/ nyams rtogs kyis phyug

— ༷/༷nga dbang ston gyi khang bzang la nyi zla skar gsum gyi bla re bres rung / nags tshal dpag bsam gyi ljon pa la lha mi'i rin gyi me tog bzhad kyang /rgya mtsho'i lan la rmig chu/ nam mkha'i lan la lag mthil/ ri rab kyi lan la rdul phran gyi dpe las ma mchis kyang / ji skad du/ slob ma la ni yon bslang tshi/nga / /des kyang4 gus pas dbul bya ste/ /rin yid 'ong chung ma dang / /rang gi lus dang sa gzhi dang / /mdor na bya ba de 'dra ba/ ji ltar bla ma mnyes 'gyur bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyisamanyes byed mchod pa'i sprin phung / bka' drin gtang rag gi maṇḍal mtshon tsam dumo mo 'ibacas 'bul lam zhu ba lags na/ 'di skad ces kyang brjod pa/ mgon khyod bskal brgyar mi 'gyur rtag brtan cing / /thub bstan dpal mophyogs kyi mthar rgyas shing / /'gro rnams bde skyid gar gyi yongs rtsen pa'i/ /bku shis rgya mtsho'i sa gsum khyab par mdzod/ /ces pa'i don bzhin/ mtha' dbus yul gru ma lus pa'i lte bar snyigs dus kyi skyon mtshangaklong du rdol ba'i skabs 'dir lhag par thugs bskyed dang snying stobs kyi go cha cisakyang gzhom du med par ya lad du bgos te/ rtag brtan mi 'atso g.yung drungartadam pa'irang khams sa'atsho bzhes nas/ sngar mu rshazhin sa lung rtogs zungartsa'abrel gyi thub bstan spyi dang bye brag khyad par gser mngog cod pan 'chang ba'i rang srol/ nges 'byung sdom gsu ma gtsang ma'i brturka/zhugs kyi spyong pa dag pa/ bying rgod skyon dang bral ba'i rim gnyis kyi smoca nga/ brtam pa/ rtag chad mtha' dang bral ba'i rnal 'khyor gyi la ba zab pa sogs 'tshol bral bstan pa'i snying bo phyogs mthar rtswa

/11 41//411/ gu la la skyong ba dang / thub bstan rgyas shing 'gro kun bde skyid kyis 'tsho ba'i bkra shis phyogs khyab tu 'gro ba'i bka' drin thugs gsang rin po che bang ba'i za ma tog tu bsnams pa dang / khyad par du ma 'ongs pa na 'jasaudabyangs rnam sprul rigs ldan drag po'i 'khor lo dpa' gtum drag spyod kyis rol ba'i zlos gar ci yang bsgyur te/ yan lag bzhi ba'i dpung tshogs pa chen po 'di la go mtshams med pa'i rnam 'gyur gsal bar dkrigs te/'jigs pa mi zad pa'i nga ro dbyangs su 'tsher zhing khro gtum drag shul gyi —khro gnyer bzhin la rdzogs nas/ 'jigs shing drag po'i mtshon chas bar snang la nyi zla rgyu ba'i go skabs kyang 'phrogs pa lta bu'i drag po g.yul ngor spyod pa'i mdzad pa sgyu ma chen po'i 'phrul du rtsen pa na/ skyabs rje rigs kyi bdag po nyid kyang blon po gtum chen g.yu thod ces zhu ba gtum zhing drag la dpa' zhing rtul phod pa/ gzi brjid che la drag shul chas su rdzogs pa/ sku dbang che la bsod nams dus su bdo ba sogs rgyu skar gyi khrod na zla ba/rkang 'thung gi tshal na dpag bsam gyi ljon pa bzhin du phebs pa'i dus su/ nam zhig gsang ba drag po'i chas rdzogs nas/ /pha rol mi bsrun drag po'i g.yul ngo la/ /'joms pa'i rtse dga' nyams pa med pa'i dus/ / dgra thabs las kyi 'khor lor snying nas re/ /zhes kyang zhu ba'i don bzhin/ bdag cag rdo rje slob ma rnams kyang mu stegs g.yul ngo 'joms pa'i dpung tshogs su gyur nas pha rol dgra sde mi bzad pa'i dpung kun dbyings su bcom ste/ rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal bogyiyab rje bla ma yab sras gdan 'dzoms naso 'jam mgon tsong khe pa'i ring lugs snying poro byu

146 dang po'i sangs rgyas 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal bo kun mkhyen bla ma 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas chu bya lor seng ge gshong du thi ka la tsakra'i a bhi khyu gnang skabs kyi bshad pa la spel ba/oṃ bde legs su gyur cig /dpal ldan nyin byed bye ba'i 'od zer gyi/ /mdangs kyis 'khyud pa padma rā ga yi/ /ri dbang sma tshogs gar gyis rol pa'i dpes/ /dpag bya bcom ldan dbang pos dge legs stsol/ /ces srid zhi'i dge legasakyi sgo 'phar yangs por grol ba'i rten 'byung rmad du byung ba'i bden tshig gi 'od ris phyogasasu spros pa'i sgo nas/dpal ldan thub pa mtha'aXdag gi gdung 'tshob chen po/ rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying po'i rang lugs kyi bdag po/ dben sa bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa'i srog shingagacig bu/ rnam 'dren skal ldan ras pa'i chos brgyud kyi yub/ bdag cag rnaddha/sa/ kyi me rtag phog pa'i lhaskal/ skyabaglegacigadursā kyistonapa rdo rje'achangachen rba gang si zhabs skyegs sreng zhi'idregs pa can

141mtha' dag gis dbang med du 'dud pa/ 'dod rgu'i dngos grub ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas gang gi nye drung ga la bar/ skabs su 'os pa'i gtam tshogs latig gi phreng bar spel ba sdebs legs tshig gi shing rtas rnam par 'dren pa la ci yang brel ba ni/ dag pa dang ma dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi bkod pa rgya dang phyogs su ma lhung ba'i dbus na bskal bzang rnam 'dren stong gi phyag mtshan du bzhes pa'i zhing khams mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bya ba stegs bu la me tog dang ri rab la bang rim bzhin du bkod pa mdzes par chags shing / gang gi lte bar dzam bu'i rgyal mtshan gyi rkang 'thung ral ba'i cod pan du 'dzin pa/ lho gling grub pa'i gnas mchog 'di la/ bskal ba bzang bo'i sangs rgyas rim par byon pa dang 'byon par 'gyur ba mtha' dag pas sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa ston pa las deng gi dus su/ 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med don kun grub pa de nyid nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul bstan te/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams la theg gsum mdo sngags sna tshogs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor pas lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten mtha' dag dge legs kyi snang ba yug gcig gis khyab par mdzad de / nag phyogs bdud kyi ris ma lus pa spa bkong / dkar phyogs lha mi'i tshogs mtha' dag pas ni rgyal ba'i rnga brdung / mtho ris dang thar ba'i sgo 'phang rnam par phye bas na/ phan pa dang bde ba'i dpal mi zad pa'i dge ma tshad mtha' dbus yongs la rgyas pa 'di lags la/ byang sems sa chen po la bzhugs pa rnams dang sprul ba'i nyan thos dbag tu med pa'i

)(sna /spre — citshogs bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun dang shing rta chen po rjes 'brangs bcas pas 'phags pa'i yul du thub pa'i ring lugs mya ngan med pa'i rkang 'thung yongs su brkyangs pa dang / gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir bsod nams mi zad pa'i dpung ba stobs su mtho ba'i chos rgyal rim byon dang / lo paṇa gser gyi ri bo lta bu rnams kyis rgyal bstan 'dzam bu'i mchod sdong spyir bskyangs shing / rig 'dzin badma 'byung —gnas dang rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogacasagasang sngags snga 'gyur ba dang / ‘ jo 'brom yab sras sogs mnyam med bka' gdams pa dang / sa chen gong ma lnga sogs dpal ldan sa skya pa dang / mar mi dwags gsum sogs bka' brgyud pa rnams kyis chos tshus g.yas 'khyil dung gi sgra 'gog med mkha' khyab tu bsgrags pas grub mtha' so so'i sgo nas bde bar gshegs pa'i rang lugs rnam par dge ba'i dpal du bsgrubs pa re re nas ya mtshan pa'i gnas kho na yin na'ang / khyad par du mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal bos/ tshogs gnyis rlabs tshen spyod pa shar ri'i rtser/ /rgya la sras dpa' bo smra ba'i zla ba 'dzegs/ /thub bstan ku mud bzhad pa'i dpal yon can/ /rje btsun bla ma snying gi mun sel rgyal/ /zhes rgya cher bsngags pa ltar/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mes po/ / bstan pa thams cad kyi bdag po/ gangs ljongs tshad— ma'i ston〉pa rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying bodngha de nyid— nas rtag chad kyi mtha' rmang sa— —nas khegs pa'iji'akhrul bral dbu ma chen po'i lam bzang dang / — gsang tshon rdorje theg pa'i 4zabaphulablu zung duwābrel ba snyi—nga bor byas pa'i bstan pa thams cad gru ba zhi lam gyis khyer ba'i bka' srol gser —mdog —cod pan

144'chang ba'i rang lugs dru ku la'i gos dkar yug gcig gis stod dza ti'i me tog rgyas pa'i sanas shar rgya mtsho chen pa'i 'phang ba la thug gi bar du brkyangs pas rgyu skar gyi dbus na zla ba dang / rkang 'thung gi tshal na dpag bsam bzhen du grub mtha' gzhan las khyad par du 'phags shing dri ma med pa'i bka' srol de nyid 'dzin pa'i skyes bu po ni nam mkha'i skar tshogs las grangs mang / chos kyi dgon sde ni phyogs 'tshams khor yug tu tshom bu spungs pa las/ bdag cag gser ljongs yangs pa'i zhing 'dir/ bis pa partsi ta ngag dbang mi pham zla bas/ rong ston chos kyi rgyal bo'i 'phrin las kyis/ /gser ljongs dkyil 'khor rnam par dkar ba 'di/ /stong phrag zla ba'i spu long rab g.yos pas/ /smag rum lhag med byas pa'i mthu 'am ci/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gang gi 'phrin las kyis gser ljongs yangs pa'i 'dzin ma la phan pa dang bde ba gzugs can bzhin du mdzad spra'i byed po/ bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel pa'i paṇḍi ta dang grub pa'i khyu mchog gnam gyis sa gab pa lta bu byon pa dag gi khrod na zla med pa'i ston pa rdo rje 'chang 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i legs bshad kyi sgra dbyangs nam mkha'i — tsho mtha' klas par sgrog pa'i thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i rtsa lag rme spyan ras gzigs dbang skyabs mgon skal ldan rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo ni/ ji skad du/ mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang / /bstan paṃ'i snying bo bshad sgrub rnam gnyis dang / /dam pa'i rnam/ thar sdom gsum nyams len la/ /phan tshun 'gran bzhin 'bad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar 'chad rtsod rtsom gsu/ma/ bshad sgrub rnam gnyis/ sdom gsum nyams len

150so so'i ngos nas rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying bo'i rang lugs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i rnam thar mkhas pa rnams kyi yid 'phrog pa sha stag tu gyur cing /khyad par du/ sa rdo rje 'dra ba'i sked pa nas/ mi khyod kyis sgrub rgyud bstan pa spel/ zhes lung bstan pa'i 'bras bu smin pa'i dus la babs pa na/ legs par bshad pa mi zad pa'i nga ro bsnyings pa med par sgrogs pa'i mkhas dbang stong phrag du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal bde chen chos —'khor gling du thos bsam rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang gsar du bskrun pas/zhing 'dir rgyal bstan gyi chu bo mtha' dag gang las 'byung ba'i ma dros kyi rgya mtsho chen por gyur pa 'di bzhin lags shing / skyabs gcig 'jam pa'i rdo rje nyid ni bskal ba dpag tu med pa'i snga rol nas sa bcu'i rim pa yongs su rdzogs te stobs bcu'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad zin na'ang /mtha' klas pa'i gdul bya gar dmigs su sku'i 'phrul ba dpag tu med pa bstan pa ni chu zla'i grangs bzhin gzhal du ma mchis shing / lho phyogs dzam bu'i cod pan gyi rtse mo mkha' la reg pa'i gling mchog 'di nyid du yang /sbyan dang mngon shes kyi gsang ba mkha' dang mnyam pa rgyal sras blo gros rin chen/ zung 'jug lhan skyes kyi phyag chen brjen par mjal ba grub chen sha wa ri ba/ mthu nus gnam lcags kyi 'khor los nag phyogs phye mar 'thag pa rwa lo rdo rje grags pa/ dus mthar mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug 'gran zla dang bral ba grub dbang 'jigs med bsam gtan sogs 'khrungs rabs myu thi li'i phreng ba mtshar du dngar zhing /

151khyad par du gser ljongs yul gyi paṇa chen mi pham zla bas/ blo bzang rgyal pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /mkhyen rab thogs med nam mkha'i sgo phye nas/ /rmedzam gling chos kyi nyi ma khyod shar bas/ /phyogs kun dge legs 'odajikyi lham mer mdzes/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par sku tshe 'di la gzhon nu nas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi byin rlabs kyi 'od zer ci das/ra reg pas mkhyen rab kyi padmo rtsol med du rgyas pa'i steng / ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa de bzhin gshegs pa rab gsal rgyal bo'i rnam 'phrul zhwa dmar parnyi ta dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ rigs gsum zlos pa'i ya gyal de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer kun 'phags dpal brtsegs rgyal bo'i rnam sprul khri chen rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi mes po rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ rgya chen gnas lnga gzigs pa'i parnyi ta blo bzang dpal ba sogs mkhas grub nyis 'dzom gyi skyes bu 'dzam gling na mtho la grags che ba du ma'i zhabs sen zur phud kyi rgyan du 'bral med du mchod de/ bstan pa'i gzhung shing sde snod rnam gsum/ bstan pa'i snying bo rgyud sde rnam bzhi/ bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan thun mong rig gan sa sogs cha lag phra mo tshun chad nas lus pa med par gsan pa dang / sbyangs pa rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol du son pa mdzad cing / smin byed dbang gi chu bo/ grol byed khrid kyi lde mis/ rgyab rten lung gi dpung tshogs/ gser zhun cod pan 'chang pa'i rang lugs kyi bgrod pa dag la med mi rung gi chos skor rnams ga'/na dang bsre bslad dang lhag lus med par brtson pa chen pos yang dag

15 2 —sprerno bzhes/ bka' bab tshad ma kun ldan/ snyan brgyud gser gyi yang zhun man ngag bdud rtsi'i yang zhun dag ni thugs la bum pa gang byo'i tshul du bzhes pas dri ma med pa'i rang lugs kyi bstan pa mtha' dag rgya mtsho chen po sa la bskyil ba bzhin du 'tsho bzhes pa dang / 'phral gyi kun spyo da phra mo nas kyang chos 'dul pa'i lag len dang bstun pa phyi gtsang nang gtsang padmo'i chun po bzhin du gyur pa dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i pha srol gra ma nyams par mdzad ngos bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi nyams bzhes thun drug thun bzhir chu bo'i rgyun ltar bskyangs/ rtogs pa mi zad pa nam mkha'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag tu phyes/ mkhas pa la 'os pa 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dam pa la 'os pa 'phrin las rnam gsum 'gog pa med pa sa chen po'i mtha' dbus ma lus pa la khyab brdal du 'jug pa na ris su ma bcos pa'i phyogs kun dge legs 'od kyis lham mer mdzes shing gsal ba 'di bzhin lags la/ de lta bu'i skabs nyid na bdag cag rgan gzhon thams cad kyis dad 'dun rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas bgrang bya lo grangs du ma'i snga rol nas yang dang yang du/ gsol 'debs dbyangs kyi rol mo ci yang bsgrags pa la brtse ba chen pos zhal gyis bzhes te/ 'khor slob dag pa mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa sha stag gis mdun bdar te dgon sde 'di nyid du byon nas snga phyi du mar rje yab sras kyi legs bshad/ chos kyi phung bo mtha' dag gi snying bo gcig tu 'khyil ba/ sa gsum gyi rin chen gcig bu rnams kyi bklag lung nam mkha' srid kyi bar gnas pa'i bka' drin bskyangs/ dus phun sum tshogs pa nag pa zla ba'i yar tshes bzang bo

gyu — 1shuX)ge'adi nyid la/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po nyid bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis/ snying rje dga' ba bcu drug thugs rje sum cu rtsa gnyis/ zag med brgya dang zhe bzhi sogs yon tan gyi rigs ma lus pa sku bzhi'i ngo bor brnyes pa'i dpal ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas stong gzugs mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po mthar thug pa'i ngo bor sku bzhengs te/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa/ skye rgu ma lus pa'i gtsug gi nor bu dam pa/ ris su ma bcas pa'i bstan pa mtha' dag gi sgron me/ yangs ba'i 'jig rten ma lus pa'i phan bde'i mtshungs med/ mtha' dbus kyi rtogs ldan mtha' klas pa'i dkyil 'khor ba sku gsung thugs kun tsu blozang bo'i gzi byin lham mer bzhugs pa gyigong sa skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa bdun pa chen po dang / sku'i phreng bar mkhas pa dang grub pa'i brtul zhugs yang dag par bzhes shing / lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gi 'dren pa gcig pu/ bstan pa'i dar chen phyogs mthar skyong ba'i 'phrin las kyi bka' babs chen po/ rong chen kirte sprul ba'i sku rin po che dang /—che rgu'i dkyil 'khor rnam par rgyas pa'i dbus na nyi zla ltar yongasabyusu grags pa'i skyes chen dam pa bse khri rgan rin po che sogs bstan pa 'dzin pa'i blalke sprul/ nyams rtogs kyis phyug pa'i bya btang / mdo sngags la mkhas pazhi bshes gnyen/ sdom gsum la gces pa'irī rab byung / dad gus kyis brgyan pa'i stag shar sogs phyogs nas 'a dus pa dang / yaspru rje rdo rje 'chang sku snga phyis thugs rjes bzung zhing spyan gyis bskyangs pa/ —chos kyis bstod cing srid kyis skyor ba/ khong yab sras kha dad pa brtan cing / sdu

1//blo44/ — — ske— dam tshig gtsang ba/ sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes kyis sems rgyud gtams pa/ seng ge gshong skya ser dang bcas pa la/ chos phun sum tshogs pa gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo'i smin byed dbang gi sta gon/ byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun/ gong ma gong chen rdo rje slob dpon chen po'i dbang mtha' rten dang bcas pa/ sngon dus ston pa rdo rje 'chang gis shrī rte na kar chos rgyal zla ba bzang po sogs dang / cha bsags grong gi blos bslang du rigs ldan 'jam dbyangs grags pas drang srong nyi ma'i shing rta sogs la dbang kun rdzogs par bskur ba dang cha mtshungs par gnang ba ni/ e ma mi 'jigs khri la zhabs bkod nas/ /legs par bshad pa rgya mtsho'i gar gyi rol/ /sa gsum myos pa'i dga' ston rnga yab kyis/ /thub bstan dus kyi rdzogs ldan bos pa bzhin/ /zhes kyang dar dir du sgrogs pa la 'gro ba 'di dag ci yang brel bar gyur to/ /de lta bu'i bka' drin gzugs can du grub na/ srid rtse las 'phang mtho kṣing / nam mkha' las zheng che ba dang / mgon po nyid kyi sku'i tshod du dpag na/ stong gsum gser gyi maṇḍal la gser dngul mu tig gi tshom bu bkod kyang / nam mkha' dbang sngon gyi khang bzang la nyi zla skar gsum gyis bla re bres rung / nags tshal dpag bsam gyi ljon pa la lha mi'i rin chen gyi me tog bzhad kyang / rgya mtsho'i lan la rmig chu/ nam mkha'i lan la lag mthil/ ri rab kyi lan lagirdul phran gyi dpe las ma mchis kyang /ji skad du/ slob ma la ni yon bslang bya/ /des kyang gus pas dbul bya ste/ /rin chen yid 'ong chung ma dang / /mdor na bya ba de 'dra ba/ /

— —— — 11/5/bloji ltar bla ma mnyes 'gyur bya/ /zhese gsungs pa ltar gyis mnyes byed mchod pa'i sprin phung / bka' drin gtang rag gi maṇḍal mtshon tsaca/ du/mo mo mobacas 'bul lam zhes zhu ba lags na/ 'di skad ces brjod la/ mgon khyod bskal brgyar mi 'gyur rtag brtan cing / /thub bstan dpal mo phyogs kyi mthar rgyas shing / /'gro rnams bde skyid gar gyis yongs rtsen pa'i/ /bkra shis rgya mtshos sa gsum khyab par mdzod/ /ces don bzhin/ mtha' dbus yul gru ma lus pa'i lto bar snyigs dus skyon mtshang klong du rdol ba'i skabs 'dir lhag par thugs bskyed dang snying stobs kyi go cha cis kyang gzhom du med par ya lad du bgos te/ rtag brtan mi 'gyur g.yang drung dam pa'i rang khams su 'tsho bzhes nas/ sngar mu bzhin du lu nga rtogs zung 'brel gyi thub bstan spyi dang bye brag khyad par du/ gser mdog cod pan 'chang ba'i rang srol/ nges 'byung sdom gsum gtsang ma'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa dag pa/ byangarurgod skyon dang bral ba'i rim gnyis kyi sgom pa brtan pa/ rtag chad ma/tha' dang bral ba'i rnal 'byor gyi lta ba zab pa sogs 'khrul bral bstan pa'i snying bo phyogs mthar skyong ba dang / thub bstan rgyas shing 'gro kun bde skyid kyis 'tsho ba'i bkra shis phyogs khyab tu 'gro ba'i bka' drin thugs gsang rin chen dbang bo'i za ma tog tu bsnams pa dang / khyad par ma 'ongs ba na 'jam dbyangs rnam sprul rigs ldan drag po'i 'khor lo dpal gtum drag spyod kyi rol ba'i zlos gar ci yang bsgyur te/ yan lag bzhi ba'i dpung tshogs pa chen po 'di la go mtshams med pa'i rnam 'gyur gsal bar dkrigs te/

156 'ji gas nga/ mi zad nga ro dbyangs su 'tsher 'i/nga khro gtum drag shu' gyi khro gnyer rdzogs nas/ 'jigs shing drag po'i mtshon cha bar snang la nyi zla rgyu ba'i go skabs kyang phrogs pa lta bu'i drag po g.yul ngor spyod pa'i mdzad pa sgyu ma chen po'i 'phrul du rtsen pa na/ skyabasacirje rigs kyi bdag po nyid kyang chos kyi rgyal bo chen po 'jigs med zil gnon sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/chos srid kyi gzi byin mtha' dag sgo thams cad nas thams cad du rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po dang gnyis su med pa lta bur phebs pa'i dus su /nam zhig gsang ba drag po'i chas rdzogs nas/ /pha rol mi bsrun drag po'i g.yul ngo la/ 'joms pa'i rtse dga' nyams pa med pa'i dus/ /dgra thabs las/ kyi 'khor lo snying nas re/ /zhes kyang zhu ba'i don bzhin/bdag cag rdo rje slob ma rnams kyang mu stegs g.yul ngo 'joms pa'i dpung tshogs su gyur nas pha rol dgra sde mi bzad pa'i dpung kun dbyings su bcom ste rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal bo yab rje bla ma yab sras gdan 'dzoms nas 'jam mgon tsong kha pa'i ring lugs snying por gyur pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo spyi dang / dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i gsang chos rgya cher stsol ba'i bdud rtsi longs su byas te zung 'jug sku bzhi'i go 'phang rgyal thabs su blangs nas mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i phan bde ci yang spel pa'i shis pa dngos grub du zhu zhu/ zhes gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs pa lags na/ bka' rjes skyong zhal bzhes bzang po bde chen spyi bo'i mdzes rgyan/ thos 'dzin rna ba'i bcud len/ yi ga bsil ba'i gsos sman/ sems zung sa bdud rtsi'i snying bor khyed mkhyen mkhyen lags/ /

157rdzong dkar zhal snga nas blo bzang chos 'phel rgya mcho rong bo'i gser khrir gsar bzhugs skabs khri bshad du thugs bzhed ltar spel ba /'o lags so/ de yang ji skad du/ rmad byung yon tan gting mtha' mi mngon 'i/nga / /lung dang rigs pa'i rlabs phreng chal chil g.yo/ /bslab gsum nor bu'i mdzod kyis yongs su gtams/ /'phags tshogs 'dus pa'i mtsho chen rgyal gyur cig /ces gsungs pa ltar rmad du ṣṭang ba'i dri ma med pa'i mdo rgyud ma lus pa'i dgongs don rang dbang du 'byed par mkhas pa'i skye bo 'ba' zhig gis bsngags par 'os pa'i yon tan gyi gting mtha' mi mngon zhing / dgag sgrub lung rigs kyi rlabs phreng bla nas bla dang mkha' nas mkhar 'phyur ba'i mu tig gi phreng ba kun gsal bu mos mgul ba'i rgyan du nye bar blang pa/ phul byung rtogs pa'i yon tan bslab gsum nor bu'i bang mdzod mi zad pa'i gter gyis yongs su gtams pa'i grags pa dkar bo'i cod pan srid pa'i rtse mor g.yo ba'i 'phags tshogs 'dus ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis gral gyi gzhi bzung / tha snya/da ② rngespu/ pa'iri me horngoka/ chun po rnam dzwa/pyod zur phud kyi rtse la g.yo/ med du

158pacings ba'i dpyod ldan bgrang las 'das pas gral gyi zur brgyan/ dad gsum mdzes pa'i lang tsho mngon par gsal ba'i phyogs 'grul ba rnams kyis gral gyi mtha' rten te/ gangs dkar cilhun gyis grub pa'i ri bor zla zhun khu bas lan brgyar byugs pa ltatshobu'i rnam dkar dang smon lam rnam par dag pa'i srad bu la/ dam tshig gtsang ba'i dri ngad khor yug tu 'thul ba'i gser gyi me tog lu gu brgyud du 'brel pa rnams 'di ltar lhan gcig tu gdan 'dzoms pa'i dbus su gang zhig gleng bar bya na/ rtogs brjod dpag bsam rin chen 'khri shing las/ji skad du/ mthong dang ma mthong bde las lam ni legs bshad kyis gsal sgron me lta bur spyod/— /legs bshad bdud rtsi'i ro ni nyams myong ldan pas mchog tu dga' ba'i char dag 'bebs/ /legs bshad don gnyer yul la gnyer bya kun mkhyen dag kyang don gnyer nyid du 'gyur/ /de slad dam pa rnams la legs bshad dang mtshungs dga' ba ci (rang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rmad du byung ba'i chos ldan gyio bya ba dang rjes su 'grel ba legs rma ra bshad pa'i gtam gyi phreng ba spel ba las blo gros dang ldan pa rnams la dga' ba bskyed pa'i thabs gzhan yod pa ma yin na'ang / bdag lta bu la mkhas pa rnam par dgos pa'i legs bshad kyi rol mo ci dgar dkrol ba'i nus pa chu shing gi snying bo dang / kun gsal gyi me tog bzhin gyur pa ni nyams rgyus can gyi thugs sa/sang 7me long gi ngos na gsal ba de ltar lags la/ 'on kyang blo gros dpag tshod tsam gyis/ chos ldan sngon rabs kyi lo rnyas zur tsam zhu na/ lus can rnams la gcig tu

sna 159nga mnyes shing gshin pa'i byams brtse'i rtogs pa klong du gyur zhing / 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa lhun gyis grub pa'i stobs kyis mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro ba mtha' dag rname par grol ba'i skal ba can du sgrub pa'i skye dgu yongs kyi rnam 'dren rgyal ba spyi dang / khyad par du rgyal ba'i nyi ma stong phrag tshar du dngar ba rnams kyis bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor las spros pa'i — lung rtogs chos kyi 'od snang gis nye bar 'khyud pa'i sgron me bskal ba 'di la sangs rgyas stong byon pa'i nang na pad ma dkar bo ltar mchog tu bsngags pa'i gnas su gyur pa bdag cag gi rnag 'dren bzhi ba shākya'i rgyal bo de nyid kyis/ ji skad du/ dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed cing / /bskal ba grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis bsas/sa/ /bar du sa/cod pa'i bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad pa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltasdo/ dang po thugs bskyed/ bar du tshogs bsags/ mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad la/ de yang kun mkhyen bu ram shing ba de nyid kyis dang po thugs bskyed pa'i tshul la ma sde rnams su sna tshogs zhig gsungs kyang / tshad ldan gyi mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhed pa ltar na dmyalta ba'i gyar sar 'khrungs pa'i tshe na smon sems bskyed cing / rdza mkhan gyi bu khye'u snang byed du gyur ba'i tshe na/nga ni sdon tshe dman par gyur pa na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub chen la/ /'jams gang zhig gis dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang po byang chub du ni sems bskyed do/ /zhes pa ltar 'jug sems bskyed/ de nas slar 'khor bsnar nam mkha'i mdun na 'don chen po bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul du

160 sku'i skye ba bache/sa pa'i tshe na/ rang sras de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying bo'i drung du tshe lo brgya ba'i dus kyi 'gro ba snyigs ma lnga bdo pa sogs kyi sgo nas nyam thag cing kha nyen par gyur ba rnams la lhag par brtse ba'i smon lamā po lnga brgya btab te bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi rtsa ba brtan po rmang nas 7gas par mdzad/ /bar du tshogs bsags tshul la/ theg bsdus las/ bzang dang smon pa'i stobs can dang / /'dun brtan khyad par 'gro ba yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' grangs med gsum/ /kun tu rtsom par mdzad pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar khyad chos bzhi ldan gyi 'jug sems rgyud la skye ba nas bzung ste grangs med gsum gyi tshogs bsags pa'i mgo brtsams shing / de nas bzung ste rgyal sras kyi spyod pa bya dka' ba grangs mang ba/ skye bo phal ba rnams kyis lta ci/nyan rang dgra bcom pa chen po rnams kyis kyang yid smon tsam yang bya dka' ba'i tshogs gnyiyokyi spyod pa rmad du byung ba skyes rabs so bzhi ba dang /brgya ba/ rtogs brjod dpag bsam rin chen 'khri shing sogs las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin thugs nyams su bstar bas sa bcu dang lam lnga'i rtogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i yal 'dab kyi grib bsil phyogs su rdzogs shing / gzhan phun gyi me tog mkha' khyab tu bzhad pa'i snang ba 'byams klas par gyur/ /mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul la/ yab sras marngal ba'i mdo las/ bskal ba dpag tu med pa'i snga rol nas de bzhin gshegs pa dbang bo'i tog zhes bya bar sangs rgyas par gsungs pa sogs ci rigs snang yang / phal bo che mdo ltar na ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs skyu

16nga sgo dpag tu med pas bsdus pa'i tshogs gnyis/ kyi spyod pa mthar phyin pa na snod bcud kyi 'byor ba nam mkha'i dbyings ltar rgya che 'ing / chu sa/terabazhin zad mi shes pa gzhi dang snying bo me tog gis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi zhing gi 'og min du nges pa lnga ldan longs sku rnam snang chen po'i skur mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te zag pa med pa'i ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig sogs mthar thug gi 'bras bu'i yon tan mi zad pa'i gter chen por gyur/ de nas/ ji skad du/ sprin bral nam mkha' dwangs bar zla ba'i gzugs/ /gcig las rang 'dra'i snang brnyan mtha' yas pa/ /rnyog bral mtsho rdzing kun tu 'a bad med par/ /'char ba'i rnam grangs sus kyang brjod nus min/ de bzhin gnyis snang spros pa kun spangs pa'i/ /ye shes mchog gi dbang phyug mthu chen rnams/ /gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul gar gyis rtsen pa'i mtha'/ /tshur mthong blo yis dpyod pa'i yul las 'das/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nam mkha'i mtha' klas par chu zla'i rol ba bzhin gdul bya rnams kyi skal ba dang 'tshams par snang ba'i sprul ba'i bkod pa mtha' yas pa ni smra brjod kyi yul las 'das par gyur la/mdzad pa phyogs gcig pa'i dbang du byas na/ 'dzam bu'i kaung 'thung gsar ba'i rgyal mtshan khur du bzung pa'i lang tsho mchog tu dar ba ngo mtshar ba'i mdzes pa phal du byung ba'i zhing 'dir/ yab rgyal bo sras ༄ gtsang dang / yum sgyu ma lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su zil gnon me rta la sku bltarma sa shing / gzhon nu'i rol rtsed la sogs pa'i legs mdzad gser gyi 'od tshogs kun nas spros pa'i 'jig rten thams cad ngo mtshar bdud

༷/ji41)shā/// —4 — — — rtsi 'i char gyis ci yang myos par byas/ de nas bla na med pa'i ye shes/ kyi bdud rtsi'i go 'phang gsar du brnyes pa'i tshul mdzad de/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams la/ rang gi khams dang bsam pa mos pa bag la nyal ji lta ba gzigs nas/ dman pa la mos pa rnams la chags bral gyi spyod pa ston phyir yul wa ra na sir/ drang srong smra ba ri dwags kyi nags su bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor zhing / rgya chen po la mos pa rnams la sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa ston pa'i phyir du ri dbang bya rgod phung por bka' bar ba mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor dang / yangs pa can sogs su bka' tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing / zab mo la mos pa rnams la chags bcas sngags kyi spyod pa ston pa'i phyir/ dpal ldan 'bras dkar spungs pa'i mchod rten dang /u rgyan chos kyi gan mdzod ri rab lhun po'i rtse mo sogs gnas nges pa med par/ zab gsang sngags kyi chos 'khor bskor bar mdzad pa'i legs rigasung dbyangs kyi yan lag mi 'jigs stobs kyi rgyud las drangs pa seng ge nga ro'i sgra dbyangs phyogs bcur bsgrags pas mu stegs phas kyi glang bo mtha' dag gcig char skrag par mdzad cing nag phyogs bdud kyi ris ma lus pa pham pa'i rgyal rnga phyogs su brdungs shing / mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo 'phar yangs por phye ba'i grags snyan tshangs pa'i rol mo 'jig rten gyi mtha' dbus kun tu khrol pa'i dge mtshan gsar du byung ba'i ston pa thugs rje can de nyid ni phral yun kun tu bdag cag rnams la bka' drin che ba mtha' dag gi rtsa ba yin la/

163de ltar rgyal bas legs par gsung pa'i bstan pa rin po che de nyid ni/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi sdug kun gyi rims nad drungs nas 'byin pa'i sman gyi ljon pa dang / phan bde dngos po zad pa med par stsorme pa'i dpag bsam gyi ljon pa lta bu yin la/ de nyid 'jig rten 'dir ring du gnas pa'i thabs ni/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ ston ba'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de 'dzin byed pa smra byed pa/ /sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lung gi bstan pa 'chad nyan dang / rtogs pa'i bstan pa sgrub pa'i sgo nas legs par gtagal phabs pa yin/ de yang bshad sgrub kyi rtsa ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i dam pa rnams kyis 'dzin skyong spel ba kho nar rags las pas na/ mnyam med zas gtsang gi sras po de nyid chos sku'i dbyings su gzugs sku'i snang ba nye bar bsdus pa'i tshul bstan pa'i 'og tu 'od srungs chen po sogs gtad rabs bdun dang / theg chen dang po'i slob dpon lnga brgya sogs kyis rgya gar shar nub kyi yul gru rnams su mdo phyogs kyis bsdus pa'i bstan pa rnams dang / rgyal po ind+ra khyu ti grub chen pa sa ra ha sogs kyis rgya gar dang / gsang 'dzin zla ba bzang bo sogs kyis dpal ldan shaṃ bha la sogs bar sngags kyi bstan pa spel pa'i bka' drin ci yang bskyangs shing / khyad par du/ bde gshegs gsung rab tshule gnyis shing rta'i srol/ /legs pa ra phye bas rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog /sa gsum 'gro na nyi ltar ba/sal mdzad pa/ /klu sgrub thogs med/ ces gsungs si ltar/ rgyal ba'i lung las bsngags pa'i me toge gi phreng ba

164 mkha' la thor zhing / thugs rje cha shas kyi dkyil 'khor yongs/ su rdzogs pa las dri ma med pa'i legs bshad kyi 'od dkar rnam par spros pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa ngan rtog gis slad pa'i 'a4la ba mtha' dag drungs na sa phyung ste/zab pa dang rgya che ba'i lam srol yangs por phye ba'i shing rta chen po rnam gnyis dang / de dag gi rgyud 'dzin dang bcas pas mdo sngags zung gi bstan pa mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan thugs bskyed kyi dpung ba brtan pos gyen du bslang pa ni gzhal bar dka' ba'i bka' drin gyi gnas su che/rang cag kha ba can pa rnams la bka' drin che ba'i lo rgyus kyi dbang du byas na/ gru 'dzin zhing gi bdag po 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug gang gi thugs rje 'od kyis nye bar bzung ba'i zhing khams gangs ri'i phreng ba tshar du dngar ba'i yul ljongs 'di nyid du/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas mi'i gar gyis rnam par rol pa mkhan slob gnyis kyis gtso mdzad pa'i lo paṇa/ skyes mchog nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar bgrangs lasa'adas pa rim par byon pa rnams dang / 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam sprul chos rgyal mes dbon blon po'i tshogs dang bcas rnams kyi dam pa'i chos kyi sgron me gsar du sbar ba dang / dar zin gong 'phel du gtong ba'i thabs mkhas 'phrul gyi byed pa khur du bsnams pa'i bka' drin mchog tu che/ khyad par du/ a tsārya dmar bo dang / paṇḍi ta shams thabs —sngon po can sogs kyis sbyor sgrol gyi chos spel pa sogs la brten/ gangs can bstan pa'i chu mtsho ngan rtog rtog mas slad par gyu ra ba'i lis/ nyid na/

— tso 16bye lha bla ma khu dbon sogs kyis sku srog la mi ltos pa'i dka' ba brgya phrag gi sgo nas/ lnga brgya pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu dpal lha gcig dri bam ka ra shrī dzñā nā zhes grags pa'i utpal kun tu bzhad pa de nyid spyan drangs te/bstan pa rin po che la dag ther dri ma med pa mdzad pas mdo sngags bshad sgrub gyi srol sngar med gsar du 'dzugs pa dang / nyams pa sor chud pa ’dang / ma nyams pa gong 'phel du gtong ba sogs kyi sgo nas bsta na pa yongs su rdzogs pas gangs ljongs dpal gyi khyon yangs bar khyab par mdzad pas 'brom ston pa chos kyi rgyal po dang / sku mched ma gsum sogs bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen sa/ser ri'i phreng ba tshar du dngar pa lta bu rim par byon pa rnams kyis bsta na pa thams cad gru bzhi — lam gyis 'khyer ba'i srol bzang bo 'di nyid mi nyams shing 'phel pa'i thabs ci yang mdzad la/ gzhan yang skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang bo bdag nyid chen po blo ldan shes rab/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug cha ba chos kyi seng ge/ gnas lnga rig pa'i gtsug rgyan sa skya paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub pa/ gangs can gyi shing rta ba chen po red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros sogs bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes chen mu tig gi phreng pa dar la brgyus pa lta bu rim byon rnams kyis bstan pa mchog tu spel bas na/ de dag gi rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa rnams bka' drin che/ de rnams spyir bka' drin che ba'i lo rgyus ni/'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ nga ni mya ngan 'edas 'og tu/ /sa yi steng 'di stongs ba na/ /khyod ni byis pa'i gzugs nyid kyis/ /sa ngas rgyas

———3(1() ————mdzad pas byed par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal bo tsong kha ba chen po de nyid rgyal ba thams cad kyi yab gcig rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor lo mthon mthing ral ba'i zur phud yongs su btang ba ste/ ngur smrig gsar ba'i bla gos zlum por 'chang ba'i gar bsgyur ba ni gor ma chag mod/ thun mong snang tshod kyi mdzad pa'i dbang du byas na/ bskal ba dpag tu mede pa'i snga rol nas rgyal ba dbang bo'i tog gi spyan sngar ma dag pa'i zhing rnams su/ mtha' bral dbu ma'i lta ba dang zung du 'brel ba'i rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang spel ba'i snying stobs kyi go cha bzhes/ mkhas pa dang grub pa'i rnam par rol ba du mas phyogs dang mtshams rnoms su bstan pa ci yang rgyas par byas shing / lhag don du/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir kha cig sngags la mos nas mdo la ca 'byin pa dang / 'ga' zhig mdo la mos pas sngags la ca 'byin pa sogs bstan pa thams cad 'gal med grogs su 'khyer ba'i lugs srol gtan nas med par bstan pa rin chen rmang nas nyams te ming gi lhag mar 'gyur du nye ba na/ lho brag mkhar chu'i gnas bshad las/ tsong kha'i yul du sku 'khrungs nas/ /'gro don dbus su skyong bar byed/ /mdo sngags gnyis kyi bstan srog 'dzin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar shar phyogs tsong kha'i yul du sku bltams shing / chos rje rigs pa'i dpa' bo don grub rin po che nas spyan gyi 'bras bu bzhin gzhon dus nas bskyangs te/ bslab ston dang bcas dbus 'gyur chos kyi zhing du rdzong brda byas shing / der yang rje btsun red mda'u ba dang / nya dbon kun dga' dang/sa ba/ mkhas grub khyung bo lhas

dngha— phru/(1//pa dang / gung gsumyo/ bde chen chos kyi dpal ba sogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i mkhas grub chen po bcu phrag gsum lhag gi zhabs pad tshul bzhin du bsten te rgya bod kyi gzhung lugs ma lus pa la sbyangs pa mthar phyin par mdzad pa ni rtogs brjod las/ de nyid phyir na mi pham chos rje dang / /'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis zhes grags pa'i/ /gzhung la phyogs re ba dang rags pa res/ /tshim par ma byas kun la zhib tu sbyangs/ zhes gsu ngas pa ltar la khyad par du gang gi yongs 'dzin thun mong ma yin pa rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal mngon sum du bstan te nyin mtshan khor yug tu lam yongs kyi ngo bo/ go rim/ grangs nges gang gi thad le yang the tshom sogs kyi dri ma phra mo tsam yang med par mdzad/ /'ol kha lha'i sdings/ re sgreng rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas sogs 'bigs byed kyi ri bo gyen du bslang ba dang / skabs gsum gyi skyed tshal sa la 'phos pa lta bu'i dben gnas du mar thos pa'i don ma lus pa thugs nyams su bstar bas nyams dang rtogs pa'i gter kha klong du rdol ba'i tshul bstan/ de dus bod gangs can ljongs na mkhas pa dang grub pa dregs pa dang che dgu'i grangs su bgrang ba mtha' dag gi zur phud kyi rtse mo la zhabs sen zla tshes gsar ba'i dog pa mngon par bkod de/ 'chad pa legs 'doms lha yi rgya chen dang / rtsod pa ngo mtshar legs bshad kyi phreng ba spyi dang /bye brag tu/ mdo sngags mtha' dag khyad patho rgyud sde theg /rgyud sde mtha' dag khyad par bla med theg /bla med mtha' dag khyad par sgyu lus la/ /sngon med legs bshad gter chen/ zhes bsngags pa'i phreng pa

16skye spel pa ltar lta ba sgyu lus kyi skor gtso bor gyur ba'i mdo sngags kyi sa/nad mtha' yas pa zhig sa 'og gi gter bzhin mi mngon zhing / mkhas pa dang grub pa'i mtshan snyan gsar bgi cod pan ci yang g.yo ba'i skyes mchog dam pa sus kyang ljags rtse g.yo ma nus pa'i gnas de dag lag mthil gyi skyu ru ra rlon pa bzhin dus kyi mthar yang gsal bar mdzad de/ bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer shes pa/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde ngazhi'i 'chad nyan/ bslab pa gsum dang / rim pa gnyis kyi nyams len ya ma bral zhing lta sgom spyod pa'i cha gang la'ang 'khrul bral gser sbyangs btso ma 'i rang khams bzhin du gyur te dpal nyams med ri bo dge ldan pa zhes yongs su grags pa'i lugs srol bla na med pa 'di nyid gsar du btsugs shing / bu slob sdom pa gsum gyi tshul khrims la gnas nas/ skyes bu gsum dang rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor lhur len cing / sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i rnga bo che rgyun mar sgrogs 'di mkhas pa nam mkha'i dbyingasdori su skase tshogs bkra ba'am/ nor 'dzin gyi gzhi la rkang 'thung 'khrigs pa/ da pyid dus kyi shing la me tog gi do shal mdzes pa lta bur bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon pa ni/ sras kyi thu bo rnam gnyis/ nang thugs kyi sras gcig pu/ 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bu chen rnam bzhi/ dbus gtsang bstan pa'i sgron me chen po bcu/ rgya chen mang du thos pa'i dbon sras gnyis/gzhan don lhun gyis grub pa'i sems dpa' drug rnam dpyod phul du byung ba'i mkhas pa gnyis/ bstan pa phyogs mthar bskyod pa'i bu chen drugaskad rngaṭa/nyis smra ba'i lo tsā pa chene po gnyis/ tshe blos btang gi rtogs ldan lnga

169sogs kyis mtshon pa'i dngos slob ya nga brgyud dang bcas pas 'khor lo gsum gyi legs mdzad bla na med pa'i sgo nas shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng gyen du 'phyur ba nas nub phyogs dza ti'i rkang 'thung gi snye ma phyogs su dud pa'i bar gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde bskrun pas phyi gtsang nang gtsang padma'i sbrubs lta bu'i ring lugs dkar 'jam yug gcig gis khyab par mdzad pa dang /khyad par du/ nang thugs kyi sras gcig bu na/khas grub smra ba'i nyi ma slar ya nga mi'i sha tshugs bzung ba paṇa chen snang ba mtha' yas sku phreng na rim dang / 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bu chen bzhi'i ya gyal thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang po dge slong sdom brtson chos kyi rgyal bo'i rnam par rol ba phyag na padmo gong sa la rgyal ba'iri dbang bo sku phreng rim byon rnams kyis grub pa'i mtha' 'di nyid dus kyi mthar yang mi nyams par dbu 'phang dgung du btegs pa dang 'degs ba'i/na par 3/ dzad pas/ ji skad du/ dge legs gzi byin bye bas 'khyud pa yi/ /lugs bzang dri med bai ḍūr dkar po yang / ma rungs snyigs ma'i mi gtsang gis sbags te/ ri mo'i gzugs brnyan 'dzin par gyur ba na/ /slar ya nga 'dren mchog mar me mdzad dpal nyid/ /thun mtshams ngur smrig zol la brten pa gang / /blo bzang rgyal ba kun gyi dbang bo zhes/ /grags pa'i nor 'dzin khyab pa 'jig rten byon/ /mgon po mchog dang de sras yang sras sogs/ /bgrang du yas pas bstan pa'i dri ma kun/ /bkrus te bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan rtser ma chod pas/ /'gro la

lke ri170'dod rgu'i char chen ci yang 'bab/ /mkha' dbyings rgyu skar tshogs la co 'dri ba'i/ /gtsug lag khang dang dase/ 'dun 'dus pa'i sde/ /tshar du mngar bas rgya mtsho 'a gos can yang / /lci ba'i khur chen ma bzod 'dar ba snyam/ zhes ga/sung pa ltar lags pas/ 'jam mgon rgyal ba yab sras bka' drin gyi dpal du che/yang sgos su rang cag gser ldan 'dzin ma'i ljongs 'dir phan bde spel ba'i bka' drin gyi dbang du byas na/ mdo smad dbyig 'dzin yangs ba'i thig ler bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa pazhi ta dang grub pa'i khyu mchog gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu/ bar snang gi skar tshogs dang sa'i dregs pa bzhin byon pa'i nang na/tsho sgo gsum brtul zhugs gtsang ma'i gdams pa sogs dam pa'i rang rtags lhan skyes su gsal zhing / shes bya mdo sngags rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la sbyang bas grub pa'i mtha' rgya ma/tsho lta bu'i pha rol du son pa mkhas pa'i mkhas pa chen po/ gangs khrod rdza khrod sogs dben gsum ri bo'i mgul du sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba la zla med pa'i drang srong bsam gtan pa chen po/ 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i legs bshad kyi sgra dbyangs nam rma kha'i mtha' klas par sgrogs pa'i thub bstan yongs kyi rtsa lag rnam 'dren bla ma/ skal ldan rgya ma tsho dpal bzang bo zhes cha/tshan snyan gyi dri bsung phra mo tsam yang snying la sa/dung ba sel ba'i bdud rtsir gyur ba de nyid/ nges don du 'phags mchog phyag na padmo rang cag gi skal ba dang mtshams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rnam par rol ba ni bka' gdams glegs bam sogs lung tshad ma las

—7 nga—gsungs rnga/ ltar lags la/ drang don gyi dbang du byas na'ang dpal 'byor mnga' thang gi rlabs phreng g.yas su 'khyil zhing / rigs rus cho kṣ-irabrang gtsang ma'i ri mo ma ngon par gsal pa'i rgyud du rab byung bcu ba'i tshan me lug sgeg mo'i 'dzum 'od gsar ba'i dge mtshan mchog tu dar ba na/ ji ltar shar gyi ri bo'i phrag pa las zla gzhon gsal ba'i me long rnyog med du thon pa ltar ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas mtshan dpe lang tsho 'jig rten yangs pa'i rgyan du bltams/ gzhon nu nas rang gi khu bo grub dbang chos pa rin po ches sku drung du blangs nas chos srid zung gi sgo nas spyan gyi 'bras bu bzhin gces par bskyangs te dgong lo bcu gcig gi dus su dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing du bskyal/ 'dzam gling rgyan gyi chos sde chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi chos grur zhugs te lo bcu phrag gcig gi ring la bka' pod chen po lnga la gsan sbyong mthar phyin par mdzad pas mkhas pa'i mdun sar legs par bshad pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa la khyu mchog rlabs po che'i gnas thob/ rgyal ba sa/nyis pa'i rgyal tshab dam pa khri chen blo gros rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ gangs can chos kyi dbang bo tshul khrims chos 'phel/ mkhas pa'i dbang bo bstan pa dar rgyas/ dwags po bsod nams nyi ma/ rgyal sras don yod chos kshi rgya mtsho sogs bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi mnga' bdag du ma las/ tshidzwas snga phyi'i sdom pa dang / dbang khrid man ngag gi rgyun mtha' dag bum pa gang byos kyi tshul du bzhes par rma dzad pa ni/gsung mgur las/ sa khyad 'phags dbus kyi phyogs su song / /

172gnas khyad 'phags 'brog ri dge ldan du/ /skyabs khyad 'phags blo sbos rgya mtsho'i drung / /khrims khyad 'phags rab byung sdom pa blangs/ /grogs mkhas mang 'dus pa'i chos kyi grwa/ /dpal byang rtse thos/ bsam gling mchog tu/ /pha 2jam dbyangs tshul khrims chos 'phel dang / /bka' bcu phrag smra ba'i dge pa'i bshes/ /mtshan blo gros rnam rgyal bya ba gnyis/ /lo gsum tsam bsten nas bsdus sbyor la// /brtson me ltar 'bar bas legs par sbyangs/ /dus de rjes mkhas grub bstan dar ba/ /gzhung sde snod 'chad pa'i bla mar bzung / /spyir po ti lnga la cung zad ltos/ /sgos dbu ma phar phyin zhib tu bslabs/ /zhes dang / blo rno zhing smra lce bde ba'i rgyus/ /khong lung rigs smra ba'i mkhas pa'i tshogs/ /gang 'o dus par ston bzang grags pa thob/ /dpal chos 'khor lha sa'i gnas mchog tu/ /skyabs kun 'dus paṇa chen sprul ba'i sku/ tshigs byi ma 'i dge slong mkhan po mdzad/ /rgyud yongs rdzogs khrims kyi bdud rtsis bltams/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar nor gyi phung bo ci dgar thob pa'i ded dpon chen po rang yul du ldog pa ltar dgongs lo nyer gcig pa la rang yul gser ldan yangs pa'i lte bar zhabs sen utpala'i dog pa 'god par mdzad de/ thos pa'i rjes 'jug sgrub pa snying bor byed/ /skyes pa'i rdzong las tshegs chung thar bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don thugs la dgongs nas lho rgyud dang byang rgyud kyi dben pa'i dga' tshal brgya phrag du mar bslab pa sa/sum dang / rim pa gnyis kyi ting 'dzin gzungs kyi sgo mtha' yas pa la 'jug ldang byas pas sgrub 'bras kyi rtogs pa ma luri trī/ pa'i

— 1ṭī3klong brdol /dgong lo nyer bzhi ba la bla ma chos pa rin po che'i bka' ltar rang re'i bla ma bsam gtan rin chen khu dbon gyis phyag 'debs mdzad pa'i sde 'dir bshad grwa btsurges te/ dad gtong nor bu'i 'phyang 'phrul gyis mngon par sgeg pa'i sbyin bdag so so nas phul ba'i dngos po rnams kyis dge 'dun gyi sde la bsnyen bkur ba dang / gtsug lag khang dang / sku gsu nga thugs rten bzhengs pa dang / spyi rdzas sbyor 'jags mdzad pa sogs bya ba las kyi 'khor lo nam mkha'i mtha' la reg pa dang / brtsi bzhag gtong ba sogs legs par bshad pa'i rol mo ci dgar dkrol bas gdan sa chen po 'di nyid dbyar gyi dpal mo'i mdzes pa dang 'grogs pa'i chu gter bzhin 'phel zhing / lung dang rtogs ba'i rtsal yongs su rdzogs shing bshad sgrub zung du 'jug pa'i mdzad bzang dpung pa brtan pos blo bzang rgyal ba'i sa/dugs dkar srid rtser 'degs pa la rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi dpal la co 'dri ba'i rma khas dbang stong phrag du ma'i bsnyi gnas su bskrun pa ni/ rje nyid kyis lo nyer lnga lor tshe grwa tshang btsug lo de nas lnga bcu rtsa drug bar/ /lo sum cu so gsum grwa tshang bskyangs/ /zhes dang /dgos bdag gi grwa tshang 'di nyid du/ /blo rigs pa'i sgo dbyed bsdus sbyor la / /dus yun ring sbyong ba'i srol yang btsugs/ /de'i dbang gis rjes 'jug bu slob rnams/ /gzhung dka' gnas ri /sa pa'i lam nas 'dren/ /khong mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis phyogs 'di khyab/ /zhes bka' stsal ba ltar ro/ /sa/zhan yang phyogs ris med du mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad pa

114 — snedang / rtsod pa dang / rtsom pa gsu ma gyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa spel ba dang / bshad pa dang sgrub pa zung du 'jug pa'i lam bzang dus khor yug tu gzhol ba'i nyams len dang / sdom pa gsum gyi bcas mtshams ngo lkog med par srung ba sogs phan tshun ya ma bral bar gcig grogs su gcig 'gro ba'i legs mdzad mtho ris chu bo 'bab pa'i rjes su song ba'i sgo nas 'jam mgon bla ma'i rjes 'jug —gi khrod na gser ri'i dbus na lhun po dang rkang 'thung gi tshal na yongs 'du bzhin shin tu mtho bar gyur pa ni/ ji skad du/ mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang / /bstan ba'i snying po bshad sgrub rnam gnyis dang / /dam pa'i rnam thar sdom gsum nyams len la/ /phan tshun 'gran bzhin 'bad/ ces gsu ngas pa ltar la/de rjes mkhas pa dang grub pa'i khyu mchog blon chos khri rin po che blo bzang chos grags sogs mgon po gang gi chos kyi mkhan khri la zhabs sen pad rag snang bas nye bar 'khyud pa'i khri chen rim byon dang / yab rje bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho de nyid slar yang mi'i gar la bsten pa gangs can gyi nye bar 'khor chen po ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang srid pa gsum gyi bla na 'phags pa'i gdugs dkar gcig gis yul gru mtha' dag khyab par mdzad pa dge 'dun 'phrin las rab rgyas/ ngo mtshar byams brtse'i rtogs pa klong du gyur ba'i tshul bzung ba skyabs mgon blo bzang chos grags rgya mtsho/ thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i shes bya'i gnas mtha' dag la 'jigs pa med pa'i spobs pa lhan skyes su mnga' ba blo bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho sogs sku phreng gong ma

— — ༷/ //rte/sdu/rnams dang / khyad par du lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan bye ba'i tshogazlo kyis thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid la dbang bsgyur zhing / snyigs ma'i dus kyi skye bo dmu rgod pa rnams thabs mkhas kyi 'phrul gyi byed pas yang dag pa'i lam la 'god pa/ rang cag rnams kyi skyabs mchog mthong ba don ldan thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po skal ldan blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba dpal bzang po sogs kyi chos srid zung gi sgo nas chos sde 'di nyid dgon bu lag dang bcas pa tshul bzhin bskyangs pas na yab sras de rnams bdag cag la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa las kyang bka' drin che ba yin la/dgos pa skabs don gyi dbang du byas na/ bdag lta bu la rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho'i nang thugs kyi sras gcig bu rje grub pa'i dbang po ma ṇi ba shes rab bkra shis dpal bzang po sku phreng na rim gyi mtshan snyan sngon las zlog tu med pas 'dzin dgos byung ba ma gtogs/ de dag gi zhabs kyis sa la reg pa'i rdul gyi cha shas tsam gyi yon tan yang ma mchis shing / thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig pa'i gnas la sbyangs pa 'i yon tan/ gang zhes rang rgyud du 'khyer ba'i nyams myong / 'chad rtsod rtsom pa sogs mkhas pa'i bya ba/ 'jig rten gyi shes sgo yong thang gang thad nas grwa tshang rin po che'i chos srid kyi gdugs dkar dgung du 'degs pa'i nus pa med pa kun gyi thugs nges ltar lags mod/ 'on kyang dge 'dun rnams kyi thugs 'dun dang / rgyal ba chos kyi rgyal bo gang gi bka'i me tog gi phreng ba spyi bor babs pa'i dbang gis/ glang chen gyi kha la byi bas 'deg5 4

116 —pa ltar gdan sa chen po'i 'chad nyan gyi khur len dgos byung bar/ de ring gnam la gza' skar 'phrod sbyor/ sa la bkra shis g.yang chas/sa/phun sum tshogs pa'i dus tshigs dge ba'i nyin 'dir dam pa'i chos kyi mkhan khri la nye bar 'khod nas lung dang rigs pa smra ba'i dge 'dun li khri'i chu gter mkha' la 'phyur pa dzo te bu la chos kyi dga' ston gyi tshul du rtsi bzhag 'bul ba khri chen gong ma na rim gyi phyag bzhes yin pas/ de la spyir sde snod kyi rim pa la dbye na chags bcas gdul bya'i ngor gsungs pa'i gsang rgyud sde bzhi'i sde snod dang / chags bral gyi lam la mos pa'i ngor gsungs pa'i phar phyin theg pa'i sde snod gnyis su yod la/ tshul phyi ma de la'ang rtsa ba bka' dang / dgongs 'grel bstan bcos kyi rim pa gnyis su grags pa las/ da lta'i gdul bya rnams kyirtsa gtso bo 'dzin skyor gyi rigs byed pa phyi ma nges shing /tshul de la ji skad du/ dbu tshad zung du 'jug pa'i lta ba dang / /chos mngon mdzod dang pha rol phyin pa'i sgom/ /bstan pa'i nang mdzod 'dul ba'i spyod pa rnams/ /ma tshang bslab gsum ya bral 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /bka' pod lnga la tshang bar sbyongs shig ang // /gsungs pa ltar lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa lta ba'i cha gtso bor ston pa dbu tshad dang / lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa'am sgom pa'i cha gtso bor ston pa mngon pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'am spyod pa'i cha gtso bor ston pa 'dul ba'i bstan bcos te bka' pod chen po lnga zhes nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa las de ring skabs su babs pa / bstan bcos
