———— — 177————mngon par chogs pa'i rgyan yin la de la rgya bod kyi yul du tshig 'grel sa/// lha / don 'grel rgya cher 'grel sogs mang du byung ba las/ khyad par gyi chos/ du ma'i sgo nas zla dnge bral ba 'grel chung don gsal nyid yin pas/ 'di nyid kyi dbu nas brtsi bzhag 'bul ba la/ khyed sa/san pa po rnams kyang snod kyi skyon gsum spangs pa/ 'du the/sa drug bsten pa sogs kun slong kun spyod kyi cha gang nas kyang bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas pa'i mig rgyan du 'gyur pa zhig gi sgo nas gsan par tram̐nu/ /ne rlo

178dus dbang skabs kyi maṇḍal bshad pa/ 'o lags so/ de yang ji skad du/ stong chen yig lnga'i mthar thug bde ba che/ /thig le yig drug phyag rgya chen mo dang / /mnyam par sbyar ba'e e waṃ bla na med/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ stong chen yig lnga'i 'dus spyi waṃ yig drang don gyi dngos pos kun du mtshon par bya ba/ mtshon bya nges don gyi waṃ yig ma chog mi 'gyur gyi bde ba nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i ting nge 'dzin/ thig le yig drug 'dus pa'i bdag nyid e yig drang don brda thabs kyi dngos pos mtshon par bya ba/ nges don gsang pa'i snying po stong nyid chos kyi dbyings mi zad pa spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba dang mnyam par rol ba las/ phyi snod rdzi'ajig rten la gnas pa'i stong chen yig lnga dang / nang bcud kyi 'jig rten la tshang ba'i stong chen yig lnga sa/nyis so/ /lam dus kyi stong chen yig lnga nges don bde ba chen pos rnam par sbyangs/ phyi 'jig rten gyi bkod pa la gnas pa'i thig le yig drug dang / nang phung khams skye mched la rdzogs pa'i thig le yig drug gnyis so/ /sbyor ba yig drug gi bdag nyid kyi thige le yig drug gis zad par sbyangs te/ stong chen yig lnga'i rma thar thug mchog mi 'gyur gyi bde ba chen po dang / thig le yig drug gi mthar thug stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo mnyam par sbyar ba'i rang ḍisdon

179'bras bu e waṃ bla na med pa'i ngo bo thugs 'gyur med bde ba chen po'i ye shes snying rje chen po'i bdag nyid sku rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid bem chos zad pa kun tu bzang pa'i stong gzugs longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku gnyis lhun grub zung 'jug chos sku 'i bdag nyid du mngon par bzhengs pa/dpalo dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi ‘rakhor lo chen po dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid nas/ ji skad du/ rnam pa bcu po don bcu'i don/ /thub dbang stobs bcu khyab pa'i bdag /kun gyi don ni ma lus byed/ /rnam bcu dbang ldan che ba po/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyi 'jig rten khams gsum gyi bkod par gyur ba'i srid pa rnam bcu dbang ldan/ nang rdo rje lus rten la bsten pa'i sbyang bya srid pa rnam bcu/ lam dus kyi pha rol du phyin pa bcu dang / sa bcu dang shes pa sogs lam dus kyi 'khor lo'i ngo bor gyur ba'i rnam bcu dbang ldan gyis sbyangs te/ stobs bcu dbang bcu la sogs pa'i 'bras dus kyi rnam bcu dbang ldan mngon du bya ba'i ched du/ khyim bcu gnyis dang dus sbyor bcu gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i phyi dang / 'pho chen bcu gnyis dang rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i nang gi bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis kyi gnyen por gyur ba bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi la dman 'bring mchog gi dbye ba'i bskyed rim bcu sa/nyis/ sbyor ba yan lag drug la bde ba dang stong bas phye ba'i rdzogs rim bcu gnyis kyi bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis/ nges don gyi rdo rje'i nyi ma snang ba che ba/ zla cha bcu drug dang tshes zhag bcu drug gis mtshon pas phyi dang / thig le bcu drug

180 dang khams bcu drug gis mtshon pa'i nang gi de nyid rnam pa bcu drurga/ gi gnyen por gyur ba'i stong nyid bcu drug dang mnyam par sbyar ba'i de nyid bcu drug rig paldi dga' ba bcu drug nges don gyi rdo rje'i zla ba dri ma med pa'i 'od de gnyis bdag nyid gcig tu gyur ba'i lam bzang po ston par dgongs te/ de yang ji skad du / yan lag bcu gnyis srid rtsa bton/ /dag pa rnam pa bcu gnyis ldan/ /de nyid rnam pa bcu drug rig /rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa/ /rnam par sangs rgyas kun rig mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul ba'i sku/ /bye ba dpag med 'gyed pa po/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'bras dus kyi bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis kyi bdag nyid de nyid rnam pa bcu drug rig pa/ mi 'gyur bde ba bcu drug gi ye shes byi dpal dang / rnam pa lnga dang nyi shu skad cig ma gcig dang sgyu 'phrul dra bas rma ngon par byang chub pa/ rang don spangs rtogs phun tshogs dang sa/zhan don sprul sku bye ba dpag med 'gyed pa'i dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi skur mngon par bzhengs nas chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor du grags pa sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ sras kyi thu bo dpal ldan gtum chen g.yu thod dbus/ thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i gdul bya rgya mtsho'i sprin gyi bkod par kun nas dkrigs pa la/ gzhi dus kyis dri ma bdun 'khrud cing lam dus kyis sa bdun thob pa'i nus pa 'jog pa/ rim pa dang po'i yan lag bzhi'i rnal 'byor sgom pa dang thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa la dbang bar byed pa/byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun sngon 'gro sa dang sta gon gyi cho ga dang

181 bhebacas pa/ gzhi dus kyi thig le bzhi'i dri ma sbyong zhing lam dus kyi rdo rje bzhi'i nus pa smin pa dang / 'bras dus kyi sku bzhi'i sa bon 'jog cing byang chub ba'i/'i lag rjes spel ba/ rim pa gnyis pa'i yan lag ba'i/'i rnal 'byor sgom pa dang ma chog gi dngos grub sgrub pa la dbang bar byed pa/ drang don 'jig rten pa'i dbang dang nges rdon 'jig rten las 'das pa'i — dbang bzhi rnam par dag pa/ mdor bstan rab tu mdo bstan/ mdor bstan chen po ste mdor bsdus rnam gsum/ rgyas bshad rab tu rgyas bshad/ rgyas bshad chen po ste rgyas pa gsum gyi rgyud dang 'brel ba/ sa/nasapa brgyad cu rtsa gcig gi sgo nas phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi dus 'khor gtan la 'bebs pa rtsa ba'i rgyud 'grel ba dang bcas pa/ mdorobasdus sugacu so gnyis kyi sgo nas phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi rnam bzhag rgya cher ston pa bsdus rgyud 'grel ba 'grel bshad man ngag dang bcas pa ston pa por ched du dbang ba rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang rang bcas pa ri bo dge ldan pa'i bka' srol dri ma med pa'i phyag len ji lta ba bzhin legs par stsal/srid pa sum cu rtsa gcig gi snod bcud chags 'jig gnas gsum gyi rnam bzhag dang khyim dang gza' skar dus sbyor gyi rim pa sogs phyi dus kyi 'khor lo/ nang rdo rje lus kyi skye 'jig srung gsum gyi rnam bzhag dang rtsa rlung thig le bkod pa bye brag tu phye ba sogs nang dus kyi 'khor lo smrin byed drang nges kyi dbang bcu gcig gi rnam bzhag grol byed skyed rdzogs kyi rim gnyis sgrub pa sgrub chen thig le rnal 'byor phra mo'i rnal 'byor gyi yan lag

182 bzhi dang sbyor ba yan lag drug gi rnam bzhag grol ba 'bras bu'i ngo bo padma'i 'dab ma rgyas pa'i spyan du grags pa sku bzhi/ nyijin mor byed pa'i sku zhes brjod pa rdo rje bzhi/ ye shes kyi sku zhes pa'i sgras bstan pa byang chub bzhi/ thams cad mkhyen pa zhes pa'i mtshan gyis gleng ba mkhyen pa bzhi dang / 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ stong ba chen po ye shes lnga/ /thig le stong ba yi ge drug /ces pa ltar/ thig le yig drug mthar thug nges don gyi e yig gzugs sku stong gzugs chen mo/ stong chen yig lnga mthar thug nges don waṃ yig thugs mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po/ rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi yig bcu mthar thug nges don gyi rnam bcu dbang ldan stobs bcu'i bdag nyid kyi 'bras bu rnams dang / ji skad du/ rtsa rgyud sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ /rdo rje nyi ma snang ba che/ /rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od/ /chags bral dang po chags pa che/ /kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas so so'i rang bzhin gyi yon tan rdo rje nyi ma snang ba che ba / sku gsung thugs kyis bsdus pa'i yon tan rdo rje zla ba dri ma med pa'i 'od chen po/ lhun gyis gruthe pa dang rgyun mi chad pa'i 'phrin las kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od sogs gzhan dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnam bzhag so so'i ngo bo gaṭa/la la don 'dril ba/ mtha' chod la gol sa spangs pa/lam du bsgrig la lag tu blang bde ba bcas 'chad pa'i bka' drin ni nam mkha' ji srid du lus dang srog gi dngos pos mchod kyang cha tsam gzhal sa/ la nus/ de ltar na ji skad du/ mchod 'os bstod 'os phyag gi gnas/ /

rtag tu ri mor bya ba'i 'os/ /bkur 'os rjed par bya ba'i 'os/ phyag byar 'os pa bla ma'i rab/ /ces pa'i don cha tsam lag len du brdar rma tshon byed du/ ྾ mo ྾da ni gsol ba 'debs pa'i snying po ni/ bdag cag gi me tog phog pa'i lha skal/ ྾ ྾/ /

184rdo rje 'chang khri chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi yang sprul rin po che gdan sar phebs skabs kyi bshad lan ngo mtshar ring mo/oṃ bde legs su gyur cig lus can kun gyi bla med bsod nams zhing / /phongs pa'i re ba yid bzhin skong ba'i gter/ /thar 'dod rnams kyi gtsug gi rgyan gyi mchog /mchog gsum rin chen dam pas dge legs stsol/ /zhes bden tshig shis pa brdzod pa'i sgra dbyangs snying por 'phyur ba'i kun du dge ba'i ngag tshig man da ra ba'i phreng ba phyogs su bstar te/ rmad du byung ba'i gtam gyi sbyo ra ba/ don bzang gi lus bkra ba/ rjod byed kyi tshig mdzes pa/ rten 'brel gyi sgo legs pa/ ba yar dga' ston gyi rgyan du che nges gang zhig smra na/de yang rnam 'dren nyi ma stong gi gzi byin gyi lang tsho bzung zhing / dam pa'i chos kyi rin chen rgyan phreng du ngom pa'i bskal ba bzang po mi mjed 'jig cen gyi zhing khams 'di la snod bcud kyi bkod pa rgya mtsho'i rmin ltar chags pa las/ dzasbu'i 'khri shing gi rgyal ma tshan snying por blangaṭa4 pa'i bkod pa mi zad pa'i tha gru ku na du yangs pa'i 'jig rten 'di nyid ra kwa tu krab )kyi rigi ri//lnga

18byonas ring bo ma lon pa na/ 'od gsal lha las chad pa'i mi rigs kyis bsong/ nams rnam par rgyas pa'i mnga' thang la longs spyod/ de'i dus na bsod nams kyi mtshan dang ldan pa ya rabs kyi ngang tshul brtas pa/sna mkhyen rab kyi dgongs pa zab pa/ gzhan phan gyi kun spyod dar ba/ rma nga pos bkur ba'i rgyal bo sogs sngon gyi rgyal bo lnga dang / 'khor los bsgyur ba lnga sogs byung ste 'gro ba mtha' dag gis rdzogs ldan gyi dpal la longs spyad pas/ ji skad du/ bsod nams dpaka bas/ma rgyas pa'i dga' tshal du/ /bde skyid mnga' thang sprin gyi bkod pa ni/ /ci yang byung ba bsam brjod yul laru/ 'das/ /rdzogs ldan dga' ston dar ba'i tshad la rtog /ces rang bzhin brjod pa ltar la/skye rgu tshe lo brgyad khri ba'i dus na sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig dang /tshe lo bzhi khri ba'i dus na sangs rgyas gser thub/ tshe lo nyi khri ba'i dus na sangs rgyas 'od srungs 'jig rten du byon te/ dam chos kyi nyi ma shar/bde skyid kyi pad tshal rgyas/ — dga' ston gyi yo lang dar/ snod bcud kyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pas lha yul las skyid che ba/ klu yul las parjid che ba'i grags snyan gyi rol mo da dung ma yal ba 'di bzhin lags la/ skye rgu tshe lo brgya ba'i dus su 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med sras gtsang gi sras po thub pa don kun grub pa de nyid lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gi mig gi bdud rtsir byon/ chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum bskor te/ mtho ris dang thar ba'i lam phye/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sgo/ sa/tan/ rnam par gro9si ba'i ngadud rtsi dpag tu med pa bkye ba na/ snod kyi bkod pa

————9sngi6 — — ——— rdzogs ldan gyi dpal las byin chags pa/ bcud kyi 'jig rten tshangs pa chen po las gzengs mtho ba/ chos kyi snang ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor las 'od gsal ba/ srid kyi yo lang lha yi dpal 'byor las rgyas drags pa/ lha mi'i dga' ston dag pa'i zhing khams las kyang 'phel che bas 'gro ba mtha' dag lugs gnyis kyi longs spyod dang mnga' thang dgung la reg pa'i dpal dam pa la legs par spyod pas/ 'di skad du/ dag pa'i snod bcud rgya rma tsho'i bkod pa las/ /ches cher lhag pa gna' bo'i dus bzang du/ /chos srid rin chen bdun gyi ba gam las/ /mtho ris thar ba'i tshal du rtsen pa mang / /zhes brjod pa lags te de ni ngo mtshar ba'i gtam gyi sbyor ba dang po yin/gangs can sā la'i ljongs chen po/ gru 'dzin zhing gi bdag po lha 'jig rten dbang phyuka yab yum gyi sa/dul zhing thun mong ma yin pa 'di nyid du/ sprul ba'i spre'u dge bsnyen dang / sprul ba'i brag srin dga' ma gnyis kyis mi'i 'gro ba spel te stod mnga' ris skor gsum nor gyi grong khyer/ bar dbus ga/tsang ru bzhi chos kyi grong khyer/ smad mdo khams sgang drug mi'i grong khyer zhes pa 'di chags/ mi rgyud lha las chad pa/ chu rgyud gangs las brdol ba/ rgyal bo rgyal rigs kyi spyi po nas dbang bskur ba/gnam gyi mthongs las bsod nams kyi shed mong btsan pos 'dod dgur sgyur ba'i mi'i dbang po gnya' khri btsan po bod 'bangs yongs kyi spyi bdag tsho rgyal rabs kun gyi thog mar byon/de nas thugs bskyed kyi mthu btsan pa/ bsod nams kyi stobs che

——— —— 181ba / mnga' thang gi mtha' rgyas pa/ dpal 'byor gyi mtsho rdol ba/ rang sde byams pas skyong ba/ gzhan sde zil gyis gnon pa'i rgyal rabs nyer drug tsam song ba na/ thub pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam sprul lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan zhes mtshan tsam gyis kyang skye dgu bde la 'god pa'i mi rje sa'i tshangs pa chen po de byon/ de'i sku ring la gnyan po gsang ba rnam gsum sogs dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes te/ dam chos nyi ma chen po 'byung nges kyi snga ltas/ rmad du byung ba'i skya rengs dang po 'bad rtsol la ma ltos par bsod nams kyi dgung las shar/de nas bzung / snod la bkra shis kyi byin chags te rtsi shing nags tshal gyi bongs tshod dgung du reg pa/ 'bru drug snye ma'i lang tsho g.yur du za ba/ grong dang grong khyer gyi bkod pa lha las lhag pa/ gser dngul dar zab kyi 'byor ba klu las 'phags pa/ bcud la bkra shis kyi dge mtshan g.yang du chags pas mi mthun pa'i 'thab rtsod med pa/ mi 'byor ba'i dbul phongs bral ba/ gzhon la rigs rgyud kyi 'dab legs dbyar dus kyi rgya mtsho las kyang 'phel /la che ba/ rgan la tshe thag gi ri mo dal 'gro'i bu mo'i rgyun las kyang zad pa med pa/ gzi byin zla ba las kyang che mngon pa/ blo gros nyi ma las kyang mdangs gsal ba/ grags pa 'brug sgra las kyang skad che ba de 'dra byung ba red/ de la 'di skad kyang gleng ste/gangs ljongs sa yi tshangs pa rabs gcig gi /legs byas dpag bsam rgyas pa'i gdengs ka las/ /byin chags snod bcud dge ba'i ri mo 'dis/ /byed po skyengs pas 'dod pa khams las brgal/ /zhes bya ba

rī188 ni ngo mtshar ba'i gtam gyi byeor ba gnyis pa yin/de nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang mi'i dbang po'i srid pa sgyu ma'i gar du rtsen pa/ chos kyi rgya la bo srong btsan sgam po zhes gzhon nu nas sprul ba'i rang bzhin gyi rnam thar rjen par ngom pa dgung lo bcu gsum nas stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba chen po'i go 'phang bdag gir bzhes te/ 'phags yulachos kyi zhing la dam pa'i chos kyi zam stegs btsugs/ / rgya nag stong khun gyi yul la gnyen gyi 'brel ba bzung / bod yul gangs can gyi ljongs la dam pa'i chos kyi sgron me gsar du sbar te bstan pa'i srol phye bas/ lha yul me tog gling / rgya gar 'phags pa'i gling / stag gzig nor gyi gling / rgya nag ngo mtshar gling / klu yul nor bu'i gling / zhes yongs su grags pa'i gras la bod yul chos kyi gling zhes snyan pa'i tha snyad skye rgu'i rna ba'i rgyan du gyur ba 'di byung / rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa sna tshogs pas bod 'bangs yongs kyi kha lo chos la bsgyur/ rang sde rjes su skyong ba'i lugs gnyis kyi khrims ra dam po gser gyi gnya' shing ltar lci la mdzes pa'i dpal du spel/ gzhan sde zil gyis gnon pa'i byed pa rlabs po che tshangs pa chen po'i cho 'phrul las kyang shugs drag pas mtha' dbus kyi dregs ldan mtha' dag gis nor bu'i cod pan gyi rtse mo bod du dud de/ spyod pa sna tshogs kyi legs skyes bzang po rgya mtsho las kyang rgyun 'byung ba dang sa gzhi las rlangs pa thon pa bzhin du byung / 'jig rten gsum po ma lus pa'i rten gyi snying bo ra sa 'phrul snang gi sa/tsug lag khang dang mtha' 'dul gyi lha khang bzhi sogs rten dang brten pa dpag med pa'i

189bkod pa bkram/ paṇḍi ta dang grub pa'i dbang phyug du ma spyan drangs te mdo sngags kyi rgya mtsho chen po bod yul gser ldan gyi gzhi la ci yang bskyil/ snyan pa'i grags pa yug gcig gis srid pa'i rtse mo man chad khyab gdal du khebs par mdzad pas byang phyogs gangs ri'i rgyud kyi yul gru 'di nyid lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gis mgo bo'i thod bzhin bkur ba'i zhing du bskrun par mdzad pa yin la/ de skad du/ zag med 'phrul ba'i bkod pa gzengs mtho ba'i/ /gru 'dzin nor bu'i zhing de bdag po bcas/ /sā la'i ljongs su 'phos pa'i ngo mtshar gyis/ /kun yid myos pa'i pha mtha' su yis gzhal/ zhes pa ste de ni ngo mtshar ba'i gtam gyi sbyor ba gsu ma pa yin/de nas 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rnam 'phrul/ mi rje khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ring la mkhan slob chos gsum gdan 'dzom/ nag po'i phyogs kyi lha 'dre mi gsum dam la btags/ gsal g.yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang khor yug le lag dang bcas pa rdzogs par bzhengs// bshad grwa dang sgom grwa mang du spel/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa yo ngas su rdzogs pa'i srol ka dar rgyas su mdzad cing / baṭanam yas rab ston gyi rim pa lo bcu gsum du mdzad de bod yul gangs can gyi ljongs 'di chos kyi phyogs nas 'og min sa la 'phos pa 'dra ba/ srid kyi phyogs nas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha yul mngon sum du spos pa lta bu nyan na rna tshim pa / rig na mig /thengs pa/ bsam na sems skyid pa/ mi chos gtam gyi dpe la yang / lha dbang mi bzang mi dbang bzang / /mi dbang 'jamā

190dpal lde btsan yin/ /lha yul mi skyid bod yul skyid/ /bsam yas chos kyi pho brang yin/ /zer ba byung ba de ltar red/de nas mnga' bdag ral ba can gyi sku ring la 'on cang rdo'i lha khang dpe med bkra shis dge 'phel sogs bzhengs/ ka cog zhang gsum sogs lo paṇa mang du 'dzom/ skad gsar bcad kyis bka' bstan thams cad gtan la phab/ bye brag rtog byed che 'bring chung gsum sogs dam pa'i chos kyi ba/nam thig btab/ bstan pa snga dar gyi 'khor lo sasum gyi rgyal mtshan ci yang bsgrongs pa'i grags snyan ga bur gyi dri bsung da dung gong 'phel du gnas pa 'di byung bas smra ba'i 'bab stegs glog ltar 'khyug pa las/ gangs ri'i do shal mdzes pa'i nor ldan mar/ /gna' dus bstan pa'i ba dan rab dkar bas// /mun pa'i go skabs phrogs pas 'jig rten na/ /phan bde snang ba 'bar ba'i mtha' mi dpog /ces kyang kun du rgyu ste ngo mtshar ba'i gtam gyi sbyor ba bzhi ba yin/bstan pa phyi dar la bla chen po dgongs pa rab gsal gyis bstan pa'i me ro mdo khams smad nas gsos/ lo paṇa bka' drin can du mas bstan pa'i me ro mnga' ris stod nas gsos/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang byang chub 'od sogs chos rgyal thugs bskyed can khu dbon gyis dka' ba brgya phrag gis lnga brgya ba rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu dpal ldan a ti sha chen po gdan drangs/ mnyam med jo bo chen po dang 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung sa/nas yab sras kyis thub bstan dri ma med pa'i bdud rtsi bod yul gru 'dzin gyi zhing du mi nub pa'i rgya mtshor baspyil/ mi'i /ba daripe la'ang /

191legs bshad dpung gis sa steng gang / /log chos sa yi 'og tu bros/ /zer ba de byung /de nas rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mtha' dag gi snying gi thig le / spyan gyi 'bras bu/ chos kyi ded dpon// khams gsum gyi bla ma/ skye rgu ma lus pa'i rnam 'dren/ rgyal ba'i gdung tshob/ bstan pa mtha' dag gi bdag po/ 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal bo tsong kha pa chen pos/ dpyad gsum rnam par dag pa'i lung rigs kyi lam nas bshad’sgrub kyi bstan pa rmo yongs su rdzogs pa la 'khrul ba'i dri ma phra mo nas bsal te byi dor yang dag par bgyis/ 'dul ba ka ri ka nas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bar gyi mdo sngags kyi sa/nad ma lus pa me bshad pa 'chad nyan gyi lag len/ sgrub pa nyams len gyi phyag len rkang tshugs pa btsugs// chos kyi rgyun chags pa'i bshad grwa dang sgrub grwa/ rang gi gdung 'tshob pa'i slob ma dang slo ba brgyud/ shar rgya mtsho chen po'i rlabs phreng dgung la 'argyur ba nas/ nub sna ma'i me tog gi ze ba srid du ring ba'i bar spel te/ snyigs ma las kyang snyigs mar rdzogs ldan gyi dus ston/ ma dag pa'i zhing la dag pa'i7 'jig rten byung bas/ 'di skad du/ phyogs kyi me tog phon po'i ngos yangs su/ /grags pa'i zla zer 'khyud pa'i rtse dga' las/ /rdzogs lda na ku mud bzhad pa'i dus ston gyis// /sa 'dis dag pa'i zhing la gus pa btang / /zhes kyang bsnga gas te de ni ngo mtshar ba'i gtam gyi sbyo ra ba lnga ba yin/༄ khyad par du rang re'i yul gru gser mo ljo ngas 'di'i dbang du byas

192 na/ grub pa brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rong lha rje de nyid lha dang bla mas lung bstan te thugs bskyed kyis sa 'dir byon/ rgya gza' dang bod gza' gnyis khab tu bsus te rgyal thang dang blon chos la kha gnyis su gzhi btang / mi las 'das pa'i lha'i sras po rong mdo sde 'bum 'khrungs/ de la sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam par 'phrul ba'i rigs sras dgu 'khrungs pa rnams/ nyi zla bzhin du lang tsho mdzes pa tshangs pa bzhin du thugs dgongs zab pa/ lha dbang bzhin du gzi bajid che ba/'khor bsgyur bzhin du mnga' thang dar ba/ thu dbang bzhin du 'byor ba rgyas pa/ dbang phyug bzhin du kha dreg btsan pa/ khyab 'jug bzhin du dpa' rtsal che ba/ lugs gnyis kyi 'phrin las ches cher yangs pa sha stag yin pas/ reb gong yar nang dang reb lag rdo bis rnams su mnga' 'bangs chos bzhin skyong ba'i sa dbang chen po'i srid 'dzin pa rnams kyis 'akro khams snyong ba'i khur 'khyer/ sras che ba rong bo'i bla ma bsam gtan rin chen gyis dam pas lung gis zin pa sa gzhi rdo rje 'dra ba rgyal thang gi lte bar sa 'dzin྾ mo ྾khang dang dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs bzhengs te rong bo bde chen chos 'khor gling gsar 'debs mdzad/ sras gsum pa blo gros seng ge lung rtegs kyi yon tan che zhing 'phrin las rgyus te/ rgya nag tā ming rgyal bos dbu blar bkur/ chos dang grub rtags mang du gnang bas/ tā ko shrī'i mtshan dang las ka bka' shog dang bka' tham gnang / sngar srol ltar reb gong rong 'brogasha sde ljongs khri phrag mang po mnga' zhabs su tshud/ dbon rigs phyi ma rnams kyang gong ma'i dbu blar

— 193 byon pa sogs mdzad pa rgya che/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo las/sum rtsen bkod pa byed po'i pir chen gyis/ /mngon su ma sa la bris pa'i ri mo la/ /gser ljongs yul zhes brjod pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /gtam gzhan rgyu ba'i go skabs ka la phrogs/ /zhes rang bzhin brjod pa ni ngo mtshar ba'i gtam gyi sbyor ba drug pa yin/de nas rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtshos mdo smad lho rgyud kyi phyogs 'dir bstan pa'i sgron me gsar du sbar ba'i tshe/ mkhas mang bye ba'i 'byung gnas grwa tshang thos bsam rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btab/ bka' pod lnga'i 'chad nyan gyi rgyal mtshan btsugs/ sgrub brgyud kyi chu mgo bkra shis 'khyil gsar du bskrun/ bu slob ston sgom gnyis 'dzom nyi zla lta bu sha stag gis chos sde che phra du mas sa steng thams cad khyab par byas te sangs rgyas gyi bstan pa ljongs 'dir nyi ma shar ba lta bu mdzad/ 'gro ba mtha' dag legs pa'i lam yangs po la bkod/ gnam stong la zla ba dadzwastigs dus la rdzogs ldan bkug pa lta bu'i bka' drin bskyangs/ de lta bu'i sro ka de nyid7 skyabs mgon sku phreng rim byon gyis yar ldan du spel bas lugs gnyis char nas dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing khams gnyis pa lta bur yod pa 'di yin /de'i phyir/ paṇa chen ngag gi dbang phyug mi pham zla bas/ mdo smad tsong kha'i lho ngos reb gong gi yul de/ /mtha' khob yang khob smag rum thibs pa zhig min no/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar gsol bas/ /dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing khams gnyis pa rang yin no/ /zhes

194 —don gnas kyi bsngags brjod rmad du byang ba 'di gnangarnye deni ngomatshar ba'i gtam gyi sbyor ba bdun pa yin /khyad par du yul dus bye brag gi me tog rnam par bkra ba'i lding khang 'di nyid du/ yongs 'dzin parnyi ta 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i gser zhal las/ dpal bde gshegarngadzikun gyi spyi gzugs che/ /lha 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang dngos/ /pha skal ldan rgya mtsho sprul ba'i sku/ /rje 'phrin las lung rtogs rgya mtsho'i sde/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa mtha' dag gi spyi gzugs/ gru 'dzin zhing gi mgon po 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho u bu cag gi mgon du byon pa/ skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa bdun pa chen po 7 skal ldan blo bzang 'phrin las lung rtogs rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam rgyal dpal bzang po 'di nyid ni/ phyi snang tshul gyi mdzad pa ngo mtshar ba'i dbang du byas na yab rje bla ma mchog gi sprul sku mtshan bzang gi me tog bkra ba/ bsod nams kyi gzi byin 'bar ba/ lugs gnyis kyi mnga' thang rgyas pa/ grags snyan gyis sa steng khyab pa/ nang yon tan lhun rdzogs kyi dbang du byas na/ phal bas bsgrun du med pa'i yon tan lhan skyes nas mnga' zhing / lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan sbyor byung gis 'phel ba/ mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan gzugs can du rdzogs pa/ mdzad 'phrin bzang po'i grib bsel 'khor yug tu snyoms pa/ sa/sang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnas tshod kyi dbang du byas na/ rab 'byams rgyal ba ma lus pa'i snying rje'i rang gzugs 'phags

19tsupa 'jig rten dbang phyug dang dbyer ma mchis pa/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i bkod pa grangs dang rma tha' mi dpog pa/ cir yang 'char la cir yang mdzad pa/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis rim dang gcig char bstan nas skal ba dang ldan pa rnams rnam grol la 'god pa ni/ ji skad du/ phyi yab rje skal ldan sprul ba'i sku/ /nang yon tan kun rdzogs 'jam pa'i dbyangs// /ches gsang ba thugs rje chen po dngos/ /pha skyabs mgon bdun pa chen po'i zhabs/ /zhes tshad mar gyur ba'i lung las don dang ldan par bsngags pa ltar la/ thun mong snang tshod du'ang / dus 'dir 'dzam gling na 'gran zla med pa'i yon tan gyi dpal mngon du mdzad pa'i bla ma dang yongs 'dzin du ma tshul bzhin bsten/ lhan skyes nas mkhyen rab thogs pa ma mchis pa'i nam mkha' rab tu yangs pa'i sgo phye/ mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i chos tshul ma lus pa la sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad/ dus 'khor yug kun tu thos bsam sgom gsum ya ma bral ba'i mnyam bzhes dmar zhing / 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang bla na ma mchis pasacibastan 'gro'i don rmad du byung ba spel te 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan du byon pa 'di ci lags pas/ rtogs brjod rin po che gsang gsum snang ba'i sgron me las 7 gong sa thams cad mkhyen pa 'di ba ngo bo spyan ras gzigs la rnam pa 'jam dpal dbyangs zhig rang bzhin gyis phebs pa dang / yongasda 'dzin paṇa chen ngag gi dbang swo ni mdo stags rig gnas kyi sbyangs pa bas—ma gyis mi khyab par ma zad/ gdul bya skyong ba la thabs mkhas gzhan las cherib

196 dang / mtshan zhabs rigs smra rnams dang lhan cig slob sbyong gi rkyen 'dzom pa bcas lo zla nyin zhag re la sku yon kyi skyed thon te dus 'dir dzam gling mdzes rme'i rgyan bdun par bzhengs bzhin pa 'di lags so/ /zhes gsungs la/ pa shlau ta chen po don yod rdo rjes kyang / thugs ma khyen rab nam mkha'i sgo phye bas/ /chos mdo sngags rig gnas ma lus pa'i/ /don ji bzhin kun mkhyen partsi ta/ /pha skyabs mgon bdun pa chen po'i rīzhabs/ dus khor yug thos bsam sgom pa dang / /thabs 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang gis/ /rje gong ma'i rnam thar skyong mdzad pa/ /pha skyabs mgon bdun pa chen po'i zhabs/ /zhes bsngags pa don ldan gyi rol mo seng ge'i nga ro'i rgyud du drangs pa ltar te/ 'di ni ngo mtshar ba'i gtam gyi sbyor ba brgyad pa yin/mchog sbrul mthong ba don ldan gang gi dbang du byas na/ de yang rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho'i dus na nang thugs kyi sras gcig mkhas spub chen po shes rab bkra shis kyi sku'i skye ba bzhes/ rnam 'dren bla ma'i gsang ba gsu ma gyi bang mdzod yongs su bzung ste gang gi chos kyi rgyal srid nyams pa med par mnga' thang mtha' dag dgung du spel/ ya ba rje bla ma slar yang sprul ba'i zlos gar sgyur ba ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho la lung dang rtogs pha'i chos tshul mtha' dag phog ste yab rje rang gi rgyal srid du dbang bskur/ gong sa sku phreng gsum pa'i dus na lcang lung khri rgan 'jam dbyungs dge 'dun bstan 'dzin gyi rnam par byon te/ skyabs mgīrna dgi 'asīn 'phrin las rab rgyas kyi yongs 'dzin 'gran zla med pa'i

197 go sar bzhugs/ thos bsam rnam rgyal gīng ji/ khrir bzhugs te yande rje dam pa'i rang lugs mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur bsgrengs/ gong sa sku phreng bzhi ba dang lnga ba'i dus na 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal rmatshan dang / grub chen skal bzang grags pa sogs gzhi byes su sprul ba du ma bzung ste yab rje'i bla ma'i 'phrin las rgya cher spel/ gong sa skyorka phreng drug pa'i dus na rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya metsho dasgel bzang po'i rnam par byon/ gong sa skya bas mgon mchog gi bu slob gser ri'i greng ba lta bu'i khrod na mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'gran zla med pa tshangartswapa bo'i mdun na tshangs pa gnyis pa bzhin du bzhuges/ dbang khrid marno ngag gi bang mdzod rgya mtsho chen po bri gang med pa lta buro bzhugs pas dri ma med pa'i chos rgyun stsol ba la ljongs 'dir rje 'di dang mtshungs pa yab rje bla ma'i brgyud 'dzin gyi khrod du ma byon par gleng yang don gnas kyi tshod du byas pas chog lhag par gyi gong sa skyabs mgon blodun pa chen po 'di ba'i rigs bdag dang po mdzad de thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyal srid du dbang bskur/ skye rgu thams cad mgon dang bstan pa thams cad bdag po dang bcas pa 'di byung bas/ 'di skad du/ e ma ljongs 'di'i phan bde srog /khyod nyid kho nas mngon bzung bas// ma lus 'gro ba'i zur phuni ni/ /mi zad bka' drin khur gyis spud/ /ces pa 'di ni ngo mtshar ba'i gtam gyi sbyor ba dgu ba yin/da ni skabs don gyi rim pa la/ khri chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs de nyid

198 nas bsam bzhin du tsha/nga sa thams cad mkhyen pa dang sku mched du phebs pa'i thugs smon dang bka' phebs mdzad/ ji ltar bka' stsal ba de ltar bden pa mngon du gyur pa na/ nang thugs kyi sras gcig yab gcig rdo rje 'chang 'jigs med pazhi ta chen po nas/ bka' gsang rnam par bkrol te 'jigs pa med pa seng ge'i sgra bsgrags/ bu slob sbyin bdag dang bcas pa sa dang po rab dga' la 'phos pa lta bu'i dga' ba mngon par rgyas/ dga' bas dar spyar/ spro bas dung bus/ dad pas mngon par bstod de gser zhal zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dngos su mjal bar re ba'i mig 'bug zum pa med par gnas pa la gyi gong sa thams cad mkhyen pa chen pos gang ci'i bka' khyab lhugs par sa/nang ba ltar lung rtogs yon tan gyis phyug pa'i bla sprul/ lugs gnyis 'phrin las kyis mtho ba'i bla ma / lung rigs mgrin rgyan gyis sgeg pa'i dge bshes/ bshad sgrub dbang thang gis khengs pa'i dgon sde/ chen po'i lung las kyis zin pa'i phyag gnyer/ stobs 'byor mnga' thang gis dregs pa'i dpon po/ btsan phyug dpal gsu ma gyis longs pa'i rong 'brog kha drag dpa' rtsal gyis rgyags pa'i stag shar/ 'khor gsum go mtshon gyis brgyan pa'i dpung chen/ rgyan dang gos lhan gyis 'byor ba'i gzhon nu sogs kyi rta bsu da nga rkang bsus kyi rim pa mang po tshar du dngar/ gur kum gzhon nu'i 'khri cishing mgo lcog ldem pa la gser gyi me tog gi cod pan rnam par spras pa lta bu'i ser phreng dpag tshad khri phrag gi bar du spras/ lha bsus mchod bsus kyi rim pa rgya ma chad cing rol mo'i bye brag mtha' yari shaṃ pas dri za'i dga'

— — — byā 18)8/tshal gnas 'dir 'phos pa snyam byed pa byas/ chos kyi 'bel gtam sa/ra rol glu gzhas ngo mtshar gral 'phros/ dkar ston dmar ston/ ja dang zho chang / rten 'byung gi dngos 'bul/ go babs ster cha sogs rgya che la dpangs mtho ba/ gra dag la grangs mang ba ngom che la ya mtshar ba/bltas na mig khengs pa/ bsam na yid tshim pa/ bshad na rang dga' ba/ gleng na gzhan spro ba/ gzhi na sdod pa'i tshogs dga' ba yin tsa na da gang sa gang ci nas bka' drin che zhu ba 'di yin te// 'di skad du/ phun tshogs dge mtshan bkra shis 'bum phrag gis/ /mngon par mdzes pa ga'al med khang ba na/ /lugs gnyis rdzogs pa'i dga' ston rgya che bas/ /skye rgu bde ba'i longs spyod g.yang du chags/ /zhes bya ba ni ngo mtshar ba'i gtam gyi sbyor ba bcu ba yin/slad ma'i char la ji skad du/ zhu 'phrin kun bzang sprin gyi me tog las/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kun gyi/ /mdzad pa rang gi rnam thar gyi/ /cha shas la yadra rdzogs pa'i lcid/ /'gro la bka' drin char du snyil/ /zhes zhus pa ltar/ skyabs mgon bdun pa chen po sku mched 'di gnyis kyi zhabs pad bskal ba rgya mtsho'i bar du brtan/ phyi nang gsang gsu ma gyi yon tan/ ma khas btsun bzang gsum gyi rnam thar/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi legs mdzad/ 'khor lo rnam gsum gyi 'phrin las/ma tshan snyan bstod gsum gyi grags snyan sogs ches ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa dang rnam thar mtha' dag 'dzam gling mtha' gru yangs pa'i rgyan du bkod de ljongs 'dir gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i lugs gnyis bde

200 ————skyid kyi/ nyi ma rdzogs phar 'char bar 'argyur ba ni/ tshad mar gyur ba'i 'u nga las/ rje khyod kyi sger skal gdul bya'i zhing / /yul reb gong gser mo ljongs chen du/ /dus snyigs ma'i rgud pa kun zhi nas/ /g.yang bde skyid nyi ma 'char bar mdzod/ ces rga/sungs pa ltar la/ de ni ngo mtshar ba'i gtam gyi sbyor ba bcu sku/cig pa yin/ de ltar smra ba'i nyi ma chen po gang gis ston bshad rgyas par gnang ba la/ lan tsam zhig 'bul khul bgyis pa ni/ lugs gnyis kyi 'gro lugs dang sgo bstun pa'i dga' ston gyi cha gcig ste/ 'dir tshogs thams cad dgyes pa chen po bskyed pa ci gnang / zhes zhu zhu lags/ /

201stod cha bis mdo'i sems bskyed yar zhus kyis 'thus par byas te rong bo'i lam rim skabs yar khyas kha snon/phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i chos sde chen po rong bo'i thos bsam gling zhes mtshan tsam yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rgyan du che ba/ mdo smad lho rgyud kyi bshad grwa ma lus pa'i phyi mo/ ljongs 'di'i bstan pa mtha' dag gang las gyes pa'i rtsa ba/ lung dang rigs pa smra ba'i mkhas pa mtha' yas pa'i bskyi gnas/ bshad sgrub kyi rtsal dang ldan pa'i skyes chen dpag tu med pa'i 'byung khungs/ sdom brtson dge 'dun khri phrag rgya mtsho ltar 'khyil ba 'di nyid kyi lugs gnyis mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan che bgres rnams kyis dbu mdzad/ bka' rab 'byams smra ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis gdong khur te grwa rgan gzhon thams cad kyis 'dun sa chig dril gyis kha zhe med par snying thag pa nas gsol ba yang dang yang du btab pa la brten nas/ kun mkhyen bla ma parnyi ta chen po nyid nas dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du mdzad de/ sngon thub pa'i dbang bo sa bcu'i sems dpa' dang dgra bcom pa zhi dul gyi ngang tshul rab

da lnga02 tu yangs pa stong phrag mang pos bskor te/ mnyan yod kyi gtsug lag khang du gshegs pa'i rnam thar nged cag la mig mthong lag /zin gyi tshul du bstan pa/ mdo sngags rig gnas yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po'i 'khor dang bcas te gdan sa chen po 'di nyid du chibs bsgyur/ 'jigs pa med pa'i seng ge'i khri la khyu mchog rlabs po che'i stabs kyis gshegs/ 'bum phrag nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gcig char dkrigs pa lta bu'i gzi byin gyis snang ba yongs su rgyas pa'i sku mchog lham mer/lhang nger bzhugs shing / gsung 'gog pa med pa'i tshangs dbyangs mtha' dbus kun la khyab gdal du bsgrags te/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad kyi gnad bsdus pa/ shing rta chen po rnam gnyis kyi lam srol gzhir btang ba/ mnyam med jo bo yab sras kyi gdams pas khog phub pa/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi man ngag srog tu byas pa/ rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying bo rang gi thugs kyi bcud phyung ba/ byang chub la ma rim chen mo zhes grags pa chos dang chos min gyi shan 'byed byed/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i gzhung thig gcig bu/ mkhas pa dang sgom chen pa mtha' dag gi bca' yig chen mo de nyid kyi bshad lung rnam par dag pa zla ngo gcig gi jing la bka' drin du stsal zhing / de yang zhal lung gi rgyun rnam dag gnang ba tsam ma yin par nyi ma re re bzhin du/ gzhung gi spyi khog 'char ba'i yan lag tu bsdus don gyis sa bcad sngon du btang / gzhung tshig zhib mor nges pa'i yan lag tu tshig gi 'bru ma lus pa mthar chags su gnyer/gsung rab thams cad rnga/—/noms ngag tu 'char ba'i yan lag tu brka//'a pod

203chen po lnga la sogs pa bka' dang dgongs 'grel yod do cog gzhung gi thad ka thad kar sbyar/ gzhung chen mo la bshad pa 'jug pa'i yan lag tu dpyod tshul gyi man ngag mi 'dra ba lde mig tu stsal/ mkhas pa'i legs bshad so sor nges pa'i yan lag tu yig cha so so'i bzhed tshul ma 'dres par bkod/ bshad pa'i rigs na yam du mi 'gro ba'i yan lag tu rang lugs kyi 'jog mtshams rgyab skyobs dang bcas te gnang / gang shes nyams len la 'char ba'i yan lag tu dmigs khrid kyi mdo lag tu len tshul byin/ gang gsung thams cad tshad mas gting phug pas sgro 'dogs chod zin gyi don bsgoms pas rtogs pa mngon du gyur ba'i nyams myong kho na'i steng nas gsungs pa sogs legs par bshad pa thang mar brdal te brag thog nas chu 'phyo ba ltar gnang bas gdul bya rab 'bring tha gsum gyi rgyud la sngon med pa'i legs bshad kyi sa bon bsam gyis mi ‘khyab pa bskrun te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob nges su mdzad pa dang / khyad par du/grwa tshang rin po che 'dir bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtha' yas pa zam ma chad par 'byung ba'i rmang gzhi brtan por btsugs pa'i bka' drin ni bdag cag gis lus srog longs spyod ji snyed pa'i bskal ba gaṅgā'i klung gi bye grangs su bsnyen bkur yang cha tsam gzhal bar ga la nus/ 'on kyang / zla med zhing la bsod nams bskrun pa dang / /rnyed dka'i chos kyi dbu 'phang bstod pa dang / /rang gzhan dge tshogs sdud pa'i thabs mchog la/ /sri zhu bla mar bgyid las gzhan sdod min/ /zhos pa yid la brnag pas dngos po dman yang bsam pa rnam par dag pas

204kun nas bslangs te rten 'brel gyi legs lam cung zad bsgrigs pa ni/mo mo moces 'bul lam zhu ba lags na/slad kyi don la gsol ba 'debs pa'i snying po ni/ gzhom gzhig bral ba mi 'jigs seng ge'i khrir/ /bskal brgyar zung 'jug nor bu'i za ma tog /rab brtan mdzad bzang tshangs pa'i me tog gis/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde mdzes pa'i dpal byin cig /ces gsol nas/ dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa ma lus pa'i spyi gzugs yab gcig chos kyi rgyal bo kun mkhyen pazhi ta chen po nyid ni bskal ba brgya phrag gi bar du bstan par bzhugs pa dang / bshad sgrub kyi mdzad bzang sa gsum na 'granatshuzla med pa'i dpal du 'phags bzhin pa 'di'i mu nas gser mdog cod pan 'chang ba'i ring lugs dri ma med pa spyi dang yang sgo sa grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho'i lam srol 'dzin skyong spel ba'i thugs bskyed gzhar yang mi 'dor ba dang / chos sde 'di nyid kyi skye rgyud lung rtogs kyis mtho ba'i bla ma khri gdan zur/ mdo sngags lung rigs kyis phyugs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gang bzhugs/ blo gsal don gnyer gyis rgyan ldan khrims ldan dge 'dun mtha' dag gi chos srid 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba gang mchis yar zla bzhin gong du 'phel ba dang / grwa tshang thos bsam rnam par rgyal ba'i gling 'dir/ gser gyi ri bo ltar gzi byin che ba'i skyes chen dam pa nyi ma dang zla ba ltar grags pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu/ rgya mtsho sa la 'khyil ba 'dra ba'i mdo sngags yongs rdzogs kyi bshes gnyen/ stag seng mchongs la 'gran pa lta bu'i bshes gnyen rigs pa smra ba/ don mthun

205gser gling la chas pa lta bu blo gsal chos don gnyer ba/ gangs dkar dpal du chags pa lta bu'i lnga rig mkhyen pa'i mkhas pa/ pad dkar chun po rgyas pa lta bu'i sdom gsum dag pa'i btsun pa/ dpag bsam ljon pa rgyas pa lta bu'i lhag bas/ma dkar ba'i bzang pa sogs/ thos bsam sgom gsum// 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum/ lta sgom spyod ga/sum gang thad nas gru bzhi lam mer 'dzoms pa'i mkhas mang 'dus pa'i tshogs yar rgyas 'byung ba dang / gyi gong sa skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po'i gdul zhing / lha btsun spyi dpon nang so chen mo'i mnga' zhabs reb gong gser mo ljongs 'di'i/ skye rgyud rigs kyis ma tho ba/ tsā dreg gtam gyis btsan pa/ shed can stobs kyis dpa' ba / rgyu can nor gyis phyug pa/ gnyen can dpung gis brjid pa/dad can bsod nams kyis ngom pa gang mchis kyi bsam don bde blag tu 'grub pa dang / khyad par du/ 7 skyabs mgon bdun pa chen po thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyal srid la bshad sgrub gser gyi 'khor los mnga' dbang bsgyur te/ ljongs 'dis mtshon pas yangs pa'i sa chen po rtsol med 'phrin las kyi stobs yang dag pas nye bar skyong ba'i dngos grub bka' drin du stsol ba mkhyen mekhyen zhes zhu nga/ lags na/ don ldan gsung gsang bdud rtsi'i bsangs gtor gyis/ ri /bdag cag gdung ba zhi ba'i dpal byin nas/ / sngon med dga' ston spel ba'i phun tshogs ni/ /deng 'dir bkra shis dpal gyi snying bor stsol/ /zhes kyang zhu lags/ /

— 206 kun mkhyen 'jigs med parnyi ta skyabs mgone bdun pa'i rigs bdag tu phebs skabs 'bul bshad du spel ba/oṃ bde legs su gyur cig phun tshogs bshad sgrub gser gyi 'khor lo yis/ /blo bzang bstan la 'dod dgur dbang byas pa'i/ /rnam 'dren chos kyi rgya la po yab sras kyi/ /rlabs chen mdzad 'phrin phyogs las rgyal gyur cig /ces shis pa brjod pa'i snya na tshig gi me tog ci yang gtor te/rmad du byung ba'i rten 'byung phun sum tshogs pa'i legs lam gyi sgo 'phar yangs por phyes nas/ de yang ji skad du/ mi 'gyur bde stong ye shes rol rtsed las/ /gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gzugs kyi skus/ /dpag yas skal ldan smin cing grol mdzad pa'i/ /zla med skyabs mgon dam pa'i zhabs drung du/ /zhes smra ba'i dbyangs kyi rgyud las drangs pa bzhin/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag po/ rgyal dang rgyal sras rma lus pa'i mes po/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi thugs mi 'gyur 'de stong chen po'i rol gar cir ya nga bsgyur pa/ sa/sum ldan rdo rje

— — 201'dzin pa chen po/ khyab bdag dus kyi ston pa bla na med pa'i gzugs skur mngon par bzhengs te / ris su ma bcas pa'i skal ldan dpas/ par mi nus pa'i blo sna smin cing / srid 'i/'i rgud pa las grol bar mdzad pa 'i skye rgu'i rnam 'dren dbang bo/ mdzad 'phrin zla med pa'i skyabs mchog bla ma'i zhabs drung thar 'dod yongs kyi 'jug ngogs khyon yangs par/ gus pa chen pos zhus bzhin gsol ba 'debs pa'i snying bo ni/de yang mkhas dang grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba chen po/ gyi gong sa (skyabs mgon bdun pa chen po'i rigs kyi bdag po sa/tso bor gyur pa nyid ni / bskal ba dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas 'jam dpal zhi khro dang gnyis su med par sku bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i go 'phang la longs su byas zin na'ang / nam mkha'i dbyings na zla ba gcig nyid kyang / /sa yi steng na chu snod ji snyed par/ /grangs bzhin 'char ba'i ya mtshan 'dir ltos dang / /bsam yas rgyal ba'i rol ba yid la 'bab/ /gsungs pa ltar/ dag pa dang ma dag pa'i zhing khams ji snyed par/ gdul bar bya ba'i grangs mnyam gyi sprul ba bgrangs su med par ma zad/ rgyal ba don kun grub pa'i mdun na/ 'jam dpal lta bu blo gros rin chen/ /shing rta chen po klu sgrub kyi mdun na/ /grub pa'i khyu ma chog sha wa ri ba/ /bha ro grub pa'i dbang bo'i drung na/ /rwa lo mthu stobs rdo rje grags pa/ /rgya la ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa'i dpal du/ /gsang chen ryā dzod 'dzin dpal ldan rdo rje/yab rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i sras su/ /rna la 'byor dbang bo shes rab rgyal mtshan// /sgru ba bstan mnga' bdag gser khang ba'i sras su/ yub pa'i

20skyedabang rgyug 'jigs med bsam gtan sogs mtshan tsam gyis kyang bstan pa skyong ba'i skyes mchog mtha' yas pas bstan 'gro'i phan bde dgung du spel ba'i mur/ sku tshe 'dir yang rigs rus phun sum tshogasmo pa shingasā la chen po lta bu'i rgyal rigs su sku'i srid bzung / gong sa drug pa chen po sogs ye shes kyi spyan mnga' ba du masardzong dkar grub pa'i dbang bo'i yang sprul du thag bcad/ gzhon nu nas kun mkhyen rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa'i gral la zhugs te/ rtsod dus kyi dpal ldan a ti sha chen poco zhwa dmar paṇḍi ta dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi 'phags pa nye bar 'khor gcig pu khri chen 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho/ dus 'dir zla med pha'i parnyi ta chen po/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma blo bzang dpal ba sogs legs par bshad pa ji snyed pa'i dgos 'dod dngos grub tu zhu ba'i chos kyi ded daphon chen por bsam sbyor mtshungs pa med pas yang dag par bsten/mdo rgyud rig gnas la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i bya btang seng gi srab med nam mkha' la 'phyo ba lta bu du ma ma tshan zhabs su khrid de/ bstan pa'i gzhung shing byams chos sde lnga/ bstan pa'i snying bo rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum/bstan pa 'i lcags ri tshad ma sde bdun/ bstan pa'i gzhi ma 'dul lung sde bzhi/ bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan mngon pa gong 'og sogs mdo phyogs kyis bsdus pa'i bka' pod ma lus pa dang / sgyu lus ma thar thug ston pa pha rgyud kyi rgya la bo dpal gsang ba 'dus pa/ bde stong mthar thug ston pa ma rgyud kyi gtso bo dpal 'khor lo sdom pa/ 'khrul 'khor mthar thug ston sge gshed rgyud kyi snying bo dpal chen lha ra wa ba/ stong gzugs mi 'gyur pa'i

209bde ba rtsal du 'don pa gsal rgyal dus kyi 'khor lo/ spyi sgor migasang ba mtha' yas pa'i 'atram̐ng khungs 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud sogs gtso bor byas te/sgro sngags phyogs bsdus pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod lhag lus med pa dang / sgra dang tshad ma/ bzo dang gso ba/ snyan tshig dang ldeb sbyor/ skar rtsis dang dbyangs 'char sogs mkhas pas bsgab 'os kyi rig pa'i gnas yod do cog la nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu gsan sbyong bla na med pa sngon 'phags pa'i yul gyi pazhi ta rnams kyis ji ltar mdzad pa de lta bu phyag tu bstar bas/ da lta'i dus su rgyu skar gyi khrod na nyirtsozla/ rkang 'thung gi tshal na yongs 'dus bzhin du/ rgya gar chu bo gang ga tshun na 'gran zla dang bral te 'dzam gling rgyan gyi partsi ta chen por bzhugs pa lags shing / smin byed chos kyi chu bo la spyi bka' dang zur bka'i dbang sum brgyar nye ba/ rjes gnang rigs gtad kyi skor brgyad brgya lhag dang /grol byed khrid kyi gdams pa la/ myong khrid gzab khrid kyi rigs bdun cu lhag gzhung don bogs chod du ster ba'i bshasdolung sum cu skor dang /rgyab brten lung gi rim pa la bka' bstan sa/tsor gyur gyi glegs bam lnga brgyar nye ba dang / chos tshan khri phrag du ma'i chos rgyun tshong 'dus kyi 'o ma baji/na bsre bslad du ma gyur pa/ gangs seng dkar mo'i 'o ma lta bu 'khrul bral rtsod med kyi gnas su bzhugs shing / med du mi rung bar gsan dgos pa'i rigs mchis so cog gi rgyun bzhes pas lung chos kyi bang mdzod du gyur pas/ ṭwāṃ ji skad du/ rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i dbang khrid bshad pa'i rgyun / /

210mtha' dag thugs kyi yol gor legame bzung nas/ /nges gsang theg pa'i rgyud kyi zab gnad kun/ /gsal gzigs rig sngags 'chang ba'i dbang bor grub/ /ces brjod pa ltar te/ de ltar lung gi bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chen por gyur pa na/ dben pa'i gnas mchog dge legs chos rdzong sogs su dgun dpyid mtha' dag la bcad rgya dam po dang / dus rnam kun du thun bzho'i rnal 'byor chags med kyi ngang nas/ sangs rgyas bcom rildan 'das kyi dgongs don/ shing rta chen po gnyis kyi lam srol/ 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i thugs bcud// dben sa bka' rgyud rin po che 'i snyan brgyud/ grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho'i rma na ngag yongs su rdzogs pa thugs nyams su bstar bas nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad klong rdol/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi mdzad pa mtha' klas pas zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i ring lugs 'dzin skyong spel ba la thugs bskyed kyi rang mdangs gzugs can bzhin du gyur te grags snyan gyi rnga bo che srid zhi'i rna ba'i rgyan du gyur pa'i skabs nyid na/ 7 tho/nga sa skyabs mgon bdun pa chen po sa/ser ljongs yul gyi mugon dang / skyabs dang dpung gnyen zla med pa'i chos srid kyi 'khor los sgyur pajichen por mnga' dbang bskur ba la / bshad snab gnyis char gyi rang rtsal yongs su rdzogs pa'i rigs kyi cod pan rje nyid lta bur gdan 'dren mi med mi rung ba'i nges shes thob nas / nged cag 'a/bas gras su gtogs pa che phra kun nas thun mong du gsol ba btab pa na/ mgon po nyid nas kyang / blo bzang rgyal byā'i dkyilu 'khoru chen po yis/ /mkhyen rab zhogs med nane matisdo sgrosgo phye

ma — /shā/rdo41/ ༷1/ nas/ /'dzam gling chos kyi nyi ma khyod shar bas/ /tsogs kun dge legs 'od kyis lham mer mdzes/ /zhes pa'i don la ring mo nas brnag pa'i thugs bskyed kyi 'jug pa dus las mi yol ba'i dgongs pa tshomangon du mdzad de/ bla brang nor bu gru badzin gyi chos kyi gtsug lag khang chen por/ lha mi'i dregs ldan mtha' dag gi gtsug gi nor bu dang / phyogs kyi skal bzang ma lus pas dad pas phyag bya ba'i mchod sdong / 'jigs pa med pa seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i khri la zhabs sen bkod de/ dus gsu/ma rgyal ba thams cad kyi lam po che byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i myong khrid kyis thog drangs te zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor zhing / slad— mar mdo sngags rig ba/nas snyan brgyud man ngag gi rim pa gang mchis thams cad lhag lus med par bum pa gang byo'i tshul du stsal ba'i legs ne mdzad gtan pa med pa'i sgo rab tu dbye ba la/ e ma 'di lta bu'i thugs la rab tu btags pa lags so/ /zhes zhu ba'i rten dang / nam yang gzhal du med pa'i bka' drin nam mkha' ltar yangs ba'i cha tsam bsab pa'i phyir dang / mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam/ /de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi/ /ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes don lag tu len pa'i ched du/ mo mo mobacas 'bul na/ dgyes pa chen pos bdag gir bzhes te/ bskal ba bye ba rnams su yang / /chos ston mdzad cing bzhugs gyur cig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bskal ba khri phrag khri dzeg tu zhabs pad mi 'gyur rdo rje'i khams su brtan nas/ rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho'i sku phreng re re'i

212 dzedus na'ang yab sras gnyis kyi thugs bskyed lu gu rgyud du 'brel bas skyabs mgon mchog gi phrin las khor yug tu spel ba ji lta ba bzhin/ sku tshe 'dir yang gong sa bdun pa chen po la/ mdo rgyud kyi gzhung bshad/ rig gnas migadzrab khrid/ dbang chen gyi byin rlabs/ bklag lu nga gi chos rgyun/nyams khrid kyi man ngag snyan brgyud kyi zhal shes gang yod pha nor bu la 'bog pa bzhin du gnang ba dang / mkhas pa la 'os pa'i 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ spub pa la 'os pa'i lta sgom spyod gsum/ bstan 'dzin la 'os pa'i bshad sgrub zung 'brel/ chen po la 'os pa'i 'phrin las rlabs chen rnams kyang ring bo mi thogs par bdag gir mdzad pa'i 'gal spong mthun sgrub thams cad/ kun mkhyen grub dbang bla ma nyag gcig pus thugs khur cher bzhes mdzad pa dang / skyabs mgon mchog sprul rin po che 'di nyid kyi sku tshe bshad sgrub kyi mdzad pa/ lugs gnyis kyi 'phrin las yab sras kyi thugs bzhis dang / nged cag gi re 'dun ltar rgyas pa la phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad gang yod thugs dam zab mo'i byin rlabs dang / mthu stobs mi zad pa'i dpung gis lhag med du sel ba dang / mdor na gangs can rgyal ba'i dbang bo bdun pa chen po ji lta ba bzhin/ dge ldan bstan pa'i mnga' bdag lha dang mi'i ston pa/ rgya bod hor gsum du 'phrin las rtsod med du gyis ba'i gzhi rtsa skyabs rje dam pa nyid la re ba ltos pa snying thag pa nas 'cha' bar byed na/ re sa nas bslu bar mi mdzad par/ spyan gyi 'bras bu dang thugs kyi ze 'u 'bru bzhin du skyong ba mkhyen mkhyen mkhye/ na/zhis gsol ba hur tshugs su 'debs pa dang / chos sde chen po 'di kas

gtsos chos kyi grwa rnams su bshad sgrub 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba mtha' dag gong 'beel du 'gyur ba'i thugs bskyed kyi dpung stobs cir yang spel ba mu zhu zhu/ ches zhu na zhal bzhes 'gyur ba med pa'i me tog rgya cher stsol ba mkhyin mkhyen lags// //

2 14seng ge gshong ya 'go'i 'du khang rab gnas skabs sku phyogs rnam gnyis la zhu byar spel ba/'o lags so/ de yang ji skad du/ dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrogs pa'i tshul/ /ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te/ /chos rnams ma lus yongs su ston pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang 'jig rten bde legs shog /ces shis brjod ngo mtshar gyi me tog mngon par gtor te/ lung dang rtogs pa mi zad pa rgyal bcirnams dang tha mi dad pa'i dpal ldan bla ma chos kyi rgyal bo yab rje rdo rje 'chang chen po rnam gnyis nyi zla zung 'brel gyi zhabs drung skal bzang thar 'dod yongs kyi 'jug ngogs dam par / 'jigs shing zhum pas gus pa dang bcas te zhu bya'i snying bo ni/ de yang bdag cag skya ser thams cad kyis ring mo nas 'bad pa chen pos gtsug lag khang 'di nyid rten dang brten par bcas pa legs par bsgrubs te/ ji ltar re ba'i 'bras bu lhag dang bcas yongs su grub pa deng gi dus nyid na/ ye shes kyi byin dbab pa'i ched du mgon po rnam gnyis la gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pa thugs rje'i gzigs pa dus las mi yol bas nye bar dgongs te/ dbang phyogs sa 'dzin gyi rtse mo las rnam par dag pa'i nyi zla lhan

215rgyas su shar ba bzhin du phyags phebs/ skye rgu'iri bsod nams spel zhing 'jig rten la bde legs kyi bkra shis ci yang rgyas pa'i rab gnas kyi dgongs pa phun sum tshogs pa/ de nyid bcu zung dang ldan zhing mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len phra rags ma lus pa la sbyangs shing mkhas pa'i rab gnas mdzad pa po phun sum tshogs pa/ lo zla gza' skar bzang zhing tshes grangs dus sbyor bdud rtsi thun mtshams sogs rnam par dge ba'i rab gnas kyi dus phun sum tshogs pa/ yid mthun bkra shis shing zhi rgyas kyi las la mchog tu bsngags pa'i dge mtshan ma lus pa mngon gyur du tshang ba'i rab gnas kyi gnas phun sum tshogs pa/ rgyud dang bstan bcos las ji ltar gsungs shing 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i phyag bzhes gra ma nyams pa'i cho ga rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las phyi ma khungs dag ngos gtsang phyag tu bstar ba'i rab gnas kyi cho ga phun sum tshogs pa/ sku gsung thugs rten gyi rigs dang gtsug lag khang bgrang phreng rdo dril mtsho rdzing skyed tshal sogs las da lo'i gtsug lag khang brten pa ngo mtshar dang bcas pa'i rab gnas kyi bsgrub rten phun sum tshogs pa sogs/ phun sum tshogs pa drug ldan gyi sgo nas ji ltar lnga ldan zhing gi dkyil 'khor/ dzam bu'i rgyal mtshan gyi rkang 'thung rnam par nga/krigs pa'i zhing khams 'di nyid kyi rgyan du mngon par bskrun pa'i tshogs khang khor yug dang bcas la rnam par dag pa'i byin phabs pa'i bka' drin ni/ stong gsum yangs pa'i yol go ma lus pa rgyal srid rin po che bdun gyis bkang ste phul yang cha tsam gzhal ga la nus/ 'on kyang 'byor tshogs kyi dngos 'bul mtshon tsam 'bul ba ni 'di ltar/

216྾ ྾ ྾ bcas 'bul ba lags na/ ji skad du/ blo bzang 'dun sa chos kyi pho brang 'di/ /bslab gsum rnam dag rtse gcig sgrub la brtson/ /rnal 'byor rab byung tshogs kyis yongs gang bas/ /thub bstan yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ blo ldan skal bzang mtha' dag gi 'dun sa/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i chos kyi pho brang rmad du byung ba 'di nyid/ rig gnas sbyong ba'i mkhas pa/ bslab gsum sgrub pa'i btsun pa/ bstan 'gror sman pa'i bzang ba/ rnal 'byor sgom pa'i grub pa sogs mtshan don mthun pa'i rab byung mtha' yas pas yongs su gang ste/ bshad sgrub kyi bya ba dri ma med pa'i ba dan gyi rgya/la mtshan srid pa'i rtse la reg pa'i bar du bsgrengs pas thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas/ pa dang / phan bde mi zad pa'i snang ba bla lhag tu dar bas/ yangs pa'i 'jig rten ma lus pa bkra shis bde skyid kyi dpal gya nom pas khyab pa mkhyen mkhyen zhu lags///

214yab gcig chos kyi rgyal po pha rgod bla ma rdo rje 'chang nas yig sgar du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor skabs kyi bshad par spel ba/de yang ji skad du/ 'jigs med rnam dpyod sprin gyi phung bo las//mnyan 'os dam pa'i chos zab bdud rtsi'i char/ /blo ldan rgya mtsho'i gsos su 'beeb mkhas pa/ /mchog sprul smra ba'i dbang bo/ zhes bsngags brjod bden tshigargyagi dbyangs snyan 'jigs pa med pa seng ge'i nga ro'i rgyud du drangs pa ltar/ rang don phun tshogs phyi nang gsang ba'i bdud rigs lhag ma med par dag pa chos kyi dbyangs su bcom nas 'jigs pa med pa stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi'i bsdus pa'i rnam par dpyod pa'i ye shes kyi sprin phung ci yang dkrigs pa'i klong zad mi shes pa las/ gzhan don phun tshogs mnyan par 'os pa'i yan lag sogs drug cu'i dbyangs kyi khyad par ma lus pas rab tu snye ba'i gsung ngag dri ma med pa'i lam nas dam pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs zab la rgya che ba sgrib gnyis mi bzad pa'i rims nad drungs nas 'byen pa'i bdud rtsi tshad du longs pa'i gru char/ris su ma chad pa'i gdul bya blo gros kyi rtsal dang ldan pa sogs yon tan gyi

〈pe1nyu) — — mdzes pa phyogs su rdzogs shing grags snyan gyi rol mo ci dgar 'khrol ba ñtsa ma/tsho'i grangs su 'ardal ba'i phan bde myu gu g.yur du za ba'i gsos su/thugs bskyed kyi smon pa dus su smin cing 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyu nyid kyis phyogs dang dus su ma dmigs par rtag par 'beb pa la mkhas pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rigs thams cad kyi bdag po dpal chen rdo rje 'jigs byed rgyal ba thams cad kyi mes po rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mchog gi sprul ba'i sku dus kyi mtha' na smra ba thams cad las rnam par rgya la ba'i dbang bo sa/cig pur grub pa/ dpal kun mkhyen grub pa'i dbang bo gang gi zhabs zung bkra shis kyi dge mtshan srid na dregs pa can mtha' dag gi nor bu'i cod pan rnam par sgeg pa'i lang tsho dang nye bar 'grogs pa'i nye drung ga la bar/ phu dud kyi dngos po ma lus pas phyag byas te gang zhig zhu ba ni/rgyal ba'i bstan la rgyal ba las/ /lhag pa'i mdzad pa grangs mang ste/ /skye rgu'i phan bde spel ba la/ /'gran zla dben pa'i grags pa 'bar/ /zhes kyang zhu ba ltar/ mgon po nyid ni sngon dus kyi yar sna grangs su mi bzung ba'i skabs nyid nas rigs thams cad kyi bla ma dam pa dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang tha mi dad par sku bzhi bri gang ma dmigs pa'i rgyal thabs longs su bzhes zin na'ang / thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyal bstan cir yang spel ba la gang 'dul gyi rol gar zad mi shes pa bzung ba ni/ yul gser ljongs kyi parnyi ta ngag dbang mi pham zla bas/nam mkha'i dbyings na zla ba gcig nyid kyang / /sa yi ste nga na chu snod ji

219 snyed par/ /grangs bzhin 'char ba'i ya mtshan 'di ltos dang / /bsam yas rgyal ba'i rol ba yid la 'bab/ /ces gsungs pa ltar lags pas/kun mkhyen bu ram shing ba'i drung na rgyal sras kun gyi thu bo jam dpal blo gros rin chen/ shing rta chen po klu sgrub kyi mdun na grub thob yongs kyi gtso bo dpal ldan sha wa ri ba/ lha gcig gri paṃ ka ra'i drung na paṇa chen kun gyi dbang po paṇḍi ta sa yi snying bo/ 'jigs mdzad bha ro chen po'i mdun na mthu stobs yongs kyi 'khor sgyur rwa lo rdo rje grags pa/ 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i drung na sgrub bstan yongs kyi mnga' bdag rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ ba so chos kyi rgya la mtshan gyi drung na rig 'dzin yongs kyi dbang po grub chen dpal ldan rdo rje/ skyabs mgon skal ldan rgya mtsho'i drung na mkhas grub kun gyi sa/tso bo thugs sras shes rab bkra shis/ ྈma 'dren gser khang pa'i mdun na rtogs ldan yongs kyi thu bo grub dbang 'jigs med bsam gtan sogs mkhas pa dang grub pa'i sprul ba mtha' klas pas thun mong ba pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa mi nub pa'i rgyal ma tshan dgung du btegs pa'i phyag rjes kyi ri mo mi shigs pa rdo rje/ mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung / mi nub pa rgyal mtshan bzhin du deng gi dus nyid na'ang mtha' dbus kun na gsal ba 'di bzhin lags la/ grub pa'i dbang bo kun mkhyen bla ma chen po nyid kyang / gser ljongs yul gyi sa dbang tshangs ba chen po rnam gnyis kyi ya gyal shing sa la chen po lta bu'i rigs rgyuni du sprul ba'i zlos gar mngon du bsgyur/ sa'i steng na che ba'i che ba mtha' dag gi

lha20 — — — — gtsug gi cod pan du gyur cing / rtsod med kyi mkhas pa khyu ma chog rlabs po che'i gnas mngon du mdzad pas/ nyi ma dang zla ba ltar grags che ba'i dge ba'i gshes gnyen 'dzam gling rgyan gyi mkhas grub du ma rigs kyi bdag po'i tshul du bsten de/ ji skad du/ 'phral yun 'dod pa 'jo ba'i bum pa bzang / /kun gyi dga' skyed rmad byung rgyan gyi phul/ /mkhas rgu'i gtsug nor dbang byed 'khor lo che/ /grags pa'i me tog phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i ljon/ /zhes pa'i bsnga gas brjod mi zad pa'i me tog char du gtibs pa'i go/nas bla na med pa/ sgra dang tshad ma/ bzo dang gso ba/ snyan tshig dang sdebs sbyor/ mngon brjod dang zlos gar/ skar rtsis dang 'byung rtsis/ dbyangs 'char dang dus sbyor/ brtag pa dang rten 'brel/ lugs kyi bstan bcos kyis mtshon pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i rig gnas che phra mtha' dag sbyangs pas/ mkhas pa chen po'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad/ bstan pa'i sa/zhi ma 'dul pa'i spyod pa/ bstan pa'i gzhung shing phar phyin gyi sgom pa/ bstan pa'i snying bo dbu ma'i lta ba/ bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan mngon pa'i ting 'dzin/ bstan pa'i lcags ri tshad ma'i rigs pas mtshon pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'i gzhung don rgya mtsho lta bu la gsan bsam phu thag chod pa gnang bas nges don kyi partsi ta chen po'i gnas bdag gir bzhes/ 'bras bu rnam mthun gyi lam zab rmad du byung ba rgyud sde rnam bzhi/ sgyu lus bsgrub tshul gyi rang bzhin rtsal du 'don pa pha rgyud gsang 'dus/ 'od gsal mngon byed kyi lam zab rtsal du 'don pa ma rgyud bde ma—chog zab gnad brgya phrag

sto — rwaperwarterwa/gis gzhan las/ ches cher 'phags pa 'jigs mdzad dbang bo/ bshad sro la thun min gyis rgyud sde spyi las phye ba dus kyi 'khor lo sogs gsang chen rgyud kyi theg pa ma lus pa gzigs pa'i rgyud chen rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i mtshan snyan don ldan gyi grags pa rang gir mdzad/ mkhas pa brgyud pa'i bshad srol/ rtogs ldan brgyud pa'i nyams bsdur/ rnal 'byor brgyud pa'i drod tshad/ tshad ldan brgyud pa'i zhal shes/ lhag par du 'jam mgon snyan brgyud kyi man ngag dben sa bka' brgyud rin po che zung 'jug gi mu tig dar la brgyus pa lta bu skyabs maso/na skal ldan rgya mtsho sogs gru ba chen nas grub chen la snyan nas snyan dang zhal nas zhal du brgyud pa'i gdams pa mtha' dag gi bang mdzod gcig pu grub pa'i yab gcig man ngag gi gter chen rje btsun chos kyi rgyal por bsngags pa don dang bcas shing / de lta bu'i gsung rab rig byed dang bcas pa'i gzhung kun gdams par shar te / dben pa'i gnas mchog dge legs chos rdzong dang / pad dkar chos kyi gling mchog sogs sgrub pa'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid ma lus pa rang chas su rdzogs pa'i dga' tshal du mar lo sbrel zla sbrel gyis myong ba tshad la 'beb pa'i sgrub pa lhur bzhes shing / dpyid dbyar ston dgun gyi dus bzhi kun tu thun drug thun bzhi'i nyams bzhes chag lus dang bri 'jog ma mchis pas mkhas gub rtsol med la yon tan ches cher tu grags pa'i nyams dang rtogs pa mi chizad pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo yangs por grol/ mkhas pa la 'os pa'i 'a chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ rtogs ldan la 'os pa'i lta sgom rnam dag bsta na 'dzin la 'os pa'i mkhas btsun bzang gsum/ chen po

222la 'os pa'i rnyed bkur grags gsum sogs gcig las gcig lhag gi tshul du 'phel ba na/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug gis/ ma tshang med rgyu de la ni/ /'bras bu gang gis zlog par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ gzhan don 'phrin las kyi rgyu tshogs tshad du longs gshis/ skye rgyud kyis mtho ba'i bla sprul du ma/ yon tan gyis mtho ba'i bya bral mang po/ chos spyod kyis mtho ba'i dgon sde che phra/ lung las kyis mtho ba'i dpon slob brgya phrag dpal 'byor gyis mtho ba'i ru sde khri phrag mang pos dad gsum mi 'gyur pa'i zur phad kyis zhabs stegs 'jigs pa med pa'i seng ge'i khri la 'dud cing /༄bstod bsngags mi zad pa'i rol mo brgya phrag mgrin pa'i dbyangs su 'gug pa/ gces rgu'i yo byad kyi dngos po snyim pa'i bcud du byas te thugs rje don yod 'phrul gyi zhags pas nye bar zin pa la rangs shing brel ba'i skabs nyid na/ bdag cag sgrub pa'i dga' tshal yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi dge 'dun 'dus spyi nas kyang spyan 'dren gyi gsol ba nan cher phul ba la sgrib pa mi mnga' ba'i ye shes kyis dus la bab par gzigs/ brtse chen btang snyoms mi mnga' bas gdul bya'i gral du dmigs te/ ji ltar ngang ba'i rgyal bo ngang ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ bstan pa'i bdag po dgra bcom yongs kyis bskor ba/ mnyam med jo bo paṇa chen du mas bskor ba bzhin/yongs su rdzogs pa'i bshes gnyen du ma'i 'khor slob dang bcas gdan gshegs/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba so thar gyi sdom pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i dngos po la bkod/ sa chen po la gnas pa'i sems dpa' chen po du mas ljags rtse g.yo bar mi nus pa'i gsung bshad 'byams klas pas mtha' bcad/

— 223man ngag dmar /phrid kyi 'a ga len dpung du ba sgril ba brgya phrag gis khog phub/ nyams myong tha snyad kyi sgrib g.yogs dam du ma 'byar mtha' klas bas ngar bton te byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i nyams khrid smin rgyas su stsal/sku bzhi'i sa bon theb nges kyi dbang bzhi tshad du 'khyol ba rnam grangs su bskur/ grol byed dang rgyab brten gyi khrid lung gang 'dod lhugs par byo ba'i bka' drin ni/ srid kyi phan pa rgya che yang / /chos kyi chung ngu'ang de lta min/ /rang srog gis kyang lan stong du/ /de la lan chen ldon mi 'gyur/ //zhes pa ltar drin lan bsab tu med pa'i gnas kho nar gyur na yang / lnga bcu pa las/ mchog tu dang bas dus gsum du/ /dkyil 'khor me tog bcas thal mos/ dze /ston pa bla ma bsnyen bkur zhing / /zhabs la spyi bos phyag bya'o/ /zhes pa'i don cha tsam lag tu bstar phyir/ mo ྾ mobadag cag rnams kyis phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi lus longs spyod dge ba'i sprin tshogs ji snyed mchis me byang sems kun tu bzang po'i sgyu 'phrul las byung ba'i mchod tshogs su dadzags te 'bul ba lags na / dgyes pa nam mkha'i sgo mo 'bum phrag phye ngos spyi sger gyi bstan srid ma lus pa'i sa/dugs dkar khor yu ga tu brtan cing phan bde mi zad pa'i grib bsil ci yang snum pa'i dga' ston rdzogs ldan gyi dpal du rgyas pa dang /yang sgos/ nged cag dge 'dun gyi sde 'ji nyid lugs gnyis dpal 'byor gyi rgya mtsho yangs la zab pa/ mang thos chos spyod kyi mdzad bzang mtho la brling ba/ bshad sgrub zung 'jug gi nyams bzhes gsal la rdzogs pa/ mtshan snyan grags dkar gyi dbyangs snyan brjid la ring ba sogs 'phral

rwarterwartethe ————yu na 'dod pa'i don ma lus pa lhun grub rkye 'armer ba dngatsho/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rebra sa tsho bzhis mtshon pa'i thag nye rang gi sbyin bdag 'brel thogs thams cad kyi yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / skyabs gcig chos kyi nyi ma chen po nyid/ 7 zhwa ser bstan pa'i bdag po gcig pur zha—bas pad bskal ba khri phrag cabazhugs ngos sgrub pa'i sde 'di nyid du'ang yang dang yang du rnyog pa med pa'i zhabs sen gyi zla ris mngon par bkod de mdo sngags zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor rgya cher bskor ba mkhyen mkhyen/ zhes rtse gcig tu ga/sol ba 'debs pa lags na/ re 'bras don smin gyi snyenal bzhes gser gyi cod pan bdag cag rnams kyi spyi bo'i rgyan du stsal ba zhu zhu/ / / /oṃ bde legs su gyur sgyeg sgo gsum legs bsdoms blo chen bzod ldan drang / /g.yo dang sgyu med sngags dang rgyud shes shing / /de nyid bcu zung bri dang 'chad mkhas pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa/tso la/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sgo gsum nyes ltung gi phyogs las legs par bsdoms pa btsun pa'i yon tan// sngags dang rgyud kyi don sogs ji bzhin ma khyen pa mkhas pa'i yon tan/ g.yo dang sgyu med par gdul bya la phan 'dogs pa brtse ba'i yon tan/ phyi dang nang gi de nyid bcu phrag gnyis dang dkyil 'khor bri dang man ngag 'chad pa sogs gsang chen rdo rje slob dpon mchog gi mtshan nyid mtha' dag mngon du gyur pa/ kun gzigs ye shes kyi nyi ma chen po gang gi 'a/bas stegs mi 'jigs sa/dong lngas btegs pa'i khri 'phang rnam par mtho ba'i nye drung du྾ ྾ ྾'dod skal ba bzang po ma lus pa'i 'jug ngogs dam par/ yan lag mchog gi snye ma mdud du dud

225 —cing bla gos ngur smrig gi sne mo phrag pa'i phyogs su brka/la te/ gcig tu gus pa'i rnam 'gyur gyi lang tsho ci yang mdzes pas gang zhig zhu bar bya ba ni/ ji skad du/ phan dang bde ba ma lus pa'i/ /rtsa lag mchog ni bstan pa ste/ /de yi gzhi rten bshad sgrub kyi/ /rtsal dang ldan pa'i dam pa'o/ /zhes brjod pa ltar/ lhar bcas skye dgu ma lus pa'i phan bde mtha' dag gi 'byung khungs ni sag ngas rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i nyag gcig yin la/de nyid kyi phyir na rnam 'dren don kun grub pa rgyal ba shākya'i dbang bo de ri tshe/ skunyid kyis dzaspu'i rgyal mtshan gyi rkang 'thung mngon par bkra ba'i zhing khams yangs par/ dman pa la mos pa rnams kyi ngor theg dman gyi bstan pa/rgya chen po la mos pa rnams kyi ngor sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa/ gdul bya shin tu dbang rnon chags bcas la mos pa rnams kyi ngor gsang chen bstan pa'i chos tshul ci yang gsungs pas 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nyid lnga ldan 'og min chos kyi zhing khams las kyang rnam par lhag pa'i phung bo gcig pur mdzad pa de ltar lags la/ tshul de lta'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa gnas shing dar rgyas su 'gyur ba'i gzhi rten ni/ bshad sgrub kyi rang rtsa la kho nas rdzogs pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rim byon rnams la rag las pas na/ rgyal sras sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras chen rnams dang / 'phags pa nyan thos dgra bcom pa na so bstan mo'i sa/tad rabs bdun dang / rshang rta chen po rnam gnyis sogs dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ dpal ldan sa ra ha pa sogs yang dag grub chen brgyad cu sogs paṇḍi ta dang grub chen brgyad cu sogs paṇḍi ta dang grub pa'i

226khyu mchog thugs bskyed mi zad pa nam mkha'i mthong las yangs pa rnams kyis 'phags yul chos kyi zhing du bstan pa rin po che'i dbu 'phang dgung du 'degs pa mdzad/ chos kyi rgyal bo thugs bskyed kyi zla ba dkar ba/mnga' thang gi mtha' gru yangs pa rnams kyi sku ring la bod yul gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir yang sprul ba'i lo paṇa du ma'i mdzad bzang gser gyi 'khor lo thogs med du bsgyur bas mdo sngags kyi srol ka ma lus pa yongs su dar rgyas su gyur/ sgrub 'phrin man ngag la mkhas pa snga 'gyur rig pa 'dzin pa/ sgra tshad rigs lam la mkhas pa dpal ldan sa skya ba yab sras/ gtum mo phyag chen la mkhas pa mar ba'i bka' brgyud ya bzhi/ gsang chen rgyud sde la mkhas pa khro phu bu ston dpon slob/ ngo mtshar rig gnas la mkhas pa shong dpang mkhas pa'i rgyud 'dzin/ lam khrid blo sbyong la ma khas pa bka' gdams gzhung ba man ngag sogs skyes chen dam pa nam mkha'i skar tshogaṭa / lta bus bstan pa la bya ba ci yang mdzad/ khyad par du gangs can tshad ma'i ston pa/ rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i dbang bo/ khams gsum bla ma tsong kha pa chen po brgyud 'dzin dang bcas pas mdo sngags kyi bstan pa ya ma bral ba/thos bsam sgom gsum gra ma nyams pa/ lta sgom spyod gsum mthar ma lhung ba/ sngon med pa'i lam srol rnam par dag pa yug gcig gis dbang phyogs rgya mtsho'i sbru ba gyen du 'dzum pa/ nub phyogs dza ti'i snye ma g.yur du za ba'i bar la khyab brdal spel ba'i phyag rjes bskal ba'i mthar yang gzhig tu med pa 'di ltar lags shing / mdo khams g.yar mo thang zhes lha yi yu rme/ /mtho ris 'dzin ma sa la 'phos 'dra ba/ /mdo sngagaṭashrī chosakyi

227 lgornga chen ldir ba'i zhing / /rnam par dge ba dus kyi mtha' la byung / /zhes bsngags pa'i me tog ci yang gtor ba'i gnas su mtho ba 'di nyid du/mkhas pa dang grub pa'i skyes bu zam ma chad pas bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad cing / khyad par du kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje yab sras brgyud 'dzin nyi zla lta bu rnams kyis rje ring lugs dri ma med pa'i bka' srol 'di nyid 'dzin skyong spel ba'i mdzad 'phrin sa chen po la bsod nams kyi dpung ba btsan po nam mkha'i shed mong gis bsgyur bas/ 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa gser mdog cod pa na 'chang ba'i rang lugs sa gzhi las ma tha' yangs pa/ nam mkha' las dpangs mtho ba/ nyi zla las 'od gsal ba 'di nyid byung ba lags/ yang sgos su rje btsun bla ma dam pa nyid ni sku bzhi'i go 'phang ring mo nyid nas longs su byas zin na'ang / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i 'phrin las kyi gdugs dkar srid rtse bar du sgreng ba'i thugs bskyed dus babs kyi dbang gis/sku'i thog ma mer rgan mkhan po dkon mchog seng ge pa ni/ rigs phun sum tshogs pa shing sa la chen po lta bu'i rigs su skyabs mgon sku phreng gnyis pa'i dbon sras su sku bltams/ kun mkhyen partsi ta'i gsung bzhin dbus sa/tsang dag pa'i skyed tshal du chos srid kyi de nyid ma lus pa la sbyangs pa'i pha rol tu son/ mdo smad bkra shis 'khyil du skyabs mgon sku phreng gsum pa'i phyag mdzod dang yongs 'dzin/ tshogs chen khri ba gsum su ma 'brel tu mdzad de lugs gnyis—kyi dpe srol sngar yod gong 'phel dang snga ra med gsar 'dzugs kyis bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba zhes dbus 'gyur chos

228 — da /de kyi zhing khams gnyis pa lta bu 'di nyid byung ba'i gzhung bsrings/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad chu zla bzhin du rtogs pa dang / rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor zab mo'i gdeng dang ldan pas phyogs bcu'i gnyan chen po sogs phyogs zil gyis mnan pa'i lo rgyus ches ngo mtshar ba yongs su grags pa de lta bu'i sku phreng rim byon gyis skyabs mgon mchog gi 'phrin las kyi me tog sa chen po la mdzes pa'i rgyan du spel ba'i rnam par thar ba bzang bo rnams yongs su rdzogs par bdag lta bu'i so skye phal bas brjod par ga la nus/sku tshe 'dir yang gzhon nu nas dam pa'i yon tan lhan skyes su mnga' ba'i mdzad pa bzang po bdag gir ba'es te chos sde chen po bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar bka' pod chen po rnams la mtha' chod pa'i sbyangs pa rmad du byung ba mdzad/ 'jam gling rgyan gyi paṇa chen bde thang mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho sogs rgyal bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' bdag du ma bsam sbyor gnyis kyis bsten te/ gsan bya dam chos kyi ngo bo darga/ pa/ byung rim ngos gtsang gi 'byung khungs dag pa/ 'chad tshul phyag len gyijirim pa dag pa'i rtsod med chos rgyun gyi rnam grangs rang phyogs la dar grags che ba rnams chad lhag med par gsan/ mang du thos pa'i don rnams lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i nyams len du dril te thun bzhi thun drug gi rnal 'byor chu —bo'i rgyun la gzhol ba las nyams dang rtogs pa mi zad pa chos kyi rgya mtsho 'i gter kha klong du ldalo/— 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa ris su medadkupa'i skye rgu'i phan bde mchog tu yangs pa'i rtsa lag tu smin pa nas / —da lam kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng rim byon gyi

— 229 thugs rje'i grib bsil la brten pa'i chos sde 'di nyid chibs kyi kha lo /bsgyur/ dag pa ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rgya ma chad par/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor mtha' dag spro zhing bsdu ba'i byed po/ la/ sbyor yan lag bdun ldan zung 'jug mkhyen dpyod mgon po'i rnam par sku bzhengs te/ snying rje dag pa dag pa dga' ba bcu drug thugs rje chen po sum cu rtsa gnyis sogs rmad du byung ba'i dgongs pa da byings nas langs pas smin byed dbang gi chu bo mtha' dag dgung nas gru char du phabs shing /ji skad du/ dpal ldan 'dus las ma/chog gzhan med/ /'jig rten gsum gyi rin chen gyur/ /snying po las ni snying po mchog /rgyud kun gyi bla ma'i bla/ /zhes bsngags pa/ dam chos thams cad kyi gtso bo/ rgyud sde mtha' dag gi snying po/ dngos grub ma lus kyi 'byung khungs/ grub chen rim byon gyi gzhung lam/ 'ja' lus dag pa sgyu ma'i sku rin po che sogs gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba'i gnas rnams mtha' drug tshul bzhe'i ri rim pas rgya btab ste ston pa/ dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun ma/ bshad rgyud chen po drug dang 'phags pa yab sras kyi man ngag lde mig tu byas te/ bod kyi bla mar 'gos so so'i man ngag gis gzhi bzung / sngon med pa'i 'chad thabs rnam pa bzhi thad sgrags mdzad nas rgyud don yid bzhin gyi nor bu lag mthil gyi rdzas bzhin ston pa'i phyag srol rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying bos ji ltar btsugs pa/ mkhas grub chen po shes rab seng ge sogs kyis ma nyams par bskyangs pa las kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa brgyud 'dzin dang bcas par bum pa gang byo'i

230 tshul du byung ba'i bshad lung rnam par dag pa dgyes bakṣi/na stsal ba dang /gzhan yang gang 'dod kyi chos bka' bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgya mtsho'i sprin gyi bkod pa ji bzhin spros pas nged cag skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams gsang chen rdo rje rigasra gcig tu smin par mdzad pa'i bka' drin ni/ nam mkha'i dbyings kun mchod rdzas kyis bkang zhing sa gzhi mtha' dag rin chen gyis gtams te bskal ba chen po gaṅgā'i bye snyed du phul yang cha tsam gzhal ba ga la lang / 'on kyang bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang nes/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gsungs pa/ /shes nas dngos po thams cad kyis/ /bla ma yongs su mnyes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don nyid mtshon byed tsam du/ bka' drin gtang rag gi maṇḍal dang sbrags par/ mo ྾ mobacas 'bul lam zhu ba lags na/brtse chen ye shes chen pos nye bar ba.e/sa te/ slad ma'i char yang gzhom bral rtag brtan g.yung drung mi 'gyur tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bor lhun chags nas mkha' khyab phan bde dpal gyi dngos 'byor rdzogs ldan dbyar gyi lang tshor ci yang 'gug pa'i thugs bskyed dang mdzad 'phrin thogs bral nam mkha'i sgo chen gtan pa med par dbye ba dang / rgyal bstan gur kum gyi me tog dus snyigs grang ba'i reg bya'i dri mas nam yang ma gos par sa chen 'dzin ma'i khor yug rnam par mdzes pa'i rgyan du 'phyor ba dang / khyad par du gser zhun cod pan 'chang ba'i rang bstan mdo sngags bshad sgrub kyi lam srol rnam par dag pa 'di nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang / de 'dzin gyi skyes chen dam pa skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras sogs spyi dang yang sgos

da wa da spred da wa ——rī — — 6— dang — — 23 1 rang cag gi me /tsāg phog pa'i lha skarma kunee ma khye —/ skya bas ma bo/na mchos/ sprul bherin po che zhabs pad brtan cing mdzad 'phrin rgyas pa dang / dge 'dun gyi sde rnams thugs mthun cho sa spyod kyi rim pa gong 'phel du rgyas pa dang /bye brag tu sgrub pa'i dga' tshal 'di nyid kyi chos srid kyi legs tshogs mtha' dag yar zla'i 'phel ba la 'gran pa dang / yangs pa'i 'jig rten thams cad bde skyid mi zad nam mkha' mdzod la rang dbang du spyo da pa'i skyabs 'jug thugs byams brtse'i klong nas nam yang mi 'dor ba mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhu na zhal bzhes mi 'gyur nor bu'i cod pan bdag cag gi dad pa'i zur phud rnam par mdzes pa'i rgyan du stsol ba ci gnang / / / /

232 — yab rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i sras— kyi thu bo yu ngogs mkhan chen sku phreng drug pa blo bzang lung rtogs chos kyi rgya mtshos gnyan thogasto tu dbang 'ga' gnang skabs zhu rgyur spel ba/de yang ji skad du/ tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs zla ba thub dbang gi /gtsug tor mkha' las rnam 'khrungs mtshan tsam zhig /bzang bas 'od ta rir mibargyas 'chi bdag mun pa las/ /rtag tu rnam rgyal mdzad des shis pas skyongs/ /zhes shis pa'i bden tshig phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs mu dang mtha' ma dmigs pa'i zhing khams mtha' klas pa'i dbyings su rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dga' ston mgron du bsu ba'i char du bsnyil te/zhang zhung paṇa chen chos dbang grags pas/ skye dgu'i mngon mtho nges par legs pa'i tshogs/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdams pa zab mos bskrun/ /lugs de mi nub rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad pa/ / mtshungs med bla ma mchog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ ris su ma bcos pa'i skye dgu bde sdu ga

———— tswa/)/3)(3)longs su len pa po mtha' dag gi mdzan mtho 'khri shing gi phung po tshar du dngar zhing nges legs me tog gi rtse dga' lhu gas par grol ba'i dga' tshal ji snyed dmigs pa yod do cog ni/ thub chen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyi gdams pa zab mo rgya rmatsho chen po'i rgyun bzang phyogs su gyes pa'i dag byed rgyu rkyen du babs pa kho nas bskrun pa dpyad gsum dag pa'i ra ba las mi 'gongs shing / lugs de nyid mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan bzhin du 'dzin pa la thugs bskyed kyi dpung ba brtan po gzhar yang mi g.yo ba gnam chen po'i kwa ba mdzad de/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi 'phrin las srid zhir ring ba'i skyes mchog 'gro ba'i 'dren pa dus kyi yang mtha' na 'gran zla dang mtshungs pa med pa'i dpal ldan bla ma ma chog gi zhabs stegs thar ba 'dod pa mtha' dag gi 'jug ngogs dge legs kyi dngos po g.yang du chags pa'i mdun sar/ 'jigs pa med pa'i spobs pa'i lang tsho dar la bab cing dog 'dzer med pa'i rang ngag gi gling bu snyan rgur zlos te gang zhig gleng ba ni/ de yang / rigs mtha' dag gi bdag po/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi bla ma/ bdag cag yongs kyi skyabs gcig mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal bo nyid ni / sku bzhi'i rgyal thabs chen po zag med kyi mnga' thang klong du gyur pa'i dpal la ring mo nas dbang bsgyur na yang / rnam 'dren phyag na padmo'i rang lugs kyi nor bu bri gang ma dmigs pa nam mkha' chen po'i mdzod du dkrigs pa/ thugs bskyed kyi shing rta rma med pas dus/ kyi mthar yang mi nyams par 'dren pa la/ gsum ldan dam bca'i ri mo rdzogs su med pa'i ten 'byung 'gag pa dang rgal ba 'i mthu las gser ljongs nor 'dzin gyi

—dzo ྅4thig le rab tu yangs pa 'di nyid la/ mkhas grub sa/nyis ldan gyi yon tan rtsibs stong rnam par bkra ba'i 'khor lo nam mkha'i mthongs las bsgyu ra ba/ skyabs mgon skal ldan rgya mtsho'i mdun na sras kyi thu bo bsam gtan rgya mtsho/ rtsod ngag seng ge nga ro mkhas pa'i mdun sar sgrogs pa la 'jigs pa med pa'i khyu mchog rlabs po che'i gnas rma ngon du mdzad pa/ma/khan chen rigs pa'i dbang phyug dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ yon tan lhan skyes kyi dri bsung gzhon nu nas spro ba la rtsod med bstod bsngags rol mo phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i rna rgyan du gyur pa/ sprul ba'i skyes chen dkon mchog chos 'phel rgya mtsho/ byams brtse zhi dul gyi yon tan rmad du byung ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i che dgu ma tha' dag gi dbus na lham me lhang nger snang ba/ rgyal sras bdag nyid chen po blo bzang don yod rgya mtsho/ mkhas pa'i grags dkar gyi ba dan khor yug ri bo'i bar du 'jug pa la don gnas/ lung rtogs kyi yon tan bri gang med pa'i rgya mtsho chen po sa la 'khyil ba'i ngang tshul gzugs can du gyur pa/ dregs ldan gtsug gi cod pasna blo/ bzang dpal ldan rgya mtsho sogs/ nyi zla ‘ pta bu'iskyes chen rim byom/ gyi rnam pas grub pa'i dbang phyug skal ldan rgya mtsho'i rang lugs kyi gdugs da7/ra po bla nas bla dang dgung nas dgung du btegs te dzaspu'i rkang 'thung gi zur phud yon por ma gyur pa'i zhing khams ma lus pa phan bde mi zad pa'i snang ba dkar po su kyi /kro/ gcig gis khyab par mdzad pa de ltar lags ge/khyad pa ra du gnam chen po ka ba med pa'i dbyings la sa mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi ma'i sa/dan khri ‘ra rigs pa'i 'khor los/ bsgyur ba chen po bye ri /ba'o/

235chen chos kyi rgyal bo'i sku ring nas bdag cag skya ser thams cad kyi/ me tog phog pa'i lha skal thun mong ma yin par gyur te chos srid dam tshig 'gyur ba med pa gser gyi nyag thag ring du bskyangs pa'i rten 'byung grwa ma nyams gru ma chag pa'i dbang gis mgon po nyid ni 'di ka'i rigs rus pad dkar gyi chun po dri mas ma reg pa la sprin dkar gyi dum bu yongs su sbrum pa'i rgya rnam par grol ba'i rum las nyin byed kyi dkyil 'khor 'jig rten gyi mig tu bltams pa bzhin du srid zhi'i mig gi bdud rtsir 'khyungs/ gong sa thams cad mkhyen pa drug pa chen pos ljongs 'di'i che dgu gzhan las 'bur dod kyis spyan bskyangs gzhan 'gran med pa sogs kyi sgo nas thugs kyi ze'u 'bru ltar ci ya nga bskyangs shing / rwa chen rdo rje grags pa grub chen 'jigs med bsam gtan/ kun mkhyen dbyig gi gnyen po zhwa dmar pazhi ta chen po/hor chen sde snod sa/sum pa ba bshes gnyen ye shes rgya mtsho/ ye hor lnga rig pa chen po chos rje grags pa rgya mtsho sogs rigs kyi bdarge por bkur te/ sgru tshad seng ge mjing bsnol/ dbu phar nyi zla zung 'jug 'dul mngon dpag bsam sprel ma/ rgyud sde yid bzhin 'khyil ba/ man ngag rin chen tshom spungs sogs la gsan bsam mtha' chod par sbyangs/dgang bka' rtogs pa'i sgo 'byed/ smin khrid rtogs pa'i gzhung shing /bklag lung rtogs pa'i rgyab rten/ bogs 'byin rtogs pa'i ngar 'don bcas kyi skor larmeng rtsod med khungs thub kyi rigs can ma lus pa brtson pa chen pos bzhes pas bstan pa rin po che'i rtsa lag bla na med pa'i gnas su 'tsho gzhes pa ni/ gyi ji skad du/ bdag nyid chen po khyod kyi sku gsung
