236 rithugs/ /rgyal ba'i rdo rje gsum dang dbyer med pa/ /thub bstan phyogaru/ mthar 'phel ba'i rtsa lag tu/ /'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i bka' drin nga/zhal mi phod/ /ces gsungs pa de ltar lags pa'i skabs nyid na bdag cag bgres gzhon ma lus pa'i dad gsum zla ba'i rang khams ches cher g.yo ba dbyar dus chu gter 'phel ba'i rlabs phreng dgung la reg pa las 'da' bar ma gyur pas rkyen byas/ gsol 'debs gser gyi dril chung snga phyi rgyun chags su 'byung ba'i gdangs su bkug pa la/ sgrib pa mi mnga' ba'i mkhyen pa ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mdangs rgyas/ nye ring mi mnga' ba'i thugs rje byams brtse'i rang bzhin du 'du byas/ dus/ las mi yol ba'i bskyod pa rab tu ldang ba yang ba'i ngang tshul gyis phebs te/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa/rtogs brjod dbyangs can ngag gi rol mtsho las/ /mchod sbyin brgya ba'i lung gis lha'i bzo bo/ /lha yul sa la 'god par rjes gnang ba'i/ /yul 'khor skyid pa'i dpal dang lhan cig pas/ /sum rtsen dga' ba'i tshal mang mog por btang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar bsngags par 'os pa/ gser ljongs yul gyi le lag sgrub pa'i skyed tshal byams pha gling gi gtsug lag khang chen mo dag pa ye shes kyi pho brang rgya rnam par ma chad pa lnga ldan 'og min chos kyi zhing khams su byen gyis brlabs te/ chos phun sum tshogs pa ting 'dzin gsum gyi lam las zab gsal gnyis med kyi rtogs pa klong du rdol byed rnam par sa/nang mdzad po'i smin byed bum dbang yongs rdzogs mtha' rten dang bcas pa/ zab gnad lngas khyad par

231du 'phags shing ting 'dzin gsum dang rnal 'byor bzhi'i lam las zung 'jug dus dgra'i dbang po bde blag tu ster ba dge lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i lha chos kyi smin byed dbang bzhi cha lag dang bcas pa/ zhe chos ston pa po phun sum tshogs pa dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal po gang zhig dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po chen po so so'i skur mngon byang so so'i ting nge 'dzin phri lhag ma mchis pas gsal rdzogs su bzhengs te/ chos ston pa'i khyad par phun sum tshogs pa rtsa rgyud de nyid bsdus pa'i 'phros rgyud ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud las bstan pa kun rig rtsa ba'i smin dbang slob dpon kun dga' snying po sogs yo ga'i mkhas pa rnam gsum gyis rgyud 'grel chen po rnam gsum cho ga cha lag dang bcas pa las gtan la phab pa ji lta bur khams gsum bla ma tsong kha pa chen pos gsang don rnam par phye bar nyi ma ltar gas la bar mdzad cing rje nyid kyi man ngag ltar bu chen so sos ṭīka chen ṭīka chung rnams su bkral ba'i lam nor 'phrul dang bral ba sa/zhi lam 'bras gsum gyi phyag rgya bzhi'i khongs su rnam par bsdus pa'i bshad srol gyis gzhi bzung / rtsa bayad phyogs mthun gyi rgyud dang mkhas pa'i bstan bcos ma lus pas rgyab brten cing dam pa'i skye bo bar ma chad pa'i man ngag snyan du brgyud pa ji snyed pas zur rgyan nas thog mtha' bar gsum gyi 'byams bshad ngo sprod brda sbyo ra gyi rigs la chad lhag med par thams cad rig pa chen po'i smin dbang zhib tig tu stsal ba dang / mthar thug longs spyo da rdzogs pa'i mu sgrub byed thabs kyi rnam pa ji snyed pa'i snying bo 'ja' lus sgyu ma'i snga/ sgrub tshur rtsa( pa du 'don pa pha rgyud bye ba phrag drug gi zab gnad/ mthar thug ye

238 shes chos sku 'i sgrub byed shes rab rnam pa ji snyed pa'i snying bo bde chen 'od gsal lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes sgrub tshul rtsal du 'don pa ma rgyud bye ba bcu drug/ gi zab gnad/ sdig can dbang med metsan thabs kyis 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs mkhas 'phrul gyi 'khor lo ji snyed pa'i snying bo rtsal du 'don pa gshed skor rnam grangs gzhal med kyi zab gnad/ rgyud 'bras theg pa ma lus pa'i lam gyi srog shing ji lta ji snyed kyi shes rab dngos grub tu sgrub tshul rtsal du 'don pa dus dgra'i rgyud 'bum char gtogs dang bcas pa'i zab gnad sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i zab dgus khyad par du 'phags pa dpal chen hai ra wa ba'i rim gnyis kyi lam rim ma lus pa smin grol 'aribras bu'i dbang gsum gyi khongs su bsdus pa'i legs brtso/da ngo mtshar bas brda sbyar/ ra skyo zhang gsum gyi phyag len ma dag pa'i cha rnams kyang rgyang du bsrangs te/ phyag len phra mo re yang rgyud dang rgya gzhung tshad thub dpang du btsugs nas dbang bzhi rnam par dag pa breskur tshul yab rje rgya 'a ba gnyis pas srol phye/ bu chen mkhas grub rnams kyis srol bskyangs nas phebs pa'i dbang gi chu bo byin rlabs kyi char du bsnyil ba'i bka' drin ni/byang chub sems dpa'i skyes rabs las/ legs par smras pa rnams kyi rin thang zhig /gal te nges par bcal du rung na ni/ /de yi rin du rgyal srid nyid kyang sbyi na/ /khyod kyis gyod kyang smra bar ga la snyelngagyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar kho na lags pas/ mo ྾ ྾ces 'bul lam zhu ba lags na/ dgyes pa nam mkha'i sgo 'phar rang grol gyi klong nas bdag cag thams cad kyi legs lam chos srid dpag bsam gyi ljon pa khor yug tu

rgyas shing phan bde grib bsil gyi dngos la 'dod dgu longs su byed pa'i skyabs 'jug dang / skyabs sa/cig kun kazigs dbang bo nyid kyang sde 'dir rims phebs kyis zab rgyas chos kyi bgo skal ci yang 'gyed pa mkhyen mkhyen zhu lags// //

240 gong sa mchog rka sar la gser zhal bskur skabs zhu rgyur spel ba/oṃ su snyi/ lung rtogs rin thang med pa'i 'khor lo yis/ /thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyal thabs la/ /dbang bsgyur mtha' dbus dregs zhan ma lus pa/ /'phrin las don yod lcags kyus dbang gyur cig /ces yid la brnag don chen po las brtsams te shis brjod g.yas 'khyil dung gi rang sgra chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i mtha' dang mnyam par bsgrags rnga/'i rten 'brel gyi phung bo rang byung lhan grub bde ba chen po'i ngo bor yongs su grub pa sngon tu btang ste gang zhig zhu bar bya ba ni/ dag pa dang ma dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi bkod pa rgya dang phyogs su ma lhung ba'i dbus na skal bzang rnam 'dren stong gis phyag mtshan du bzhes pa'i zhing —khams mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bya ba stegs bu la me tog dang /ri rab la bang rim bzhin du bkod pa mdzes par chags shing / gang gi lte bar dzam bu'i rgyal mtshan gyi rkang 'thung ral ba'i cod pan du 'dzin pa/lho gling grub pa'i gnas mchog 'de la/ bskal ba bzang po'i sangs rgyas rim par byon pa dang 'byon par 'gyur ba mtha' dag pas sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa ston pa pres deng gisadus su 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med don

241kun grub pa de nyid nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye thes kyi ngo bor mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul bstan te skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams la theg gsum mdo sngags sna tshogs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen skor bas lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten mtha' dag dge legs kyi snang ba yug gcig gis khyab par mdzad de/ nag phyogs bdud kyi rus ma lus pa ni spa bkong / dkar phyogs lha mi'i tshogs mtha' dag pas ni rgyal ba'i rnga brdungs/ mtho ris dang thar ba'i sgo 'phar rnam par phye pas na phan pa dang bde ba'i dpal mi zad pa'i dge rma tshan ma tha' dbus yongs la rgyas pa 'di lags la/ byang sems sa chen po la bzhugs pa rnams dang sprul ba'i nyan thos dpag tu med pa'i tshogs bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun dang shing rta chen po rjes 'brangs dang bcas pas 'phags pa'i yul du thub pa'i rang lugs mya ngan med pa'i rkang 'thung yongs su bskyangs pa dang /gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir bsod nams mi zad pa'i dpung ba stobs su mtho ba'i chos brgyad rim byon dang / lo paṇa sa/ser gyi ri bo lta bu rnams kyis rgyal bstan 'dzam bu'i mchod sdong spyir bskyangs shing / rig 'dzin padma 'byurnga gnas dang rjes 'bangs nyer lnga sogs gsang sngags snga 'gyur pa dang / jo 'brom yab sras sogs mnyam med bka' gdams pa dang /sa chen gong ma lnga srogs dpal ldan sa skya pa dang / rmi ra mi dwags gsumu sogs bka' brgyud rngag rnams kyis chos tshul g.yas 'khyil dung gi rad sgra 'gog med mkha' khyab tu bsgrags pas grub mtha' so so'i sgo nas bde bar gshegs pa'i rang lugs rnam par dge ba'i dpal du bsgru bas pa re re nas

242ya mtshan pa'i gnas kho na yin na'ang / khyad par du mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal pos/ tshogs gnyis spyod pa rlabs chen shar ri'i rtser/ /rgyal sras dpa' lo smra ba'i zla ba 'dzegs/ /thub bstan ku mud bzhad pa'i dpal yon can/ /rje btsun bla ma snying gi mun sel rgyal/ /zhes rgya cher bsngags pa ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mes po/ bstan pa thams cad kyi bdag po/ gangs ljongs tshad ma'i ston pa rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying po de nyid nas rtag chad kyi mtha' rmangs nas khegs pa'i 'khrul bral dbu ma chen po'i lam bzang dang / gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i zab lam zung du 'brel ba snying bor byas pa'i bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis khyer ba'i bka' srol gser mdog cod pan 'chang ba'i lugs bzang rū ku la'i blo/sa dkar yug gcig gis stod dza ti'i me tog rgyas pa'i sa nas shar rgya mtsho chen po'i 'phang ba la thug gi bar du bskyangs bas rgyu skar gyi dbus na zla ba dang / rkang 'thung gi tshal na dpag bsam bzhin du grub mtha' gzhan las khyad par du 'phags shing dri ma med pa'i bka' srol de nyid 'dzin pa'i skyes bu chen po ni nam mkha'i skar tshogs las grangs mang / chos kyi dgon sde ni phyogs mtshams khor yug tu tshom bur spungs pa las/bdag cag gser ljongs yangs pa'i zhing 'dir/ bis pa paṇḍi ta ngag dbang mi pham zla bas/ rong ston chos kyi rgyal po'i 'phrin las kyis/ /gser ljongs dkyil 'khor rnam par dkar ba 'di/ /stong phrag zla ba'i spu long rab rgeyos pas/ /smag rum lhag med byas pa'i ma thu'am ci/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gang gi 'phrin las kyis gser ljongs ya/ngas pa'i

243'dzin ma la phan nga/ dang bde ba gzugs can bzhin du mdzad pa'i byed po/bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i paṇḍi ta dang grub pa'i khyu ma/chog gnam gyi sa gab pa lta bu byon pa dag ji/ khrod na zla med pa'i ston pa rdo rje 'chang 'chad rtsod tsom pa'i legs bshad kyi sgra dbyangs nam mkha'i mtha' klas par sgrog pa'i thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i rtsa lag spyan ras gzigs dbang skyabs mgon skal ldan rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo ni/ ji skad du/ mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang / /bstan pa'i snying bo bshad sgrub rnam gnyis dang / /dam pa'i rnam thar sdom gsum nyams len la/ /phan tshun 'gran ba'i/na 'bad /ces gsungs pa ltar 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ bshad sgrub rnam gnyis/ sdom gsum nyams len so so'i ngos nas rgya‘ra ba 'jam dpal snying po'i rang lugs 'dzin skyong spel par mdzad pa'i rnam thar mkhas pa rna mas kyi yid 'phrog pa sha stag tu gyung cing / /khyad par du/ sa rdo rje 'dra ba'i rked pa nas/ /mi khyod kyis sgrub rgyud bstan pa spel/ /zhes lung bstan pa'i 'bras bu smin pa'i dus la babs pa na/ legs par bshad pa mi zad pa'i nga ro bsnyengs pa med par sgrog pa'i mkhas dbang stong phrag du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal bde chen chos 'khor gling gsar du bskrun pas zhing 'dir rgyal bstan gyi chu bo mtha' dag gang las 'byung pa'i ma dros kyi rgya mtsho chen por gyur pa 'di bzhin lags shing /yab rje bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho de nyid slar yang mi'i gar du brten pa mdo smad kyi 'phags pa nye bar 'khor chen po ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya

244 mtsho/ 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang srid pa gsum gyi bla na 'phags pa'i gdugs daner gcig gis yul gru mtha' dag stib par mdzad pa dge 'dun 'phrin las rab rgyes/ ngo mtshar byams brtse'i rtogs pa klong du gyur pa'i tshul bzung ba blo bzang chos grags rgya mtsho/ thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i shes bya'i gnas mtha' dag la 'jigs pa med pa'i spobs pa lhan skyes su mnga' ba blo bzang 'phrin las rgya mtsho sogs sku'i phreng ba tho/nga ma rnams dang / khyad par du/ lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad lhun gyis grub pas thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i chos kyi srid la dbang bsgyur zhing / snyigs ma'i dus kyi skye bo dmu rgod pa rnams thabs mkhas zad mi shes pa'i 'phrul gyis yang dag pa'i lam la 'god pa/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang mtshan brjod par dka' ba/ phyag na padmo blo bzang skal ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba dpal bzang pos chos dang srid kyi 'phrin las zung du 'jug pas gser ljongs yangs pa'i bstan 'gro'i phan bde dgung du spel ba ni/ mkhas mchog dpa' bos/ de'i mtshon byams pa ru mtshon phra mo'i dpung gi cho ga tsam/ /de'i ni mi khro tshig rtsub mi smra pa yang legs par srung / /de yi bka' khrims chos yi na rgyu me da nor yang dam pa mchog /de ltar rmad du byung yang ngan pa'i chos srid dregs pa med/ /ces gsungs pa mngon du babs pa lags la/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang de nyid nas bdag cag gdul bya mtha' dag thugs rje'i ra ba las phyir ma gzhol bar/legs bshad 'phrul gyi lde mig las/ phyag na padmo'i gsang gsum sa

——krobon mchog /mthon po'i rigs kyi zhing sar btab pa las lus can yongs kyi dbugs 'byin phan bde'i gsos/ /mi dbang dge sbyor lo tog 'di ge bltams/ /zhes gab thungs pa ltar/ skye rgu ma lus pa'i gtsug gi nor bu/ 'gro ba'i sgron me/ 'jig rten gyi mig gcig rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar dregs ldan thams cad kyi bla na sku gsung thugs kun tu bzang po'i spyod yul can/ skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po/skal ldan blo bzang 'phrin las lung rtogs rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam rgyal dpal bzang po nyid rigs phun sum tshogs par sku'i skye ba bzhes shing / mi mthan phas kyi sde thams casne thags bskyed mi zad riring dmi pa'i dpung gis zil gyis mnan te/ ji ltar 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal bo gling bzhi'i mkha' la 'phags nas rang gi gnas su spyon pa dang /tshangs pa chen po tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu dpag tu med pas skor te sum cu rtsa gsum nas tshangs chen du ldos/ pa dang / ston pa thub pa'i dbang bo bdag — nyid chen po'i 'khor dang bcas te ljongs nas kun dga' ra bar btegs pa bzhin/ sku'i gzi ma nyams/ gsung gi mdangs ma shor/ thugs kyi gzigs pa ma btang par gser ljongs yul gyi nyan yod rgyal byed kyi tshal chen po phyogs las rnam rgyal bde chen chos 'khor gling du phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba skal ldan rgya mtsho yab sras kyis chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor ba'i pho brang sde bzhi'i lang tsho g.yang du chags pa'i gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang du bde bar phyags phebs/ de nas bzung mkhas/ grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal snga nas/ lus kyi myu gu dang por gyur pa

246yi/ /gnas skabs der yang jio5ོna tan me tog ni/ dpaka med dri bzang rdzogs pa'i snying po can/ /'di lta'i ngo mtshar su yis bsam mi bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sku'i na tshod kyi myu gu gzhon nur gyur pa'i gnas skabs nas/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag khri chen dang po'i mgon po 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho/ mgon po gang gi sprul ba'i rang 'dra spyan ras gzigs dbang blo bzang lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos mi pham dbyangs can dges pa'i rdo rje ste rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gsum dbu blar bsten pa'i sgo nas dbang lung man ngag gi rgyun mtha' dag bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan dang gsan bzhin pa dang / yongs 'dzin bgres pa rigs pa'i dpa' bo dge 'dun rgya ma tsho dang / mongs 'dzin gzhon pa snyigs dus kyi paṇa chen blo bzang dpal ba rnam gnyis las rigs pa'i bsgodze skal spyir bzhes shing / khyad par du/ gser ljongs yul gyi gnas lnga gzigs pa'i ma hā partsi ta 'jam dbyangs bla ma blo bzang dpal ldan gyi spyan sngar bka' pod so so dang rgyud sde rab 'byams/ thun mong rig pa'i gtsug lag phyogs med la gsan sbyong mdzad pa'i sgo dang por phyes te/ bsdus sbyor gyi rigs pa la brda bstan pa tsam gyis rtog ge rgan po dag gi khengs pa snyil ba'i mkhyen rab kyi nye ma sgrib g.yogs med pa'i dkyil 'khor las spros pa'i lung rigs kyi dga' ston nam mkha' mdzod kyi bang ba kha phyes pas/ bdag cag skyabs mgon mchog gi 'phrin las kyi grib bsil la gnas pa'i gser ljongs yul gyi dregs zhan mtha' dag gi rgyud la kun dga' mi zad pa'i bdud rtsi rdzogs ldan dang po'i sprin du 'khrigs pa las/

ci247e ma/ bdaka cag sa/ser ljongs yangs pa'i gdul bya rnams ni skal ba dang ldan no/ /thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che mgon gyis zin no/ /bstan 'dzin skye bu rnams ni ston pa dang bcas so// /zhes bsngags pa sar ba'i mandar dbang med du spro zhing / ji skad du/ shes rab me long gtsug lag kun la gsal/ /'phrin las dpal gyis 'gro kun 'bangs su sdud / /gzi byin che na/ pos sa/zhan phyogs zil gyis gnon/ /thugs bskyed mchog gis bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel/ /zhes gsungs pa ji lta ba bzhin legs mdzad kyi bkod pa mtha' dag chad lhag med par bstan dang ston bzhin pa'i skabs nyid na/ sgrub pa'i dga' tshal 'dus bzang chos gling 'dir chibs zhal gyi dang po bsgyur te seṅge'i khri la zhabs sen gyi padmo nye bar bkod pa'i legs skyes dang rten 'byung mtshon byed du/ mo mo ྾bcas 'bul lam zhu ba lags na/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos/mdor na skyabs rje'i zhabs pad bskal brgyar bstan/ /gzhan phan 'phrin las snang bas sa gsu ma khyab/ /lung rtogs pad tshal mtha' dbus kun tu 'phel/ /'gro rnams rab dga'i gar gyis rtsen par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar zhabs pād mi bshig g.yang drung gsar ba'i lang tshor bskal ba rgya mtsho'i bar du g.yo ba med par thos bsam sgom gsum/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sogs yon tan zad mi shes pa'i bang mdzod jam gling na 'gran zla med pa myur du bdag gir bzhes nas/ che btsan rnam par gnon pa'i gzi brjid kyi dpal lhag par rgyas shing / skye bo mi srun pa rnams chos dang mthun pa'i bka' khrims btsan

248 pos rgyas btab ste/ mtshungs pa med pa'i snying stobs/ kyi phrag pa brtan pos bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i legs tshogs mtha' dag gong 'phel du bgyi ba'i khur chen po bla nas blar btegs te 'gro ba rnams rab dga'i sa/ra gyis rtsen pa dang / mgon po gang gi 'phrin las la brten nas khrimarsā ldan ngur smrig 'chang ba'i sde 'dir yang dge 'dun thams cad thugs mthun zhing khrims gtsang ba'i sgo nas chos spyod rnam bcu'i mdzad bzang dbyar mtsho bzhin du 'phel ba la brten nas/ 7 skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'phrin las phyogs su skyong ba dang mchod gzhi rka sar tsho gsum du'ang bkra mi shis pa'i rigs thams cad ming tsam yang mi 'byung zhing / tshe bsod stobs 'byor mnga' thang rigs rgyud sogs legs tshogs kyi dngos po thams cad gong du 'phel ba la brten nas skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' khrims tshul bzhin brtsi ba'i 'bangs su bag yangs su rol chog pa'i skyabs 'jug brtse bas gzigs pa mkhyen mkhyen zhes zhu lags/ /

ma mar — — — shā//rdo44//dro/shel dgon nas skyabs mgon la yar zhus/'o lags so/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi rma khyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs/ gyi gong sa thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa'i zhabaru/ stegs mi 'jigs seṅge brgyad kyis nye bar btegs pa'i khri 'phang rab tu yangs pa'i nye drung du/ sgo gsu ma gus pas lha phyag sngon du btang nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i snying bo ni/ de yang yab rje chos kyi rgyal po rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho zhes mtshan tsam gyis kyang 'jig rten bde legs su mdzad pa de nyid nas gser ljongs yangs pa'i 'jig rten 'di nyid du dang po sari/ngas rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i srol btod/ bar du bstan pa rin po che rgyas par mdzad/ tha mar bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med par mdzad de mdo smad kyi ljongs 'dir sangs rgyas dngos su byon pa dang 'dra ba'i mdzad pa rlabs po ches skye rgu rnams mngon mtho nges legs kyi lam bzang po la mngon par bkod/ thugs rje'i shugs kyis ljongs 'dir nam yang ma btang bar slar yang sku'i phreng ba rim byon gyis rjes/ su bzung ste choru/ srid kyi 'phrin las yang dag pas rab tu bskyangs par mdzad/ da lta'i dus 'di nyid na yang gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan mtha' dag byulhun grub tu mnga' ba/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs

25khye — kyi ze'u 'bru/ skyabs mgon rgyal ba'i nyi ma chen po nyid/ rī bdag cag ljongs 'di'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gi ma gon dang skyabs su byon te 'phrin las kyi snang ba bla na med pas sa chen po rgya mtsho'i rma thar thug gi bar tshul bzhin skyong ba'i mur/ de ring rnam par dge ba'i nyin 'dir/ mgon po nyid kyi nye gnas/ kun dga' bo gnyis pa lta bur yongs su grags pa chu dmar sgom chen blo bzang rgya mtshos btab pa'i sgrub pa'i dga' tshal 'di nyid du gser zhal mngon par bsgyur/ byams pa'i spyan gyis gzigs/ brtse ba'i gsung gis bsus/ zab rgyas chos kyis rgya cher skyong ba'i rten 'brel mdzad/ mthong thos dran reg gis skal ba dang ldan pa ma tha' dag don dang ldan par mdzad pa'i bka' drin ni chos dang mthun pa'i rnam dpyod kyis bsam shes pa zhig gis bsam na nam yang drin lan gzhal du med pa'i gnas su che bas/ stong gsum gang ba'i gser dngul yod na'ang rtse gcig 'bul ba'i 'os su che mod/ sgrub bde 'di ni rnam 'dren bla ma yab sras kyi dus kyi ri khrod pa'i kun spyod dkyus rma 'i srol ga da dung cung zad gnas pa'i rkyen gyis zang zing 'byor ba'i yo lang gi rigs gtan nas med gshis/ gya nom la grangs mang ba'i 'bul ba zhu ba'i nus pa rngo mi thogs/'on kyang rten 'brel mtshon byed tsam du/ mo ྾ ྾bcas 'bul ba lags la/ don gyi gtso bo ni snyigs dus 'gro ba'i brlang spyo da ci tsam bdo ba de tsam du thugs bskyed kyi tho/ cha lnga/ga par bzhes te/ 7 zhabs pad bskal ba rgya mtsho'i bar du brtan pa dang / 'jig rten kyi khams spyi dang bye brag tu re skong gser mo ljongs 'di chos srid gnyis ka'i sgo nas tshul bzhin— skyong

ba'i thugs rje rab tu yangs pa dang / sgrub pa'i sde 'di'e bla ma dge radun dang bcas pa thugs mthun khrims gtsang gi ngos nas chos spyod kyi bya ba rnams mi nyams gong 'phel du 'byung ba dang / gong sa mchog gi lugs gnyis bka' khrims rnam par dag pas dus rnam kun du bde bar skyong ba khyed mkhyen mkhyen zhes gsol ba 'debs pa lags// //

zhe12/5shārti tre — ———— bis mdo'i mchod rten kun phan mthong grol chen mo gsar bzhengs skabs bshad pa sbyi chu dmar sprul sku'i khri zhus kyis 'thus pa la kha 'gengs su khri gser kha pa'i ngor spel ba/'o lags so/ de yang ji skad du/ mo mo ྾khyad par du kun gzigs chos kyi nyi ma gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po nyid ni bskal ba ches dpag tu med pa'i snga rol nas dus gsum rgyal ba mtha' dag gi mes po rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs dang gnyis su med par lhun gyis grub zin na yang thugs rje'i gzigs pa dus las mi yol ba'i dbang gis dag pa dang ma dag pa'i rol ba sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul gyi bkod pa 'byams su klas pa'i klong nas zhing 'dir yang zung 'jug grub pa'i brtul zhugs mngon du mdzad pa grub brnyes sha wa ri ba/ mthu stobs mi zad pa'i byed pa rlabs po ches phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal 'chang ba rwa chen rig pa 'dzin pa/ mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi yon tan nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo phye ba rnam 'dren skal ldan rgya mtsho'i nang thugs kyi sras mnyam med shes rab bkra shis/ rim

ri 253ba/nyis kyi rtogs pa klong du gyur pas sa'i steng na zla med pa'i grub pa'i rtags mtshan mngon du gyur pa rje btsun grub pa'i dbang bo 'arijigs med bsam gtan sogs sku'i phreng ba zung 'jug dar la brgyus pa sha stag gis thub bstan mi nub pa'i dbu 'phang bla nas blar btegs pa'i grags snyan gyi ba dan dus kyi mthar yang gsar du bsgrengs pa bzhin du mchis par ma zad/ bdag cag gi mthong ba don dang ldan pa nyid nas kyang / ji skad du/ phyag na padmo skal ldan rgya mtshos/ mkhas pā'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang / /bstan pa'i snying bo bshad sgrub rnam gnyis dang / /dam pa'i rnam thar sdom gsu ma nyams len la/ /phan hūṃn 'gran bzhin rī'abad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sku gzhon nu nas theg pa mchog gi bshe sa gnyen 'dzam gling na ches pa'i che ba nyi ma dang zla ba ltar grags pa du ma'i zhabs pad bsam sbyor phun sum tshogs pas zur phud kyi ngos la spa bar mjod de/ ma/do sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i gzhung bshad sna tshogs/ dbang khrid lung gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos rgyun mtha' dgasnyan brgyud zhal shes kyisabyubasdus pa'i man ngag gang yod bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan bsam mdzad de sdom pa/ gsum gyi nyams len la mi 'khrul ba'i gzer theb pa'i gnad kyis bshad pa dang sgrub pas bsdus pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i snying bo mtha' dag gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer ba la 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pari'i bzhed srol ji rto ba bzhin mngon du mdzad/de lta bu'i rgyu phun sum tshogs pa'i nyams rtogs kyi yon tan mtha' dag nang nas rma ngon du mdzad pas rgyu la mi 'akṣal ba'i 'bras bu phun sum

254 tshogs pa 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis gser mdog cod pan 'chang ba'i ring lugs spel ba la 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa mkha' ltar yangs pas deng dus bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu'i dbus na rgyu skar khrod kyi zla ba gzhon/ rkang 'thung khrod na yongs 'du zer ba'i dpe ltar gyur ba'i legs mdzad kyi phung po thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba ni sras bcas rgyal ba ma lus pas bsngags brjod kyi me tog gtor bzhin pa lags la/nye ba'i char yang / bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i gsos sman san med pa'i gnas su dgongs te yul dus bde 'jags kyi mchod rten ngo mtshar mthong grol chen mo 'di ka gsar du bzhengs pa la thog mtha' bar gyi byatshub ma lus pa ra bkas khyab par mdzad cing nang rten bri sgrub kyi rim pa gang yod phyag bstar nas mdzad pa las/ da lam rten nyid byin rlabs kyi gter chen por bsgrubs pa dang / rgyu sbyor ba rnams kyi bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya cher spel ba/ slad mar bstan srid kyi 'phel rgyas dang bkra shis pa'i phyir/ rab gnas kyi rgyud don rje btsun tsong kha pas ji ltar bkral ba'i dgongs pa dang phyag len gyi rim pa gzhir bzhag pa'i steng nas sbyor dngos 'jug gsum gyi cha kun phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan gyi sgo nas bka' drin bskyangs pa ni/ ji srid 'khor ba ma stong bar du nyin re bzhin stong gsum rin chen sna bdun gyis bkang ste phul kyang bka' drin gyi cha tsam yang ga la bsob/ 'on kyang rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ glang bo rta dang shing rta sogs/ /yon gyi dam pa dbul bar bya/ /de nas de 2 nan tan gyis/ /longs spyod g.yo ba 'bul bar bya// /gal te lha nyid dgyes

255'dod na/ /bla ma gus pas dgyes bya zhing / /zhes gsungs pa'i mtshon byed tsam du dbyes sto na dang 'grel bar 'byor rten gyi dngos 'bul phran tsam mchod sprin du spros shing / bdag gzhan rnams kyi dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs dang bcas pa rin chen kun tu bzang po'i maṇḍal gyi rnam par 'bul na/ brtse chen thugs rje'i klong nas nye bar dgongs te/ mi 'jigs seṅge'i khri la zhabs zung mi 'gyur ba'i g.yung drung mi shigs pa'i rdo rje / mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du lhun chags ngos rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying po'i bstan pa phyogs mthar spel ba dang / yangs pa'i 'jig rten kun tu 'phrin las kyi dge legs yar zla'i dpal bzhin 'phel zhing / rten 'di bzhengs pa la lus ngag yid kyi ngal bas zhabs 'degs bgyid pa'i las byed dang 'brel thogs kyi sbyin bdag tha na rjes su yi rang tsam bgyis pa yan chad kyi 'gro ba mtha' dag nam zhig 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po nyid byang phyogs kā la ba'i dag sa pho brang chos kyi 'dun saragasang 'dzin grub pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med pas/ rol ba'i dus nyid na 'khor gyi thog mar skyes te zab gsang chos kyi bdud rtsis tshul bzhin skyong ba mkhyen ma khyen/ zhes snying thag pa nas gsol ba 'debs pa lags// //

256 mtshan sgrog sprul sku 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal mtshan gdan sar gsar bkod skabs zhus lan du spel ba/'o lags so/ de yadzo ji skad du/ bsod nams dar rgyas ri rgyal lhun po bzhin/ /snyan grags chen pos nam mkha' bzhin du khyab/ /tshe ring nad med gzhan don lhun gyis grub/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i mchog gi bkra shis shog /ces dge legs kyi snang ba mi zad pa'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag dbye ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad rme'i yal 'dab ngo mtshar bas ngag gi lam yangs por bya sa te gleng bar bya ba ni/ dam pa'i skyes rabs kyi phreng ba du mar gzhan phan 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa dge legs grib bsil snum po'i zol gyis mtha' yas gdul bya'i gtsug tu snyoms par babs pa mchog sprul mthong ba don ldan gang zhig 'jigs pa med pa'i khri la mnga' gsol bas gong mnan te mchog dman bar ma'i tshogs pa bgrang yas rgyu skar gyi tshom bu sa la 'phos pa lta bu'i dbus su smra ba'i khyu mchog gang gis/ mdo las/gang tshe skye bo mang po'i dbus su son gyur pa/ /der ni mkhas pa'i chos kyi gtam las 'jug par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mkhas pa la yongs su grags pa/ chos tshul la brjod don 'brel ba/ ya rabs dam pa'i

—— — — 15ṭwāṃlugs dang mthun pa'i skabs bab ya mtshan gyi rdon rnams snyan tshig dri za'i 'phang 'gro'i rgyud du drangs te kun yid gcig tu myos pa'i datro/'a ston gyi tshul du brjod pa la lan gyi rim pa mdor bsdus shig 'bul ba'i dbang du byas na/ de yang bdag cag gi rnam 'dren zas gtsang gi sras po de nyid kyis zhing 'dir chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsu ma dang gsang chen rgyud sde bzhi'i chos tshul mi zad pa rgya cher bskor bas 'jig rten thams cad bde legs kyi snang ba dam pas khyab par mdzad pa dang / bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun dang shing rta chen po rnam gnyis sogs tshad ma'i skyes bu rim byon gyis thub bstan mi nub pa'i dbu 'phang dgung la reg par mdzad pa dang /chi byang phyogs gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir dang po bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ bar du bstan pa'i srol btod/ tha mar bstan pa snga dar la mkhan slob chos gsum dang / phyi dar la lha bla ma khu dbon gyi bka' drin la brten naso dpal ldan lha gcig tī pam ka ra la sogs pa'i lo paṇa tshad thub rnams dang / grub mtha' so so'i skyes chen dam pa bgrang las 'das pas chos tshul dung gi rang sgra 'gog med mkha' khyab du bsgrags pas gangs ljongs dpal gyi thig le rnam par dge ba'i zhing du bsgrubs/ —khya/ da par du/ bka' gdams glegs bam las/ tho mar bstan pa'i me ro dag /grags pa'i mtshanachi gyis gso bar byed/ /ces/ sogs mdo rgyud dpag tu med par lung bstan tshangs pa'i nga ros lan gcig min par bsngags pa mnyam med chosaneekyi rgyalapo tsong kha pa chen po de nyid kyis 'khrul

shākya/rngo/ste — — — sto 4༅༅ bral dbu ma'i lam bzang rdo rje theg pa dang zung du 'brel —ba snying bor byas pa'i bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer ba'i lugs bzang dar dkar yug gcig gis mtha' dbus yongs la khyab par bres pa ni grub mtha' gzhan las khyad par du 'phags shing / dri ma med pa'i srol nyid 'dzin pa'i skyes chen ni nam mkha'i skar tshogs las grangs mang ba chos kyi dgon sde ni phyogs mtshams khor yug tu tshom bur spungs pa lta bu yod pa las/ mdo smad sto rgyud kyi lte bar/ gru 'dzin zhing gi bdag po 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug de nyid theg pa mchog gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rol ba ci yang mdzad pa/ mkhas pa dang grub pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med pas gangs can bstan 'dzin bye ba'i gzi byin nyi ma'i drung na me khyer gyi lang tsho ji bzhin bgyid pa rong ston chos kyi rgyal po rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtshos rong bo dpal gyi dacigon chen phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i chos 'di nyid phyag 'debs mdzad de/ bu chen thugs sras rnams kyis ji ltar bskyangs tshul ni nyid nas ji ltar brjod pa las lhag zhu mi dgos/skabs su babs pa ni/ lung rtogs yon tan gyi rtsibs stong thogs pa med par bsgyur ba'i stobs kyis shar phyogs mi dbang gtsug gi zur phud gang gi zhabs mthil la rnam par btud pa/ chen po hor gyi yul grur 'khod pa'i rgyal phran du ma mnga' 'bangs dang bcas pa dang / nges pa don gyi zhwa ser cod pan 'ardzen pa'i ma hā parnyi ta dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang bo sogs mkhas pa'i tshogs bgrang las 'das par legs par bshad pa'i bdud rtsi ci yang 'gyed pa'i chos kyi rgyalaspo chen po mtshan sgrogs hu thog thu

259blo bzang dar rgyas dpal bzang bos 'khrul bral bstan pa'i snying bo mi nub pa'i dbu 'phang dgung la reg par ma zad/ sku phreng gnyis pa rje btsun 'jam dpal bstan pa rab rgyas sogs yangacisprul phyi ma rim byon gyis kyang gluyab gcig skal ldan rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i chos rgyud ma lus pa gzugs can gyi dngos po phrag par blangs pa bzhin du phyag mtshan du bathung zhing /'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bya bas chos kyi rnga chen po brdung zhing bkra shis kyi dril chen rnam par dkrol/ tshangs chen yid kyis bkod pa las gzhan du ma byas lhun gyis grub pa lta bu'i rang byung stong sku'i lha khang sogs gtsug lag khang rten brten pa bcas 'bum phrag ṣṭhama'i dkyil 'khor sa la spungs pa bzhin du mdzad pas sde 'dir 'khor lo gsum gyi phyag rjes nam yang bsub tu med pa'i ri mor babs pa kun gyis nges 'drongs ltar la/ don de dag thugs la brnag nas phyogs 'di'i che rgu du mas khur du blangs te lha dang bla ma tshad ldan du mar snga phyir yang yang lung zhus kyis da lam yang mchog gi sprul ba'i sku rin po che 'di nyid 'khrul med0nges 'dzin bgyis pa de ltar lags la/ 'di nyid gang du 'khrungs pa'i yul dang rigs rus kyi rang ba'i/na cung zad brjod na/ stod mnga' ris gung thang nas sog la skya bo yan la dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha/ bar sog la skya bo nas rma chu'i khug pa yan la mdo stod mi'i chol kha/ smad rma chu'i khug pa ma/sa rgya'i mchod rten dkar bo yan la mdo smad rta'i chol kha zhes gragayopa'i phyi ma 'di la yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i rma klungo dal gyis 'bab pa'i phyogs las bkye ste lho byang gi rgyud gnyis

4245() ————su yod pa las lhorshahūṃd —rmed kyi cho rmerge rdengos grub kyi mtshan ma rdo'i kwa ba rang byung du yod pa'i cha nas kwa ring du 'bod pa/ sa la dge bcu'i lang tsho rdzogs ldan gyi dpal ltar nyams pa med par yul mi btsan rgyug mnga' thang gi dregs pa rang gir spyod pa/ rtsod med kyi mkhas pa shar kwa ring bka' bcu phun tshogs rnam rgyal dang / sgo mangs bla ma blo bzang chos dar sogs skyes chen dam pa zam ma chad par skyes pa'i zlos gar bsgyur ba/ stag ge don yod rgya mtsho dang / paṇḍi ta ngag dbang dge 'dun bstan 'dzin sogs kyis snyan brgyud kyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs su bsgrongs pa/ yab rje rdzong dkar sku phyogs rnam gnyis kyis phyag mtshan du bzhes shing / bdag cag gi skyabs gcig khyab bdag grub pa'i dbang bo rje 'jigs med zhabs kyi sku phreng snga phyis zhabs kyis bcags shing chos tshul gyi gdugs dkar dgung du btegs pa sogs chos srid kyi rlabs phreng mkha' la 'phyo ba de nyid kyi mi khyim dpal 'byor chu bo g.yang du chags shing / ya rabs kyi ngang tshul zla lta ra gsal ba/ rmad du byung ba'i rigs rus phun su ma tshogs pa'i rgyud la sa byung ba yab rje 'jigs byed skyabs zhes dkon mchog bla mar 'dzin cing bsod nams las kyi brtul zhugs la gnas pa/ pho rab kyi rang bzhin lhan skyes su 'grogs shing snying stobs kyi phung bo bla na med pa'i cod pan du 'chang ba/ yum dpa' mo skyid ces bud med mchog gi mtshan nyid kyi dngos po mtha' dag rang byung du rdzogs pa dbang po'i sgo kun bag med pa'i gnas las ngang gis ldog pas rgyal rigs rikyi btsun mo dam pa'i rjes su rkang ba 'jog pa sogs kun gyis bsngags pa'i me tog gi sil ma ci yang

261'thor ba'i gnas subyuche ba 'di bzhin yin la/ gang du yab rje gong ma rim byon gyi khri la dbang bskur ba'i gnas ni/ ji skad du/ gangs ri'i mgon po rgyal ba rgya mtsho yi/ /thugs rje'i ga bur 'thul ba'i sā la'i ljo ngas/ /pur rgyal bod kyi 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor na/ /gser ljongs zhes bya sa yi thig le yod/ /ces bsngags pa re skong gser mo ljongs zhes grags dkar zla ba'i 'od ris phyogs su gsal ba/ stod na 'brog ru phan tshun dbyar gyi na bun dum bur chags pa lta bu/ smad na rong khyim yangs pa'i bkod pa lha yi grong khyeng gnam nas 'phos pa lta bu/ dbus na rong bo dpal gyi dgon chen 'og min zhing gi rgya rnam par ma chad pa lta bu/ ri sul khor yug tu sgrub pa'i dga' tshal bco brgyad sogs 'bras dkar gyi tshom bu sil mar bkram pa lta bu'i grong dang grong khyer/ dgon dang dga' tshal/ chos srid kyi 'byor ba 'phags yul gyi dpal la snyegs pa/ thugs bskyed mi zad pa 'phrul gyi 'khor lo nam mkha'i dbyings las thogs pa med par bsgyur bas dregs zhan yongs kyi gtsug gi cod pan dang 'grogs pa gong sa phyag na padmo skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen cing sa/zigs pa sku phreng rim byon/ gang de'i chos rgyud kyi rgyal mtshan thugs bskyed dpung ba brtan pos bla nas blar 'degs pa'i skyes chen dam pa/ lung rigs sgra dbyangs kyi nga ro nam mkha'i mtha' klas nga/ra sgrog pa'i bathe/sa gnyen chen po/mkhyen rab shel dpo/ra gyi me long shes bya'i rol sgeg 'dzin pa'i mkhas dbang mang bo/ gos dkar lcang lo'i rgyan phreng yongs su 'dzin pa'i sngags 'chang rig pa 'dzin pa/ lha sngags ting 'dzinasgyu la/ mnga' brnyes pa g.yung

262brung bon gyi rnal 'byor/ gnam bskos chos rgyal gong rim gyi lung las kyis mngon par mtho ba lha btsun nang so gsar rnying gi gtsos mi dbang sa yi dbang phyug mi chos gtam la mkhas shing lo rgyus kyi dge thonma pa/tshangs pa chen po'i blo'i byed pa 'chang ba'i mi bzang / gshin rje khros pa lta bu'i dpa' ba dang rtul phod pas mi bsrun dgra sde 'jom pa la snying stobs dang sgyu rtsal la byang ba'i stag shar dpa' bo/ dngos po sna tshogs kyi bang mdzod mkhar du brtsigs pa'i khyim bdag sogs snod bcud kyi phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa mes po chen bo'i blo'i rwa ba las 'gongs pa dag gi snying bo/ ji skad du/ sa rdo rje 'dra ba'i sgrod pa nas/ /mi khyod kyis sgru ba brgyud bstan pa spel/ /zhes tshad ma'i lung gis zin pa 'dzam gling rgyan gyi chos sde chen po phyogs las rnam rgyal bde chen chos 'khor gling gi chos kyi gadhe la chen po 'ari nyid lags la/ bkra shis gang zhig gnam la gza' skar bzang / /bkra 'i/sa gang zhig sa la byin kyang chags/ /bkra shis gang zhig bar du dga' ston 'phel/ /bkra shis phun0tshogs dge ba'i nyi ma 'dir/ /zhes de ring ma bcos rang 'grigs kyi rten 'brel mtha' dag lhun gyis grub pa'i nyin 'dir/ ri bo ltar 'phang mtho ba/ rma bya ltar mdangs bzang ba/ cang shes ltar 'gros legs pa'i cibs la lha'i sras po rgyan gyis rnam par spras pa nam mkha'i mthongs las babs pa bzhin mchog gi sprul ba'i sku rin chen mthong ba don dang ldan pa nyid bde bar chibs pas dbu drangs/ lung rtogs yon tan gyis mtho ba/ rigs rus dpal 'byor gyis dregs pa/ ngo mtshar mdzes 'phyor gyis sgeg pa'i ser skya

— —— — — — ——— — — ṅka — — 72(3༷ wa chibs skyel ba rnams kyis mtha' brten// phyogs krādi'i dregs zhan bar rma 'i skyes po bgrangs bar mi spobs pa dag gis rim bzhin rta bsus kyi bkod pa yid du 'ong ba mtho ris kyi dmag tshogs sa la 'phos pa lta bus zur brgyan/ ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan phrag par bkal ba'i dge 'dun ba—gres gzhon rnams kyis mchod pa'i dngos po dpag tu med pa tshar du dngar ba sgyu ma'i 'phrul gyi bang mdzod las ched du blangs pa lta bus ma dun bdar te/ gdan sa chen po'i mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i dbang bo brgyad kyis btegs pa'i chos kyi khri 'phang mthon por zhabs sen utpal gar gyi ri mo nye bar bkod pa la/ legs skyes kyi dngos 'bul/ chos srid kyi 'bel gtam/ dga' ston gyi yo lang gang thad nas rgya che la gral 'grigs pa/phyis 'byung rten 'brel gyi cha rnams lhun grub tu gyur ba lags la/ slad mar yang / mgon 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i bkas mngon par mtho ba se ri cun wang chen mo/mdzod pa chos rje nyi ma bkra shis/ 'di ka'i makron gnyer che ba/ sku rtsa gling rgya'i bla dpon sogs kyis gtsos zham ring ba so so nas rang la sku don che phra gang babs khur du blangs te / mchog sprul rin po che nas gser mdog cod pan 'chang ba'i rang lugs ma med pa'i chos kyi khri la bltan pa mtha' dag gzugs su 'dzin pas 'chad pa dang rtsod pa dang rtsom pa ma lus pa la rang dbang du spyod pa'i rgyal thabs su dbang bsgyur nas 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad pas bstan 'gro'i pan bde spel ba'i zhabs 'deṭa tshul bzhin mdzad par zhu zhu zhu zhes gal po che la nan tan gyi tshul du zhu ba de ltar lags/ /

tswaskyi(1dze/ — —— — —— chu dmar sgom sprul sku phreng lnga ba bees mdo'i gdan sar gsar phebs kyi skabs khri las thog pa gser kha sprul ba'i sku'i ngor spel ba/ 'o lags so/ de yang ji skad du/ mi shigs g.yung drung khams su lhun chags pa'i/ /ngo mtshar sku gsum dkyil 'khor nyin mor byed/ /tshe dbang grub pa 'chi med lha tshogs kyis/ /deng 'dir dngos grub snang ba'i sgo phyis shig /ces dge legs snang ba mi zad pa'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag cig char dbye ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i yal 'dab ngo mtshar bas ngag gi lam rnams yangs bar byas te/ dam pa'i skyes rabs kyi phreng ba du mar gzhan phan 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa dge legs grib bsil snum po'i zol gyi ma/tha' yas gdul bya'i gtsug la snyoms par babs pa mchog sprul mthong ba don ldan sa/nga zhig 'jigs pa med pa'i khri la mnga' gsol bas gong mnan te cha/chog dman bar ma'i tshogs bgrang yas rgyu skar dzogyi tshom bu sa la 'phos pa lta bu'i dbus su gang gleng bar bya ba ni/ — ji skad du mdo las/ gang tshe skye bo mang bo'i dbus su son gyur ba/ /

265der‘ni mkhas pa chos kyi gtam la 'jug par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/mkhas pa la yongs su grags pa/ —richos tshul la brjod don 'brel ba/ ya rabs kyi lugs srol dang mthun pa'i skabs bab ya mtshan gyi don 'ga' snyan tshig dri za'i phang 'gro'i rgyud du dal bus drangs te kun yid gcig tu myos pa'i dga' ston gyi tshul du brjod pa la/ de yang bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dpal nyams med zas gtsang gi sras po de nyid kyis bla na med pa'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i gser gyi ljon pa chen po lnga phrag snyigs ma'i 'gro la mi dmigs pa'i smon lam chen po lnga brgya btab pa'i drod gsher gyis nye bar bskyangs pas rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rgya che la gradas mang ba/dpag par dka' ba'i gzungs dang ting 'dzin gyi sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag gi yal ka stong gis dra ba phyogs dang phyogs su bre ba las sku bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i ngo mtshar gyi me tog ci yang bzhad patsho na/ lha dang mi'i drang srong chen po rnams kyi bsti gnas wa ra na si'i 'gram gyi tshal dang / ri dbang bya rgod kyi phung bo mkha' la 'phyo ba lta bu'i spo dang / grong khyer chen po drug gi ya gyal yangs pa can sogs su sngon lha dang mir gyur ba'i drang srong sus kyang ma bskor ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo chos kyi sku mi zad pa'i dbyings las rgya cher bskor bas 'jig rten thams cad bde legs kyi snang ba dam pas khyab par mdzad/ de nas sprul ba'i nyan thos chen po gtad rabs bdun dang shing rta chen po glu sgrub dang thogs med sogs tshad ma'i skyes bu rim byon gyis thub bstan mi nub pa'i dbu 'phang dgung la reg par bgyis pas 'phags yul gling phran dang bcas pa 'og min zhing gi rgya rnam

266par ma chad pa'i cha lag gcig tu gyur pa bzhin du mdzad/ nam zhig ri bo gangs can gyi rtse mo mkha' la bsnyegs pa'i phreng ba khor yug tu dngar ba'i mi mkhyud zlum por 'khril ba'i lte ba byang phyogs bho ṭa'i ljongs zhes yongs su grags pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag la bsod nams mi zad pa'i dpung ba gnam gyi thed mong gis nam mkha'i mthongs las dbang bsgyur ba lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi ring la dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes te bsil ba'i ljongs chen po dkar 'jam yug gcig gis khyab pa'i snga ltas kyi skya rengs dang po shar/'jig rten dbang phyug mi rje chos kyi rgyal bo'i rnam par rol ba lha chen po srong btsan sgam po'i dus su sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nyi ma bod yul phan bde'i pad tshal zum pa med pa'i dpal du shar bas 'gro ba rnams dga' ba'i ca co da dir gyi gdangs su khrol/ de nas ring bo ma lon paro mkhan slob chos gsum zhes mtshan gyi cha shas re yang 'gro ba ma lus pa'i rna ba'i bdud rtsir gyur ba de dag gi bka' drin bsgul tu med pa'i shing rta'i lam la bsten te bshad pa dang sgrub pa'i srol ka yongs su rdzogs pa'i ljon pa rma med pa khor yug nas wo/ ra yug tu rgyas pa'i gru 'dzin zhing gi yon tan ljongs 'di'i bsod nams kyis nye bar drangs pa bzhin tu gyur/ yid bsrubs 'phrul gyi byed pa snying la rang stobs su rdzogs pa'i rgyal bo glang dar mas thub bstan ming gi lhag mar byas pa na/ bla chen po'i thugs rje zla zer dag pa'i dpal las bstan pa'i me ro mdo khams smad nas gsos/ lha bla ma khu dbon gyi thugs bskyed gzhar ya nga mi g.yo bas nam mkha' ltar khyab par mdzad pa las sprul ba'i skyes mchog lo chen rin chen bzang bo dang /

267 —dpal lha gcig dri bam ka ra sogs kyis dri ma med pa'i mdo sngags kyi srol bzang stod nas btsugs pas/ rim bzhin lo paṇa tshad thub dang /'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas thugs sras sku mched gsum sogs mnyam med bka' gdams pha dang / sa gong ma lnga sogs sa skya pa dang /mar mi dwags gsum sogaspu bka' brgyud pa rnams kyi chos tshul g.yas 'khyil dung gi rang sgra 'gog thed mkha' khyab tu bzhad bas gangs ljongs daphal gyi thig le rnam par dge ba'i zhing tu bsgrubs/ khyad par du bka' gdams glegs bam las/ tha mar bstan pa'i ma ro dag /grags pa'i mtshan gyis gso bar byed/ /ces sogs mdo rgyud du mar lung bstan tshangs pa'i nga ro mi 'gyur bden tshig dbyangs kyi rol mos lan gcig min par bsngags pa mnyam med chosacikyi rgyal bo tsong kha pa po de nyid kyis rgyal ba'i bstan la rgyal ba rang nyid slar byon dzi las kyang lhag pa'i bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad ba'i sgojinas rtagajichad kyi mtha' thang nas khegs pa'i 'khrul bral dbu ma chem/ po'i lam bzang gsang chen rdo rje theg pa dang thung du 'brel ba snying bor byas pa'i bstan pa thams cad gru bzhir lam gyi rjer pa'i srol bzang dar dkar yug gcig mtha' dbus yongs la khyab par bres ba'i grib bsil gyi cha shas re yang rgyu skar gyi dbus na zla ba dang rkang 'thung gi tshal na dpag bsam misngon pa bzhin du grub mtha' gzhan las khyad par du 'phags shing / dri ma med pa'i srol de nyid 'dzin pa'i skyes chen ni nam mkha'i skar tshogs las grangs mang / chos kyi dgon sde ni phyogs rṣa/tshams khor yug tu tshom bur spungs pa lta bu yod pa las/ mdo

268 smad lho rgyud kyi sa'i lte ba/ nges pa don du 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug de nyid drang don dge ba'i bshes kyi rol ba ci yang mdzad pa mkhas pa dang grub pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med pas nagangs can bstan 'dzin bye ba'i gzi byin nyi ma'i drung na me khyer gyi lang tsho ji bzhin bgyid pa rong ston chos kyi rgyal bo rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho de nyid la thugs sras ston sgom gyi bu chen mang du bzhugs pa'i khrod na sras kyi thu bo kun dga' bo sa/nyis pa chu dmar sgom chen blo bzang rgya mtsho zhes grags snyan gyi utpal skye rgu'i rna bar rtag tu 'grogs pa gang des mdo dbus gnyis kar chos kyi rgya mtsho mi zad pa'i klong la thos bsam gyis rol pa lhur bzhes/ lhag pa ra paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal satshan/ bstan 'dzin blo bzang rgya mtsho/ grub chem skal ldan rgya mtsho gsum gyi zhabs rdul rnyog pa med pa gtsug gis mchod de snyan brgyud kyi man ngag rdzogs par mnos/ bcu gcig shel gyi dgon pa sogs bsam gtan gyi gnas chen du mar sgrub la gcig tu gzhol bas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyi sgo ma tha' yas pa mngon du mdzad pa sogs sras bcas rgyal bas bsngags 'os kyi rnam par thar ba rgya mtsho 9 rte bu mchis la/ ga mgon po de nyid slar yang sprul ba'i blos gar mdzad pa ngag dbang blo bzang bstan 'dzin ni mkhas btsun bzang ba'i yon —tan dang 'khor lo dzogasum gyi mdzad bzang rlabs che zhing khyad par du phyogs las rnom par rgyal ba'i chos sde chen po thub bstan chos 'khor gling 'di'i mkhan khrirtel dbang bsgyur te lo ngo sum cu rtsa grangs la tshul bzhin bskyangs pas mdo sngags rig

sa la — — la bye//rdo/11)////gnas phyogs med la sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa/ gzhung brgya'i dgongs don rang dbang du spyod pa'i bshes gnyen bgrangs las 'das pa thon te dus de na sde 'di nyid 'dzam gling rgyan gyi chos sde chen por gyur pa'i gtam rgyud kyi phreng ba deng yang ma nyams par gnas shing / sku phreng gsum pa dge 'dun 'phrin las lhun 'grub ni yon tan gyi rang rtsal khong nas rdzogs pa/thugs kyi dgongs dbyings dkyel che zhing thabs mkhas kyi 'phrushā ‘ dang ldan pas 'di ka'i chos kyi mkhan khri la zhabs sen bkod thog dbyar gnas kyi gzhi'i spyag len dang chos thog gsar du btsugs pa dang 'du khang chen po legs par bskrun pa sogs phyag rjes che ba'i rnam thar dang bka' drin gyi ri mo nam yang bsub tu med par bdog la/ rje gong ma bla bzang thogs med tshul khrims ni spyi dang bye brag gi yon tan mtha' yas pa'i bang mdzod bdag gir mdzad pa dang / dgon 'di'i khri dngos dang zur ba gang gi skabs su yang chos srid kyi srog shing gcig pu mdzad cing / nye char mgon po gang gi thugs rje dpyid kyi lang tsho dus las mi yol ba dang skal ba bzang bo'i gdul bya'i bsod nems kyi rten 'byung bslu ba thed pa'i rgyu las rigs ru0 sun sum tshogs pa'i skyed tshal dam tha/ra mchog gi sprul ba'i sku blo bzang legs bshad rgya mtsho nyid lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa'i mgon dang skyabs su sku bltams par/ sgrib bral ye shes kyi gzigs pa thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i lha dang bla ma du mar lung zhus kyis 'khrul med nges 'drongs nyid de/ gang la ltos bcas rnams kyi re ba don dang ldan par gyur/ da ni ji skad du/ de ring gnam la bkra shis gzadza skor 'char/ /sa la khri

tswaskyirwarte() — — —— — ——— — — —— gdugs nyi ma'i 'od kyang dro/ /bar du mi nor khang zhing longs spyod 'phel/ /phun tshogs bkra shis dge pa'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gnam la gza' dang skar ma skor ba'i khrod du sbyor/ sa la byin chags rten 'brel gyi rang mdangs ma btsos lhan gyis grub pa'i nyin 'dir/ ri bo ltar 'apang mtho ba/ rma bya ltar mdangs bzang ba/cang shes ltar 'thos legs pa'i chibs la lha'i sras po rgyan gyis rnam par spras pa nam mkha'i mthongs las babs pa bzhin du mthong ba don dang ldan pa nyid bde bar bcibartswapas dbu drangs/ lung rtogs yon tan gyis mtho ba/ rigs rus stobs 'artsor gyis dregs pa/ ngo mtshar mdzes 'aspyor gyis sgeg pa'i ser skya chibs skyel ba rnams kyis mtha' pharten te lha'i dbang bo skabs gsum gyi tshul du chas pa'am rgya gar paṇa chen gangs can gyi sngongs su gshegs pa bzhin du phebs pa la/ lung dang rigs pa smra ba'i mkhas dbang 'bum phrag rol ba'i chos sde chen po thas mdo dpal gyi dgon chen thub bltan chos 'khor gling zhes chos srid ji zad pa'i rlabs phreng phyogs kyi bu mo'i rna ba la 'khyud pa 'ari ka'i chos kyi gdan khris mtho ba'i skyes sprul/bslab gsum yon tan gyis rgyug pa'i bshes gnyen/ ngur smrig dar zab kyis thubs pa'i bgres gzhon mang bas rta bsus dang mchod bsus kyi bkod ba gser gyi sa gzhi la rin po che'i sngon pa sna tshogs pa 'phrul gyi phreng bar spel ba bzhin du byas/ gnam bskos pa'i lung las kyis mngon par mtho ba stong dpon chen mos gtsos yula'adi'i mi bzang seng do rnams dang snyes po bgrangs 'das pas bamu ba dang dad pas phyag dang bcas gdan sa

—— tswa/rdo///tswa/gachen po'i me 'jigs seng ge brgyad kyis btegs rnga7) khri la zhabs sen badmo nye bar bkod pa'i legs skyes dang rten 'byung mtshon byed du྾ mo mobacas 'bul lam zhu ba lags na/ji skad du/ e ma 'dzam gling yangs pa 'dir/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i rin chen gru/ rnam dkar ba dan lhab lhub tu/ /g.yo ba'i dpal gyis mtho bar 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ du4/ 'dir thugs bskyed dang snying stobs kyi go cha lhag par bzhes te zhabs pad mi shigs g.yung drung gi ngo bor bskal ba rgya mtsho'i bar du brtan bar bzhugs nas/ mkhas btsun bzang bo'i yon tan gyi bang mdzod bdag gir bzhes te 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i legs bshad kyi sgra dbyangs rgyun mar sgrog pa la brten nas 'jig rten mtha' dag bkra shes dang dge legs chen po yun nas yun du skyong ba spremakhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhu lags// // rī

shā rte///rte//// — ————bees mardo'i lha zhis pa khrir bkod skabs khri las thog pa blo bzang grags pa rgya mtsho'i ngor spel ba/'o lags so/ bkra shis don gnyis na grub rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bkra shis lung rtogs phun tshogs dam pa'i chos/ /bkra shis bshad sgrub dpal ldan 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /bkra shis rgya mtshos mtha' dag rgyas gyur cig /ces shis brjod g.yas 'khyil dung gi rang sgra zhing khams rgya mtsho'i mtha' dang mnyam par bsgrags pa'i legs byas rten 'brel gyi phung bo rang byung lhun grub bden pa chen po'i ngo bor yongs su grub pa sngon du btang ste / ji skad du/ blo bzang mkhyen brtse'i mkha' dbyings las/ /thub bstan padmo'i kha 'byed pa/ /dpal ldan chos kyi nyi ma de/ /skal bzang shar ri'i rtse la 'phags/ /zhes pa ltar/ blo chen rgyal ba yongs kyi mkhyen brtse mi zad pa khams rnam par dag pa'i dbyings las nye bar ba'e/ngas pa/ thub bstan padmo'i dga' tshal rgya mtsho'i mtha'i bar du 'byed pa la nges don dpal ldan chos kyi nyi ma chen po bdag cag skal pa bzang bo ma tha' dag gi zur phud shar gyi ri bo'i ba gam la zhabs sen 'od tshogs kyi ri mo rnam par bkod pa/ mchog gi sprul ba'i sku rin po che gang gi zhabs

— 273 stegs 'jigs pa med pagle seng ge— chen po brgyashe skyeṅge rbortorgeṅge —pagle khri — 'phang yangs pa'i ga la bar/ gang zhig zhu bar bya ba ni/ chos kyi dbyings mtha' klas pa mi zad pa rnam par dag pa'i klong 'di la dag pa tshodang ma dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams til gyi gang bu ltar mu ma mchis pa'i dbus na/ bskal bzang rnam 'dren nyi ma stong gis phyag mtshan du bzhes pa'i zhing khams mi mjed 'jig rten gyi zhing zhes bya ba/ sdong bu la me tog dang / ri rab la bang rim bzhin du bkod pa mdzes par chags shing / gang gi lte bar dzam bu'i rgyal mtshan gyi rkang 'thung ral ba'i tsod pan du 'dzin pa/ lho gling —grub pa'i gnas mchog 'di la/ bskal ba bzang bo'i sangs rgyas rim par byon dang 'byon 'gyu ra mtha' dag pas sangs rgyas pa'i rma dzad pa ston pa las deng gi dus su/ 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med don kun grub pa de nyid nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi ngo skobor mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul bstan te skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams la theg gsum mdo sngags sna tshogs kyi chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor bas lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten mtha' dag dge tshogs kyi snang ba yug gcig gis khyab par mdzad de/ nag phyogs bdud kyi ris ma lus pa ni spa bskong / dkar phyogs lha mi'i tshogs mtha' dag pas ni rgyal ba'i rnga brdung / mtho ris dang thar ba'i sgo 'phar rnam par phye bas phun pa —dang bde ba'i dpal mi zad pa'i dge mtshan mtha' dbus yongs la rgyas pa 'di lags la/ rgyal ba'i ring lugs dri ma med pa de nyid gnas pa dang 'phel ba ni/ bde bshegs gsung rab tshul gnyis shing rta'i srol/ /legs

274par phye bas rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog /sa gsum 'gro la nyi ltar gsal mdzad pa/ /klu sgrub thogs med ces bsngags pa ltar/ shing rta chen po rnam gnyis sogs ma khas pa dang grub pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams la rag las pas na/ yul chen po drug gis mtshon pas rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul dang / kha ba'i ri bo khor yug tu mdzes pa bod yul gru 'dzin gyi zhing khams sogs su sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul ba mtha' yas mdzad pa'i rol ba sna tshogs pa bstan te/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa mi nub pa'i 'phrul sgo sna tshogs pas bsgrub par mdzad la/ yang sgos su gangs ljongs tshad ma'i ston pa rgyal ba 'jamabyudapal snying bos rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rgyal pa nyid las lhag pas bya ba rgya cher mdzad de/ shar rgya mtsho chen po nas nub dza 7'i me tog gi dri bsung 'thul ba'i bar la sngon med pa'i chos kyi srol ka bla na med pas khyab par mdzad pa ra brten/ yul gru ri sul gyi khong gsang ma lus pa chos kyi sde chen po rgyu skar gyi phung bo sa la 'phos snyam byed sa sha stag gis gang ba las/ mdo smad lho rgyud kyi mtha' 'dir yang bis mdo dpal gyi dgon chen phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i chos sde chen po lhun chags gong 'phel gyi tshul du byung ba la/ ji skad du/ ngag gi dbang byug mi pham zla bas/ ji ltar klung rnams sa yi steng du so so yang / /rgya mtsho'i ngang la ro gcig 'dris pa de bzhin du/ /'di na 'chad dang nyan po sosmoso ltar snang yang / /khyod 'ba' zhig gi sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol ba ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skyabs mgon g.yer gshong chos kyi rgyal bo sku phreng rim byon dang gnyis su med pa la gnyis su snang ba'i tshul du dam pa'i zlos gar du mas

lha13 phyag gi mtshan ma dang spyan gyi 'bras bu bzhin skyong bar ma dzad pa las/ smra ba'i khyu mchog ma lus pa'i ral ba'i gdengs ka la yon tan gyi tshogs ngo mtshar bas mngon par dbang bsgyur ba lha zhis blo bzang nyi masku dpal bzang bo'i zhal snga nas kyis kyang sku'i phreng ba du mar rjes brtses gzigs pa bla na med pa'i byed ṅge gzhar yang ma dor bas/ da lta yang rigasaurus cho 'brang gi dga' tshal rnam par dag cing sa/tsang ba lho phyogs ma la ya'i 'khri shing dgung la dkrigs pa lta bu'i rgyud du/ zla ba zhun ma'i khu ba lan brgyar byugs pa'i gangs dkar gyi ri bo la nyin byed stong gi 'od zer kun nas 'khyud pa'i dpal yad zil gyis mnon pa lta bu'i mtshan dpe gzi byin gyi phung bo lhan ne lhang nger byon cing / rtags dang mtshan ma yang mtshan gyi ri mo dbang bo'i gzhu ltar bkra ba mtha' yas khor yug nor 'dzin gyi gzhi la 'khod pa ma lus pas ci yang smos par byas/ dus gsum gzigs pa'i ye shes dri ma med pa'i spyan mnga' ba skyabs mchog dang po'i mgon po yab rje 'jigs med zhabs kyis mkhyen pa ye shes kyi me long dri ma med pa'i ngos la ji bzhin gsal bar shar ba'i skabs nyid na gsung ngag bden pa bslu ba med pas bdag cag ltos bcas thams cad la ji ltar ngetshos 'drongs kyi gsal cha 'jig rten dge legs kyi snang ba dang por lung bsgrags/ mkha' la nyi zla sprin dkar gyi ri mo byed pos ched du bris 'dra/ sa la ri klung bkra shis kyi rtags mtshan gdod nas grub pa lta bu'i gnas su / de ring bkra shis shing phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin 'dir mgon po nyid mi 'jigs khri la zhabs sen bkod de skye dgu mtha' dag dga' zhing spro ba'i dpal dar ched

— 1skyirwarte(1 — — — ji ri — dzha — — —— du 'bul ba 'di bzhin lags na/ ji skad du/ zhabs pad mi 'gyur bskal brgyar dilhun chags shing / /lung rtogs gzi byin skye dgu'i dbus na mtho/ /chos kyi dung 'bud chos kyi rnga yang brdungs/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur 'dzug par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sa gsum 'gro ba'i yon gnas bla na med pa'i mchod sdong chen por zhabs zung mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rang khams stug po'i ngo bor lhun chags bskal brgya'i bar du bzhugs shing / lung dang rtogs pa'i gzi byin zla zhun 'bum phrag 'od du 'tsher ba'i lhun po'i dpal bzhin lhar bcas skye dgu'i dbus na zla med rma ngon par mtho ba'i mdzad pa rang gir banes te/ phyogs dang ris su ma bcos pa'i blo gsal mkhas mang bye ba tshar du dngar ba'i tshal la/ sngon med pa'i legs bshad mi zad pa 'phrul gyi dung bus shing rnga brdungs/ mdo sngags chos kyi rgyal mtshan mkha' khyab tu bsgrengs bas phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kun du bzang bo'i cod pan gtsug tu bcings pa'i chos kyi rgyal bor mnga' dbang bsgyur ba mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen lags zhes gsol ba seng ge'i nga ro'i sgra dbyangs ci yang sgrog na mkhyen brtse dag pa chos kyi klong yangs po la 'dogs pa bka' drin du zhu zhu/ /

277sgar so ma'i skyabs mgon la yar zhus/oṃ su sti/ skal bzang dregs ldan lha brgya'i dkyil 'khor du/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i 'phrin las lung rtogs dpal/ /rgya mtshor spel mkhas 'jigs bral dbang phyug che/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal zhabs la/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'phags mchog phyag na padmo'i sgyu 'phrul gyi rol ba rnam 'dren skal ldan rgya mtsho'i sprul ba'i zlos gar chen po/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skal ba bzang bo'i gdul bya mtha' yas shing / dregs ldan gyi skye bo bgrang las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho chen po sa la 'khyil ba 'dra ba'i dbus su/ blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i 'phrin las kun gyi snying bo lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa rin po che rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i grangs su spel ba la mkhas grub gnyis 'dzoms kyi rtsal rdzogs pa/ 'u gas gnyis 'apin las kyi gzi byin gzhan las khyad du 'phags pas 'jigs pa bral ba'i dbang phyug chen po'i gnas rma ngon du byas pa/ sde bzhi phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal ni phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba/ 7gong sa skyabs mgo na thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po'i khri drung du/ nye bar gus pa'i lha phyag tshul dang mthun pa sngon du btang ste gang zhig zhu ba ni/ de yang skye rgu ma lus pa'i gtsug gi nor bu/ sa gsum gyi 'dren pa zla med pa/ srid zhi'i dregs ldan snyan gyi phyag yul/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bdag po chen

278 po/ 'dzam gling yongs kyi skyabs mgon bla ma chen po/ gyiskal ldan blo bzang 'phrin las lung rtogs rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam rgyal dpal bzang bo nyid ni/ drang don thun mong gdul bya'i snang ngo la yang / 'phags chen dam pa zam ma chad pa'i rgyud du rigs phun sum tshogs par skye ba mngon par bzhes/ rnam 'dren chos kyi rgyal bo yab rje sku phreng rim byon gyi pho brang gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang du phyag phebs te/ dus 'dir sa gsum na zla med pa'i mkhas grub chen po du ma dang / mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'i yongs 'dzin du ma'i zhabs pad bsten te/ dbang lung man ngag gi rgyun seng ge dkar mo'i 'o ma 'dra ba rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan pa dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i sbyang bar bya ba'i gnas yod do cog la gsan bsam mtha' chod pa gnang bzhin pa dang / bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don spyi dang / bye brag tu gser ljongs yul gyi bstan srid kyi phan bde ma lus pa'i khur bsnams te gang la gang 'tshams kyi mngod 'phrin sa chen po'i rgyan du gyur ba sha stag bdag gir bzhes shing / grags pa dkar po'i ba dan gyi rgyal mtshan phyogs nas phyogs dang khor yug nas khor yug tu lha dang bcas pa'i 'asgro ba mtha' yas pas bsgrong bzhin pa dang / da lo yang mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i shes bya rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa'i kun mkhyen bla ma chen po/ 5— bshad sgrub zung 'brel gyi bang rtsal yongs su rdzogs pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu chen po/ pha gcig dang po'i sangs rgyas mkhas pa dang ghab pa'i dbang snyag zla med pa/ yab rje rdo rje 'chang 'jigs med

279zhabs dang / 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal bo yongs 'dzin blo bzang dpal ba las mdo sngags kyi chos tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / khyad phar rig pa'i gsang tshig mtha' yas pa bzhes slad/ chos kyi dga' tshal nyams dga' ba/ snyigs dus/ kyi thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa dmar parnyi ta dang / kun mkhyen 'jigs med paṇḍi ta yab sras sogs paṇḍi ta sha stag zam ma chad par phebs te bshad sgrub kyi rgyal mtshan bsgrengs shing lung rigs kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa'i gnas mchog 'dir chibs kyi kha lo mngon par bsgyur ba ni bdag cag yul phyogs 'dir 'khod kyi ser skya thams cad la yid bzhin gyi nor bu char du phabs pa las kyang bka' drin gyi khur lci bas/bka' drin legs po mtshon pa dang / mchog tu dga' ba'i dga' ston mtshon tsam du/ ྾ mo molags na ji skad du/ zhabs zung dregs ldan gtsug na lham me bar/ /legs bshad chos kyi sgra dbyangs phyogs rnams las/ /rnam pa ra rgyal ba'i mtshan mar mngon bsgrags nas/ /rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dga' ston ci yang 'gyed/ /ces pa ltar/ zhabs zung mthong ba don ldan nam yang 'gyur ba med par lha mi'i dregs pa can mtha' dag gi zur phud rtse la lham mer lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs shing brtan pa dang / lung dang rigs pa'i legs bshad zad mi shes pa'i nga ro grogs seng ge srab med du 'phyo ba'i mtshan zhabs pa rnams daje lhan cig phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal du ma bsgrags pas gser ljongs yul gyi kho ra khor yug thams cad chos dang grags snyan gyi rnga sgras lhan cig 'gengs shing / nged cag gang la re ba'i mig 'bur gtod pa thams cad la sngon

280 — — med pa'i dga' bde zad mi shes pa stsol ba dang / dgon ri khrod gnyis mi chos spyod kyi rim pa legs lam yong ba dang / yul phyogs 'di la lo legs bkra shis kyi dge mtshan dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas pa'i thugs rjes gzigs pa mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ zhu lags/ /— — rnyo

— —— 281khyung mgon skya phreng gsum pa khrir phebs bshad lan du sngags 'chang pasma rgya snyatsho'i mos 'dod bzhin spel ba/ 'o lags so/ de yang ji skad du/ bkra shis gang zhig thog mar dge ba don gnyis mthar phyin rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bkra shis gang zhig bar du dge ba nyon mongs gdung sel dam pa'i chos/ /bkra shis gang zhig tha mar dge ba rig grol gnyis ldan 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /bkra shis gang zhig rin chen gsum gyis deng 'dir bkra shis char du bsnyil/ /zhes shis pa brjod pa'i ngag tshig dri ma med pa'i me tog manda ra ba'i phreng ba mtshar du dngar ba dad gsum yangs pa'i snyim pa gzengs su mtho bas mkha' la gtor bas sngon bsus te gang zhig gleng bar bya ba ni/ de yang rang cag rnams kyi 'dren pa bla na med pa skyabs gcig mthong ba don ldan mchog sprul nyi ma gzhon nu gang gi zhabs zung bkra shis kyi 'khor lo mi 'jigasauseng ge'i khri la rab tu bkram pas nyi zla bzhin gral gyi gong mnan/ zab gsang rgyud sde yongs kyi gzhung la‘sbyangs stobs kyi rnam dpyod kun nas brtas pa'i lus stobs kyi rtsel yongs su rdzogs shing— / sgom sgrub nyams myong gi ting

282 dge— ———— ——9dku — — ——— — — —byu—'dzin brtan po g.yo ba mi mnga' ba'i g.yu ral phyogs su gsig pa/legs par bshad pa'i dbyangs kyi nga ro phyogs bcur sgrogs pa la 'jigs pa med pa'i gnas thob pa/ /phur thogs rig sngags 'chang ba stong phrag du ma phreng bar bsgrigs pas gangs dkar gyi lhun po thar chags su bstar ba bzhin gral gyi gzhi bzung / rgyan gos kyi 'ja' mtshon mngon par bkra zhing / dad gus kyi rnam 'gyur mchog tu rgyas pa'i phyogs yas mas kyi bos mgron tsan dan gyi ljon pa kun nas dud pa lta bus gral gyi mtha' mdzes par byas te/ sngon bsags legs smon gyi rnam dkar mu tig gsar po'i do shal lu gu rgyud du 'brel ba rnams 'di ltar lhan gcig gdan 'dzom pa'i dbus su/ sngags 'os yon tan gyi nor bu'i cod pan srid du ring zhing /mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'aspor lo'i sgo 'phar yangs por phye ba gang gis/brjod don gyi 'gengs zab pa/ rjod byed kyi tshig snyan pa/ lo rgyus kyi dge tho na pa'i maṇḍal gyi bshad pa phun sum tshogs pa la lan tsam zhig 'bul ba skabs su babs pa yin la/ de yang bdag ni ngo mtshar rig pa'i gnas la sbyangs stobs kyi shes rab phra ba dang / chos dang srid kyi bya ba la mthong rgya chung bas na/ mkhas pa rnam par dgyes pa dang / 'jig rten ngo mtshar du byed pa'i legs bshad gtam gyi rol mo ci dgar dkrol ba'i nus pa med mod/ 'on kyang / rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi snyan ngag pa po dpal ldan dpal bo'i zhal nas/ ya rabs rnams dang 'phrad na skyes kyi mchog /tshogs kyi nang na mkhas pa mgu bar byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar rang blos dpog tshod kyis rmad du byung ba'i chos ldan gyi bya ba dang rjes

— 283su 'brel ba'i gtam gyi phreng ba cung zad spel ba ni/ lus can rnams la gcig tu mnyes shing sa/shin pa'i byams brtse dang ye shes kyi rtogs pa klong du gyur cing / mkha' khyab tu 'jug pa'i 'phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i stobs kyis zhal gyi dbugs rgyu ba tsam gyis kyang 'gro ba mtha' dag rnam paragrol ba'i skal ba can du sgrub pa skye dgu yongs kyi rnam 'dren rgyal ba chen po kun mkhyen bu ram shing ba zhes grags pa dang / mdzad 'phrin gyi snang ba bskal bzang rgyal ba'i nyi ma stong phrag tshar du dngar ba'i dbus na lnga brgya tha ma'i 'gro ba rnams la lhag par ga/sal ba de nyid kyis/ dang po lus can rnams 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las rnam par bsgral nas sku bzhi'i ye shes kyi grong khyer yangs por rnam par 'god pa'i ched du bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed/ bar du bskal ba chen po grangs med gsum gyi yun la pha rol du phyin pa drug gis bsdus pa'i tshogs gnyis kyi spyod pa mtha' yas pa sku nyams su bstar/ mthar snod bcud kyi 'byor ba nam mkha' ltar rgya che ba nges pa lnga ldan 'og min chos kyi zhing khams su longs sku'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pa na/ 'dzam bu'i 'khri shing gi ba dan khur du 'chang ba'i gling 'dir ma chog gi sprul sku'i rnam par byon nas ri dbang bya rgod kyi phung bo sogs su mdo phyogs dang / nub phyogs u rgyan gyi yul rnams su dam pa'i chos kyi snying bo zab gsang sngags kyi chos 'khor legs par bskor bas 'jig rten mtha' dag ngo mtshar ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi khyab pas legs tshogs dge mtshan gyi chu bo g.yas su 'khyil ba la lhar bcas 'gro ba ma lus pas ci dgar longs spyod pa'i skal ba bzang bo mngon du gyur/

284 de nas 'od srungs chen po sogs 'phags pa dgra bcom pa chos kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyis theg pa thun mong ba'i bka' rim pa gsum bsdu bar mdzad cing / byams pa sogs sa bcu'i srema.oṃdapa' chen po rnams kyis theg pa chen po'i bka' rnams bsdus pa dang / khyad par du/ mthu stobs nus pa'i mnga' bdag dpal phyag na rdo rjes gsang sngags rgyud sde rin po che'i bka' bsdu ba yang dag par mdzad pas bstan pa rin chen 'jig rten na yun ring du gsal ba'i bka' drin legs par bskyangs shing / de nas 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang / rgyal bo ind+ra zu ti/ grub chen sa ra ha/ dpal ldan sha wa ri ba sogs grub chen brgyad cu rnams kyis mkhas ba'i bya ba 'chad rtsod tsom gsum gyi legs mdzad bla na med pas thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan dgung du 'degs par mdzad/bye brag tu/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir dam pa'i chos dar ba'i lo rgyus kyi dbang du byas na/ mdo las/ nga'i bstan pa'i tha ma la byang phyogs kha ba can gyi yul srin po gdong dmar gyi rgyal khams sku gnyis dang byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul byar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'dir/ thog ma'i dus su/stod du glang bo che dang ri dwags/ bar du spre'u dang srin mo/ smad du bya dang srin po'i tshogs kyis bkang nas yod pa la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam sprul spre'u byang chub sems dpa' dang / rje btsun sgrol ma'i sprul ba brag srin mo gnyis 'dus pa las mi'i 'gro ba 'phel te phyogs

28zidang mtshams su mi'i grong khyer chen po chags ste rgyal bo gnya' khri btsan po la sogs pa'i gnam bskos gong ma rim byon gyi ring la ya rabs kyi srol bzang gong 'phel du mdzad pas 'gro ba rnams dam pa'i chos kyi snod rung du byas/ sangs rgyas kun tu bzang bo'i rnam sprul chos kyi rgyal bo lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi ring la dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes/ gru 'dzin zhing gi mgon po 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i ring la dam pa'i chos kyi srol btod/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul ba rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi ring la dam pa'i chos rgyas par mdzad pa'i slad du/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i paṇḍi ta mtha' dag gi nang na rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar mngon par mtho ba dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho spyan drangs te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gangs dkar kyi ri la nyi ma shar ba ltar gsal bar mdzad pa la nye ba na/ bod kyi lha srin rnams khros te dmar bo ri la thog 'phen pa/ mi nad dang phyugs nad gtong ba sogs ltas ngan pa sna tshogs byung ba na/ ji skad du/ mthu stobs nus pa'i rtse brgya gdengs tsam gyis/ /nag phyogs lha min ming gi mthar byed cing / /grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba yongs kyi gtso/ /padma 'byung gnas bka' drin gzhal nus min/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ kha ba ri ba rnams kyis bka' drin dang bsngags pa brjod pa'i me tog gi phreng ba 'thor ba'i yul du gyur ba rgya bod kyi grub pa'i skyes po ma lus pa'i gtsug gi nor bu/ 'dzam bu gling gi rigs sngags 'chang ba mtha' dag gi gtsa bo/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul la dbang 'byor ba'i slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas spyan 'dren pa'i

286slad du/ blon po gnyis g.yog dang bcas pa rdzong brda bgyis pa slob dpon gyis mkhyen nas mang yu la gung thang du byon pa dang mjal/ bod la phebs par gsol ba btab pas zhal gyis bzhes te rim bzhin phebs/brtan ma bcu gnyis/ gnyan chen thang lha/ yar lung sham po sogs lha srin gdug pa can rnams kyis cho 'phrul sna tshogs btang ba rdzu 'phrul gyis tshar bcad de dam la btags/ mkhan chen bo rnyi sa twa/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan te mkhan slob chos gsum gdan 'dzom pa'i sgo nas bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag sbra/ nga mang bo gsar du bzhengs pa dang / mkhan pos sad mi bdun sogs rab tu byung bar mdzad/ slob dpon chen pos rgyal bo nang mi dang bcas pa la/ rdo rje phur ba dang dpal rta mchog rol ba sogs kyi dbang dang /rgyud sde zab mo'i man ngag rdzogs par gnang bas chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis dpal rta mgrin grub ste bod yul 'gengs ba'i rta skad lan gsum du bsgrags pa dang / gzhan yang / 'bre dpal gyi blo gros/ sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ gnub nam mkha'i snying bo/ bai ro tsā na sogs du mas grub pa brnyes te nam mkha' la 'phur ba/ ri brag la 'dzul ba/ lus kyi lha'i dkyil 'khor skye bo mang bo la ston pa sogs grub pa'i rdzu 'phrul mang du bstan/ slob dpon bi ma la mi dra sogs kyi bka' drin las theg pa rim dgu'i yang rtse rna na ngag rdzogs pa chen po zhes grags pa/ zab mo'i phyogs shas che ba man ngag gi sde/ zab gsal gnyis ka cha mnyam pa rlung sde sogs rim par dar bas gnyis med a ti yo ga'i lugs srol 'di nyid gangs can

287gyi ljongs su nyi ma las kyang ches cher gsal bar gyur/ de nas cung zad nyams par phyogs pa na gnub ston sangs rgyas ye shes zhes bya ba'i grub pa'i khyu mchog de nyisbyisne byon nas lo brgya dang bcu gsum gyi bar du bzhugs nas rgya gar dang bal bo'i yul gyi rma khas pa mang bo bsten te mdo sngags kyi gzhung la thos pa mtha' chod par mdzad cing / bshad sgru ba zung gi sgo nas gsang sngags kyi bstan pa rin chen dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ dus phyis su klong chen bka' gter/ o rgyan smin grol gling ba rig 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje sogs so so'i rgyud 'dzin gyi mkhas grub nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu bgrang las 'das pa byon pas snga 'gyur bstan pa'i ru mtshon stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang drug rnams su g.yo ba med par bsgrongs/ khyad par du/ khu byug gis brgyan ljon shing ra ba dang / /khang phran bye bas bskor ba'i grong khyer dbus / /nor bu'i ba gam bzhad pa'i gzhal med khang / /gser g.yu'i rgya phibs 'bar bas ci yang mdzes/ /zhes bsngags pa ltar skabs gsum skyed tshal sa la 'phos pa lta bu'i nor 'dzin gyi gzhi la / grong dang grong khyer gyi tshom bu mu tig gi dog pa ltar bkra ba/ gtsug lag khang dang chos kyi sde mang bos phyogs kun mdzes pa/ yul mi rnams rang bzhin gyis yid drangs shing rnam ri dkar gyi chos la dad pa/ dpa' 'dzangs brtul phod kyi snying stobs che zhing srid 'byor mnga' thang gi chu bo g.yas su 'khyil ba sogs dge mtshan gyi ri mo rnam par bkra ba'i yul gru chen po gser mo ljongs kyis mtshon pa'i mdo smad sa'i thig le yangs por rang cag rnams la phyogs dus rgyal ba zhi

288 rmekhro rnams las kyang bka' drin lhag par che ba/ mkhas pa dang grub pa'i rtags mtshan mngon du gyur ba'i yon tan gyi bang mdzod 'dzin pa/ theg pa rim dgu'i yang rtse gnyis med a ti yo ka'i chos tshul gyi lam bzang gsal bar byed pa la thugs bskyed kyi mthu phul du son pa 'dren mchog dze dpal chen 'jigs med nam mkha' bzang bo zhes mtshan snyan gyi rnga bo srid pa gsum gyi bla na ldir ba de nyid sku phreng rim byon gyis dkyus bshad gzhung gi chu bo 'grel ṭīka stong thun dang bcas pa/ snyan brgyud gdams ngag gi chu bo gnad yig dam/ ra khrid dang bcas pa/ byin rlabs dbang gi chu bo bskur thabs ngo sprod dang bcas pa/ phyag bzhes 'phrin las kyi chu bo bstan srung drag sngags dang bcas pa ste bka'i chu bo chen po bzhi 'dus kyi lugs srol khyab brdal du spel bar mdzad cing / da dung mdzad 'phrin gyi 'jug pa rgyun mi chad stabs/ slar yang rigs rus cho 'brang phun sum tshogs pa/ ngo mtshar mdo rgyud kyi gzhung la mkhyen rab rgyas shing / ting 'dzin rdzu 'phrul gyi dpal la mnga' dbang 'byor ba/ gsang chen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag grub mchog sna tshogs rang grol sogs sku bltams pa'i sde ya rab kyi srol bzang ma nyams gong 'phel du yod pa dgu rong du 'bod pa'i yul grong du ngo mtshar ba'i ltas phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas mchog sprul zla tshes gsar ba'i lang tsho bsngags par 'os pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs rnams lhan skyes su mnga' ba bdag cag lha mir bcas pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gi mig gi bdud rtsir bltams pa/ chu nang gi padmo bzhin sku dang yon tan gyi myu gu nyin re bzhin bskyed drag par gyur ba'i skabs lags pa/ de

— —— 289 —ring gnam la gza' skar dang sa la 'phrod sbyor phun su ma tshogs pa/ bkrashis pa'i dge mtshan ma lus pa mngon du gyur ba'i nyin 'dir/ lugasaganyis la mkhyen dpyod nam mkha' ltar yangs pa a mgron mchog sprul rin po che dang / mi brgyud kyi rtsa ba brtan cing / stobs 'byor gyi yal ka yangs shing / mi chos kyi gtam la mkhas pa sogs kyis phyogs 'dir mngon par mtho ba spyang lung dpon po 'bangs mi dang bcas sku bdag sku rtsa/reb gong stod smad kyi bu slob gos dkar lcang lo'i rgyan phreng rnam par g.yam̐ ba'i sngags 'chang rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis rta bsus/ mchod bsus kyi bkod pa lha dang dri za'i 'jig rten gyi ngo mtshar la co 'dri ba lta bu dang bcas spyan drangs/ yab rje gong ma rim byon gyi gdan sa khyad par can gyi gtsug lag khang gi chos kyi gdan khri la nye bar bkod de 'gro ba mtha' dag rnam par dge ba'i mgon dang bcas pa'i dga' ston du/ legs 'bul gyi dngos po gya nom pa/ maṇḍal gyi bshad pa tshig bkra legs pa/ nged cag rtsa 'jing rnams la bzang gos kyi gyon pa sogs rtso/ babs dang bstun pa'i dngos po spam mtho ba dang bcas gang thad nas legs lam che nges byung /slad mar yang / sku bdag sku rtsa dang / bu slob sbyin bdag dang bcas pas 'dun pa chig dril gyis mchog sprul gzhon nu 'di nyid kyi zhabs zung dge legs rtsibs stong rnam par bkra ba'i re kha gzhar yang mi g.yo ba dang / sku yon gsan sbyong gi rigs rnams yar tshes kyi zla ba'i 'phel kha/ bzhin nyin rer yang yar rgyas su 'gyur ba dang / 'phrin las snang ba'i mu 'khyud ris med gdul bya yongs kyi phan bde'i padmo'i rtsa lag dam par

290 — — 'gog med mkha' khyab tu rgyas pa'i thabs la 'bad pa cis kyang zhu zhu zhu zhes gal bo che la nan tan/ dam pa'i chos la brgya tshar gyi dpe ltar mgrin pa gzengs su btegs nas brjod pa lags/ /'o lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gi zhing sa/ bslab gsum yon tan gyi rgyan phreng legs par 'chang ba'i 'phags tshogs/ 'dus sde 'di nyid kyi dge 'dun chos khrims gser gyi cod pan gtsug tu 'dzin pa ma lus pa'i snyan drung du gang zhu na// de yang khams gsum rnam 'dren yongs kyi gtso bo kun mkhyen shākya don kun grub pa de nyid kyi mdzad chen mi 'dra ba'i sgo mo bye ba grangs kyis mi chod pa yod pa las/ mu stegs cham la phab pa'i cho 'phrul gyi mdzad pa bzang bo'i dus ston/ lha mchod mi mchod smon lam chen mo yongs su grags pa de nyid deng dus kyi lo khyud 'di nyid kyi ring la'ang legs par tshugs te nyin zhag nyi shu lhag dang bcas pa'i ring la mgo rgan pa 'dul khrims kyi srog shing 'dzin pa rnams nas bathung /mjug ban gsar 'du khang gi sgo la zhugs pa yan chad kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi 'dul ba/ dge 'dun gyi nang khrims/ bca' yig gi dgongs don/dge bskos kyi tshogs gtam khyad du ma bsad par tshogs la phebs lugs/'don pa gsung tshul/ gral du bzhugs lugs/ phyi nang nas rgyu tshul gang thad nas tshul mthun ma dzad pa bka' drin che zhu ba las 'os ci yod/ kho bo cag nas kyang sku phyogs rdo je 'chang gi bka' lung rtsis/ lung khog 'di dang dgon pa 'di ga'i chos srid kyi la rgya bsam nas/ nang nas mjal na dad pa skye ba/ phyi nas nyan na yi rangs 'byung ba/ dgon pa dang ku ba

ldozer ba 'di grong ba dang khyad med du ma song ba/ sngon gyi phyag srol bzang bo 'dra ba re e 'byung bsam nas/ mthon po'i ngo ma 'tshos/ dma' mo'i gnya' ma bskyangs par/ kha nas lha phog klu phog lag nas mgo brdungs mjug brdungs byas pa yin/ de min ngo chen gyi ngo 'tsho/ shed can gyi dpung 'tsho/ kha mi lta grogs mi byed pa tsho la ngan zur ci phog byed/ ngo med shed med sa/nyom chung gi skor la sdug las ci thong byed snyam pa yid kyi dgu la'ang nam yang dran pa med/ de ltar yin min kun gzigs ye shes kyi spyan ldan bla ma dang chos skyong dpang du bzhugs yod pa red/ 'on kyang nor ba rgyal bo la yang 'byung / 'khrul ba mkhas pa la'ang srid zer tsa na/bdag gti mug gi mun pa thib pa/ zhe sdang gi me stag 'bar ba zhig yin stabs/ ma drangs pa'i yo che ba/ ma shes pa'i skyon che ba/ don med la lag rdung byas pa/ dgos med la gtam ngan btang ba/ yar gyi lha la bgom pa/ mar gyi klu la mnol ba yod na/ bzod pa'i rang bzhin can yin pas bdag la nyes par mi brtsi bar bzod par bzhes dgos pa yin/da phan chad kyang mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ gtsug lag khang dang kun dgar brtson/ /chos kyi spyod yul dga' med cing / /bud med chang la chags pa'i blo/ /de lta bu ni rab byung min/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/nag chang rkus gsum byed ma/khan rab byung min par gsungs pa ltar/ de 'dra'i mthong thos dogs gsum gyi rigs gang na yod kyang sadug pa med pa smos ci dgos/ yar 'then la bong chad gyen la gtad pa bzhin du bla mas kyang bsgul mi thub/ mar 'then la chu sna thur du rgyug pa bzhin du bkag

292kyang mi khog pa/ mi byed dgu byed mi dran dgu dran byed pa rnams nas kyang gzab na bzang / bla ma rdo rje 'chang dang las sna so so'i bka' chad phog tshe/ chung na ngo tsha ru myong / che na dpag tshad rgyang grags byed kyang / rtsa rkyasbru gis gdung khyog pa/ mdzub mo res gnam 'degs pa gang nas yong /grwa bgres rnams nas phyag dang skor ba/ maṇḍal mchod pa/ kha bton dge spyor mdzad pa dang / bar shar pa rnams nas kyang sgra snyan ngag rtsis sa ris/ dag yig sum rtags/ lam rim blo sbyong rang rang gi gang 'dod re khrid pa dang / ban phrug chung chung so so nas kyang 'don cha 'dzin rgyu/ yi ge 'bri rgyu sogs yon tan rin chen la 'bad 'bad re byed rgyu sku mkhyen gsung mkhyen/ tshad ldan gyi bla ma mjal/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob/ dgon pa la rab byung byas pa la don re yod pa bka' drin skyong / zhes nga zhu ba po zhu mi mkhas kyang / khyed gsan pa po rnams gsan mkhas pa'i sgo nas gang zhus snyan rgyab kyi bser bu mi mdzad par ci zhus phyag len la 'dibs pa mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhu lags// //

293 seng ge gathong nas chos bka'i mjug tu bshad byar stsal ba/ oṃ bde legs su gyur cig /dpal ldan nyin byed bye ba'i 'od zer gyi/ /mdangs kyis 'khyud pa padma ra ga yi/ /ri dbang sna tshogs gar gyis rol ba'i dpes/ /dpag bya bcom ldan dbang mos dge legs stsol/ /ces srid zhi'i dge le gas kyi sgo 'phar yangs por grol ba'i rten 'byung rmad du byung ba'i bden tshig gi 'od ris phyogs su spros pa'i sgo nas/dpal ldan thub pa mtha' dag gi gdung 'tshob chen po/ rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying bo'i rang lugs kyi bdag po/ dben sa bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa'i srog shing tshugucig pu/ rnam 'dren skal ldan ras pa'i chos brgyud kyi yu ba/ bdag cag rnams kyi me tog phog pa'i lha skal/ /skyabs gcig dus kyi ston pa rdo rje chen po gang gi zhabs stegs srid zhi'i dregs pa can mtha' dag gis dbang med du 'dud pa/ 'dod dgu'i dngos grub ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas gang gi nye drung ga la bar/ skabs su 'os pa'i gtam tshogs mu tig gi zeng ba spel ba sdebs legs tshig gi shing rtas rnam par 'dren pa la cir yang brel ba ni/ skyabs gcig 'jam pa'i rdo rje nyid ni bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i snga rol nas sa bcu'i rim pa yongs su rdzogs te stobs

294 — — bcu'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad zin na'ang / mtha' klas pa/'i gdul bya gar dmigs su sku'i 'phrul ba dpag tu med pa bstan pa ni chu zla'i grangs bzhin gzhal du ma mchis shing lho phyogs 'dzam bu'i cod pan gyi rtse mo mkha' la reg pa'i gling mchog 'di nyid du yang spyan dang mngon shes kyi gsang ba mkha' dang mnyam pa rgyal sras blo gros rin chen zung 'jug lhan skyes kyi phyag chen rjen par mjal ba grub chen sha wa ri ba/ mthu nus gnam lcags kyi 'khor los nag phyogs phye mar 'thag pa rwa lo rdo rje grags pa/ dusacimathar mthu stobs kyi dbang myug 'gran zla bral ba grub dbang 'jigs med bsam gtanasogs 'khrungs rabs mi thi li'i phreng ba mtshar du dngar zhing / khyad par du gser ljongs yul gyi paṇa chen mi pham zla bas/ blo bzang rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /mkhyen rab thogs med nam mkha'i sgo phye nas/ /'dzam gling chos kyi nyi ma khyod shar bas/ /phyogs kun dge legs 'od kyis lham mer mdzes/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par sku tshe 'di la gzhon nu nas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi byin rlabs kyi 'od zer ci dgar reg pas mkhyen rab kyi pad mo rtsol med du rgyas pa'i steng /ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa de bzhin gshegs pa rab gsal rgyal bo'i rnam 'phrul zhwa dmar brnyi ta dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ rigs gsum zlos pa'i ya gyal de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer kun 'phags dpal brtsegs rgyal bo'i rnam sprul khri chen rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi mes po rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabasapa/ rgya chen gnas lnga gzigs pa'i paṇḍi ta blo bzang
