—— ba ༷/sprirdo/)//bye/dpal ba sogs mkhas grub gnyis 'dzoms kyi skyeri ga bu 'dzasnag gling duno durirmo ḍa / grags che ba du malde zhabs sen zur phud kyi rgyan du 'bral med du mchod de / bstan pa'i gzhung shing sde snod rnam gsum/ bsta na pa'i snying bo rgyud sde rnam bzhi/ bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan thun mong rig gnas sogs cha lag phra mo tshun chad nas lus pa med par gsan sbyangs rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol du son pa mdzad cing / smin byed dbang gi chu bo/ grol byed khrid kyi lde mig rgyab rten lung gi dpung tshogs/ gser zhun cod pan 'chang ba'i rang lugs kyi bgrod pa dag la med mi rung gi choru/ skor rnams sa/zhan dang bsred bslad dang lhag lus med par brtson pa chen pos yang dag par bzhes/ bka' babs tshad ma kun ldan/ snyan brgyud gser gyi yang zhun/ man ngag bdud rtsi'i yang snying dag ni thugs la bum pa gang byo'i tshul du bzhes pas dri ma med pa'i rang lugs kyi bstan pa mtha' dag rgya mtsho chen po sa la bskyil ba bzhin du 'tsho gzhes pa dang / 'phral gyi kun spyod phra mo nas kyang choru/ 'dul ba'i lag len dang bstun pa phyi gtsang nang gtsang padmo'i chun po bzhin du gyur pa dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i pha srol gra ma nyams par mdzad ngos bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi nyams bzhes thun drug thun bzhir chu bo'i rgyun ltar bskyangs/ rtogs pa mi zad pa nam mkha'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag du phyes/ mkhas pa la 'os pa 'chad rtsod rtsom gsu ma/ dam pa la 'os pa 'phrin las rnam gsu ma 'gog pa med pa sa chen po'i yo tha' dbus ma lus pa la khyab brdal du 'jug rngapre na/ ris su ma bcos pa'i phyogs kun dge legs 'od kyis lham mer mdzes shing gsal ba

296 — 'di bzhin lags la/ de lta bu'i skabs nyid na bdag cag rgan gzhon thams cad kyis dad 'dun rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas bgrang bya lo grangs du ma'i snga rol nas yang dang yang du// ji skad du/ nyes pa'i tshogs kun spangs la skyabs su mchi/ /bdag cag lus dang longs spyo da thams cad kyis/ /bde bar gshegs la bla med mchod par bgyid/ /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag 'dir ni dgongs par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ gsol 'debs dbyangs kyi rol mo cir yang bsgrags pa la brtse ba chen pos zhal gyis bzhes/ dgra bcom 'khor gyi tshogs kyis mdun du bdar྾ mo ྾lding zhing gshegs/ /zhes pa dang tshul mthun par 'khor slob dag pa mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa sha stag gis mdun bdar te dgon sde 'di nyid kyi gtsug lag khang du phyag phebs/ thun drug thun bzhi'i thugs dam bsam brjod las 'das pa gnang ste yul gru khor yug dang bcas pa rdzogs ldan dpyid kyi sa gzhi lta bur byin gyis brlabs/ skya ser thams cad kyi blo kha chos dang snod kha g.yang du bsgyur nas snod bcud ma lus pa bkra shis phun su ma tshogs pa'i dpal la ci yang bkod/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal bo yongs 'dzin pazlo ta chen po nas mchog dman bar ma'i gdul bya rang rang gi skal ba dang mos par 'tsham pa'i mdo sngags rig gnas kyi legs bshad rmad du byung ba'i sgra dbyangs mthon por bsgrags pas nag po'i phyogs ma lus pa'i spa bkong / dkar po'i phyogs ma lus pa'i dbu bstod/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sgo gtan/ mtho ris dang thar ba'i sgo phye ste gser ljongs yul la legs byas bskal ba'i mthar yang mi nub pa'i bka' drin stsal/ e ma

297mkhas grub yongs kyi cod pan dag /'grogs pa'i zhabs mthil nor bu'i me long 'di/ /gang gi spyi bos phyis pa thams cad kyang / /shes bya'i gnas kun sa ler mthong bar nges/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don las dad pa dang 'dun pas mtshams sbyar te mos pa'i zab chos stsol bar gsol ba btab pa na/ dpal ldan dus kyi ston pa chen po nyid skyabs mgon skal ldan ras pa'i chos kyi gdung 'tshob du thugs bskyed dpung ba brtan po'i shed mong btsan pos nye bar bzhengs te/ dbang chen rtogs pa'i sgo 'byed/ smin khrid rtogs pa'i srog shing / bklag lung rtogs pa'i rgyab rten gyi tshogs zab la rgya che ba/ gtsa nga la ngos dag pa/ dka' zhing don che ba/ mang zhing mnog che ba dang / gtso bo pha ma'i rgyud kyi gtso bo rnam gnyis kyi 'grel ba dang bcas pa'i bshad pa rim par stsol ba'i sgo nas re skong sa/ser mo ljongs zhes yongs su grags pa gang gi dga' ba'i tshal ma lus ba bshad sgru ba 'phrin las kyi dar dkar yug gcig gis khyab pa'i sgo 'phar yangs por grol ba la legs byas kyi rten 'byung rgya cher mtshon phyir/ mo ྾ ྾ji skad du/ kun mkhyen dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i gser zhal las/ lus can phan bde'i gnyen gcig rgyal ba'i bstan/ /gnas pa bshad sgrub kho na'i rjes 'gro bas/ /bstan 'dzin lha brgya'i zur phud mdzes rgyan du/ /skyabs mgon skabs gsum dbang bo zhabs brtan mdzod/ /ces bka' bstsa la ba ltar/ lus can skye rgu mtha' dag gi phan bde ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gzhi rten gcig pu rgyal bstan rin chen mi nub par ci yang dar ba ni kun mkhyen bla ma chen po nyid lta bu'i bshad sgrub kyi

/de 2tram̐ljo— da dgemadzad pa bzang bor kho na'i rjes/ su 'gro ba'i phyir na/ bstan 'gror sman pa'i che rgu mtha' yas pa'i zur phud kyi gdengs ka rnam par mdzes pa'i rgyan gcig skyabs mgon mchog gi zhabs zung mi 'gyur rtag brtan g.yung drung rin po che'i khongs su lhun chags shing / 'khrul bral rgyal ba gnyis pa'i ring lugs 'di nyid shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i lbu ba mkha' la bres shing / nub phyogs sna lnga'i me tog sa la bkram pa'i bar du spel ba'i thugs bskyed dang 'phrin las dgung du reg pa dang / 'dus sde spyi dang bye brag dga' ldan phun tshogs gling 'di nyid du chos srid kyi me long mtha' dag rdzogs ldan gyi dus bzhin rgyas shing / sdom gsum dag pa'i btsun pa/ rig gnas smra ba'i mkhas pa/ bslab gsum sgrub pa'i rtogs ldan/ bstan 'gror sman pa'i skyes chen rgyun chags su phebs pa dang / dgon 'di'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag seng ge gshong sde yar mar gyis mtshon pa'i yangs pa'i 'jig rten kun du dge legs bde skyid kyi phang bo zad mi ce/sa shing dbyar dzwas kyi ri gi 'a dbasgo chu gter bzhin du 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang /'dod don gyi snying bo dril na/ ji skad du/ mdor na skyabs rje zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan/ /gzhan phan 'phrin las snang bas sa gsum khyab/ /lung rtogs pad tshal mtha' dbus kun du 'phel/ /'akro rnams rab sgruga'i gar gyis rtsen par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar gyi tsho dgongs pa ḍū na mdzad pa mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhes zhu ba lags/mo ྾ ྾rgyan du gyur pa 'di bzhin 'am gzhes pa ni bstan 'gro spyi dang bye brag bcas la bla na med pa'i bka' drin gyi gnas mchog du gyurapa

— wa 299 lags la/ yang sgos nged cag la bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thugs dgongs dang bka' drin tshul bzhin bskyangs pa'i dbang du byas na/ gong sa skyabs mgon sprul sku rin po che 'di nyid kyi thog mtha' bar gsum gyi bya ba che phra gang yod/ lung las kyis mtho ba'i mi chen/ mtshan snyan gyis 'ur ba'i bla chen gang la yang blo ma gtad/ stobs 'byor gyis dregs pa'i spyin bdagarang 'dod kyis 'brid pa'i gnyen rigs su la'ang gros ma bstun par7dus gsum rjen par gzigs pa'i kun rna khyen bla ma chen po nyid la blo snying brang gsum gtad de gsol ba phur tshugs su zhus pa na/ skyabs rje rdo rje 'chang nyid nas kyang gang smras dgongs pa'i ma thil du bsnams te/ rab tshes chu phag gi lo la thog mar brtsad gcod tshul/ btsal dus dang btsal ba'i yul phyogs sogs kyi skor la gsung bkod pha mes kyis bu la 'bogs pa bzhin du mdzad/ snga phyir 'khrul med nges 'drongs kyi brtag pa ji snyed phyag du bstar te/ rab tshes shing byi'i lo la rtse gzhung dga' ba 'khyil ba nas dri ma med pa'i rgyu mtshan thams cad gsang rgyar grol te sa/sung nas mchog sprul yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po 'di nyid nged cag spyi ba'i dpal du byin te/ thun mong spyi khyab la paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen par 'khrul med thag gcod kyi bka' lung gnang du bcug na don 'di bzhin 'grub nges dang 'phral phugs su legs pa'i bkod 'doms thams cad sba gsang med par thugs dgongs bskyangs pa dang / shing glang lor kha dar 'bul rgyu/sta ga lor gdan sar bkod de khri ston zhu rgyu/ sku bcar yongs 'dzin gyi bsko bzhag rab byung bcu drug pa'i thog mar khri chen rdo rje 'chang gdan

300 drangs te rab byung bzhes nas bka' chos kyi rigs gang zhu dang go rim tshun chad la gsung bkod thams cad sba gsang med par bka' drin du bskyangs/khyad par du glang lo la bdag cag gi sku dbon dam pa lugs gnyisakyi mnga' thang gis dregs ldan zil gyis gnon pa de nyid kwa ring dugyisku dngos kyi mdun du mjal te7gong sa mchog sprul sku dbon gnyis dang bcas pa kun mkhyen nyid miphyag tu phul te sku tshe mdzad 'phrin gyi rigs mtha' dag khong nyid la gtad/ sku don 'gangs che ba kun la sa/sung bkod mthil phyin pa gnang na 'byon bzhud phra mo tshun chad nas gsung bkod las cung zad kyang mi 'da' bar sgrub nges kyi dam bca' 'gyur med phul/ sa sbrul lo la 'di ka nas kyang lan gcig ma yin par yang yang gdan 'dren nan chen zhus sar྾ ྾ mokun mkhyen྾ mo momadzad de zhal bzhes yang dag par mdzad/ slar yang skyabs mgon mchog sku 'khor grwa rigs sbyin bdag dang bcas pas/ ji skad du/ nyes pa'i tshogs kun spangs la skyabs su ma chi/bdag lus dang longs spyod thams cad kyis/ /bde bar gshegs la bla med mchod par bgyid/ /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag 'dir ni dgongs par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ gsol 'debs kyi rol mo cir yang bsgrags pa la brtse ba chen pos nye bar dgongs te/ dgra bcom 'khor gyi tshogs kyis mdun du bdar྾ ྾ ྾lding zhing gshegs/ zhes pa'i ngang tshul ji bzhin par 'khor slob dag pa mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa dang bcas phyogs 'dir phyag phebs/ dmar khrid bde lam chen mo'i nyams khridatrekyis rma tshon pa'i myong khrid/ bde gsang 'jigs

301gsum dang dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen gyis mtshon pa'i dbang bka'/'jam dbyangs chos skor dang snar snang brgya rtsas mtshon pa'i spyi zur gyi rjes gnang / mdo sngags kyi lam rim chen mo gnyis kyi bshad sra'i mtshon pa'i bshad lung / bka' pod chen po lnga dang / bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi rgyud kyi lung gi mtshon pa'i bklag lung / dben sa bka' brgyud kyi man ngag gis mtshon pa'i snyan brgyud zhal shes/ mdo phyogs dang sngags phyogs kyi bo tis mtshon pa'i nyer mkho'i chos spyod/ rdzas sngags srung ba'i rigs kyi las sna tshogs sogs zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor zhing / slad mar྾ mo ྾mdo sngags rig gnasamo mo ྾mdor na skyabs mgon bdun pa chen po rdo rje 'chang blo bzang 'phrin las bstan pa rgya mtsho dpal bzang po ji lta ba bzhin dge ldan bstan pa'imo mo momanga' bdag྾ mo ྾mkhyen mkhyen zhes gsol ba phur tshugs su 'debs pa dang ྾ ྾ ྾sku 'tsho brtan pa dang sgo gsum gyi bya ba phra mo yan chad skyabs mgon mchog gi mdzad 'phrin rgyas pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig tu 'gro zhing tshul de la brten nas rang gi 'di phyi'i legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba brtan por tshugs pa dang // mo mo mochos sde chen po/ mo mo ྾longs 'dzin dam pa/ sku dbon 'jam dbyangs bsod nams/ dge legs rgya mtsho/ myi rtsa tshe thar gla med a chi thi butta/ nang chen gnyer ba/ su ru gong 'gab kyi 'ge ba sogs kyis gabo byas pa'i zhabs zhu thams cadamo mo mobaslab gsum rim gnyis kyi yon tan rgyan tu 'phyor ba'i 'phags tshogs 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i mdun sar gus pas zhu bar bya ba ni/ de yang

3spu2 — rang cag gi ston pa bla na med pa/ rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying bo de nyid kyis sngon rgyal ba dbang bo'i tog gi spyan sngar thugs bskyed pa ltar zhing 'dir byon/ mdo sngags kyi gsung rab mtha' dag gdams par shar ba/lta sgom spyod gsum khyad par phul du phyin pa/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan rmad du byung ba/ dam pa'i rnam thar gyi sdom gsum rnam par dag pa/ mkhas pa'i rnam thar gyi 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum bzang ba/ grub pa'i rnam thar gyi nyams rtogs gdeng tshad thob pa/ bshad sgrub zung 'jug gi nyams len tshad du 'khyol ba/ mdo sngags zung 'jug gi lam bzang mngon du gyur ba/ thabs shes zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor legs par 'byongs pa/gzhan don 'phrin las kyi bya ba shugs 'byung du rgyas pa/ bstan don gong 'phel gyi phyag rjes mngon du gyurngo ba'i bka' srol bla na med pa'i bstan pa'i srol sngar med gsar du btod sgos pa sor chud par mdzad de yongs su rdzogs pa'i bstan pas sa steng khyab par mdzad/ khyod nyid byis pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyur/ /zhes lung bstan pa ltar rnam pa so so'i skyes bo'i tshul bstan kyang / mdzad pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa gzugs can du bstan te gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus pa la/ dus tshigs khyad par can de la dge ldan lnga mchod/ zhes 'dzam gling la yongs su khyab pa'i dus mchod chen mo de tshugs/ rang re'i dgon 'dir yang de bzhin sngon nas tshugs pa ma nyams gong 'phel du yod pa 'di bzhin lags pas/ thams cad kyis dus khyad par can 'di la rje bla ma'i bka' drin rjes / su dran bzhin pa'i ngang nas/

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas pa/ sems can la bde skyid rgyas pa/ rang rang gi gtan 'dun 'grub phyir/ zhal 'don chos spyod/ lha mchod mi ma chod/ gling me gang rgyas so/gas la 'bad nas/ thugs smon skyabs 'jug yang dag re gnang ba mkhyen mkhyen zhu lags// //

304 rong bo bde chen chos 'khor gling gi cho 'phrul smon lam skabs kyi rten bshad/'o ma gyur nam mkha'imo mo mogasan bya dam pa'i chos ni/ gong sa skyabs mgon rim byon rnams kyis ched du bsgrigs pa'i rten sna tshom spungs ma sgrom gsum gyi nang na bzhugs pa 'di dag so so'i ngo sprod bsdus pa byed pa la gnyis/ 'dir tshogs thams cad kyis spyir bsod nams kyi nor dang khyad par dad gus kyi nor glesags dgos tshul/ de lta'i nor bsag pa'i thabs su 'dir bzhugs rten so so'i che ba brjod de ngo sprod pa'o//dang po ni/ ji skad du/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba dang / /dal dang mi lus thob pa dang / /dge goms rung ba 'di lta bu/ /dkon na nam zhig thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten 'dir byon te dam pa'i chos kyi sgron me sbar/ rang res dal bas mdzes pa'i mi lus kyi rten bzang bo thob/ bsod nams dge ba'i las la ji 'dod du goms su rung ba'i dus 'dir nges par 'di phyir phan pa'i bsod nams zhig bsag dgos/ slob dpon dpa' bos kyang / gang zhig dge bas phyug pa'i mi/ /bskal ba grangs med kyis thob nas/ /'dir ni rmongs

305bas bsod nams gter/ /cung zad tsam yang mi gsog pa/ /rin chen gling phyin 'tshong ba ni/ /lag pa stong bas rang khyim bzhin/ /ldes deng skabs rmongs ba sogs nyon mongs kyi gzhan dbang du gyur nas bsod nams kyi gter cung zad kyang mi gsog pa ni/ rin po che'i gling du song ba'i 'tshong ba lag stong la rang yul du yong ba ltar rang gis rang de las bslu tshul med par gsungs pa red/ 'jig rten nu bsag bya'i nor rgyu nor zas gsum la byed pa ltar/ chos bas bsag bya'i nor dad pa sogs kyi bsod nams la byed pa ni/ nor bu'i phreng ba las/ dad pa'i nor dang tshul khrims nor/ /gtong ba'i nor dang thos ba'i nor/ /khrel yod ngo tsha shes pa'i nor/ /shes rab nyid kyi nor bdun te/ /nor ni dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mi zad pa yi nor bdun te/ /zhes dang / rgyal sras bzang bo dpal gyis/ nam yang mi 'dzad gtan du bde ba'i thabs/ /dad dang tshul khrims gtong dang thos pa dang / /ngo tsha shes dang khrel yod shes rab ste/ /bde bar 'dod na nor bdun 'di dag zungs/ /zhes 'phags nor bdun gyi bsod nams bsag dgos par gdams pa ste spyir de ltar yin pa gzhir byas/ bye brag tu dad gus gad che ba ni/ chos bcu ba'i mdo las/ dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la/ /dkar po'i chos rnams mi skye ste/ /sa bon me yis 'tshigs pa la/ myu gu sngon po ji bzhin no/ /zhes sa bon mes 'tshigs pa la myu gu mi skye ba ltar/ dad med la dkar chos mi 'byung ba dang / dad pa'i sa bon bzang ba la dkar chos ngang gis 'byung bar bstan zhing / ser ges zhus

/tshi6 pa las/ dad pas mi khom spong par byed/ /ces mchog gsum la dad pas ngan 'gro sogs spangs nas rim gyis 'tshang rgya bar gsungs shing /rtog gsum las/ dad pa sangs rgyas dad pa che/ /dad pa dge 'dun dad pa ma/ /dad pa bla ma dad pa pha/ dad pa lam chen dad pa gru/ /dad pa yid bzhin nor bu ste/ /zhes dang / tshoms las/ dad dang ngo tsha tshul khrims sbyin pa ste/ /chos 'di rnams ni skyes bu dam pas bsngags/ /zhes dang / 'di na skyes bu'i nor mchog dad pa ste/ /'di na chos la legs spyodari bde ba thob/ /ces sogs mdo rgyud bstan bcos kun las dad pa la bsngags pa ches cher mdzad la/ lhag par mchog gsum dngos dang sku gsung thugs rten rnams kyi byin rlabs rang rgyud la 'jug pa dad gus la rag las pa yin te/ bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor bu ltar/ /byin rlabs rang sems gus las 'byung / /lha dang bla ma dkon mchog la/ /mos gus drag po gyis shig ang / /zhes dang / byin rlabs kyi sgrang char 'bab mi 'bab/ /yid mos gus kyi klu dbang de la rag /ces dang / po to bas/ bla ma byin rlabs che dang chudzob/ /dngos la ma yin rang la rag las/ /bla ma dag la gus pa med na/ /sangs rgyas nyid la brten yang mi phan/ /dper na legs pa'i skar ma ba zhin te/ /zhes byin rlabs che chung gang 'byung rang gi dad gus la thug pa dang / dad pa med na sangs rgyas dngos la mjal gyang byin rlabs mi 'byung ba legs pa'i skar ma dang lhas sbyin ltaspyabuthan par ba/sungs pa de red/

— — //ste/du////gnyis pa de lta'i nor bsags pa'i thabs su 'dir bzhugs rten so so'i che ba brjod de ngo sprod pa la yang / 'di dag la gus pa'i phan yon dang / dngos gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mdo sde pad dkar las/mchod rten de la gang gis thal mo sbyor/ /yongs su tshang ba'am thal mo ya gcig gam/ /yang na mgo po ya gcig 'dud pa dang / /de bzhin lan gcig lus kyang 'dud pa dang / /gang gi rang bsrel gnas pa de ga la/g.yeng ba'i sems kyis sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal zhes/ /tshig gcig lun 'ga' brjod par byas pa yang / /de dag kun gyis byang chub mchog 'di thob/ /ces dang / bde gshegs sa/zugs ni rtsig dngos bris pa la/ /'khrugs bzhin pa yi sems kyis bltas na yang / /de dag rim gyis sangs rgyas bye ba mthong / /zhes dang / snying rje padma dkar po'i mdo las/ kun dga' po tha na rmi lam na de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten mthong nas sems dang bar byed na kun dga' bo dge ba'i rtsa ba de'i 'bras bu mya ngan las 'das pa yin/ zhes dang / 'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs las/ bsam mi khyab la dad byas na/ /ṅgem par smin pa bsam mi khyab/ /ces 'di lta bu'i rten khyad par ba rnams la dad pas lta ba tsam la yang phan yon rgya che ba grangs med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod par gsungs/ da lta'i dus su 'di 'dra ba'i zhing khyad par can la mjal phyag mchod skor gled pa gal che ba yin te/ gangs ljongs tshad ma'i ston pa rnam 'dren bla ma tsong kha ba chen pos zhing dam pa la dge rtsa bskrun pa'i mthu las lam gyi rim pa rnams la blo'i mthu je rgyas su 'gro bas/ mnyan na tshig mi

308zin/ bsam na don mi go basboms na rgyud la mi skye pa'i blo'i mthu shin du chung ba'i dus su zhing gi mthu la brten pa man ngag yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na thams cad kyis ltad mo blta ba'i 'du shes dang / gzhan gyi g.yam la rgyugs pa lad mo dang / byis pas lha khang la lta ba bzhin kha yengs mig yengs la ma btang bar rten khyad par can 'di tsho la mjal rgyu mthong rgyu byung ba skal ba bzang ba dang rnyed dka' ba rnyed pa'i mchog tu shes nas dad gus dang bcas te mjal bar mdzod/gnyis pa dngos la/ rgyal bo khri srong lde btsan gyis/ zhib mor bsags pa las ni nor 'byung zhing / /nyin mtshan bsams pa las ni nor 'byung ste/ /ya rabs mdzangs ba las ni phyag ris 'byung / /zhes pa ltar/ rang cag gi me tog phog pa'i lha skal/ rong ston yab sras sku 'phreng rim byon rnams dang / gang gi chos rgyud 'dzin pa'i skyes chen na rim/ lha btsun nang so snga phyi rnams kyis bzhengs ba'i lha khang so so/rten brten pa bgrang las 'das pa mjal phyag gi zhing du bzhugs pa ni/da ltar mngon sum du yod pa 'di bzhin lags la/ de dag so so'i nang bzhugs byin rten gyi ngos 'dzin kyang dkar chag gdan rabs rnam thar sogs su ci rigs pa'i tshul gyis gsal bas blo gros dang don gnyer 'dzoms pa rnams kyis mkhyen par mdzad na legs/ /deng skabs smon lam chen mo'i dus su gdan drangs te rten mjal gtong rgyu 'di la'ang rang bsrel rnam bzhi tshang ba yin te/ chos sku dang sku gdung dang / yungs 'bru lta busri rang bsrel gsum ni/ sku dang thugs kyi rten 'di dag gi

309gathungs gzhug gi tshul du tshang la/ sku bal gyi rang bsrel na bza'i skor kha byang ltar rim gyis gsal bar 'gyur zhing de lta bu'i rang bsrel rnam pa bzhi mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro ba rnams mya ngan las 'das ba'i skal ba can du bsgrub pa'i phyir du7 skyabs mgon sku phreng rim byon thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba'i dbang gis sa gsum na rnyed dka' ba'i rten 'di rigs phyogs nas ljongs 'dir spyan drangs te rang cag gi bsod nams kyi zhing du bzhugs pa yin pas/ thog mar sku rten la sngon je thams cad mkhyen pa dgung lo nga bdun pa'i steng 'on gyi bkra shis do khar phebs skabs/ paṇa chen byams pa gling pas nyin gcig la rje sku bdun phyag batho mdzad/ rje rang gis nyin de la dbu skra bdun bsal nas sku de dag gi gzungs gzhug mdzad cing rab gnas gnang ba'i nang tshan gcig khri chen stag lung blo gros rgya mtshos chos ba rin po che la thugs dam gyi rten du stsal ba yin la dus bzang dang sger chos kyi skabs su dri bzang dang bdud rtsi 'byung ba sogs kyi ngo mtshar du ma grub chen chos ba rin po che'i rnam thar las gsungs pa ltar la /de lta'i ya mtshan gyi che ba dang ldan pa mi mang la da ltar shar gyi bkra shis do kha ma zhes grags che ba'i rje sku byin can de ni 'di yin pas thams cad kyis dad pa dang gus pa dang dga' ba dang rangs pa rnams phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du gyis la rten mjal legs par mdzod cig gong sa'i gzim khang shar ma sku phring bzhi ba'i dus me la shor skabs mes ma skyon pas rgya gar thub dbang me thub ma zhes grags pa 'di yin pas thams cad kyis྾mdzod cig /yang rgya gar thub pa 'gang chen skyubs mgon sku phreng drug paru rtse

310nas drangs pa skyabs mgon gong mas thugs gtsigs can de yin pas mo mo/ 7skyabs mgon sku phreng gnyis pas snye thang rten gras nas gdan drangayopa snye thang sgrol ma gsung byon ma yin pasamo/ gnyan ko'u yī'i 'khrugs pa'i dus sku 'bum me la btang tshe seng khri las chu rgyun byung ste me bsad pa sku 'bum 'jam dbyangs me thub ma zhes grags pa de yin pasamo/gyiskyabs mgon sku phreng gnyis pa'i thugs dam gyi rten khyad 'phags kye rdor gser sku chen mo yin pasamo/ /7gsung gi rten skyabs mgon sku phreng gnyis pa'i zhal 'don tshul khrims kyi dri ngad phyogs khyab ma yin pas ྾gyiyab rje skal ldan rgya mtshos ma ṇi bum sgrub mdzad skabs bum pa'i kha 'chings la gsal bar babs pa e waṃ rang byon ma zhes grags pa'i gos dar yin pasamo/ /gyithugs kyi rten skyabs ma kon sku phreng gnyis bas bka' gdams rten rnying gras nas drangs3pa khong gi thugs dam gyi rten bka' gdams mchod rten 'gang chen yin pasamo/ka rtags can 'di ni/ ji skad du sgrujam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /sa yi steng 'di stong ba na/ /khyod ni byis ba'i gzugs kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyur/ /zhes tshad ma'i lung gis bsngags pa/ 'jam dbyangs sgyu 'phrul gangs ljongs tshad ma'i ston pa 'jam mgon tsong kha pa chen pos rang gi bu chen ma khas grub blo bzang bya ba la nyid kyi rnam sbyar/ gsol lhung dra phad gsu ma gnang nas 'di phyogs su bstan pa spel ba'i bka' phebs pa de dus kyi rje rnam sbyar 'khrul med yin pas྾/ (kha/ rtags can 'di ni/ dpal ldan yon

311tan tshogs gnyis byed po yis/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la dbang bskur ba/ /rgyal ba gnyis ba'i rgyal— tshab chos kyi rje/ /mi pham bla ma gnyis pa rgyal gyur cig /ces bsngags pa 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis ba'i rgyal tshab smra ba'i seng ge dar ma rin chen gyi dbu zhwa yin pas྾/ (ga rtags can 'di ni/ lhun po'i drung na gser ri ji bzhin du/ /'gran zla med pa'i dge legs khyod la sbyin/ /zhes rje thams cad mkhyen pas rang gi sras po skar tshogs lta bu'i khrod nas zla med pa'i bsngags brjod dngos su mdzad pa nang thugs kyi sras po bstan pa'i nyi ma mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang po'i dbu zhwa yin pas྾/ (nga rtags can 'di ni/ spyod pa dag cing dbang bo dul ba dang / /chog shes ldan zhing snying rje yon tan gyis/ /'jig rten dag na skye bo ma 'dris pa'ang / /gzhan la de byams bzhin du de la byams/ /zhes pa ltar/ zhi dul tshangs par spyod pa theg pa mchog gi brtul zhugs la gnas ba'i sgo nas zla dang bral ba 'dul 'dzin chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sku chos red/ (ca rtags can 'di ni/ thub pa bzhin du 'jig rten gsal bar ston/ /skye dgu rnams kyi don spyod nyi ma bzhin/ / mnyam pa nyid du blo yi mun pa 'joms/ /de ni shes rab snying rje'i rang bzhin bas / /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi yon tan mthun sgang du'ang grub pa phyag na padmo bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sku chos red/ (cha rtags can mi// legs pa'i lam ston lha yi dbang po bzhin/ /rig pa'i gnas lugs rtogs shing ma thu che la/ /tshar gcod phan 'dogs bya ba'i las la mkhas/ /khyu ma/chog bzhin du de ni 'bangs rnams skyong / /zhes pa dang

312mthun pa'i rnam par thar ba mnga' pa kun gzigs lnga ba gong sa skyabs mgon blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sku gzan red/(ja rtags can 'di yang 'khor sgyur rgyal mchog lnga ba'i dbu zhwa red/ (nya rtags can 'di ni dza la sha snra las/ dga'atsho bzhi'i lhan skyes bde ba ches/ /stong bzhi'i ye shes rgyasalha'agyur te/ /chu bo rnam bzhi'i rgyun 'bab pas/ /rta gdong me chen 'bar bar gyur/ /ces pa lta bu'i rnam thar phyag len la thebs pa gsang 'dzin mi'i dbang bo tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i dbu zhwa red/ (ta rtags can 'di ni/ rig byed shes la de ni tshangs pa bzhin/ /rgyal bo rnams kyis bkur la rgyal bo bzhin/ /skye dgu rnams la brgya byin mngon sum bzhin/ /shes 'dod rnams la don spyod pha dang 'dra/ /zhes pa ltar mkhas pa/ bkur ba/ skye dgu skyong ba/ gdul bya 'dul ba'i yon tan bzhi la sa'i steng na zla med pa rgyal mchog skal bzang rgya mtsho'i dbu zhwa red/ (tha rtags can 'di yang rgyal mchog bdun pa'i sku 'gag red/ (da rtags can 'di yang rgyal mchog bdun pa'i zhabasu 'chag red/ (na rtags can 'di ni/ nor yang ster zhing tshul khrims spyad pa mnos/ /bzod pa bsten cing 'gro ba'i don yang spyod/ /'gro la phan sems mthong na zhi bar snang / /gzugs can chos bzhin de ni rnam par mdzes/ /zhes pa'i yon tan mngon du gyur ba rgyal dbang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i sku gzan red/ (pa rtags can 'di ni/ dri ma med pa dwangs pa'i rgya mtsho bzhin/ /yon tan rgyu skar dpal rgyus lam mer mdzes/ /skye bo kun don byed de btung chu bzhin/ /

— — — rje — ༷rmi1༷ phan byed yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas gyur/ /zhes pa dang mthun pa'i mdzad pa mnga' ba rgyal ba'i dbang po 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i sku 'gag red/(pha rtags can 'di ni/ bstan bcos rig byed gsang sngags pha rol phyin/ /mkhas pa'i bdag nyid mkhas pa bzhin du spyod/ /legs pa'i lam dang rjes su mthun pa ston/ /rang gi mthu yis bstan pa ring du skyong / /zhes pa ltar/ mkhas pa/ sgom pa/ ston pa/ skyong pa'i mdzad pa bzhi char la rje'i rang lugs 'dzin pa kun gyi dbus na lhun po bzhin du mtho ba paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi bzhugs gding red/(ba rtags 'di ni zla ba'i 'od zer dpal ni rab dkar bas/ /ku mu da yi dpal ni 'phel ba 'dra/ /de bas 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /yon tan dpal rnams dpal ldan de la mdzes/ zhes pa ltar gyi tshogs mdzes par gyur ba paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyi sku chos red/ (martags can 'di ni/ de ni sngon du sbyangs ba rgya chen dang / /yon tan tshogs kyis rab tu dpal 'bar zhing / /skye dgu'i tshogs kyis bkur ba'i rgyal po bzhin/ /lha rnams tshogs kyis bstod pa'i tshangs pa bzhin/ /zhes pa ltar gyi rnam thar gyi 'gangs che ba paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi sku chos red/ (tsa rtags can 'di yang paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi bzhugs gding red/ (tsha rtags can 'di ni/ blo gros snang ba rab rgyas shing / khartson 'grus stobs kyis 'od 'bar ba/ /mngon par shes pa gsal ba dang / /ye shes dkyil 'khor gsal ba yin/ /zhes pa ltar gyi mngon shes dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas ba paṇa chen bstan

༄14 pa'i nyi ma'i dbu zhwa red/ (dza rtags can 'di yang paṇa chen bstan nyi'e sku sham red/ (wa rtags can 'di ni nad kyi 'dam rdzab skem par byed pa dang / /bde dang lam dang mtho ris them skas dag /snang mdzad don chen sgron me gcig pur gyur/ /rmad byung gang de ye shes stobs kyi mthu/ /zhes pa ltar gyi ye shes chen po'i mthugadapag tu med pas mdzes ba sprul sku grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs 'chag red/ )9zha rtags can 'di/ 'gro blo'i mun pa sel byed nyi ma bzhin/ yang dag yul la gsal byed rgyas pa bzhin/ /yon tan tshogs kyi phreng ba brgyus pa bzhin/ /nyon mongs gdung ba bsil bar byed pa bzhin/ /zhes pa dang mthun pa'i rnam par thar ba dpag tu med pa ba so rje drung dkon mchog nyi ma jun waṃ gi dbu blar phebs skabs zhus ba'i sku 'gag red/ (za rtags can 'di ni/bskal ba rgya mtsho dpag tu med pa ru/ /thugs rje rgya mtsho rlabs kyis rab bskul nas/ /skyes rabs rgya mtsho'i phreng ba ston byed pa/ e ma ho 'gro ba'i yon gnas bla na med/ /zhes pa dang mthun pa'i gsang ba mchog gi bang mdzod rgyal sras blo bzang bstan 'dzin yul ljongs 'dir yab rje skal ldan rgya mtshos gdan drangs skabs gnang ba'i dbu zhwa red/ ('a rtags can 'di ni/ bsod nams rgya chen tshogs mnga' dran rtogs can/ /blo gros mtha' yas shes rab 'od mdzad cing / /mtshungs med stobs mnga' mthu rtsal rgya che ba/ /zhes pa ltar gyi legs mdzad mngon du byas pa rgyal sras skal bzang thub bstan gyi dbu zhwa red/ (ya rtags can 'di ni/bden med sgyu 'dra gzigs pa'i ye shes mnga'/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin dpal

— 315gyi 'byor ba can/ /nyin byed mkha' la mdzes pa'i tshul ji bzhin/ /thub bstan ma/dzes pa'i rgyan gyur 'di rmad byung / zhes pa ltar grub pa'i slob dpon chen po dpal 'byor rimyun grub kyi phyag dril red/ (ra rtags can 'di ni/ khyod kyi yi shes dkyil 'khor rgyas pa yis/ shes bya'i gnas rnams skad cig gcig la snang / /de bas rmad du byung ba khyod la ni/ /srid 'dir gus pa mi bskyed su zhig yod/ /ces pa dang mthun pa'i bdag nyid chen po chab mdo 'phags pa lha'i zhabs 'chag red/ (lartags can 'di ni/ tshul khrims sa/tsang spra dbang po dul ba dang / /dran pa mi nyams rab tu dben pa dang / /byams la sogs dang yid ni ting — 'dzin la/ /de ni slob ma rnams la ci nus ston/ /zhes pa ltar rang nyid drang srong gi spyod pas dben par gnas nas rjes su 'jug pa dag la bsam gtan dang mthun pa'i chos ston pa phur cog byams pa rin po che'i dbu zhwa red/ (sha rtags 'di can ni/ nags khrod zhi ba sman ljongs 'bab chur bcas/ /utpal 'dzum zhing padma rgod pa 'dra/ /ljon pa'i tshogs rnams phreng ba bkod pa 'dra/ /gnas der ting 'dzin mthu yis bsam gtan byed/ /ces pa ltar snyigs ma'i dus kyi drang srong bsam gtan pa chen po yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi dbu zhwa red/ (sartags can 'di ni/ nga dang nga yir kun du rtog pa'i yid/ /rnam par dag cing shes pa'i tshogs rnams ni/ /lta las grol zhing ji bzhin shes pa yis/ /sgyu 'drar rtogs pa'i ye shes de rtogs so/ /zhes pa dang mthun pa stong ba rtogs pa'i ye shes bde ba chen po'i klong las byams pa grub pa'i

(3))/(1) zhe ne la choci spre — — spre slob dpon khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldanacho gyi sku chos red/ (ha rtags can 'di ni/ de yis mngon sum rjes su dpag pa yis/ /yang dag yang dag min pa jis su rig /shes bya'i gnas la de yi shes rab mthu/ /nyin mor byed pas kun tu gsal byed bzhin/ /zhes pa ltar gyi mkhyen pa'i mthu rgyas pa khri ngag dbang snyan grags pa'i dbu zhwa red/ (a rtags can 'di ni/ byams pa'i bdag nyid gzhan la phan brtson pa/ /thos dang dran dang ting 'dzin rmad byung bas/ /zhes pa ltar gyi yon tan gyi dbang phyug bla na med pa khri chen ngag dbang chos 'phel gyi sku lhugs red/(ki rtags can 'di ni/ 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes dka' thub ldan/ /dka' thub nags tshal zhi bar gnas par brtson/ /sdug bsngal rnams kyis de lus dub pa med/ /rang bzhin yon tan bzang pos brgyan par gyur/ /zhes pa ltar gyi drang srong chen po'i yon tan ma lus ba lhun gyis grub pa grub chen chos ba rin po che blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi dbu zhwa red/ (khi rtags can 'di yang / tshe hril bo dka' thub bcud len mdzad/ /dus 'khor yug ting 'dzin ngang du bzhugs/ /zhes bsngags pa don ldan gyi grub chen chos pa rin po che'i bzhugs gding red/(gi rtags can 'di ni/ drang srong rnams la sgrub pa'i shing rta ba/ /chos 'dod dag la chos kyi rgya mtsho bzhi/na/ /'byung ba bzhin du skye dgu rnams la sman/ /de yi phyag rjes da dung nyams ma gyur/ /ces pa ltar/drang srong spong pa ba rnams kyi sgrub pa'i shing rta ba mo/ chos 'dod thos bsam pa rnams kyi chos kyi rgya mtsho gcig pu/ 'byung bzhi'i khams ltar

317'gro ba yongs kyi nyer 'tsho chen po'i khyad par chos gsum gyi phyag rjes dus mtha' 'dir yang gsal ba/ bdag cag gi yab gcig chos kyi rgyal bo rong ston phyag na padmo skal ldan rgya mtsho'i sku chos yin pas thams cad momadzod cig (ji rtags can 'di ni/ shes rab ldan zhing dbang po dul/ /gsal byed nyin mor byed pa bzhin/ /zhes pa ltar zhi dul gyi kun spyod nye bar 'khor dang mtshungs pa bde chen chos kyi rgyal bo ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i sku 'gag red/ 1ci rtags can 'di ni/ lhag bsam yongs su sbyangs shing zhi/ /bsod nams dpal gyis mdon par mtho/ /khor yug dbus kyi lhun po bzhin/ /rang gi yon tan lhag par gsal/ /zhes pa dang mthun pa'i lugs gnyis bsod nams kyi shed mong thogs pa med pa'i skyabs mgon gong sa dge 'dun 'phrin las rab rgyas kyi phyag phreng red/ (ji rtags can 'di ni/ mtshan rnams kun gyis lus rgyan rnam par mdzes/ /gza' skar tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i nam 3/kha' bzhin/ /dag cing yon tan tshogs kyis rab tu bkra/ /de ni snying rje'i sprin phung g.yo ba can/ /zhes pa dang mthun pa'i rgya chen chos kyi bang mdzod skyabs mgon blo bzang chos grags rgya mtsho'i sku 'gag red/ (nyirtags can 'di ni/ 'jig rten nyon mongs mes gdungs pa/ /bsil mdzad mtsho chen 'dir byung ste/ 4 zhes pa ltar yul gru du mar skye dgu dag la chos kyi bsil ba'i char 'beb pa stong skor mdo sde rgya mtsho'i sku 'gag red/(ṇḍi rtags can 'di ni/ sa bdag dpal ldan lus kyi dpal rgyas shing / /bsod nams dpal gyis skye bo'i dpal mgon sgyur/ /de ni ngang

318gis chos kyi don mthun pas/ /mthun pa ma yin chos las 'jig rten zlog /zhes pa ltar sa po chos bzhin skyong ba'i chos kyi rgyal bo/ mi dbang gtsug gi nor bu lcang skya ho ru ka rol ba'i rdo rje'i sku gzan red/(thi rtags can 'di ni/ rgya mtsho bzhin du zab gyur cing / /ri rab lta bur mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten kun gyi gtsor gyur pa/ /zhegapa ltar gyi mi'i bla ma chen po lcang skya ye shes bstan rgyan pa'i na bza' red/ (di rtags can 'di ni/ thes rab chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /skad cig chos kyi tshul shes pa/ /zhes pa ltar/ kun mkhyen bla ma chen po mkhan chen paṇḍi ta dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i na bza' red/ (ni rtags can 'di yang / rje nyid kyi dbu zhwa red/ mepi rtags can 'di ni/ nyes ba'i mun pa sel byed zla 'od bzhin/ /yang dag spyod pa gsal byed rab rib 'joms/ /kye ho dam pa rnams ni bla na med/ /ces pa ltar gyi bsngags par 'os pa khri sprul blo bzang rgyal mtshan seng ge'i sku 'gag red/ (phirtags can 'di ni/ rtsol ba thed par bas mtha' na/ /zhi la rab tu gzhol zhing 'khod/ /dge ba rnams ni yon tan la/ /re ba snying la 'jog par byed/ /ces pa ltar bas mtha'i ri sul du zhi ba mchog gi ting nge 'dzin la gzhol ba rje gser khang ba chen po'i sku gzan red/ (birtags can 'di ni/ de ni rang bzhin chos kyi bdag /thos la sogs pa'i yon tan brgyan/ /zhes pa ltar brtse ba sogs kyi yon tan gyis brgyan pa rje btsun blo bzang lung rigs rgya mtsho'i sku 'gag red/ (mi rtags canaphu'adi ni/ 'jig rten dag gis phal cher ni/ /bkur sti bya ba'i gnas su

sdo/9gyur/ /ces pa ltar skye dgu'i sri tshu'i yo4rno — ske—ṅges —ོ—ོ —tre rmere —shul dge 'dun chos skyong rgya mtsho'i dbu zhwa red/ (tsi rtags can 'di ni/nyin mor byed pas padmo la/ /sa skyong rnams kyis sa gzhi bzhin/ /drang srong dmod pa'i mthu yis kyang / /brten la srusdu ba'i cho ga byusnangabyu/ /'e/sa pa dang mthun par rang la brten pa'i bstan 'gro'i phan bde srung ba la bla med pa'i mthu chen rwa lo gnyis pa grub dbang 'jigs med bsam gtan pa'i sku gzan red/ (tshi rtags can 'di gi/ bdag gi bde ba 'dod pa spangs nas ni/ /gzhan gyi don la brtson pa'i bla mar gyur/ ces pa ltar gyi mdzad pa rang gir bzhes pa shing bza' sprul sku bstan pa'i dbang phyug gi sku 'gag red/ (dzi rtags can 'di ni/ sngon gyi yongs su sprud pa'i mthu che zhing / /snying rje'i dpal gyis yongs su 'khyud gyur pas/ 'jig rten bsil byed yon tan gyis gang ba/ /lhar bcasu kun gyis blta ba'i 'os su gyur/ /ces ltar lha dang bcas pa'i skye dgu dregs ldan can mtha' dag gi bkur snyi'i gnas su gyur ba/ srid zhi'i bla ma pho/rang cag yongs la zla med pa'i bka' drin gyi zla zer reng du skyong ba skyaphus mgon drug pa po rdo rje 'chang blo bzang skal lda na bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i dbu zhwa padma kha 'bus red/ (wi rtagasaci can 'di yang skyabs mgon drug pa chen po de nyid kyi sku chos rgyun bsnams ma red/ (zhirtags can 'di ni/ yon tan rgya mtsho'i dbus su nyer mdzes pa/ /rnam dag lus la shes rab gdengs gas mdzes/ /snying rje'i khrin gyis rab turi 'khyud gyur cing / /legs spyad char rgyun 'beb par byed par

320'gyur/ /ces pa dang mthun pa'i lung rtogs 'phrin las kyi mdzad pa gang thad nas snyigs ma'i dus su 'jam mgon bla ma gnyis bar gyur ba/yongs 'dzin partsi ta zhwa dmar dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i sku 'gag red/ (zi rtags can 'di ni/ blo gros dri med ston zla'i mkha' ltar dwangs/ /snying rje'i sprin gyis chos char kabeb par gyur/ /rgyu bar spyod pas mthong thos don ldan pa'i/ /brtan pa'i rang bzhin nyi ma bzhin du gsal/ /zhes pa'i mtshan nyid thun snang du grub pa sa la gnas pa'i bdag nyid chen po kirti blo bzang 'phrin las bstan pa rgya mtsho'i dbu zhwa yin pas thams cad ྾mdzod cig shes rab mthu yis 'jig rten gsal bor ston/ drag shul las kyi spyod pa rnams spangs kyang / /chos dang mthun pa'i bka' khri mas bzang po yis/ /mngon mtho'i lam la 'bangs rnams 'khrid mdzad de/ /zhes pa dang mthun pa'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar pa'i gnas bdag gir mdzad pa/ rgya nag tā māng zon te rgyal pos dbu blar bkur ba rong po'i bla ma blo gros seng ge dang dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ don grub seng ge gsum gyi dbu zhwa dngos gsum dang / zhwa g.yogs gsu ma red/ so so'i khyad par sngon nas shes gi med tshod red/ grub chen chos pa rin po che dang yab rje skal ldan rgya mtsho rnam gnyis kyi phyag 'khar red gyi 'khar bsil mtshan ldan 'di'i lo rgyus ma nges/ rgya nag rten 'khar 'khyogs po 'di phyis su rten gras la bzhag pa tsam las su'i yin ma nges sems dpa' chan po bla ma zhabs dkar ba la rma rgyal spom ras phul ba'i dbu zhwa'i 'dra bcos yin/ 'bru gong rin po ches gter nas blangs pa'i dung dkar

— ——— byu— ste ca — snyo — phu)—14/ — rang grags zer ba yin pas ('bad par ma/dzad de) sgra la nyon/ de ༄ ltar rten khyad par can rnams legs par mjal te sdig pa sbyangs pa dang /bsod nams bsags pa dang thar ba'i sa bon rang sems la btab pa la thams cad kyis dga' ba sgoms shig snadage ba 'di yisaskyebokun thob par shog྾ mo ྾ ji// chi —

ri 32te ——4 —ske ————cicawa4— )tsho/ /dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi sa gartsod bzhugs so/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs kyi padmo la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbu ma'i rtsa ba 'chad pa la gsu ma/ mtshan gyi don/ rgya gar skad du sogs so/ / gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don no/ /dbu ma ba'i sogs so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ stono pa la rten 'byung mtha' bral du gsungs pa'i sgo nas bstod pa / gang gis rten cing sogs so/ / rten 'byung mtha' brgyad dang bral bar 'gril ba'i tshul/ de ltar ston pa'i staka' drin rjespre/ su dran pa'i phyag go /gang ri/sa bugs brtses sogs so/ / gnyis pa la gsum/ rten 'byung rang bzhin gyis stong bar bstan pa/ de rtogs ma togs las 'khor ba'i 'jug ldog byed lugs/ rten 'byung rtogs na lta ba ngan pa ldog tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis/ dngos kyi don dang / de la rtsod pa spang ba'o/ khang po la gnyis/ bdag med gnyis mdor bstan pa dang /rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ rgyu 'bras kyi bya byed la brtags nas chos la rang bzhin dgag 'gro 'ong gi bya byed la brtagasanas gang zag la rang bzhin dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ 'bra— bu la skye ba'i rang bzhin dgag skyed byed la rkyen gyi rang bzhin rngakyi

323pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ mtha' bzhi'i skye ba dgag pa/ bdag las kyin sogs so/ / gzhan skye bkag pa la lung 'gal spang ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ lung dang 'gal ba'i rtsod pa dgod pa dang / byun rnami bzhi kyai sogs so/ /lung dang 'gal ba spang ba'o/ /dngos po rnams kyi sogs so/ / gnyis pa skyed byed la rkyen gyi rang bzhin dgag pa la gsum/ rkyen gyi rang bzhin thun mong du dgag pa dang / so sor dgag pa dang / thun mong du 'gog tshul gzhan bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ byed pa'i sgo nas rkyen du rtog pa dgag las kyi sgo nas rkyen du rtog pa dgag ba'o/ / thed dam da ༷'i sogs so/ / dang po la gnyis/ skye ba'i bya ba sgrub pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rkyen du rtog pa dgag bya ba rkyen nd+rang sogs so/ / 'bras bu skye ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis rkyen du rtog pa dgag pa'o/ /'di dag la ba3na sogs so/ / gnyis pa so sor dgag pa la bzhi/ rgyu'i rkyen gyi mtshan nyid dgag gang tshe rdzus ni sogs so// dmigs rkyen gyi mtshan nyid dgas/ yod pa'i chos 'di sogs so/ / de ma thag rkyen gyi mtshan nyid dgagachos rnams skyes sdu sogs so/ / bdag rkyen gyi mtshan nyid dgag pa'o/ /dngos po rang bzhi3 sogs so/ / gsum pa thun mong du 'gog tshul sa/zhan bstan pa la gsum/ 'bras bu 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis rkyen la rang bzhin yod pa dgag rkyen rnams so tram̐ sogs so/ / 'bras bu rkyen yin min gyi rang bzhin du grub pa dgag 'bras du rkyen gyi sogs tram̐d dang ngo/ /

324rkyen dang rkyen min gyi rang bzhin nges pa dgag pa'o/ /'bras bu 5da pas soskus ced dang ngo / /gnyis pa 'gro 'ong gi bya byed la brtags nasaci gang zag la rang bzhin dgag pa la gnyis/ rgyas par bshad/ mjug bsdu ba'o/ /de phyir 'gro dkā soskus so/ / dang po la gnyis/ las dang byed pa po la bya ba so sor dgag las dang byed pa po la bya ba thun mong du dgag pa'o/ /'gro bo yin rdzur sogs so/ / dang po la bzhi/ las la brtags nas dgag byed pa po la brtags nas dgag bya ba yod pa'i sgrub byed dgag bya ba la brtags nas dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ lam gsum la thun mong du bya ba dgag ri zhig song sdu sogs dzo/ / bsgom pa la bya ba bye brag tu das/ga pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ phyogs snga ma dgod pa dang / gang na g.yo 3 so /sa so/ / de 'gog pa'i rigs pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ las tshig dang bya tshig gcig don dang childan na gcig shos don gyis stong ba dang /'gom la 'gro / sogs so/ / gnyis ka don dang —bcas na ha cang thal ba'o/ /'gom la 'gro / sogs so/ / gnyis pa byed pa po la brtags nas dgag pa la gsum/ 'gro ba bo 'gro ba'i rten du yod pa dgag gal te 'gro bo7 sogs so/ / shā rnam grangs gsum gyi gang za—ga la 'gro ba spyir dgag re zhig 'gro bo sogs so/ / 'gro ba po la 'gro ba bye brage tu dgag pa'o/ /gang tshe 'gro ༵3 sogs so/ / — gsu ma pa bya ba yod pa'i sgrub sgyude dgag pa la lnga/ dang po'i rtsom pa ri

—————— ()12(5yod pa dgag song la 'gro ba'i sogs so/ / 'gro ba'i lam yod pa dgag 'gro rtsom rnam sdu sogs so/ / 'gro ba'i gnyen po yod pa dgag ri zhig 'gro bo sogs so/ /tha ma'i ldog pa yod pa dgag 'gom laldog ༵ra sogs so/kyi gnas parme sgrub byed dgag pa'o/ /'asmo ba da~X ni sogs so/ / bzhi ba bya ba la brtags nas dgag pa la gnyis/ 'gro ba po dang 'gro ba la gcig daja tha dad brtags te dgag pa dang / 'gro ba de kādu sogs so/ / 'gro ba por 'jog pa'i bya ba la bya ba gnyis pa yod med brtags nas dgag pa'o/ /'tho ba gad gipa sogs so/ /gnyis pa bdag med gnyis rgyas par bshad pa la lnga/ chos dang gang zag so sor phye ste bshad pa dang / dngos po tsam gyi raja bzhin gyis stong bar bstan pa dang / bdag med pa'i de kho na nyid la 'jug pa'i tshul dang / dus kyi rang bzhin gyis stong bar bstan pa dang / srid pa'i rgyun gyi rang bzhin gyis stong bar bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ chos kyi bdag med bshad pa dang / gang zag gi bdab/ med bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ chos gsum bdag med par bshad pa dang / de la bdag yod pa'i sgrub byed dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ skye mched la chos bdag dgag phung bo la chos bdag dgag khams la chos bdag dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ phyogs snga ma dgod pa dang / lta dang nyan dadu sogs so/ / de su na dbyung ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ lta ba'i cho sa

326gsum rang bzhin gyis grub pa dgag rigs pa de gzhan la'ang sbyar ba'o/ / bas nyan kyir sog so/ / dang po la gnyis/ lta ba'i byed pa po dgegi lta ba'i las dngo bye ba dgargu pa'o/ /lta 'id / thodasalo / darnga po la ginyis/ mig lte ba'i byedebyupa po yin pa danig padagatsho ginde rnam theso lta ba'i byed pa po yin pa dgag pa'o/ /lta ba nyid tram̐s soskus so/ / dang po la gnyis/ rang la mi lta ba'i rtags kyis dgag lta ba'i bya ba dang 'brel ma 'brel brtags la dgag pa'o/ /nya ba lta rdod soskus so/ / dang po la gsum/ rtags dgod pa/ lta di rang gi tram̐gs so/ / ma nges pa spang ba/ lta ba ra sogs so/ / don bsdu ba'o/ /gang tshe cung stud—sogs〈gi / gnyis bammungo jo la tshis rbadag dgig pa la gesumi/ gzugs phurdo rang bzhin gyis yod pa dgag rigs pa de gzhan la sbyar ba/ tshor daji 'dushasdu sogasapyigo / rtsod pa dang 'chad pa'i tshe lan gdab tshul lo/ /stoja ba nyid kyis soskus so/ / dang po la gnyis/ don gzhan du yod pa la rgyu 'bras dgagagazugos gā / sogs boge yod med dang 'dra mi 'dra la rgyu 'bras dgag pa'o//nisum pha khams la chos bdag gdagag pa la gnyis/ khams drug rang bzhin gyis grub ba dgake yod med kyi mthar lta ba smad pha'o/ / blo chung gang daX sogs so/ / dang po la gnyis/ nam mkha'i khams rang bzhin gyes sdo/rba pa dgag rigs pa de khams lhag ma rnams la'ang sbyar ba'o/ /

— ri 32kṇi khams lnga po sogs shād dang ngo / / dang po la gsum/ narma mkha'i khams la mtsha—/ mtshon dgag dngos po dang dngos med du grub pa dgag bkag pa rnams kyi mjug bsdu ba'o/ /de'i phyir nam mkha~X sogs byed dang ngo// dang po la gsu ma/ mtshan gzhi dgag mtshan nyid dgag mtshan gzhi 'thad ༵ sogs so/ /mjug bsdu ba'o/ /de'i phyir mtshan gagā sornos so/ / dang po la gnyis/mtshan nyid 'jug pa dgag des mtshan gzhi khegs par bstan pa'o/ /mtshan nyid 'jug pa3 sogs so/ / dang po la gnyis/ snga phyi la brtags nas mtshan nyid 'jug pa dgag nam mkha'i mtshan sdid sogs so/ / mtshan nyid yod med la brtags nas mtshan nyid 'jug pa dgag pa'o/ /ma na nyid thed la sogs so/ /gnyis pa dngos po dang dngos med du grub pa dgag pa la sa/nyis/dngos kyi don dang / mtshan gzhi maspyan nyid sogs so/ / rtsod pa spang ba'o/ /dngos dang dngos mebye sogs so/ / gnyis pa de la bdag yod pa'i sgrub byed dgag pa la gsum/ rten pa kun nas nyon mongs yod pa dgag mtshan nyid skye 'jig gnas gsum yod pa dgag rgyu las dang byed pa po yod pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ 'dod chags dang chags pa rang bzhin gyis yod pa dgag bkag pa rnams kyi mjug bsdu ba/ de ltar 'dod dīgs sogs so/ / rigs pa de gzhan la'ang sbyar ba'o/ /'dod ༵gas bzhin du

bye2skyesogs so/ / dang po la gnyis/ snga phyir 'byung ba dgag lhan cig tu 'byung ba das/ga pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ 'dod chags kyi snga rol na chags pa yod med dgag gal te 'dod chapy-is sogs so/ / chags pa'i snga rol na 'dod chags yod med dgag pa'o/ /chags pa la dīng sogs so/ / gnyis pa lhan cig 'byung ba dgag pa la gnyis/ ltos pa med pas lhan cig pa dzwa/gag pa dang / 'dod chags dang spya sogs so// gcig dang tha dad la lhan cig dgag pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ gcig dang tha dad la lhan cig spyir dgag gcig nyid sdin cig sogs so/ / tha dad la lhan cig bye brag tu dgag pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ tha dad du ma grub pas lhan cig mi 'grub pa dang / gal te tha dad sogs so/ / tha dad du grub na lhan cig dgos pa med pa dang / gal te 'dod cha3sa sogs so/ / tha dad lhan cig la brten nas phan tshun brten par bstan pa'o/ /tha dan grub /ra sogs so/ /gnyis pa mtshan nyid skye 'jig gnas pa yod pa dgag pa la gsum/'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid rang bzhin gyis grub pa dgag des 'dus ma byas rang bzhin gyis grub pa yang khegs par bstan/ 'dus byas ra~X tu sogasaso/ / de ltar bkag pa la lung dang 'gal ba spang ba'o/ /mi lam ji baspun sogs so/ / dang po la gnyis/ spyi'i mtshan nyid dgag khyad par gyi mtshan nyid dgag pa'o/ /skye dang gnas nd+rang sogs so/ / dang po la gnyis/—mtshan nyid gsum thun mong du dgag so sor dgag pa'o/ /dang po la

329gsum/ 'dus byas yin min brtags nas dgag gal te skye rwa sogs so/ /re re ba dang tshogs pa gang yin brtags nas dgas/ skyi la sogs gsu3 sogs so/ / mtshan nyid sa/zhan yod med brtags nas dgag pa'o/ /gsum pa la gnyis/ thal ba dgod pa dang / skye dang gnas kying sogs so/ / skyon spong gi lan dgag pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ thal ba dang po'i skyon spong dgag thal ba gnyis pa'i skyon spong dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/skyon spong brjod/ skye bas skye sdu'i sogs sdo/ / de dgag pa'o/ /gal te khyokā rti sogs so/ / gnyis pa thal ba gnyis pa'i skyon spong dgag pa la gnyis/ skyon spong brjod/ ji ltar mar me tresogs so/ / de dgag pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ dpe dgag don dgag pa'o/ / skye ba 'aspya ni sogs so/ / dang po 'a/ gnyis/ dam bca' la gnod pa brjod pa dgagamar me /ḍi ni sogs so / /gtan tshigs ma nges par bstan pas dgag pa'o/ /mar me spyang dang sogs so/ / gnyis pa so sor dgag pa la gsum/ skye ba rang bzhin gyis grub pa dgas/ gnas pa rang bzhin gyis grub pa dgag 'jig pa rang bzhin gyis grub pa dgo/ga pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ bskyed bya la dus gsu ma du dpyad nas dgag yod med gsum du dpyad nas dgag re zhig yod pa3 sogs so/ / 'gag ba'i/na pa yin min dpyad nas dgag pa'o/ /dngos po 'gag banikyisogs so/ /dang po la gsum/ thun mong dang bye brag tu skye ba dgag

————()()() ————bkas/ pa la rtsod pa spang / skye bzhin pa khas blangs nas kyang das/ga pa'o/ /gal te skye 8ba sogs so/ / dang po la gnyis/ dus gsum gyi skye ba thun mong du dgagaskye dang ma 3sa sogs so/ / skye bzhin pa la bye brag tu dgag pa'o/ /gang tshe skye4 ba sodas so/ / gnyis pa la gnyis/ dus gsu ma pa'i skye ba bkag pa la rtsod pa spang ba dang / rten cing 'byuX ba sogs so/ / skye bzhin pa la skye ba bkag pa la rtsod pa spang ba'o/ /gal te dngosabyu po sogs so/ / gnyis pa gnas pa rang bzhin gyis grub pa dgag pa la gsum/ las la dus gsum du dpyad nas dgag dngos po gnas sdu sogs so/ / 'ag/ga bzhin pa yin min la dpyad nas dgag dngos po 'gag bzhin sogs so/ / gnas byed gzhan yod med dpyad nas dgag pa'o/ /gnas pa gnas sdu sogs so/ / gsum pa 'jig pa rang ba'in gyis grub pa dgag pa la lnga/ dus gsu myo/ la brtags nas dgag 'gags pa 'gag pasdu sogs so/ / gnas pa yin min la brtags nas dgagare 'ig dngos ༷ sogs so/ / gnas skabs rang bzhin la brtags nas dgag dngos po yod med la brtags nas dgag re glig dngos ༵ sogs so/ / 'jig byed gzhan yod med la brtags nas dgag pa'o/ /'gag pa sdung gi sogs so/ / gsum pa la gnyis/ dngos kyi don dang / gnas ska bas de kyis sogs so/ / rtsod pa spang ba'o/ /gang tshe chos chasduṭa so gas so / / sa//su cha rnga kyu las dang byed pa po yod pa das/ga pa la gsu ma/ las dajiri pye/da pa po ngo bo

ri 331nyid kyis grub pa dgag tha snyad du las dang byed pa po 'jog pa'i tshul/byed po ladro sdu sogs so/ / rigs pa de sa/zhan la'ang sbyar ba'o/ /de bzhin nyer gun sogs so/ / dang po la gnyis/ phyogs mthun gyi bya byed ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa dgag phyogs mi mthun gyi bya byed ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ mu dang po sa/nyis kyi bya byed dgag mu sa/sum pa'i bya byed dgag pa'o/ /gyed pa por spyar sogs so/ / dang po la gnyis/dam bca' bzhag byed po yin pasdu sogs so/ / sgrub byed bstan pa'o/ /sa/nyis pa la gnyis/ dam bca' dang po'i sgrub byed dang / dam bca' gnyis pa'i sgrub byed do/— /dang po la gnyis/ sus kyang ma byas pa'i las yod par thal bas dgag yin par gyur la sogs so/ / ci yang mi byed pa'i byed pa po yod par thal bas dgag pa'o/ /yin par gyur kā sogs so/ / sanyis pa dam bca' gnyis pa'i sgrub byed la gnyis/ rgyu med du thal ba dgagagal te byed sdur sogs so/ / de 'dod pa la gnod pa brjod pa'o/ /rgyu me/ 3na ni sogs so/ / gnyis pa phyogs mi mthun gyi bya byed ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa dgag pa la gnyis/ byed pa po re re las phyogs mi mthun re re byed pa dgag byed pa por / sogs so/ / las phyogs mi mthun pa sa/nyis gnyis byed pa dgag pa'o/ /byed pa ṭwāṃ~X ni sogs so/ /gnyis pa gang zag si/ bdag/ med bshad pa 'a4 gnyis/ gang zag rang ba zhin gyis grub pa dgag gang zag rang bzhin gyis yod pa'i sgrub byed

332dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ phyogs snga ma brjod pa dang / lta dang nyan la so/sa so/ / de sun dbyung ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ nye bar len pa po ngo bo nyid kyis yod pa dgag des nye bar blang bya yang ngo bos yod pa khegs par bstan/ lta dang nyan la sogs so༈ / /nye bar len pa po ngo bo nyid kyis med pa la rtsod pa spang ba'o/ /gang zhig lta la sogs so/ / dang po la gsum/ len pa po blang bya thams cad kyi snga rol na yod pa dgag blang bya re re'i snga rol na yod pa dgag blang bya thams cad kyi snga rol na yod pa'i sgrub byed dgag pa'o/ /lta dang nyan sdu sogs so/ / dang po la gnyis/ blang bya las snga na len pa por gdags pa'i rgyu med pas dgag lta dang nyan la sogs so/ /len pa po snga na blang bya la gnas pa'i rten med pas dgag pa'o/ 4/lta la sduogs so/ / gnyis pa blang bya re re'i snga rol na yod pa dgag pa la gnyis/phyogs snga ma brjod pa dang / lta la sogs spya sogs so/ /de sun dbyung ba'o/ /lta la sokākā pa sogs so/ / gnyis pa gang zag rang bzhin gyis yod pa'i sgrub byed dgag pa la gnyis/ sgrub byed kyi dpe dgag sgrub byed kyi gtan tshigs dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gsum / me dang bud shing ngo bo nyid kyis yod pa dgag rigs pa de gzhan la'ang sbyar ba/ me dang zhing gisdu sogs so/ / /bkag pa'i don du lta ba smad pa'o/ /gang dag bdasku dang sogs so/ / dang po la gsu ma/sngar ma bshad pa'i rigs pas dgag sngar bshad pa'i rigs pas/ dag/ga

— 333de bzhin shing sdis sogs so/ / de dag gi mjug bsdu ba'o/ /shing nyid me spya sogs so/ /dang po la gnyis/ rang bzhin gcig pa dgag bud zhing gang de so/sa so/ / rang bzhin tha dad pa dgag ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ rang bzhin tha dad pa'i bsgrub bya dgag rang bzhin tha dad kyi sgrub byed dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ rang bzhin gyis tha dad na shing la mi ltos pa dang / rang bzhin gyis tha dad na shing dang mi 'phrad par 'gyur pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ dgag pa dngos dang / ma nges spang ba'o/ /de la gal spya sogs so/ /dang po la gnyis/ shing med bzhin du 'byung ba dang / gal te shing lakā sogs so/ /rtag tu 'bar ba sogs su 'gyur ba'o/ /rtag tu 'bar di sogs so/ / gnyis pa rang bzhin gyis tha dad na shing dang mi 'phrad par 'gyur ba la gnyis/dngos kyi don dang / gzhan phyir mi 'asbyad sogs so/ / de la ma nges pa spang ba'o/ /ji ltar bud /da sogs so/ / gnyis pa rang bzhin tha dad kyi sgrub byed dgag pa la gnyis/ ltos pa'i sgrub byed dgag mngon sum du mthong ba'i sgrub byed dgag pa'o/ /the ni gzhan las sogs so/ / dang po la gsum/ dus gsum du dpyad nas ltos pa dgag ltos chos yod med la dpyad nas ltos pa dgagadangos po ltos grusdu sogs so/ / ltos ma ltos gnyis ka dgag pa'o/ /zhing la stos sdu'i sogs so/ / dang po la gnyis/ dus snga phyi la ltos pa dgagagal te shing lto/ sogs so/ /dus mnyam pa la ltos pa dgag pa'o/ /gal te dngo3 po sogs so/ / gnyis pa

334 ṅka sto — —sgrub byed kyi gtan tshigs dgag pa la gnyis/ skye 'chi'i bya ba yod pa'i rtags dgag brten pa sdug bsngal yod pa'i rtags dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ 'khor ba rang bzhin gyis yod pa dgag rigs pa de gzhan la sbyar ba'o/ /'khor ba 'ba' zhi/ sogs so/ / dang po la gnyis/ 'khor ba thog mtha' bar gsum gyi cha dgag sngon mtha' mngon nam smosogs so/ / skye 'chi la dus snga phyi dang lhan cig pa dgag pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ mdor bstan/de phyir de la sogs so/ / rgyas /ra bshad/ don bsdu ba'o/ /gang la snga phyi sogs so/gnyis pa la gnyis/ snga phyi ba dgag dus mnyam pa dgag pa'o/ /skye ba dang spya sogs so/ / dang po la gnyis/ skye ba snga ba dgag gal te skye ba4 sogs so/ /rga shi snga ba dgag pa'o/ /gal te skye sdu sogs so/ / /gnyis pa brten pa sdug bsngal yod pa'i rtags dgag pa la gnyis/ sdug bsngal ngo bo nyid kyis yod pa dgag rigs ba de chos gzhan la'ang sbyar ba'o/ /sdug bsngal 'ba' zhisdu sogs so/ / dang po la gnyis/ dam bca' bzhag kha cig sdug bsnasdu sogs so/ /sgrub byed bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ sdug bsngal rang bzhin re re bas byas pa dgag gnyis ka tshogs pas byas pa dang rgyu med du smra ba dgag pa'o/ /gal te re ༷sa sogs so/ / / dang po la gsum/ sdug bsngal la lto sa te rang gzhan re re bas byas pa dgag gang zag la ltos te re re bas byas pa dgag rang gzhan re re bas ma byas pa'i sgrub byed bstan pa'o/ /

— rmo— 335 ri rnag sdugi baspyal sogs so/ / dang po la gnyis/ sdug bsngal la ltos te rang gis byas pa dgag gal te bdag spyas sogs so/ / sdug bsngal la ltos te gzhan gyis byas pa dgag ba'o/ /gal te 'di lasdu sogs so/ / gnyis pa gang zag la ltos te re re bas byas pa dgag pa la gnyis/ gang zag rang gis byas pa dgag gal te gang sdug sogs so/ / gang zag gzhan gyis byas pa dgag pa'o/ /gal te gang zasdu sogos so/ / gnyis pa dngos po tsam gyi rang bzhin gyis stong bar bstan pa la gnyis/ dngos po rang bzhin gyis yod pa dgag rang ba'in yod pa'i sgrub byed dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ gzhan la grags pa'i lung gis rang bzhin med pa bshad/ bcom ldan 'das kyisdu so/ / de ltar bshad pa mi 'thad pa'i rtsod pa spang ba/ gal te bslu cho tram̐ sogs so/ / lung de'i don rnam pa gzhan du 'chad pa dgag pa'o/ /gsum pa la gnyis/lung don gzhan du 'chad tshul bstan/ dngos rnams ngo rdzu sogs so/ / de ltar 'chad pha'i thab byed dgag pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ gzhan rmergyur rang bzhin gyis yod pa'i sgrub byed dgag stong nyid rang bzhin gyis yod pa'i sgrub byed dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ rang bzhin dang gzhan 'gyur gnyis 'gal bas dgag gal te ngo ṭwāṃ sogs so/ / gzhan 'gyur rang bzhin gyis yod pa mi srid pas dgag pa'o/ /de nyid la / sogs so/ / gnyis pa stong nyid rang bzhin gyis yod pa'i sgrub byed dgag pa la gnyis/ dngos

336 kyi don dang / gal te stong di/ sogs so/ / de la lung dang 'gal ba spang ba'o/ /rgyal ba rnams kyisdu sogs so// gnyis pa rang bzhin yod pa'i sgrub byed dgag pa la gsum/ 'phrad pa rang bzhin gyis yod pa dgagargyu rkyen bdag gir byed pa rang bzhin gyis yod pa dgag bcings thar rang bzhin gyis yod pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ 'phrad pa rang bzhin gyis grub pa dgag des 'phrad bzhin pa la sogs pa'ang khegs par bstan pa'o/ /'phran bzhin pa /nga sogs so//dang po la gnyis/ dam bca' bzhag blta bya lta 8ba sogs so/ / sgrub byed bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ gzhan rang bzhin gyis med pas phrad pa dgag gcig dang tha dad la dpyad nas 'phrad pa dgag pa'o/ /de rna dang sogs so/ / dang po la gsum/ sbyor ba dgod pa/ dang gnan kyi sogadi so/ /tshul de gzhan la yang sbyar ba/ blta bya la sospus sogs so/ / gtan tshigs sgrub pa'o/ /gsum pa la gnyis/ rtags dgod pa dang / gnan ni gnan la tram̐gs so/ /de la skyon spang ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ ma nges pa'i skyon spang ba/gal te gnaspya rna sogs so/ / ma grub pa'i skyon spang pa'o/ /gzhan nyid gzhan la sogs so/ / gnyis pa rgyu rkyen bdag gir byed pa rang bzhin gyis yod pa dgag pa la gnyis/ dngos po rnams rang bzhin gyis yod pa dgag rang bzhin gyis yod par smra na mthar 'dzin las mi 'da' bar bstan pa'o/ /

33lha yod ces bya shu sogs so/ / dang po la gnyis/ rang bzhin gyis yod pa'i sgrub byed dgag rang bzhin gyis yod pa la gnod byed bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ dngos kyi don dang / des mtha' gzhan gsum khegs par bstan/ rang bzhin yokā di sogs so/ / bkag pa'i don du lta ba smad pa'o/ /gang dag rang baṭwāṃn sogs so/ / dang po la gnyis/ rang bzhin la rgyu rkyen mi dgos shing 'gal bar bstan pa/ rang bzhin rgyu kying sogs so/ / rang lugs kyi rang bzhin gyi mtshan nyid bstan pa'o/ /rang bzhin dag trī sogs so/ / gnyis pa rang bzhin gyis yod pa la gnod byed bstan pa la gnyis/ lung gi gnod byed dang / bcom ldan dngosdu dang sogs so/ / rigs pa'i gnod byed do/ /gal te rang bsdin sogs so/ / gsum pa bcings thar rang bzhin gyis yod pa dgag pa la gnyis/ dngos kyi don dang / de'i sgrub byed dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ 'khor 'das rang bzhin gyis grub pa dgag bcings thar rang bzhin gyis grub pa dgag myang 'das kyi don du rtsom pa don med par thal ba spang ba'o/ /bdag ni len me/ sogs so/ / dang po la gnyis/'khor ba rang bzhin gyis grub pa dgag myang 'das rang bzhin gyis grub pa dgag pa'o/ /'du sgyed mya nga/ sogs so/ / dang po la gnyas/ blang bya phung bo 'khor ba dgag len pa po sems can 'khor ba dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ rtag pa 'khor ba dgag gal te 'aspre sdide sogs so/ / mi rtag pa

338'khor ba dgag pa'o/ /mi rtag na dīng sogs so/ / gnyis pa len pa po sems can 'khor ba dgag pa la gnyis/ phung bo las ngo bo tha dad pa'i sems can 'khor ba dgag sems can la dīng sogs so/ / phung bo 'a/sa de nyid dang gzhan du brjod du med pa'i gang zag 'khor ba dgag pa'o/ /gal te gang za8ga sogs so/ / gnyis pa bcings thar rang bzhin gyis grub pa dgag pa la gnyis/ bcings thar rang bzhin gyis yod pa thun mong du dgag skye 'jig chos // sogs so/ / so sor dgag pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ bcings pa rang bzhin gyis yod pa dgag gal te nye ༷ra sogs so / /thar ba rang bzhin gyis yod pa dgag pa'o/ /re shig bcings ༷ sogs so/ /gnyis pa de'i sgrub byed dgag pa la gnyis/ dge mi dge'i rnam gzhag dang / de la rtag chad spong tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis/ sems kyi dge mi dge'i rnam gzhag dang / bdag nyid legs ༷ra sogam so/ / las kyi rab tu dbye ba'i rnam gzhag go /gnyis pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa/drang srong mchog /sta sogs so/ / rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ las gnyis la las gsum du dbye ba dang / /de la las /da sogs so/ / 'thab —gsum la las bdun du dbye ba'o/mo /ngag dang bskyod dadā 5ga so/ / gnyis pa de la rtag chad spong tshul la gnyis/ rtsod pa dgod pa dang / gal te smin pani sogs sio/ / de spo nga tshul lo/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ rgyun khas blangs nas

pha —4 ————— sto shu)()8) rtag chad spong ba dang / chud mi za ba khas blangs nas rtag chad spong pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis / rtag chad spong tshul dngos dang / las lam bcu 'bras bu dang bcas pa ngos bzung ba'o/ /dkar sa'i las tram̐ sogs so/ / dang po la gnyis/ dpe dgod pa dang / myu gul sodis so/ / don la sbyar ba'o/ /sgems kyi rgyun sdi sogs so / / / sanyis pa chud mi za ba khas blangs nas rtag chad spong ba la gnyis/ sde ba gzhan gyi lan dgag gal te brtaspyas pa sogs so/ /rang gi lan gdab pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ mdor bstan pa/sangs rgyas rnasdu skying sogs so/ / rgyas par bshad pa/ don bsdus te rtag chad spang ba'o/ /stong ba nyid nd+rang sogs so/ / gnyis pa la bzhi/ khams kyi dbye ba dang rang bzhin/ na rna khams las sogs so/ / spang bya gang yin pa/ spong ba'i spang ba so/sa so / / skye ba'i tshul/ khams mtshungs las ni sogadri so/ / 'gag pa'i tshul lo/ /na ni bras bus mu gas so/ /tre gnyis pa lan la gsum/ las la rang bzhin med pas rtag chad med pa dang / gang phyir las / sogs so/ / las rang bzhin gyis yod pa dgag pa dang / rang bzhin med pas bya ba byed pa dpes bstan pa'o/ /ji ltar ston pas/ tram̐/na so/ / gnyis pa la gnyis/ rang bzhin gyis yod ba langaganod byed dgod/ rang bzhin gyis yod pa'i sgrub byed dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ rtag cing ma byas par thal ba dang / rnam smin thug med

340 du 'byin par thal ba'o/ /de ni rnasdu smin sogs so/ / dang po la gnyis/ thal ba dngos dang / gal te las sdu sogs so/ / de 'dod pa la gnod pa brjod pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ bstan bcos dang 'gal ba dang / ji ste lasatre ni sogs so/ /'jig rten gyi grags pa dang 'gal ba'o/ /tha da mas ༷/ sogs so/ / gnyis pa rang bzhin gyis yod pa'i sgrub byed dgag pa la gsum/ las rang bzhin gyis yod pa'i sgrub byed dgag las 'di ston modus sogs so/ / las dang nyon mongs gnyis ka rang bzhin gyis yod pa'i sgrub byed dgag las dang nyon mobyis sogs so/ / las rang bzhin gyis yod pa'i sgrub byed sa/zhan dgag pa'o/ / rig bsgribs1 kā'i sogs so/ / gsum pa bdag med pa'i de kho na nyid la 'jug pa'i tshul la lnga/ de kho na nyid la 'jug pa'i tshul/ de la lung dang 'gal ba spang ba/ de kho na nyid la bsgribs pa'i rim pa/ mas cad yang kyig sogs so/ / de kho na nyid kyi mtshan nyid/ don de nges par bsgrub datho/sa parngo bstan pa'o/ /sangs byes 'jig rte/ sogs so/ / dang po la gnyis/ de kho na'i lta ba gtan la dbab pa/ de bsgoms pas nyes skyon ldog pa'i rim pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ bdag ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa dgag pa/ des bdag gi ba ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa yang khegs par bstan pa'o/ /bdag nyid yod ṭwāṃ sogs so/ /dang po la gnyis/ bdag dang phung bo rang bzhin gcig pa dgag pa/

341gal te gung bo shāgs so/ / bdag dang phung bo rang bzhin tha dad pa dgag pa'o/ /gal te gung / sogs so/ / gnyis pa de bsgoms pas nyes skyon ldog pa'i rim pa la gnyis/ nyes skyon ldog pa'i rim pa dang / thar ba 'thob pa'i tshul lo/ /las dang nyon mospyas sogs so/ / dang po la gsum/ 'jig lta ldog tshul dang / bdag dang bdagaspya sogam so/ / de la rtsod pa spang ba dang / ngar 'dzin nga yisdu sogs so/ / len pa zad pas skye ba zad tshul lo/ /nang dang ji rol4 sogs so/ /gnyis pa de la lung dang 'gal ba spang ba la gnyis/ lung dang 'gal ba spang ba dngos/ bdag go zhes kyadu sogs so/ / de kho nar gang du yang brjod mi nus pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /brjod par bya babyu sogs so/ / bzhi ba de kho na nyid kyi mtshan nyid la gnyis/ 'phags pa rnams kyi de kho na nyid kyi mtshan nyid dang /gzhan las shes ni/sogs so/ / 'jig rten pa'i de kho na nyid kyi mtshan nyid do/ /gang la brten te sogs so/ / bzhi ba dus kyi rang bzhin gyis stong bar bstan pa la gnyis/ dus ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa dgag de'i sgrub byed dgag ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ dus sa/sum rang bzhin gyis yod pa spyir dgag rang gzhan gyi sde ba'i 'dod pa so sor dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ 'das pa la ltos ma ltos kyi dus gnyis rang bzhin gyis grub pa dgag rigs pa de du sa gzhan gnyis la sbyar ba/ rim pari tshulanani sogs so/ /chos gsum mtshan gzhan la sbyar ba'o/ /mchog dang tha / sogs so/ / dang po la

342gnyis/ 'das pa la ltos pa'i dus rang bzhin gyis grub pa dgagad ltar rgyuja da/ sogs so/ / ma ltos pa'i dus rang bzhin gyis grub pa dgag pa'o/ /'das pa la spya sogs so / gnyis pa rang gzhan gyi sde ba'i 'dod pa so sor dgag pa la gnyis/ gzhan sde pas 'dod pa'i dus dgag mi gnas dus spya sogs so//rang sde dngos por smra bas 'dod pa'i dus dgag pa'o/ /gal te dus spya sogs so/ /gnyis pa dus rang bzhin gyis yod pa'i sgrub byed dgag pa la gnyis/dus 'bras bu 'byung ba'i lhan cig byed rkyen yin pa dgag dus 'bras bu 'byung 'jig gi rgyu yin pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ rgyu rkyen gyi tshogs pa las skye ba dgag rgyu nyid las skye ba dgag rgyu rkyen tshogs pa las skye ba 'gog pa'i rigs pa gzhan bstan pa'o/ /rgyu rnams dang / sogs so/ /dang po la gsum/ tshogs pa snga ma las skye ba dgag dus mnyam pa'i tshogs pa las skye ba dgag gal te tshogs spyang sogs so/ / tshogs pa phyi ma las skye ba dgag pa'o/ /gal te tshogs 4pa'i sogs so/ / dngasapo la gnyis/ tshogs pa las dngos su skye ba dgag tshogs pa las brgyud nas skye ba dgag pa'o/ /gal ) rgyus / sogs so/ / dang po la gnyis/ tshogs pa la yod med skye ba dgagagal te rgyu dadro sogs so/ / tshogs pa la yod med nyid dgag pa'o/ /gal te 8 dang sogs so/ / gnyis pa rgyu nyid las skye ba dgag pa la gnyis/ rgyu 'bras ngo bo gcig pa'i phyogs dgag pa dang / gal te rgyu 'apy-ig sogs so/ / rgyu 'bras ngo so

343tha dad pa'i phyogs dgag pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ rgyus 'bras bu skye ba'i bya ba sbyor bar byed pa dgag pa dang / rgyu nyid rang bzhin gyis yod pa dgag pa'o/ /skyed par byed ༷ sogs so/ / /dang po la bdun/ rgyu 'gags pa dang gnas pas 'bras bu skyed pa das/ga 'gags pa nub ༷ḍi sogs so/ / rgyus mthong ba dang ma mthong bar 'bras bu skyed pa dgag rgyus ni mthong kāng sogs so/ /rgyus phrad pa dang ma phrad par 'bras bu skyed pa dgag 'bras bu 'das ༵smo sogs so//'bras bus stong mi stong gi rgyus 'bras bu skyed pa das/ga gal te sdubras bus sogs so/ / 'bras bu stong mi stong rgyus skyed pa dgag 'bras bu mi sto/ sogs so/ / rang bzhin gcig dang tha dad kyi rgyus 'bras bu skyed pa dgagargyu dang 'bras sdi sogs so/ / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyis yod med rgyus skyed pa dgag pa'o/ /'bras bu 8ngo bo sogs so/ / gnyis pa dus 'byung 'jig gi rgyu yin pa dgag pa la gnyis/ skye 'jig rang bzhin gyis grub pa dgag skye 'jig rang bzhin gyis grub par 'dod na rtag chad kyi skyon bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ 'byung 'jig rang bzhin gyis yod pa'i bsgrub bya dgag 'byung 'jig rang bzhin gyis yod pa'i sgrub byed dgag pa'o/ /dang po la sa/sum/ 'byung 'jig lhan cig yin min brtags nas dgag 'byung 'jig rten gang la yod brtags nas dgag 'byung 'jig gcig dang tha dad brtags la dgag pa'o/ /'byung ba dang snyi sogs so/ / dang po la gsum/

344dam bca' bzhag pa/ 'jig pa 'byung ba 4sogs so/ / sgrub byed bsta na pa/ de dag gi don bsdu ba'o/ /gang dag phan tshu/ sogs so/ / gnyis pa la gnyis/'jig pa 'byung ba dang lhanabyucig yin min dgag 'jig pa 'byung ba so/sa so/ /'byung ba 'jig pa dang lhan cig yin min dgag pa'o/ /'byung ba 'jig dī sogs so/ / gnyis pa 'byung 'jig rten gang la yod brtags nas dgag pa la gsum/ zad ma zad kyi rten la 'byung 'jig dgag zad la 'byu5 ba sogs so//dngos po'i rten la 'byung 'jig dgag dngos po yod sdu sogs so/ / stong mi stong gi rten la 'byung 'jig dgag pa'o/ /stong la 'byung /da sogs so/ /gnyis pa 'byung 'jig rang bzhin gyis yod pa'i sgrub byed dgag pa la gnyis/ mthong ba sgrub byed min pa dang / 'byung ba dang spya sogs so/ / de'i sgrub byed bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ 'byung 'jig rang dang mthun mi mthun las skye ba dgag dngos po dngos ༷sa sogs so/ / dngos po rang dang gzhan las skye ba dgag pa'o/ /dngos po bdag sdu sogs so/ / gnyis pa skye 'jig rang bzhin gyis grub par 'dod na rtag chad kyi skyon bstan pa la gsum/ dngos po rang bzhin gyis yod par khas blangs na rtag chad du 'gyur tshul/ dngos po yod paḍi sogs so/ / de ltar khas blangs kyang skyon de spong ba'i lan dgag pa/ de ltar bkag pa'i don bsdu ba'o/ /gal te dgag bzhi/ sogs so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa khas blangs nas

zang ge——byung — skedzha ri — snye — — — —— —— ༷)dze/5 rtag chad spong tshul dang / dngos po yod sdu sogs so/ /de dgag pa'i lan no/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ rgyun khas blangs kyang rtag chad spong mi nus pa dang /'bras bu rgyu di soskus so/ /rgyun nyid rang bzhin gyis ma grub par bstan pa'o/ /tha ma 'dīg par sogs so/ / lnga ba srid pa'i rgyun gyi rang bzhin gyis stong bar bstan pa la gnyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa rang bzhin gyis yod pa dgaganyon mongs rang bzhin gyis yod pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ de bzhin gshegs pa rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa dgag de la log lta sa/zhan gyi'ang gnas med par bstan pa/ stong ngo zhes shādu sogs so/ / log par bzung ba'i nyes dmigs bstan pa/ gang dag sangs rgyasdu sogs so/ / rigs pa de gzhan la'ang sbyar ba'o/ /de bzhin gshegs patram̐ sogs so/ / dang po la gsum/ len pa po rang bzhin gyis grub pa dgag blang bya rang bzhin gyis grub pa dgagagang zhig nye ༷ra sogs so/ / de gnyis ka'i mjug bsdu ba'o/ /de ltar nyer bland+ra sogs so/ / dang po la gsum/ de bzhin gshegs pa rdzas su yod pa dgagaphung min pung sbya sogs so/ / phung bo la brten nas btags pa rang bzhin gyis yod pa dgag de rnams kyi mjug bsdu ba'o/ /rnam pa lngas nitre sogs so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ phung bo la brten nas btags pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rang bzhin gyis yod pa dgag de bzhin gshegs pa dang phung bo len pa po dang blang byar rang bzhin gyis yod pa dgag pa'o/ /gal te phung bo sogs rngo/ /1na

34skye — — — — —— —snye 4— —— ———————rtsod pa dang / de dag yod sdu sogs so/ / dkon mechog gsum mi 'thad pa'i rtsod pa'o/ /gal rte 'thas bu sokwas ced dang ngo/ / gnyis pa de'i lan la bzhi/ rgezhan gyis smras pa rten 'byudza gi de nyid ma rtogs pa'i rtsod par bstan pa/ drorang gi bzhed pa stong ba'i rten 'byung gi don du bstan pa/ rten cing 'brel bar bye//rdo ///spo /// //rware 4 rigasogs so/ / ltar 'dod pa la rnam gzhag thams cad 'thad pa tshul/rten 'byung gi de nyid mthong na bden bzhi'i de nyid mthong bar 'gyur ba'o/ / gang gis rten cind+ra sogs so/ / dang po la gnyis/ gzhan gyis bkod pa'i skyon rang la mi 'jug pa'i tshul/ skyon 'god pa po nyid la skyon deci 'jug pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum// skyon brjod mi 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / skyon brjod mi 'jug pan bstan pa dngos dang / skyon du thal ba3 sokas so/ / skyon med par ma bad yon tan yod pa'i tshul lo/ ci /gang la stong trī sogs so/ / dang po la gnyisacu/ don sa/sum ma rtogs pa'i rtsod4 riphar bstan pa/ de la bshad mi sogs so / / de ltar rtsod pas bden gnyis maci rterges par— bstan —pa'o/ tre/gnyi—ṅge cithe —ṅge snye—/ gang zhigeci ma rtogs skre'i bden riganyis kyi ngo bo/ sangs rgyas rnams kyisdu sogs so/ / bden skenyis mi she—sa two gsung rab kyi nai nyid mi shes pa/ bden pa gnyis bstan pa'i dgos pa/ snyad la kyi sogs so/ / bden gnyis la log par bsdong ba'i nyes dmigs/ stong ba nyide— sdu sogs so/ / ba den gnyis rtogs dka' bas ston pas dang por sa

— — — — — ———sngu—da da da 349 —gsungs pa'idhe tshu la lo/ /de jir zhan sdus sogs so/ / gnyis’pa skyon 'god rpā po nyid la skyon de 'jug pa'i tshul la gsum/ — skyon 'god pa po la skyonadro gi 'jug pa 'i rgyu mtshan/ gang la stong nyiṭwāṃ sogajuso/ / des rang gi skyon la gzhanajigyi skyon du bzung tshu la/ sgod rna rang spya sogs so/ / skyon de rnams gang yine gsal bar brnya na pa'o/ /gal te dajis rnamadi sogs so/ / gsum pa de ltar 4sgo 'dod pa la rnam gzhag thams cad mi 'thad pa'i tshul la druge shes bya bden bzhi mi rung ba dang / gal te 'di mekyin sogs so/ / bden bzhi shes pa sogs dang 'bras bu bzhi mi rung ba dang / gal rte ktadro bzhin— sogs so/ / —dkon mchog gsum mi rung ba dang / — 'bras bu mekā / sogs so/ / byed pa po dang las 'bras mi rung ba dang / 'ga' yang chos kākā sogs so/ / 'jig rten pa'i tha snyad mi rung ba dang / rten cing 'a~Xrngo bar sogs so/ / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tha snyad mi rung ba'o/ /gal te stong ༷/ sogs so/ / gnyis pa myang 'das brtag pa la gnyis/ rtsod pa dang /gal te 'di dag4 sogs so/ / lan no/ /gnyis pa la bzhi/ dngos po rapre bzhin gyis grub pa'i phyogaso la myang 'das mi 'thad pa dang / gal te 'di kukyi soskus so/ /rang gi lugs kyis myang 'das ngos gzung ba deng / spangs pa med dī sogs so/ /de las tshul gnen du smra ba dgag pa dang / de ltar bkag pa la lung dang

350'gal ba spang ba'o/ /dmigs pa mas stud sogs so/ / gsum pa la gsum/myang 'das mtha' bzhir grub pa dgag myang 'das thugs su chud pa po mtha' bzhir ma grub par bstan/ com na nga/ sogs so/ / des grub pa'i don no/ /dang po la gsum/ myang 'das dngos por yod med so so ba'i mthar 'dod pa dgag de gnyis ka'i mthar 'dod pa dgag gal te byu ༵/ sogs so/ / gnyis ka ma yin pa'i mthar 'dod pa dgag pa'o/ /dngos min dngosatre po sogs so/ / dang po la bzhi/ myang 'das dngos po'i mthar 'dod pa dgag re zhig shā /na sogs so/ / dngos po med pa'i mthar 'dod pa dgagagal te skya nga/ sogs so/ / mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i myang 'das gang la 'jog pa/ 'ong ba dang kyi sogs so/ / mtha' gnyis su lta ba ston pas smad pa'i tshul lo/ /'byung ba dang spya sogs so/ / gsum pa des grub pa'i don la gnyis/ srid zhi mnyam nyid du grub pa dang / 'khor ba skya8 ngan sogasaso/ / lung ma bstan gyi lta ba dgag pa grub pa'o/ /gang 'das phan 1 / sogs so/ /gnyis pa rten 'byung rtogs ma rtogs las 'khor ba'i 'jug ldog byed lugs la gnyis/ lugs 'byung gi rten 'brel dang /mo lugs ldog gi rten 'brel lo/ /'khor ba'i rtsa dī /gas so/ / dang po la gnyis/ 'phen snid kyi rgyu 'bras dang / ma rig bsgribs kāsdu sogs so/ / /'grub byed kyi rgyu 'bras
