425 tshig bcas rgya chen spel bas dpal dus kyi 'alo/ ra lo'i rang bstan mtshan dus la nyi ma shar ba dang / rtsod dus la rdzog5 ldan byung ba lta bu mdzad pa na 'jig rten thams cad dge legs su byed pa'i snang ba gsum pa shar ba yin zhing /da res skabs bab kyi dbang du byas na'ang / ji skad du/ rnam dag dbang bdun thob pas sa bdun gyi/ /nus pa legs bzhag khams sogs dri ma bdun/ /'khrud cing rim pa dang pa'i rnal 'byor dang / /thun mong da ngos grub sgrub la dbang / /zhes dang / 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dbang mchog bzhis/ /sku bzhi rdo rje bzhi yi sa bon bzhag /rim pa gnyis pa'i bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi/ /nyam/ dang 'chad dang sgom la dbang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar rdul mtshon gyi dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid dang ldan par gzhug pa sngon du 'gro bas sa bdun gyi nus pa 'jog cing dri ma bdun 'khrud par byed pa/ rim pa dang po'i rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang zhing thun mong dngos grub sgrub pa'i sgo 'byed byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun dang / rdo rje bzhi'i sa bon grungs so 'debs sa rdzogs rim bsnyen sgrub yan las/ bzhi sgom pa la dbang zhing mchog gi dngos grub bde blag tu ster bar byed pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mchog dbang brgyad dang / rno rje slob dpon chen po'i skur bzhengs nas skal ldan gyi gdul bya dpag tu med pa smin 'ing grol bar mdzad pa la dbang bar byed pa sdo rje two/ba dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang dang bcas nyin bzhi'i ring smin rgya sa su bstsal te 'brel thogs kyi skal ba bzang bo mtha' dag rdo

426rje'i rigs gcig tu smin par mdzad pa'i bka' drin ni bskal ba du mar lus dang srog gis mchod kyang kazhal bar mi nus mod/ rdo rje slob dpon la byas pa gzo ba dang / dam pa'i chos kyi dbu 'phang bstod pa mtshon tsam du/ ྾ mo mo 'bul lam zhus te slad ma'i don gyi gsol ba 'debs pa'i snying bo ni/ rnam 'grel las/ snying rje dman pa nyid phyir yang / /gnas pa'i 'bad rtsol chen po med/ /gang dag brtse ba chen po ba/ /gzhan gyi ngor ni bzhugs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ snyigs ma'i rang mtshang ci tsam bdo ba dang / /dmu rgod kyi byed spyod ji tsam ngan pa de tsam gyis bla na med pa'i thugs stobs lhag par bskyed de/ ji skad du/ chos rnga chen po'i sgra yis ni/ /sems can sdug bsngal mthar bgyid cing / /bskal ba bye ba bsam yas su/ /chos ston mdzad cing bzhugs gyur cig /ces gsungs pa'i don bzhin rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid bdag cag rnams kyi phan bde rtsa lag dam par zhabs pad bskal ba ji srid du brtan cing / thub bstan spyi bye brag dang / khyadu par du ṭīka chen las/ ji srid mkha' la rlung gzhon skyod byed cing / /'jig rten nyi ma'i 'od kyis snang byed pa/ /de srid rgyud kyi bshad srol rmad byung 'dis/ /'gro la legs bshad dga' ston 'gyed par shog /ces gsungs pa'i don dang mthun par dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang byin rlabs/ bskyed rdzogs dang gdams pa/ rgyud dang 'grel ba sogs lung rtogs kyi chos tshul rnams mkha' khyab tu spel ba— dang / tshul de la brten nas/ ji skad du/gtsug lag /bang rnams klog pa dang / /kha ton gyis/ rgyas legs gnas

427shog /rtag tu dge 'dun mthun pa dang / /dge 'dun don yang 'grub par shog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ phyogs ris med kyi yul na dge 'dun gyi sde ji snyed cig bzhugs pa spyi dang / khyad par du sgar ba kha drug gi dge 'dun rnams thugs mthun zhing khrims gtsang pa'i ngos nas/ chos 'chad nyan/ zhal 'don dge sbyor/ cho ga chos spyod/ 'grig lam kun spyod sogs chos ldan gyi bya ba mtha' dag zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin gong 'phel du rgyas pa dang / tshul gzhan yang / rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig bu/ /྾ ྾ ྾gnas gyur cig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ skye rgu'i sdug kun sel ba'i sman mchog phan bde kun gyi gzhi rtsa/ rgyal bstan rin po che spyi dang / khyad par du 'jam na gon rgyal ba'i rang lugs gser sbyangs btso ma lta bu 'di nyid dang / srol de dag gis bsdus pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i lam bzang mtha' dag mi nyams dar rgyas su 'gyur ba dang /tshul de la brten nas/ ji skad du/ lha yang dus su char 'bebs shing / /mo sku ྾ dar bar shog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ yangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams spyi dang / khyad par du sgar bdun tsho drug gi yul gru 'di kar rgan gyi tshe thag ring zhing gzhon gyi 'dab lag rgyas pa dang / char chu dus su 'bab cing lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa dang / mi mthun rgud tshogs zhi zhing mthun rkyen dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang / bla mas rjes su 'dzin zheng ci byas chos su 'gro bi sogs bkra tri/sa dadza bde legs rgyun mi 'chad du 'byung ba dang /de dag skyong ba'i chos kyis mtho ba'i bla ma/ srid kyis swātho ba'i rgyal bo sogs kyis mnga' 'bangs mtha' dag chos bzhin skyong zhing bu bzhin brtse

428ba dang / yang sgori shaṃ su 'dir 'tshogs 'brel thogs thams cad rdzogs ldan phyi ma'i bstan pa 'jig rten gyi dpal du shar tshe/ 'jam/ dbyangs sprul ba'i zlos gar drag po 'khor lo can yab sras bu rgyud dang bcas pa'i 'khor gyi thog ma dang sras kyi thu bor gyur te thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i dbang gis rgyud snod rung dang bskyed rim rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bzhis rgyud smin par byas te/ rdzogs rim gzugs sgrub srog sgrub thugs sgrub sogs kyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la spungs pa bzhin du gyur nas/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba nyi khri chig stong drug brgyas las rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya zad par byas te dang bo'i sangs rgyas stong gzugs yab yum gyi rgyal thabs la rang dbang du spyod pa'i skyabs 'jug byams brtse thugs kyi dgongs dbyings nas dus nam yang 'dor ba med pa mkhyen mkhyen rma khyen/ nes gsol ba 'debs pa lags/ /

— — 429lta ba'i phyong byang ba'ugs so/ /non mo gu ru mdzi rghaṃ khri ya/ stong nyid gtan la phab pa la thog mar dgag bya ngos zin pa gal che ste/ rang bzhin gyis ma grub dgag pa yin pas rang dngos su rtogs pa'i blos dgag bya bcad nas/ rtogs par bya ba yin/ rang gis dgag bya bcad nas rtogs pa la rang gi dgag bya de'i spyi sngon du bshad dgos/ des na sngon du rang bzhin gyis grub pa'am don dam du grub pa'i tshad shes dgos/ de la tha snyad du grub tshad shes dgos/de ni don gyi ngos nas tshur grub pa dang rtog pa'i ngos nas phar btags tsam gnyis las phyi ma bya dgos te/ mdo las/ sna tshogs yid dga' me tog kha phyes shing / /gser gyi khang mchog 'bar ba yid 'ong ba/ /'di na de la byed po 'ga' med de/ /de dag rtog pa'i dbang gis bzhag pa yin/ /rtog pa'i dbang gis 'jig rten rnam brtags te/ /zhes chos thams cad rtog pas rnam par btags pa'am des phar btags pa tsam du gsungs pa dang / dri za'i grong khyer ji ltar snang gyur kyang / grong khyer phyogs bcur med cing gzhan na'ang med/ /grong khyer ming tsam zhig gis rab tu bzhag /de bzhin de bzhin gshegs pas 'gro 'di gzigs/ /zhes/ dri za'i grong khyer snang tshe gzhi der grong khyer dngos gnas pa zhig tshur grub par snang / de 'dra'i grong khyer dngos zhig gzhi der phyogs bcu dang /

43spu —de 'a sa nga/zhan gang dukrung btsal na med cing / gzhi med du grong khyer gyi snang ba tsam dang / gzhi med du grong khyer zhes btags pa tsam zhig phar rab tu bzhas/ pa de bzhin du 'gro ba rnams kyang gdags gzhi'i phung po snang ba la brten nas rtog pa dang ming gis gzhi med du phar btags pa tsam du gsungs/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ 'jig rten ma rig rkyen can du/ /gang phyir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gsungs/ /de nyid phyir na 'jig rten 'di/ /rnam rtog yin zhes cis mi 'thad/ /ces 'jig rten thams cad rnam rtog gis btags tsam du gsungs shing / rin chen phreng ba las/gzugs kyi phung bo ming tsam ste/ /nam mkha' yang ni ming tsam mo/ /zhes gzugs phung sogs 'dus byas dang / nam mkha' sogs 'dus ma byas kyi chos thams cad ming gis gzhi med du phar btags pa tsam du gsungs/ slob dpon arya de bas/ rtog pa med par 'dod chags la/ /sogs la yod nyid yod min na/ /yang dag don dang rtog pa zhes/ /blo dang ldan pa su zhig 'dzin/ /zhes 'dod chags chos thams cad la rtog pas phar bzhag tsam po de las yod pa nyid med par gsungs/ slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis ri mo bris pa'i lha sku la dbang phyug dang khyab 'jug gi sku tshur gzhi ste nga nas med bzhin du phar btags tsam yin pa de bzhin du/ chos gang yang tshur gzhi steng nas med par phar rtog pas btags gsungs pa dang / dpal ldan zla ba grags pas/ rtog pa yod pa kho nas yod pa nyid dang rtog pa med par yod pa nyid med pa de dag ni gor ma chags pa thag pa bsdogs pa la btags pa'i sbrul ltar rang gi ngo bos ma

sa 444//rdo/rdoX11 kub par nges so/ /zhes chos thams cad rang gi ngo bos cung zad kyang ma grub par thag khra 'khyil ba la sbrul gzhi med du btags pa ltar/ gzhi med phar btags tsam du gsungs/ rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i spyod 'jug tu/sgyu ma'i skyes bu bsad sogs la/ /sems med phyir na sdig pa med/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i sems ldan 'a// /bsod nams dang ni sdig pa 'jing / /zhes sgyu ma la gzhi der rta glang yul steng nas dngos yod par snang yang gzhi med la snang ba tsam las med pa bzhin/ chos thams cad gzhi med kyi snang ba tsam zhig tu zad par gsungs/ —rje thams cad mkhyen pas/ thag khra la sbrul du btags tshe/ gdags gzhi thag khra'i tshogs pa dang rgyun dang ya gyal de 'a/sa gang yang gzhir der sbrul gyi mtshan gzhir bzung du med par gzhi med du sbrul snang tsam zhig yod pa de bzhin du/ gdags gzhi phung bo'i tshogs rgyun ya gyal de las gzhan pa yul steng nas grub pa gang yang bdag gi mtshan gzhir bzung du med par/ gdags gzhi blo la shar ba na gzhi med du nga'am bdag ces btags pa tsam zhig nga la 'jog pa/ des chos kun la rigs bsgre bar gsungs/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas kyang de bzhin du gsungs/dben sa bka' brgyud pa rnams nas kyang de bzhin du gsungs te/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes kyis/ gang shar rnam rtog 'dzin par yongs rig na—/ /don nam chos dbyings gzhan la ltos med 'char/ /shar ba'i ngang du rig pa zhugs pa la/ /rtse gcig mnyam par 'jog pa e ma ho/ /zhes gang shar rnam rtog gis phar bzung ba tsam du gsungs pa dang / paṇa

4/(1rwaskye sna chen thams cad mkhyen pas tshor phung la rin chen rdo rje zhes btags pa na tshor phung de'i tshogs rgyun ya gyal de las gzhan gang yang gzhi der rin chen rdo rjer bzhag tu med pa de bzhin du rin chen rdo rje'i phung bo'i tshogs rgyun ya gyal de las gang yang gdags gzhi'i ngos na med par rin chen rdo rjer gzhi med par btags tsam po 'jog par gsungs/ drung ba rta phug pas kyang / rang sdod sa'i brag phug de'i bar snang stong pa la nga zhes phar btags tshe gzhi der btsal na nga'i mtshan gzhi gang yang mi rnyed pa de bzhin du/ rang gi gdags gzhi'i ngos la btsal na nga'i mtshan gzhir gang yang mi rnyed par nga gzhi med par phar btags pa tsam du gsungs/ dam pa gzhan gyis kyang rdo seng la btags don seng ge btsal na gang yang seng ger mi rnyed pa ltar gdags gzhi'i ngos nas btsal na gang yang btags chos de'i mtshan gzhi mi rnyed cing / gzhi med btags tsam po de btags chos de la 'jog par gsungs/ yab rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ chos gar shar rang rang yul steng med/ /brda ming gis phar la bzhag pa tsam/ /zhes dang / yul gang shar ming dang rtog pas btags/ /tshur rang steng grub pa ma mchis kyang / zhes dang / yul yul can gyi snang ba 'di dag kun/ /ming phar btags ma gtogs rang steng med/ /ces chos thams cad tshur rang steng nas grub pa med par ming brda dang rtog pas btags tsam du gsungs/ rgyal mchog bdun pa chen pos/ 'khor 'das chos rnams gdod nas stong bzhin du/ /rang gi rtog pas bris pa'i ri mo la/ /bden par bzung 'dis 'khor bar sdug thag bcad/ /'khrul snang gzhi

433rtsa chod cig snying gtamā yin/ /zhes 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi ngo bos gdod ma'am thog ma nas stong bzhin du rang gi rtog pas phar gzhi med du bris pa'i ri mo tsam zhispu/ tu gsungs/ des na chos gang dang gang la 'ang gzhi med du phar btags pa tsam dang snang ba tsam po de 'jog ra/ de tsam du grub pa ni tha snyad tsam du grub pa'i tshad do/ /de'i ldog phyogs tshur rang ngos nas grub pa de la dgag bya'i bdag ces bya ste/ bzhi brgya ba 'a/sa/ 'di kun rang dbang med pa ste/ /des na bdag ni yod ma yin/ /zhes brtags pa mtha' bzung gis rang dbang du grub pa dgag bya'i bdag gi mi7nga ༵ma du gsungs la/ rang dbang ba'i don ni/ legs bshad snying bo las/ btags pa tsam min don gyi ngos nas yod pa rang dbang ba'i ngo bo'o/ /zhes don gyi ngos nas tshur yod pa la gsal bar gsungs shing / de'i zla 'grel du/ de la bdag ces bya ba ni gzhan la rag ma las pa'i ngo bo'i rang bzhin te/ de med pa ni bdag med pa bya'o/ /zhes 'dir bstan bdag gi ming tsam ni gzhan la rag ma las pa la gsungs/ de'i don ni stong thun rlorsha/ gzhan la rag ma las pa zhes pa ni/ zhes pa nas/ shes pa gzhan gyi dbang gis bzhag pa ma yin par rang gi ngos nas yod pa la zhes pa yin no/ /zhes shes pas phar bzhag ma yin par don rang ngos nas tshur yod pa la gsungs/ lhag mthong chen mor/yul rnams la blo'i dbang gis bzhag pa min par chos de rnams la rang rang gi ngos nas gnas tshul lam sdod tshul zhig yod par/ zhes pa nas/ de la

434bdag gi rang bzhin zhes zer la/ zhes bka' stsal ba 'di las lhag pa'i dgag bya mdzub tshugs su ngo sprod rgyu med/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos/ de nas nga'o snyam pa'i blo 'di la/ /nga de rtog pas phar bzhag ma yin par/ /yul gyi steng nas grub pa ltar snang ba'i/ /'char tshul brjen gyis nges par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes dang / thamasu cad mkhyen pa skal bzang rgya mtshos/ de ltar 'khrul ba'i blo la snang ba yi/ /nga sogs ngos nas grub pa'i sdod lugs 'di/ /dgag bya phra mo yin pas blo yi ngor/ /lhag ma med par khegs pa shin tu gces/ /zhes dang / yab rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ yul gang shar gzhan la ma ltos par/ /‘ram lam du 'char 'di dgag bya ngos/ /de ltar du med pa stong nyid de/ /blos de ltar 'dzin la lta ba zer/ /gsungs pa rnams ni gzhung de dag gi gnad bsdus nas dmar brjen du ston pa'i gsung ngag khyad par can yin/yul rang steng nas grub pa zhes pa de yang / da ltar rang re la snang tshul 'di ka ltar grub pa la zer te/ yab rje bla mas/ stong nyid zer na sa gzhan na med/ /da lta'i snang tshul 'di bkag pa'i/ /stong sang de la stong nyid du/ /lta khrid rnams nas bshad nas snang / /zhes dang / da ltar gyi snang tshul 'di min pa'i/ /blos byas kyi bden grub rwa rong nge / /sdug tshur gyi 'tsho'/ la gad mo 'chor/ /zhes dang / da ltar gyi snang tshul 'di mine pa'i/ /bden grub gyi snang tshul gzhan med pas/ /'di nyid mi/ 'gog pa ra ma nus na/ /rten 'brel gyi rigs pa brgya phrag giṭa// /ji tsam du dpyad kyang nyi tshe'i lta/ /zhes gsu ngas/ de

ci — 414////////sa yang yin te/ rang re so skyes la gang snang ma rig 'khrul bas ma bslad par snang ba sa/cig tsam yang med par ma rig pa bden 'dzin gyis bslad nas snang zhing des bdeslad nas snang zhes pa yul gang shar yīl steng na tshur yod par 'bad med du lam lam 'char ba 'di ka la zer/ shar ba de ltar du yod pa ni bdag gam rang bzhin yin/ dper na byad bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan snang tshe cha kun nas byad bzhin du 'bad med du lam lam 'char la de ltar du yod pa ni skabs de'i dgag bya yin la/ de las gzhan du dgag bya 'tshol mi dgos pa bzhin no/ /lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rjes kyang /da lta rang re yi blo gsal 'ga' zhig tshugs thub bden grub sogs brda la zhen pas/ snang ba lang ling 'di rang sor bzhag nas/ /dgag rgyu rwa can zhig 'tshol bar snang ste/ /sgrib med a ma yi bzhin ras de na/ /la la ling ling de yod skad mi bda'/ /zhes da lta'i snang tshul 'di bzhin du/ grub pa bden grub dang / da lta'i snang tshul 'di ka bden grub kyi snang bar gsungs/ chos de dang de yang snang mod dgag bya dang 'dres nas snang ba las de dang ma 'dres par snang ba gtan mi srid/ lta ba rnyed tshe rang ngos nas yod pa dang yod tsam gyi khyad par so sor shes mod/ da dung snang ngor 'dres nas snang / da lta'i snang tshul 'di ltar de dang de'i ngos nas med pa dpe dang sbyar nas nyams myong la bskor tshul ni/ rgyal mchog bdun pa chen pos/ gnyid kyi myos pa'i shes ngor rmi lam yul/ /sgyu mas slus pa'i rta dang glang bo sogs/ /snang ba tsam las gzhi der don gyi dngos/ /gang yang med par blo yis btags pa tsam/ /de bzhin bdag

sna 36 — gzhan 'ong ba myang 'das sogs/ /chos kun blo dang ming gi tha snyad kyis/ /btags pa tsam las gdags gzhi rnams kye steng / /rang gis yod pa rdul tsam ma mchis so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gsal byed kyi dpe la ltos nas bsarma / gal te nga zhes phung bo'i steng nyid na/ /btags tsam min par rang gis yod gyur na/ /gzhan la rags las ltos grub mi rung bas/ /bdag phung shar nub ri bzhin 'brel med 'gyur/ /gsungs pa ltar/ nga'am bdag chos can/ rang gi rgyu rkyen la rag las pa dang rang gi gdags gzhi'i phung bo sogs la ltos pa mi 'thad par thal/ sgra rtog gis phar btags min phar don rang gi ngos nas tshur grub nas yod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste rang ngos nas yod na rang dbang du yod dgos/ rang dbang gis yod na rang yod pa gzhan la rag las pa 'gal ba'i phyir te/ gzhi rang gi ngos nas yod gyur na/ /kho rang dbang yod pa'i rtags yin phyir/ /don gzhan pa ltos pa 'gal ba yin/ /rgyu cha shas sogs la ltos gyur na/ /kho rang dbang med phyir bcos su yod/ /ces gsu ngas pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i rigs pa'i sgo nas kyang bsam par bya'o/ /de ltar bsams pas blo byang na rigs pa rgya bskyed de bsam dgos pas/ 'di lta ste/ bdag chos can/des steng nas tshur grub pa med de/ rang gi gdags gzhi'i phung bo dang rang gi ngo bos rang bzhin gcig tu ma grub/ de dang rang gi ngo bos rang bzhin tha dad du ma grub pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rang gi gdags gzhi'i phung bo dang rang gi ngo bos rang bzhin gcig dang tha dad gang rung du ma grub na/ don steng nas sam rang gi ngo bos ma grub pas khyab pa'i phyir dang /

437rang gi ngo bos grub pa dang / phung bo dang rang gi ngo bos rang bzhin gcig dang tha dad gang rung ma yin pa'i gzhi mthun myi srid pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ rtsa rtags dang bo der thal/ du ma ma yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/phung bo lnga chos can/ khyod rang gi ngo bos rang bzhin gcig yin na du ma yin pas khyab ste/ khyod du ma yin pa'i phyir/ de yang rang gi ngo bos rang bzhin gcig yin na tha dad dbye ba gtan med kyi gcig yin dgos te/ ngo bo gcig kyang ldog pa tha dad kyi dbye ba byed pa ni don gyi ngos nas rdzas tha dad du yod pa la ma ltos par rtog ngo la tha dad kyi snang ba 'char ba la ltos nas yin/ rtog pa la ngo bo gcig tu snang na ldog pa'ang gcig tu snang dgos/ ldog pa tha dad du snang phyin ngo bo yang tha dad du snang ba yin te/lto ldir ba bum pa las tha dad du snang ba dang kwa ba bum pa las tha dad du snang tshul la khyad par spu tsam yang 'byed rgyu med la/ snang tshul de las lhag pa'i ngo bo tha dad du snang tshul med pa'i phyir/ rang gi ngo bos rang bzhin gcig yin na/ rtog pa la yang rang bzhin gcig tu snang dgos/ de ltar snang na ldog pa yang gcig tu snang dgos/ de ltar na gcig yin dgos pas bdag phung gnyis kyang tha dad dbye ba gtan med kyi gcig tu thal ba 'byung ba'i gnad 'di myong thog nas thag chod pa zhig skabs kun tu gal che'o/ /spyir chos can/ gcig dang du ṣṭha/'i gzhi mthun yod par thal/bdag phung bo lnga dang rang gi ngo bos rang bzhin gcig yin pa'i phyer/gzugs thes gnyis kyi yin pa yod par tharṣa// de'i phyir/ bdag chos can/rang gi mtshan nyid kyis/ skye 'jig bye daca par thakṣ-ibee/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na

438skad cig snga phyi dang skye ba snga phyi'i bdag rnams chos can/ rgyud tha dad yin la/ rang gi ngo bos tha dad du grub pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/'jug pa las/ gang dag rang bzhin nyid kyis so so ba/ /de dag rgyud gcig gtogs pa rigs ma yin/ /zhes pa'i don grub pa'i phyir/ rtsa shes ṭīka chen las kyang / gal te lha mi gzhan yin na/ /rgyud ni 'thad pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar na/ las byas pa chud za bar thal ba dang / 'a sa ma byas pa dang 'phrad par thal ba dang / skyes pa snga ma dran pa mi 'thad par thal ba dang / skyes pa phyis pa phyi ma len pa mi 'thad par thal ba dang / skye rgyun chad par thal ba dang / thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob pa mi srid par thal ba'i phyir dang / yang bdag dang bdag phung rang ngos nas rang bzhin gcig ba sa de gnyis ldog pa tha dad med pa'i gcig dgos/ des na blang bya dang len byed kyang ldog pa tha dad tsam yang med pa'i gcig tu 'gyur la/ de ltar na/ bsreg bya dang bud shing dang sreg byed me/ bsad bya lug dang gsod pa po bshan pa/ blta bya gzugs dang lta byed mig rtog bya ma rig pa dang rtogs byed rnam mkhyen gcig tu thal bas mtshon shes bya'i grangs mnyam gyi thal ba 'byung ba shes sla ba'i phyir ro/ /yang bdag dbang bo rnams dang gcig yin na/ gzugs kho na shes pa dang / sgra kho na'i yul can du thal ba sogs dang / shes pa dang gcig yin na/ bdag mig gis mi mtho nga ba dang / zas mi za ba dang / skom mi 'thung ba dang / gos mi gon pa sogs kyi thal ba mtha' yas pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de chos can/ rtsa

krortags gnyis pa de yin par thal/ rang gi gdags gzhi'i phung bo dang 'bral med ltos mid ma yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rang gi ngo bos rang bzhin tha dad du grub na/ rtog pa la 'brel med ltos med kyi tha dad du snang dgos pa'i phyir te/ rtog pa la gang dang gang tha dad du snang phyin 'brel med dang ltos med kyi tha dad du snang bas khyab ste/ lhag mthong chen po rnams ra sa/ ji ltar skyed byed du mi rung ba las rang bzhin tha dad par snang ba 'char ba'i tshe/ tha dad rang dbang ba rag ma las 'char ba bajin du rang gi sa lu'i sa bon las tha dad pa snang ba'i tshe yang tha dad kyi de ltar du snang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa'i don grub pa'i phyir/ cha dang cha can sogs tog pa la tha dad du snang tshul yang 'di kho na ltar yin ra/ bden par grub na snang tshul ltar grub dgos te/ snang tshul gnas tshul mi mthun pa ni ngardzun pa'i sdod lugs yin pas/ bden pas sdod lugs la mi 'thad pa'i phyir/gzhan yang / bdag chos can/ rang gi gdags gzhi'i phung bo med par yang shes pa sa bzung du yod par thal/ de las sa/zhan du rang bzhin gyis yod pa'i pyir/ de chos can/ rang gi snyer phung las ngo bos gzhan du med de rang gi nyer phung med par gzung du med pa'i phyir/ rtsa shes la sa/ bdag ni nye bar len pa las/ /gzhan du 'thad pa nyid ma yin/ /gal te ga'/na na len med par/ /gzung yod rigs na sa/zung du med/ /ces nga/sungs pa'i phyir/ yang bdag chos can/rmo rang gi phung bo skye ba dang / gzhon pa dang / rgas pa dang / na ba dang / 'chi bas bdag

440 skye ba sogs su mi 'jog par thal/ khyod rang gi phung bo dang 'brel med ltos med kyi don gzhan yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod rang gi phung bo dang rang bzhin gyis tha dad yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ de bzhin du sgo gsum so sos las bsags pas bdag gis lus las bsags pa sogs mi 'thad par thal/ bdag phung gnyis 'brel med ltos med kyi don ga'an yin pa'i phyir/ yid kyis stong nyid mang po mngon sum du rtags ma rtogs kyi sgo nas skye 'phags kyi khyad par 'byed mi 'thad par thal ba dang / sangs 'phags dang sems can gyi khyad par mi 'thad par thal ba dang / mnyam brnyinag pa dang rjes thob pa'i khyad parwa mi 'thad par thal ba dang / mig so gas dang ngo bos tha dad yin pas bdag gi mig gis sa/zugs mthong ba dang rna bas sgra shos pa sogs mi 'thad par thal ba dang / cinar ba dang ma zhar ba sogs kyi khyad par mi 'thad par thal ba dang / bdag la dbang bo rno rtul sogs kyi khyad par mi 'thad par tha'/ ba lta bu mtha' yasdo//yang / bdag chos can/ spyir phung bo dang yang 'brel med ltos med kyi don gzhan yin par thal/ rang gi gdags gzhi'i phung bo dang de ltar yin pa gang zhig mtshungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar yin tshe bdag la skye gnas rga 'jig gi mtshan nyid mi ldan par thal ba dang / bdag rtag pa rang byung gi chos su thal ba dang / las gsog pa po dang / rnamyo/ smin tshor ba bo dang / 'khor bar 'khor ba po dang / thar ba thob pa bo'i bdag tu mi 'thad par thal ba sogs mtha' yas so/ /de bzhin du/ bdag gi phywang bo chos can/ yul steng nas med de/ rang gi ya gya98 / gyi phung bo lnga po

1sgo sde 41//414/༷// sa dang yul steng nas gcig tu med pa gang zhig rang gi ya gyal gyi phung bo lnga po las logs su yu la steng nas med pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ bdag phung chos can/ kyigazugs shes gnyis 7/ yin par thal/ rang gi ya gyal gyi phung bo lnga ka dang gcig yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de 'dra'i gzugs phung dang gcig yin na gzugs yin dgos/ de 'dra'i tshor phung dang gcig yin na shes pa yin dgos pa'i phyir/ rtsa rtags sa/nyis nga/ ma grub na/ bdag phung dang de'i ya gyal phung bo lnga rnams chos can/ cha dang cha can ma yin par thal/ 'brel med ltos med kyi don gzhan yin pa'i phyir/ bdag gi gzugs phung chos can/ rang steng nas med de/ rang gi yan lag lnga dang lhu chen bcu gnyis sogs dang rang ngos nas gcig tu med pa gang zhig de dag dang rang ngos nas tha dad du med pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ mgo dang phongs/ lag pa dang rkang ba/ rkang lhu dang lag lhu/ kha dang rkub/mig dang rna ba sogs kyi yin pa yod par thal ba dang / gnyis pa ma grub na/ rang gi yan lag lnga sogs med par yang bdag gi gzugs phung gzung du yod par thal lo/ /bdag gi tshor phung chos/ can/ rang ngos nas med de/ rang ngos nas rang gi ya gyal bde sdug btang snyoms kyi tshor ba rnams dang gcig tu med / rang ngos nas de dag dang tha dad du med pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ bde sdug btang snyoms gsum yin pa yod par thal ba dang / sa//nyis pa ma grub na/ tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms gsum po las logs su tshor ba zhig myong rgyu yod par thal lo/ /bdag gi 'du shes byi/ phung bo choka can/ do na steng nas grub pa med de/ don

442 lke ske— — rsha spre— steng nas rang gi ya gyal gyi bkra bar 'dzin pa dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa dang / 'khrul ba dang ma 'khrul ba'i 'du shes dag dang gcig ma yin/don steng nas rang gi ya gyal gyi de dag dang tha dad du med pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ rtog bcas rtog med dang / 'khrul dang ma 'khrul gyi 'du shes kyi yin pa yod par thal ba dang / gnyis pa ma grub na/ de dag la ma gtogs pa'i 'du shes shig rang rgyud la don steng nas gzung du yod par thal lo/ /bdag gi 'du shes kyi phung bo chos can/ rang steng nas med de/rang steng nas rang gi ya gyal gyi dad pa dang zhe sdang sogs dang gcig tu med/ rang steng nas de dag dang tha dad du med pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum gyi sa/zhi mthun yod par thal ba/ phyi ma ma grub na/ rang gi ya gyal las yan gar du gzung du yod par thal lo/ /bdag gi rnam shes kyi phung bo chos can/ rang ngos nas med de/mig gi rnam shes sogs drug po re re dang rang ngos nas gcig ma yin/ de dag dang rang ngos nas tha dad ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ dbang shes dang yid shes/ rna shes dang mig shes sogs kyi gzhi mthun grub par thal ba dang / phyi ma ma grub na/ rnam shes drug las rgya yan pa'i rnam shes rang mtshan pa zhig rang rgyud la mngon gyur du yod par thal ba dang / yid dbang lus dbang gang yang ma yin pa'i dbang bo yan sa/ra ba zhig kyang rang rgyud la yod par thal lo/ /de dag la tshogs rgyun gang rung 'jog snyam na ya nga mi 'thad de/ dus mnyam pa'i ya gyal gang rung ma bzung bar tshogs rngu bzung du med/ dus snga phyi'i ya gyal ma bzung bar rgyun bzung du med pas

— — ri 443tshogs rgyun gnyis rdzas yod ma yin par grub la/ de dag rang ngos nas grub na rdzas yod yin dgos pa'i phyir/ phyi ma der la rang gi ngo bos grub na rang dbang du yod dgos/ rang dbang du yod na/ gzhan la rag ma las par yod dgos/ rang nyid bzung ba gzhan la rag ma las na rdzas yod yin dgos pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du kharma sa bco brgyad/ skye mched bcu gnyis re re la dpyad de sgom tshul de ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos/khams drug de 'dra'i nga de ma yin zhing / /de las gzhan du grub pa ma mchis pas/ /nga zhes bya ba yul gyi steng nyid nas/ /med pa lhang gis nges par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes dang / rin chen phreng ba las/ skyes bu sa min chu ma yin/ /me min rlung min nam mkha' 'ang min/ /rnam shes de ma yin kun min na/ /de las gzhan na skyes bu gang / /zhes sogs kyi skabs nas gsungs pa'i rigs pa yang dag gis sgom tshul lo/ /de yang rigs pas zhib tu gzhigs pa'i mthar 'khor 'das dang myong ba yul can dang snang ba yul gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang steng nas grub pa pa khegs te mnyam bzhag gi nges ngo la dgag bya bden grub snang ngo la stong nyid kyi don sbyi tsam las kun rdzob kyi snang ba thams cad log nas rang ngos nas grub pa khegs pa'i stong sang de ka'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog dgos te/ rje byang chub rab gsal gyis/ 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos rnams kun/ /nang gi sems kyi btags pa tsam nyid la/ /ngo bo nyid du zhen pa'i ma rig blo'i/ /dmigs gtad gzhig nga ra mdzod cig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /sems kyang ngo bos skye 'gag dang bral bas//

dngha 444 — nga stodabyings dang rang sems dbyer med sgom paṃ 'i ngor/ /myong ni nga spros pa ma lus zhi ba yi/ /stong nyid rtogs par mdzod cig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /phyag chen rtsa ba las/ yang na mnyam par 'jog pa'i ngang / /gzugs su grub zhes pa nas/ rgyun dang tshogs zhes bya ba ni/ /phreng ba dmag sogs bzhin du rdzun/ /zhes pa nas/ mnyam par zhes pa'i skabs kyi rigs pa ni/ phreng ba chos can/ rang dbang ngam yul gyi ngos nas med de/ rang gi cha shas phreng rdog rnams la ltos nas grub pa'i btags pa yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ der thal/rdzas btags gang rung gang zhig rdzas yod ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po sla/ phyi ma der thal/ rang gi cha shas phreng ldog la ma ltos par bzung du med pa'i phyir/ yang phreng ba chos can/ rdzas yod ma yin te/ rdzas yod yin na rang rkya ba'am rang dbang ba yin dgos pas btags do na btsal na yul steng nas rnyed dgos pa gang zhig de ltar mi rnyed pa'i phyir te/ phreng ba zhes pa du ma bsgrigs pa'i don can yin la/ phreng rdog re re la bsgrigs pa'i don mi tshang / phreng rdog las logs su phreng ba zhes yul steng nas grub pa zhig med pa'i phyir/ dmag dang nags tshal sogs chos so sor sbyar nas kyang dpyod tshul shes sla/ phreng ba'i tshogs pa chos can/rang dbang du med de/ rang gi cha shas la ltos nas grub pa'i btags yod yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ der thal/ rang gi dus mnyam cha shas dag ma bzung bar rang gi dus mnyam pa'i cha shas du ma 'dus pa'i tshogs pa rang nyid yan gar du gzung du med pa'i —phyir/ phreng ba'i /na chos can/

ljosdo— gerang steng nas med de/ rang gi dus snga phyi'i cha shas dag ma bzung bar/rang gi cha shas snga phyi'i 'thud pa'i rgyun kho rang 'di'o zhes rgya— yan du gzung du med pa'i phyir/ phreng ba spyi ma chos can/ rang ngos nas med de/phreng ba bye brag pa zhig reg mthong dran pa byas pa las/ phreng ba mthong ba sogs 'jog pa gang zhig phreng ba bye brag gcig ma bzung bar/ phreng ba spyi dzo ma de yul steng nas rnyed pa mi srid pa'i phyir/ dmag dang nags tshal lo zla sogs kyi tshogs rgyun rang steng nas med tshul la yang zhib tu dpyad/ khyad par gsum ldan gyi sems chos can/ yul ngos nas med de/ rang gi cha shas la ltos nas grub pa'i btags yod yin pa'i phyir/ sems kyi tshogs pa chos can/ yul ngos nas med de/ yid kyi sems gcig la nga yod par gyur pa'i sems/ dngos por gyur ba'i sems/ shes par gyur ba'i sems kyi ldog chas phyes na dus mnyam pa'i cha shas du ma yod la/ de lta'i dzo cha shas la ma ltos par sems kho rang yul steng nas 'di'o zhes gzung du med pa'i phyir/ sems kyi rgyun chos can/ yul ngos nas med de/ rang gi snga phyi'i cha zhig ma shar bar rang nyid yan gar ba gzung du med pa'i phyir/khyab ste/ yul lam don gyi ngos nas yod na rang dbang du yod pa yin pas cha shas sogs la ltos med du kho rang btsal na rnyed dgos pa'i phyir/ de ltar tshogs rgyun spyi gsu ma chos can so sor kha spos te rang ngos nas grub pa'i spyi myong steng nas legs par shar ba'i ngang nas rigs pa yang darte/ gis dpyad pas yu la steng nas grub pa zhig gtan med pa dang / rang rang gi cha shas re la reg ma thong sogs byas pas tshogs rgyun snyi gsum de dang de la'ang

446reg mthong sogs byas pa bsnyon med tshad grub tu 'jog pa la nges pa spyong —steng nas skyes na stong ba dang snang ba'i phyogs gnyirme char la nges shes rgya cher 'phel nas dbyar dus kyi chu bo bzhin du rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /yang bdag chos can/ yul steng nas tshur grubajipa med de/ rtog pas phar btags yin pa'i sbyar/ zhes pa ni/ gang shar rnam rtog 'dzin par yongs rig na/ /don dam chos dbyings gnan la stos med 'char/ /zhes pas bltan pa'i rigs pa ste/ mdo la sa/ 'di na de la byed bo 'ga' med de/ /de dag rtog pa'i dbang gis bzhag pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /khyab pa yod de/ phul steng nas tshur grub na/ rtog pas phar 'jog mi dgos te/ dper na/ tshur rang byon du babs pa'i sku yin na phar ri mor bris pa ma yin pas khyab pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir dang / bzhi brgya pa la sa kyang / yang dag don dang rtog pa zhes/ /blo dang ldan pa su zhig 'dzin/ /zhes yang dag pa'am don steng nas grub pa'i don dang rtog pas bzhag pa gnyis kyi gzhi mthun yod par 'dzin mi rung bar gsu5sa pa'i phyer/ rang la chos gang dang gang shar ba de dang de chos can/ rang rang gi yul steng nas mid de/ brda ming gis phar bzhag yin pa'i phyir te/ yab rjegyibla mas/ chos rkang sher rang rang yul stelda med/ /brda sding gis phar la bzhag pa tsam/ /'ari shes na 'chi khari 'tsher mi dgos/ /'di ma shes 'khor bar gnyan du 'khyams/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yul gang dang gang shar ba de dang de chos can/ tshur rang steng nas grwab pa ma mchis te/ phar ming dang rtog pas btags pa yin

ge wa ——— wa 44 7pa'i phyir te/ yab rjes/ yu la geng sh-ir ming dang rtogo pas smrestogs/ — /tshur rang steng spub pa ma mazis kyang / /'es gsungs pa'i phyir/ yul dadza yul can 'di dag re re nas chos can/ rang stedzwa nas med de/ ming gis phar btags kyi chos yin pa'i phyir te/ yab rjes/ lulasa.el na gyi snang ba 'di dag kun/ /ming phar btags ma gtogs rang ltango tsede/ /de dzinyam gzhag dus su nyarmas len mithil/ /rjes spung shar rgyu ma'i rol rbar ltos/ /zhes gsungs pa'i byir/ de ltar 'khor 'das kyi tshos thams cad sgra rtog gis phar bzhag gam sgro rteg gi.oṃthar thros pa rgyun 'dzin na.oṃ rtags yang dag tu bzung nas/ rang rang gi yul steng nas spyang grubo dzi med pa'i stong sango de'i ngang lalhasems glod nes mnyam par 'jog dgos te/ yab rje bla mas/ 'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa'i tshas/ /ming brda'i thar gyis bris pa tsarmi / don steng ma grub mod bzhinatshusnang / zhes dang /'khor 'das chos rnams thamaspo cade/ /nem rtog thar gyis bris pa'i/ /tha snyad ri mo yin pas/ /a nethasi mid par glod cig /ciso gamu ngas gusau/ /chos gang dang gang yin yang rang ngos nas gtan mid stong sang de'i ngang la rig pos mnyam par bzhag tshe/ rang steng naso grupa pa zhig la thogs pa'am gzung du med pas na/ pha dam dzis kyang / stong pa'i rig pa'i mdung bskor bya/ /lta ba la thogaso rdugaso med do ding ri ba/ zhis dang /mkhas grub gzhan gyis/ khyeb bradal klong yangs/ zhes pa dang / rje thams cad mkhyen pas/ stong pa khas len bral blo'i go ba/ /zhis gsungs pa dag gi dgongs pa yang / ngo 'byor yongs ba yin no/ /de ltaro chos

— 448gang yin yang yul steng don nas med pa/ gzhi med rtsa bral du nges pa drangs pa de la chad par lta ba'i skyon yod dam snya—ma pa'i dogs pa tsam yang mi dgos te/ rgyal mchog bdun pa chen pos chos thams cad gzhi rtsa bral ba'i dbyingag /blos rtsol bas gsar du bcos min yang / /don gnyug ma'i ngo bo shes pa na/ /dmigs gtad so gang yang rang sar zhi/ /zhes dang / chos can gyi snang tshul dzatha' yas 'di/ /blo 'khrul bas bzhag pas slu ba can/ /don sdod lugs snying bo btsal ba na/ /dmigs gtad so bral ba'i stong bar 'char/ /zhes dang / gzhi ltos nas grub pas stong bar mthong / /stong bzhin du snang bas rten 'brel go /'di dbu mar gnas pa'i lta ba ste/ /mtha' rtag chad g.yang la nyam mi nga / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na chos gang yang don steng nas med na/ rang re gang snang yul steng nas yod par mngon sum du snang ba 'dis gnod do snyam na/ mi gnod de/ de ltar na yang ma rig gnyid thug gis/ /sbags pa'i so so'i skyes po'i tshogs drug ngor/ /gang snang gzhi don gyis grub pa zhig /'char tshul rang re'i blo ngan 'di la ltos/ /zhes dang / phyi snang ba sna tshogs bkra ba 'di/ /rang ngo bos ston pa ma yin yang / /sems 'du byed g.yo ba'i rnam 'phrul las/ /yul bden bden 'dra ba'i ri mo mthong / /zhes de ltar snang ba ni chos rang rang yul steng nas yod pa de snang ba ma yin par/ nang ma rig pa'i 'phrul gyis de ltar snang bar gsungs pa 'dis mtshon shes byed mtha' yas pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar stong ba'i rtogs shing lta ba rnam dag rnyed nas de la bogs sam

dhed wa ri— 449 bskyed 'asdo)na dgos te/ de ma bton na ngo bo gong (raphel du mi 'gro ba'i phyir ro /des na 'di ltar bsam par bya ste/ tshogs drug so so/'i yul du chos ci dang ci shar yang snang tshul zhib mor brtags na nang gi blos phar bzhag tsam min par don rang rang gi ngos name —grub par snang ngo / /de ltar snang ba ni dgag bya'i snang tshul dang de ltar snang ba ltar grub pa ni dgag bya'i grub tshad du ngos zin na/ 'di ltar grub na lto sa med du grub dgos pa dang gzhi grub na ltos nas grub pas khyab pa rnams sngar nges zin pa ltar dran te/ don rang rang gi ngos nas ma grub pa'i gnas tshul tshig gis ma bsgribs par don brjen pa lhang gis 'char bar 'gyur ro/ /de ni snang tshul ngosajizin gyi sgo nas lta ba la bogs 'don tshul yin la/ yang gang shar gyi ngo bo ming rkyang btags yod tsam du sngar nges pa ltar dran pas ngos zin pa na/ chos 'di chos can/ don steng nas med de/ ming rkyang btags yod tsam yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ don steng nas yod na rang tshodabang ba rdzas yod yin dgos/ rdzas btags gnyis kyi gzhi mthun mi srid pa'i phyir snyam ste/ rigs pa yang dag la dran pas bskor chags byas na gang shar stong bar shar nas lta ba gong 'phel du 'gro yang gang rang ngos nas yod par shar yong tshe/ shar ba 'di ltar du med par nges te/ sgyu ma lta bu yin pa'i phyir snyam na yang bogs thon par 'gyur te/ phyag chen rtsa ba las/ de ltaraci gomasi nas/ zhes pa nas/ rtag tu skyongs/ zhes/ dang / yab rje bla mas/ sems la ji ltar shar na yang / /shor ltar ma grub sgyu ma'i chos/ —/mig la ji ltarnga snang na yang / /snang ltar ma spub sgyu ma'i chos/ zhes

sna 5() — — —— megasungs pa ltar ro/ /gang shar ngos zin gyi sgo nas melta ba skyong ba'i gnad 'di grub chen mi tra dzo ska'i snying bo don gsum gyi dgongs pa mthar thug yin la/ rang sems rgya yan du ma 'jog chos stid kyi ngang du zhog dran pa brjed med du byas la chosanyid kyi ngang du zungs/ zhes ba'ang lta ba skyes zin mu bogs 'don tshul rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi man ngag rje bla ma'i snyan brgyud/ lta khrid dran pa bzhi ldan gyi dgongs pa 'khrul med yin no/ /phyag chen las/ 'di ltar shes nas/ zhel pa nas/ ces gsungs/ zhes chos kun gcig tu sbyar nas thogs 'don tshul sgasungs pa ni/ chos gcig bden med du gtan la 'bebs byed kyi rigs pa'i 'asdos ni/ chos kun bden med du gtan la 'beebs byed kyi rigs pa'i 'gros yin zhing / chogogacig bden spub kyis stong ba'i 'gros ni/ chos kun bden grub kyis stong ba'i 'gros yin pas/ rigs pa'i rnam grangs so sor byang chub par byas te/ de nas chos can gang shar la rigs pa de'i 'gros sbyar te bden med du nges pa drangs/ stong bar bde sang nger shar ba zhig gi 'gros chos can gang shar la kha spros te stong sang nam mkha' lta bur yang yang dran par byas spyon lta ba la bskyed mig mthong lag zin gyi tshul du 'byung ngo / /'o na stong nyid rtogs nas kyang rigs pa yang dag la bsten dgos par thal/ khyod kyis bshad tshul de'i phyir zer na/ shin tu 'dod pa yin te/ lhag mthong chen po rnams las/ skyong tshul gyi gnad bsdus pa ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar nges don gyi lta ba rnyed pa des/ zhes pa nas/ rang bzhin med par gtan la 'bebs pa'i dus dang 'dra bar so sor rtog pa'i

451shes rab kyis mang du bshad nas mthar de'i don la nges pa'i shugs bskyedwa de/ zhes dang / ma dpyad na de kho na nyid la nges pa brtan la shugs drag pa mi 'ong zhing / de ma byung na nges pa'i ldog phyogs bdag sa/snyas yod par 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs de tsam du mi gnod pas daphyad sgom mang du byas pa'i sgo nas/ zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa ltar te nges 5 ra der blta bar bya'o/ /rjes thob tu sgyu ma lta bu'i stong ba yid la bya tshul ni/ sbyir bden grub tu snang yang bden grub kyi stong bas sgyu ma lta bur gsungs ba ni/ snang bzhin—du stong pas natshosgyu ma lta bu dang / bden par grub pas stong yang gzugs sogs su snang bas sgyu ma lta bur gsungs pa ni stong bzhin du snang bas na sgyu ma lta bu yin la 'dir ni phyi g.yid la bya ba'o/ /de yang sgyu ma'i rta glang mig shes kyis mthong ba dang / snang ba ltar rta glang du med par yid shes kyis nges pa la brten nas rgyun 'dzin gzhan mi dgos par de rta glang gis stong bzhin du rta glang du snang ba tsam mo/ /zhes pa dang / rdzun pa'i snang ba'o snyam pa'i nges shes skye ba de bzhin du/ chos can de dang de rang ngos nas med pa rigs shes kyis mnyam bzhag gi dus canges pa'i shugs ma yal bar yong pa dang / tha snyad shes pa la chos de dang de bsnyon du snang ba la brten nas rgyun 'jin gzhan mi dgos par 'di ni rang bzhin gyis stong bzhin du bsnyon med kyi sna nga ba tsam mo zhesalapa'am/ bden grub tu snang ba ltar med pa'i rdzun pa'i snang ba'o/ /zhes yid rshas kyi ngersā pa skye ba'o/ /lam rim las/ sgyu ma lta bu'i stong pa lo gas su sa/tan la 'beb tshul med do//zhes gsungarsā pa ni/ rang bzhin gyismirdzimed par rtog/sa pazhi nges spru drag ngo

452 de nyid kyi rang stobs spyi snang ba shar ba na sgyu ma lta bur 'char bar 'gyur bas rtags stobs kyis gtan la 'bebs mi dgos pa'i don yin gyi/ sgyu ma lta bu yin par rigs pa yang dag gis dpyad mi chog gsungs pa min no/ /nges shes 'di ni tha snyad shes pa yin te/ rdzun pa'i snang ba dang snang stong gnyis tshogs 'dzin stangs kyi yul du byed pa gang zhig de gnyis kun rdzob yin pa'i phyir ro/ /lung gi sgo nas yid la bya tshul yod de/ ting 'dzin rgyalnga bo'i mdo las/ ji ltar smig sgyu'i dri za'i— grong khyer/ /zhes pa nas/ de bzhin shes par gyis/ zhes pa lta bu'i lung don yid la byas te bsam pa'o/ /de yang chu zla sogs snang ba na gzhi der don dngos zla ba sogs gtan med par gzhi med kyi rdzun snang tsam zhig bsnyon med du snang ba yin pa de bzhin du/ tshogs drug gi yul du snang ba 'di dag kyang don rang gi ngos nas rdul tsam yang med par gzhi med kyi snang ba tsam zhig bsnyon med du sna nga ba'o snyam du bsam pa ste/ gang snang ming rkyang btags yod tsam du nges pa'o/ /de yang rjes thob tu rgyun chags su dran par bya dgos te/rang sems rgya yan du ma 'jog snang stong gi ngang du zhog dran pa brjed med du byas la snang stong gi ngang du zungs/ zhes gsu ngas pa ltar ro/ /de ltar snang stong sa/nyis ka'i phyogs la nges pa cha mnyam du rnyed pa sa/la che ste/ lam rim las/ de 'dra ba'i snang stong la nges pa 'dren pa gnyis /tshoṭa de srid mtha' ru song bas dbu ma'i lta ba shin tu rnyed dka' ba la/ lkortswadang / dka' sa ni rang gi ngo bos spub pa'i rang bzhin ma lus par khegs pa dang rang bzhin med pa'i gang zag la sogs pa de nyid las gsog pa po

da wa4 5 dzo— 'bras bu myong ba po la sogs par 'jog pa la nges pa gting nas 'dros te/de rnams su 'jog thub pa'i gnyis tshogs de srid mtha' tsam du song bas da bu ma'i lta ba shin tu rnyed dka' ba yin no/ /zhes gsu ngas pa'i phyir/ de gnyis las kyang yul rang gi ngo bos grub pa cha thams cad nas bkag pa'i shul tu/ gzhi med byi snang ba tsam po dang / gzhi med kyi btags pa tsam po de la khyab byed tshad grub bsnyon med du 'jog thub pa de lhag par dka'/ bsnyon zhes pa rdzun byas pa'i don yin pas don la med bzhin du yod ces u tshugs kyis rdzun bya mi dgos par nges par tshad grub tu yod chog pa ni bsnyon med du grub pa'i don no/ /des na nges pa de nyid gting tshugs par skye ba dang 'phel ba ni/ lung rigs dpe gsum rgya bskyed nas yang yang bsam pa la rag las pas dang po dpe'i sgo nas bsam pa ni/ sgyu ma'i rta glang sogs don rta glang sogs kyis stong bas na gzhi der rta so gas med pa'i snang ba tsam zhig yin pa dang / de nyid sngags rdzaru/ sogs kyi rgyu rkyen las skye ba dang mig shes skyed pa'i don byed nus pa'ang yin pa bsnyon mi nus pa bzhin du/ gang zag sogs don gyi ngos nas med pas gzhi med kyi snang ba tsam zhig yin pa rang rgyu las nyon las skye ba dang rnam smin myong ba'i bya ba byed nus pa'i gzhi mthun du bsnyon mi nus par nges pa 'dren — mi 'o/ —/rmi lam gyi gzugs deng mig dang mig shes sogs don dngos tshur grub cig med par sems kyis phar snang ba dang phar btags pa tsam yin pha dang snang ba de nyid gnyid la rag spas pa dang sad pa'i tshe na sems la dga' sdug sogs skyed pa'i bya ba byed nus su mthong nas rang ngos nas medari

454pa dang rgyu las skye zhing 'bras bu skyed pa'i don byed nus pa'i gzhi mthun bzhag rung lugs bsam mo/ /yang byad bzhin gyi gzurges brnyan de nyid gang du snang ba byad bzhin byu gtan med kyang kho gzugs kyi skye mched yin pa dang rang 'thas mig shes kyi rgyu yin pa bsnyon mi dgos pa de bzhin du/gathugs sogs kyang gang du snang ba yul steng nas grub pa'i gzugs sogs —kyis stong yaja kho gzhi med nu snang ba dang rgyu ‘5sa skyes pa dang rang 'bras bskyed pa bsnyon mi dgos tshul sems pu'o// (sga 'khor) yang zhis sogs kyi sgru brnyan snyes bu'i ngag ltar 'gyur khug sogs kyi gabangs ji ltar yod pa de ltar snang yang sgra 'arnyan de la skyes bu'i ngag rdul tsam yang med pa dang gzhi med snang tsam po des rna shes sogs skyed pa bsnyon du med pa dang / tho yor la gzhi med du 'dre zhes phar btags tsam po dang / thag khra la gzhi med du sbrul phar btags tsam pos 'jigs snang skyed pa bsnyon du med pas/ gzhi med phar btags tsam la bya byed thams cad ches 'thad pa yang yang bsam pa'o/ /de ltar gsung rab dang bstan bcos las bstan pa'i dpe gang bde sna tshogs gyi sgo nas nges pa tsal bar bya'o/ /lung la rten nas bsam pa ni/ sher phyin 'as/ stong pa nyid gzugs so nes sogs kyis/ rang ngos narsā stong pa yang yin gzugs tshad grub kyang yin pa'i gzhi mthun nas/ rang ngos nas stong pa dang tshad grub kyi rnam mkhyen yang yin pa'i gzhi mabun bsnyon med du 'jog tshul dang / gang zhig rkyen las skyes pa der ma skyes/ /de la skyes pa'i rang bzhin yod ma yin/ /zhesu rkyen larsā skyes pa dang / rang bzhin gyis skye med pa'i gzhi mashān 'jog

455par gsu ngas/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ gang la stong pa nyid rung ba/ /de la thams cad rung bar 'gyur/ zhes rang bzhin gyis stong pa dang tshad grwab kyi chos de gnyis kye gzhi mthun du rung bar gsungs/ dpal ldan zla bas/ de bzhin dngos po thams cad stong na yang / /stong nyid gang la sa rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes rang bzhin gyis stong ba'i rgyu'i dngos po las rang bzhin gyis stong ba'i 'bras bu'i dngos po bsnyon med du skye bar gsungs/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu bsad sogs la/ /soms med phyir na sdig pa med/ /sgyu ma'i sems dang ldan pa la/ /bsod nams dang ni sdig pa 'byung / /zhes sgyu ma'i skyes bu dang skyes bu gnyis ka gzhi med kyi snang tsam du 'dra bas don steng nas stong yang / sgyu ma lta bu'i sems btags tsam ji/ga ldan pa 'dir skyes bu dngos la bsten nas bsod nams dang sdig pa skye ba 'thad par gsungs pa dang / 'brom ston pas/ don ye stong yin yang dbu ma chen por shar/ /'e/sa do na rang steng nayogrub pas ye nas sam thog ma nas stong pa dang med pa min pas dbu ma tshen po'am mtha' gnyis las grol bas dbus yin par gsungs pa dang / rje thams cad mkhyen pas/ 'di ltar byad bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan ni migatshudang rna ba la sogs pa gang du snang ba rnams kyis stong yang byad dang me long la brten nas skye ba dang / rkyen de dag 'ga' zhig log pa'i tshe 'jig pa gnyis bsnyon mi nus par ba/zhi mthun du 'du ba bzhin du/gang zage la'ang rang bzhin rdul tsam med kyang las gsog pa po dang 'bras bu myong ba po dang sngon gyi las dang nyon mongs sogs la brten nas skye ba'ang

456 mi 'gal lo/ /zhes gsungs/ paṇa chem thams cad mkhyen pas/ ming rkya nga gi chos bden pas stong / /bden stong kun rgyu 'bras rol bar shar/ /stong pa dang rgyu 'bras dbyer med lam/ /e ma ho bla ma'i drin gyis rnyed/ /a la la rtag chad kyi g.yang las grol/ /zhes dang / 'khor 'das rang bzhin rdul tsam med pa dang / /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel slu ba med pa gnyis/ /zhes rang bzhin gyis stong pa dang rgyu 'bras kyi rol ba'am bkod pa'i gzhi ma thun gsungs pa dang / yab rje bla mas/ ming brda tsam rten 'brel ri mo la/ /las rgyu 'bras bslu med 'char ba dang / zhes dang / tshur rang steng grub pa ma rma chis kyang / /ming brda tsam rten 'brel spruchar tshul la/ /gnad 'khrul med ma rnyed gol pa che/ /zhes tshur rang steng nas med pa dang / ming brda tsam gyis bzhag pa'i gzhi mthun la/ tshad grub kyi gnad don 'khrul med rnyed dgos par gsungs pa dang /thams cad mkhyen pa bskal bzang rgya mtshos/ gnyid 'khrul gyi rmi lam mi bden kyang / /sems dga' sdug bskyed pa'i nus pa bzhin/ /ltos grub kye rten 'bre ra mi slu bas/ /las rgyu 'bras blang dor gzab par 'tshal/ /zhes dang / 'on kyang skyes bu'i bzhin dang me long gsal/ /phrad tshe stong ba'i gzugs brnyan bsnyon med du/ /shar bzhin chos kun snang dang stong pa zung / /gcig tu 'du ba'i rten 'brel bslu med phyir/ /zhes dang / rje byang chub rab gsal gyis/ rang bzhin gyis beed kyang sgyu ma rmi lam ltar/ /tha snyad tshad grub snang ba mi 'a gog par/ /dngos kum/ snang stong zung du 'jug pa yi/ /rten

457'byung nges rnyed rmā dzod cig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /zhes sogs kyis snang ba tshad grub dang rang gi ngo bos/ stong pa gnyis zud du 'jug pa'am gzhi mthun du 'du bar gsal bar gsu ngas so/ /lung don de dag sems steng la bskor nas bsam pa'i tshe yang / snang tsam po dang btags tsam po tshad grub tu 'jog thub pa'i nges pa rnyed par rlom yang snang tsam po dang btags tsam po gzhi med rtsa bral du ma nges par rang rgyud pa'i lta bar gol ba mang bas gong 'og kun tu gzhi med kyi snang ba dang gzhi med kyi btags tsam zhes nan sbyar byas pa ni snyan brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa gong ma rnams kyi gsung brjen pa yin pas dgos pa shes dgos so/ /rigs pa'i rdzo nas bsam tshul ni/ ming phar btags tsam po la tshad grub 'jog dgos par thal/ rang gi lag pa la reg pas nga la reg pa de btags tsam dang btags don btsal nas rnyed pa gang rung la 'jog pa gang zhig phyi ma la 'jog pa mi rnyed pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste de yod pa'i phyir te/ de tha snyad pa'i shes pa la grags pa gang zhig grags pa'i don la tha snyad dpyod pa'i rigs shes dang don dam dpyod pa'i rigs shes gang gis kyang mi gnod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ lam rim las/ de la tha snyad du yod par 'dod pa dang med par 'dod pa ni ci 'dra ba zhig gi sgo nas lajog pa yirtsa/ snyam na/ tha snyad pa'i shes pa la grags pa yin pa dang / ji ltar graganu/ the'i don de la tha snyad pa'i tshad ma gzhan gyis sa/nod pa medo pa dang / de kho na nyid la'am rang bzhin yod med tshul bzhin du dpyod pa'i rigs pas garnad pa mi 'bab pa zhig ni tha snyad du yod par 'dod la/ de

da las ldog pa ni med par 'ardod do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ ri bor rwa la tha snyad tshad mas gnod de/ de med par rtogs pa'i tshad ma la ni tha snyad dpyod pa'i rigs shespoyin pa'i phyir/ bden spub la/ don dam pa'i tshad mas gnod de/ de med par rtogs pa'i tshad ma ni don dam dpyod pa'i rigs shes yin pa'i phyir/ gong gi rtsa rtags phyi ma btagyi/sa don btsal nas rnyed pa la 'jog pa med de/ lag pa nga ma yin/ lag pa lasas/zhan pa'i yul steng nas grub pa zhig la reg pa btsal na mi rnyed pa'i phyir/ yang ming phar btags tsam la bya byed 'thad de/ rang gi lag pa na nas nga na ba dang rang gi lag pa sos pas nga sos par 'jog pa gang zhispu lag pa yang nga ma yin/ lag dzi sogs las gzhan pa'i nga min gar ba yang med pa'i phyir/ 'di ni 'jug ṭīka chen po las ming / legs bshad snying bo las/ de ltar bshad pa'i rigs pa sbyar pa na/ /gang phyir 'jig rten lag pa na ba la/ /bdag ni na'o snyam du rtog deru/ na/ /de gnyis sa gzhan 'jig rten 'angasakyang med/ /ces smra dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongasapa'o/ /yang / ming brdas phar bzhag tsagal tshad grub rung ste/ bu'i lasamis bon btapa nas rjes sor bu 'di ngas paskyed do zhes 'jog pa dang / shing sdong gi sa bon tsam btab nas rjes sor shing sdong btsugs par 'jog pa pyigang zhig de ni midzwa brdas bzhag rtsem larung gi/ btags don btsal ba la mi rung pa'i phyir/ der thal/ btags don btsal na de 'dra'i sa bon ni bu dang shing sdong ma yin la sa bon la sa skegazhan pa'i bu dang shing sdong rang ngos nas grub pa zhig yod na de gnyis

459rang rang gi satsho bon dang ltos med du 'gyur ba'i byir/ 'di ni 'jug pa las/ gang phyir 'jig rten sa bon tsam btab nas/ /:bdag gi bu 'di bskyed ces smra byed cing / /shing yang btsugs so snyan du rtog des na/ /gzhan las skye ba 'jig rten las kyang med/ /ces pa'i don du gnas so//yang rtog btags tsam la 'jig rten grags pa'i rnam bzhag bsnyon med du 'jog ste/ btags don btsal nas de dag 'jog sa mi rnyed pas med par khas blangs na kun brlag pa'i nyes pas reg pa'i byir te/ 'jug pa las/ 'jig rten grags pa'i rnam bzhag kun kyang brlag /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang / yin lugs la ma dpyad par 'jug pa'i shes bas bzhag tsam la bya byed thams cad 'jog dgos/ yin lugs dpyod pa'i shes pas btsal ba ltar rnyed pa la yod pa dang / deyobatsal ba ltar ma rnyed pa la med par 'jog na gang yang bzhag tu mi rung ba'i phyir te/'jug pa las/ 'jig rten grags pa'i kun rdzob ma brlag cig /ces pa'i lung don grub pa'i phyir/ yang / yin lugs mi 'tshol ba'i shes pas bzhag tsam la tshad grub 'jog dgos te/ btags don la dpyad pa dang ma dpyad pa'i don gang rung la tshad grub 'jog dgos pa gang zhig btags don la dpyad pa'i don la 'jog sa mi rnyed pa'i phyir te/ 'jug pa las/gang phyir dngos po 'di dag rnam dpyad na/ /de nyid bdag can dngospolas tshur rol tu/ /gnas rnyed ma yin de phyir 'jig rten gyi/ /tha snyad bden la rnam par dbya da mi bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang / yin lugs la'am btags don la mi dpyod pa'i 'jig rten pa'i shes pa bzhag

460 tsam la shing rta dang / de'i yan lag can dang / cha shas can sogs ming gi khyad par kun 'thad la/ btags don btsal nas gcig tha dad sogs rnam pa bdun po gang la'ang de dag 'jog pa mi rnyed pa'i phyir te/ 'jug pa las/ de ni de nyid du'am 'jig rten du/ /rnam pa bdun gyis 'grub 'gyur min mod kyi/ /rnam dbyad med par 'jig rten nyid las 'dirari/ /rang gi yan lag brten nas 'dogs pa yin/ /de nyid yan lag can de cha shas can/ /shing rta de nyid byed po zhes 'gro snyad/ /skyesasna po rnams la len po nyid du 'grub/ /ces dang / de rnams shing rta'i rnam dpyad byas pas rnam bdun yod pa ma yin zhing / sno /de las gzhan du gyur bar 'jig rten grags pa'i sgo nas yod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/'di dag la dgongs nas tshig gsal du tha snyad 'jog tshul 'jug par zhal 'phangs mdzad cing / rje thams cad mkhyen pas tha snyad 'jog tshul 'jug pa rgyas par gsungs pa yin pa'i phyir/ mdor na/ rtsa shes ṭīka chen las/ de ltar rang gi ngo bos grub pa la rgyu 'bras khas blang du mi rung bar mthong na/ phan gnod byed pa'i rgyu 'bras la ni su sa kyang bsnyon du med pas yod pa la/ rang gi ngo bos yod pa la ni bzhag tu mi rung pa'i phyir/ ming gi tha snyad kyi dbang gis bzhag pa tsam la de dag 'thad do zhes khas blang par bya'o/ /zhes bka' stsal ba ltar sngon sbyangs kyi las 'phro dang bag chags yod pa/ skyes thob kyi shes rab che ba dag gis sngar ltar lung rigs dpe gsum gyi sgo nas rgya cher bsams te shes nas mi ldog pa'i nges pa brtan po — bskyed cing ci 'phel bya'o/ /yang de nyid— las/ bskyed bya skyed byed rang

461 —gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa'i steng nas 'jog pa la goms ches pas de bkag na ming gi tha snyad kyi dbang gis bzhag pa tsam la de dag 'jog pa blo la mi bde yang / 'jog tshul gnyis las med la snga ma la mi 'thad na/ phyi ma la 'jog pa las 'os med do snyam du blo de yi phyogs su drang dgos so/ /zhes dang / lam rim las/ zab mo dbu ma'i gzhung la sbyangs pa'i grogs/ /khyed kyi blo ngor rang bzhin med pa la/ /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel 'jog pa dka' mod kyang / /de 'dra'i dbu ma'i lugs ni yin no zhes/ /de skad smra ba'i tshul la brten na mdzes/ /zhes gdams pa ltar/ sngon sbyangs kyi rbeg chags zhan cing / skyes sbyangs kyi blo gros dman la/ mos nas yid la byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyis kyang ming gi dbang gis bzheg tsam la tshade grub bsnyon med du 'jog pa'i phyogs la blo drangs te gsol 'debs dang smon lam sogs la'ang brtson par bya'o/ /gzhan yang nges pa 'di ni stong pa rten 'byung dang rten 'byung stong pa'i don du mthong ba rnams la bde blag tu nyaphel bar 'gyur bas snying bo gsal ba mang bor bsdus pa zhig brjod par bya ste/ — 'di ltar/ sa bon mang bar ma btab pa las 'bras bu mang bar 'byung ba/ sa bon tsha ba btab pa las 'bras bu tsha ba 'byung ba sogs rgyu 'bras kyi rnam bzhag bsnyon med du khas blangs dgos pa'i phyir na/ rgyu 'abhas rnams rang gi yul ngos nas yod pas stong bar nges te/ rgyu 'bras de dag rang gi yul ngos nas yod na/ da lta rang re la yul steng nas 'brel med ltos med kyi tha dad du snang ba 'di —bzhi—na tshod dgos/ de ltar yod na

462 'brel med ltos med kyi chos la rgyu 'bras bzhag tu mi rung bas rgyu 'bras sogs kyi rnam bzhag thams cad med par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /don de la dgongs nas/ rang bzhin dag ni bcos min dang / /gzhan la ltos pa med pa yin/ /snes dang / rang bzhin bcos min ltos med dang / /rten 'brel ltos dang bcos ma gnyis/ /ji lta bur na gzhi sa/cig la/ /mi 'gal 'du bar nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ yang 'bras bu rnams chos can/ rgyu rkyen la mi ltos par thal/ rang gi ngo bos grub pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rang nyid ngo bos grub na rang nyid yod pa rang dbang gis yod pa yin gyi chos gzhan gyi dbang gis yod pa min dgos pa gang zhig de ltar na rang nyid 'grub pa rgyu rkyen gzhan la rag las pa 'gal ba'i phyir te/ngo bos grub na de 'grub pa/ /rgyu dang rkyen la ltos pa 'gal/ /zhes dang / lam rim las/ rang bzhin de 'dra ni rang gi ngo bo dang rang bzhin dang rang dbang ba'i don yin pas/ de 'dra ba yod na ni rgyu rkyen gzhan la rag —las pa 'gal te/ mi 'gal na ni grub zin pa'i bum pa slar rgyu rkyen las skye mi dgos pa khas blang du mi rung ba bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dper sgyu ma'i rta glang don steng nas rta glang du grub na de nyid 'gub pa sngags rdzas la rag ma las pa dang / lha'i gzugs ris sogs lha gzugs sogs su don steng nas yod na phar pir gyis 'bri ba la rag ma las dgos pas/ sgyu ma'i rta glang chos can/ don steng nas rta glang du med de/ rang nyid grub pa sgyu ma'i sngags rdzas la ltos pa'i phyir/ lha'i gzugs ris chos can/ lha gzugs dngos kyis stong ste/ rang nyid 'grub

— 44//rdo ༷//pa pir gyis 'bri ba la ltos pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu rnams chos can/ yul rang gi ngos nas stong ste/ rang nyid 'grub pa rgyu rkyen la ltos pa'i phyir/zhes pa'i dpe don gyis sbyor ba rnams kyis rten 'byung stong ba'i don du rtogs sla ba'i phyir/ de bzhin du yul dang yul can/ spang bya spong byed/thob bya dang 'thob byed sogs bya byed thams cad rten nas 'byung ba yin na/ rang gi don steng nas stong pas khyab dgos pas/ rtsa shes las/ gang phyir rten 'byung ma yin pa'i/ /chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin la/ /de'i phyir stong pa ma yin pa'i/ /choso 'ga' yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes rten 'byung la stong pas khyab pa gsungs so/ /bya byed sogs snang ba tshad grub 'thad la de yang don steng nas grub na mi 'thad pas don steng nas grub pa sel ba'am dgag pas/ gzhan yang snang bas yod mtha' sel ba dang /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /'bras bu rnams don steng nas spub pas stong bas rang dbaja gis yo da pas stong / rang dbang gis yod pas stong bas rang gi rgyu rkyen la ltos med yin pas khegs/ de khegs pas na rang gi rgyu rkyerna la stos nas 'grub pa 'thad do/ /des na rang bzhin gyis ma grub na rgyu 'bras stos grub 'thad par mthong nas stong pa rten 'byung gi don du 'gro ba yin no/ /dper na/ sgyu ma don dngos kyis stong pas na snang ba de sngags rdzas la rag las pa dang / lha'i sa/zugs ris lha gzugs dngos kyis stong pas na pir gyis 'bri ba la ltos pa 'thad pa bzhin no/ /'bras bu rnams chos can/ ltos nas grub ste/ rang dbang gis stong pa'i phyir/zhes pa lta bu ni stong pa rten 'byung gi don du ngos zin gong 'phel du gtong

464ba'i rigs pa yang dag yin no/ /mi shes pa mgo mkhregs kha cig gis/ ri bong rwa chos can/ ltos nas grub par thal/ rang dbang gis stong pa'i phyir zer na/ snga ma la gzhan gyi dbang gis yod pas stong pa gcod phyir rang dbang zhes dgag bya'i khyad par sbyar la/ ri bong rwa la rang dbang dang gzhan dbang gang gis kyang grub pa dgos pas khyad par ma sbyar bar stong ba'i phyir zer dgos te/ rtsa shes las/ stong nyid dgos dang stong nyid dang / /stong nyid don ni ma rtogs pas// /zhes bar ba rang ba'in gyis stong pa zhes pa'i smra don ma rtogs pa'i rtsod par bshad pa'i don la soms shig de dag ni/ khyod ni nam zhig stong pa nyid/ /rten 'byung don du mthong ba na/ /rang bzhin gyis ni stong pa dang / /bya byed 'thad pa mi 'gal zhing / /zhes dang / stong bas med mtha' sel zhing stong pa nyid/ /rgyu dang 'bras bur 'char ba'i tshul shes na/ /zhes sogs kyi don 'khrul med yin no/ /rang rgyud kyi log spyig na re/ ming brdas bzhag tsam la tshad grub rung na/ ri bong rwa yang tshad grub tu thal lo/ /zer na/ ming brdas bzhag tsam yod kyang de yin na yod pas ma khyab ste/ legs bshad snying bo las/ 'dir ming gi tha snyad 'dogs pa'i blos gang bzhag tha snyad du yod pa mi batshe/da kyang / tha snyad 'dogs pa'i blo'i dbang gis ma bzhag pa'i tha snyad du yod pa mi bzhed do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ chos de dang de la de dang de'i ming 'jog par thal/ chos thams cad ming tsam mam ming rkyang tsam yin pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab ste/ ming rkyang zhes pas ming gis phar btags min pa'i don yod— pa gcod kyi ming las don /

465 yod pa mi gcod pa'i phyir te/ legs bshad snying bo las/ ming tsam gyi don ni/ sngar ltar tha snyed kyi don btsal na mi rnyed pa la byed kyi ming yod cing don med pa'am ming ma yin pa'i don med pa ni ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ rang la ltos pa'i rang rgyud kyi phung bo dang phyi'i yod byad sogs de dag snang ba'i rang rgyud kyi rtog pa yod dus de dag yod la de dag snang ba'i rang rgyud kyi rtog pa 'gags dus de dag med 'gro bar thal/ rtog pa yod pa kho nas yod pa nyid dang rtog pa med par yod pa nyid med pa/ zhes sogs 'thad pa'i phyir zer na/ rtog pa yod pa kho nas zhes pas rtog pa la ma ltos pa'i rang ngos nas yod pa sgocod kyi rtog pa las gzhan rgyu dang cha shas sogs la ltos pa ga la gcod/ rtog pa med par mermed ces pa'ang rtog pa la gtan ma ltos par med ces pa yin gyi de dang rtog pa grangs sprod du yod dgos pa ga la yin/ rang gi phung bospyodang ri rwa ba khang khyim sogs rang ngos nas med stabs rgyu sogs la ltos pa dang / de yang rgyu gcig la kun byed pa'i nus pa med pas gang byed pa'i nus pa can de dgos pa/ de 'dra'i nus ldan gyi rgyu'i nus pa ma zad bar da dung phung bo sogs kyang mi ldog pa yin pa'i phyir te/ spyod 'jug las/sna tshogs rkyen las byung ba yi/ /sgyu ma de yang sna tshogs nyid/ /rkyen gcig gis ni kun nus pa/ /gang na yang ni yod ma yin/ /zhes dang /rkyen rnams rgyun ni ma chad na/ /sgyu ma'ang ldog par mi 'gyutna gyi/ /rkyen rnams rgyun ni chad pa na/ /kun rdzob tu yang mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes sa/sungs pa'i dpe don sbyor tshuḍa gal che ba'i phyir/ kho na re/ chos gang dang rtog

466pas phar bzhag pa na 'grub tu chug kyang btags tsam snga ma snga ma de las btags tsam phyi mardzi'abyung ba mi 'thad do zer na/ rtsa shes las/ dper na sprudzibs sprul gzhan zhig /sbrul ba mdzad ba de bzhin no/ /zheyogasungs pa ltar/ don la snang ba ltar ma grub ba sprul ba dang / gzugasadhebarnyan dang / bragardzicha sogs las rang gi rigs 'dra'i 'bras bu phyi oṃ'abyung ba ltar/ gzhi med kyi snang tsam dang / gzhi med kyi btags tsam snga ma sdoms rang gi rigs 'dra phyi ma skyed pa shin tu 'thad de/ 'di yang rang ngos nas med pa la thug go/ yang zhis(sgra 'khor)sgra brnyan gyi rgyur gyur pa'i skyes bu'i ngag la 'gyur khug sogs ji ltar thod pa dang tha na bzhad gad byas pa tshun chad 'a/sa sgra—brnyan de ji lta ba'i rnam par go rispodu skye bar ma zad/ rgyu'i ngag de 'gags nas yun ring lon pa las kyang de 'dra'i sgra brnyan skye ba dang / sgra brnyan snga ma las phyi ma skye ba sogs shin tu gsal ba'i dpe las/ don mtshon byas na nges pa 'drongs phul che'o/ /de ltar snang ba tshad grub bsnyonagamed du grub pas rang gi ngo bos stong pa la mi gnod/yul rang steng nas gtan naspomed pas snang tsamatshad grub bsnyon med du yod pa la mi sa/rnod pa dang / lhag par snang ba tshad grub 'thad pas rang ngoganas med dgos pa dang / rang gi ngo bos med pas na snang tsam tshad grub tu 'thad dgos pa'i nges shes gnyis po gcig grogs su gcig 'gro ba zhig byung na/ phyag chen las/ snang bas stong pa mi sgrib cing / /stong bas snang ba mi 'gog par/ /stong dang rten 'byung don gcig pa'i/ lam bzang de tshe mngon su ma 'gyur/ /nes dang / rje bla rma sa/ nges pa

461gnyis po phan tshun du/ /gegs med par ni grogs byed pa/ /'di la sa ngo mtshar gyur pa dang / /'di las rmad du byung ba gang / /zhes gsungs pa'i don rang lag tu chud pa yin no/ /de 'dra'i stong nyid chos can/ gdod nas stong ba'i stong ba yin gyi blos byas kyi stong pa ma yin te/ rang rgyud pa man chad ltar rang gi blos gsar du byas pa'i dgag bya rags pa zhig bkag pa'i stong pa ma yin par/chos rang rang gi ngo bos gdod ma nas stong ba'i stong nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de 'dra'i stong nyid chos can/ khyab pa'i stong nyid yin gyi nyi tshe ba'i stong pa ma yin te/ chos can phyogs re la khyab pa'i stong pa ma yin par/ chos can kun la khyab pa'i sto/nga nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de 'dra'i stong nyid chos can/ rang stong yin gyi gzhan stong ma yin te/ chos can rang gi ngo bo dgag bya gzhan zhig bkag pa ma yin gyi/ chos can rang nyid rang gi ngo bos grub pas stong ba'i stong nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de 'dra'i stong nyid chos can/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong snyad yin gyi/ chad pa'i stong ba ma yin/ bya byed sogs cha thams cad nas gtan med kyi stong ba ma yin par tshas thams cad gra zur tsam yang ma nyams par tshad grub bsnyon med du khas blang chog pa'i stong nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar gzhi rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid rtogs na lam rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong grid 'thob/ de 'thob na 'bras bu rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid mngon du 'gyur bas/dngos grub 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i yongs 'du'i 'khri shing las/ byis pa 'drid pa'i nyi tshe'i stong ba dang / /gang yang ma dmigs chad pa'i stong ba

46skyo dzo —— ci — las/ /grol ba'i lta ba mchog gi dga' ston gyi/ /bde bas tshim par mdzod cig khajam pa'i dbyangs/ /zhes dngos grub zhu ba dang / bzhi dbargya ba las/ yang dag mthong na mchog tu la/ /cung zad mthong na— bzang 'gro ste/ /de phyir nang ba dag bsams la/ /mkhas nga sa rtag tu blo gros bskyed/ ces gdams pa snying la bcings rme don yod par byas pa yin no/ /'di yang dab ma chen po'i lta ba'i bka' babs 'gran zla med pa stogrub dbang don yod rno rje'i gsung gi rol mo lagasarme/ —/ rmo bye

469snying bo don gsum gyi nyams khrid skyong tshul bklag chog gi tshul du bkod pa dag zhing bgrod pa'i them skas bzhugs so/ /thugs rje ga bur 'thul ba'i zegs ma yang / /'gro la gtan du bsil ba'i rtse dga' yis/ /grags pa'i me tog phyogs kyi mthar song ba/ /de yis dge legs phreng ba ring bos skyongs/ /'dir 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis grub chen mi dra dzo ki la gnang ba'i gdams dzi zab mo snying po don gsum zhes dam pa rnams kyis thugs rtsis shin tu gnang ba de nyid nyams su len pa'i dmigs khrid bklag chog gi tshul du 'god par bya'o/ /de yang rtsa tshig las/ /tshe 'dir rgyun gyi yi dam sgom/ /'chi khar 'pho ba'i man ngag sgom/ /bar dor bsre ba bsgom bya ste / /rgyun du sgo ma pa kun gyi gnad// /ces gsu ngas pa ltar 'di la bzha/tshe 'di'i gdaye sa ngag gi snying po rgyun gyi yi dam sgom pa/ 'chi kha'i gdams ngag gi snying po 'pho ba sgom pa/ bar do'i gdams ngag gi snying po bsge ba sgom pa/ de gsum ka'i skabs su lta sgom spyod gasnyem nyams su len

470tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum// sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ sngon 'gro thun mong ba dang / thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa tshig las/ mi rtag sdug bsngal dran byas nas/ /nes gsungs pa ltar bsam pa la/ slu'o sdod sa'i gnaso kyis slu/ /zhag mal gcig gi mtsher sa bzhin/ /slu'o gces pa'i lu sa kyis slu/ /zhag 'gar g.yar ba'o mgron khang bzhin/ /slu'o zhes sa 'i grogs kyis slu/ /zhag gcig 'grogs pa'i don mthun bzhin/ /slu'o bsags pa'i nor gyis slu/ /gzhan gyis bcol ba'i rnor rdzas bzhin/ /slu'o lang tsho'i mdangs kyis slu/ /ba mo phog kha'i me tog bzhin/ /slu'o kha yi dbugs kyis slu/ /dbyar dus ri mgo'i na bun bzhin/ /rū'o 'tsho ba'i srog gis slu/ /snum khu zad kha'i rma ra me bzhin/ /slu'o snyan grags sgra yis slu// /bar snang 'brug gi stong skad bzhin/ /slu'o tshe 'di'i bya bas slu/ /don med byis pa'i rol rtsed bzhin/ /slu'o 'di snang bsgrubs pas slu/ /tshong bas brdar ba'i gru rdo bzhin/ /zhesri gsungs pa ltar lugosrog longs spyod nye du gang yang mi rtag cing myur du rang mtshang bstan nagaslu bar 'gyur la/ shi ba'i 'og tu ngan song du skyes na dmyal ba la tsha grang / yi dwags la bkres skom/ dud 'gro la bkol spyod sogs kyi sdug bsngal ha cang che bar ma zad bde 'gro la yang ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal dang cha 'dra ba du mas rgyun chags su mnar dang mnar bar 'gyur pa gang rung la sa ma 'das pas/ de las skyob nus kyi skyabs gnas zhig btsal dgos/ spyod 'jug las/ sdig pa shin tu mi bzad byas na yang / /

411dpa' la brten nas 2jigs pa cherga po ltar/ /gang la brten nas yud kyis sgrol 'gyur ba/ /de la bag can rnams kyis cis mi bsten/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam gsum la brten sa skyabs sa byas na 'di phyi bar do 'phral phugs gang du yang mkhyen pas gzigs/brtse bas bzung / nus pas bskyabs nas nam yang mi slu ba thag chod pa yin/ des na mdun gyi nam mkhar padma 'dab bzhi ba'i/ /lte bar rin chen khri dang pad zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /de yi mdun du longs sprul bde bar gshegs/ /g.yas su lung rtogs bdag nyid glegs bam bzhugs/ /rgyab du rgyal sras nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /g.yon tu bstan srung tshogs rnams skyabs su bzhugs/ /rang gi g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab mtha' bskor du/ /pha ma rigs drug sems can 'khod par gyur/ /tshe 'dir nyer 'tshe med pa dkon mchogatshumakhyen/ /'chi khar mnar gcod med pa dkon mchog mkhyen/ /bar dor 'jigs skrag med pa dkon mchog mkhyen/ /byi mar ngan song mid pa dkon ma chog mkhyen/ /khyod las re sa ltos sa gzhan med pas/ /skyabs dang dpung gnyen mdzod cig dkon mchog gsum/ /zhes skyabs 'gro lan mang bya/ skyabs yu la rnams las 'od zer dpag thed 'phros/ /bdag gzhan kun la phog pas sdig sgrib dag /dkon mchog gsum dang nam yang mi 'bral ba'i/ /rten 'brel rma tha' dag lhun gyis grub par gyur/ /skyabs yul rnames ni dgyes bzhin 'od du zhu/ /rang la thim pas byin rgyus brlabs par gyur/ /de mur sngon 'gro sems bskyed kyang / rtsa ba

472las/ snying rje chen po rab bskyed de/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bsam pa la/shugs drag chu bo bzhi yi rgyun gyis khyer/ /zlog dka' las kyi 'ching ba dam pos bsdams/ /bdag 'dzin lcags kyi dra ba'i spubs su chud/ /ma rig mun pa'i smag chen kun nas 'thib/ /mu med srid par skye zhing skye ba ru/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyis rgyun chad med par mnar/ /gnas skabs 'di 'drar gyur pa'i ma rnams kyi/ /ngang tshul bsams nas sems mchog bskyed par mdzod/ /ces pa ltar bsam na pha ma sems can la dmigs nas byams snying rje lhag bsam rnams mi skye ba'i skabs med byung —/drin can pha ma srid zhi'i rgya mtsho las/ /sgrol phyir bdag gis sangs rgyas thob par bya/ /mdo sngags gdams pa'i snying po don gsum po/ /bsam pa thag pas nyams su blang bar bgyi/ /kha tsam min par sems bskyed shugs drag bya/ / gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ rtsa tshig las/ spyi bor bla ma snyid khar lha //rang sems skye med bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bsam pa la rang gi spyi bor shel dkar gyi mchod rten/ seng khri nas tog gi bar cha tshad dang ldan pa/ bum pa'i dbus su pad zla'i gdan la/ ngo bo rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la rnam pa 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag bzhi ba/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar zhing / 'og ma gnyis kyis shel phreng dang pad dkar bsnams pa / ral ba'i thor tshub/sa dang ldan zhing rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ ri dwags kyi pags nga sa/ nu g.yon bkab cing dar bzang po'i sto da g.yogs dang thang gos gsol ba/ zhabs

— zhe ci — dngha ri44///rteX/rdo————rdo rje dkyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mchod rten gyi phyogs ba'i/'i bang rim 'og ma bzhi la sgo re bzhi re dang steng ma gsum la re gnyis re bcas phyogs rer sgo nyis brgya lnga bcu dang bsdoms pa'i sgo stong yod par bska la bzang gi sa ngas rgyas stong bzhugs pa/ shar phyogs pa rnams rnamyo/ snang gi rnam can sku mdog dkar bo byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ lho phyogs pa rnams rin 'byung gi rnam can sku mdog ser po g.yas ma chog sbyin dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ nub phyogs pa rnams 'od dpag med kyi rnam can sku ca/dog dmar po mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ /byang phyogs pa rnams don yod grub pa'i rnam can sku mdog ljang khu g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya ma dzad pa/ rang gi snying padma 'dab ma stong ldan gyi rnam par gyur ba'i lte bar rang sems dang dbyer med pa'i yi dam thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi ba rgyan cha lugs thams cad snga ltar yongs su rdzogs pa/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lte bar hrīḥdakar po / mtha' bskor du yi ge drug ma'i sngags phreng mu tig dar la brgyus ba lta bus bskor ba/ 'dab ma stong la a dkar po dri ma med pa 'od kyi rang bzhin can stong gsal bar gyur/ bla ma lha yi gsang gsum 'od zer gyis/ /ye shes spyan drangs dam tshig pa la thim/ /bla ma lha la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos bshams mobasngo/ sa gzhi spos kyisamomi/ bla ma spyan ras gzigs bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ skyobs pa'i nus mthu/ skyong pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' pas/ bla ma yi dam/ thugs

4ṭī4 rko — — dze rje can bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong dang bcas pa/ bdag dang pha ma rigs drug gi sems can/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor bying ba//mgon dang skyabasacimed pa/ 'phongs shing nyams thag pa 'di rnams sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las myur du bsgral du gsol/ da lta nyid du྾'aspyag sa 'di nyid dumogasol/ de ltar gsol ba shugs drag btab pas/ spyi bo'i bla ma sangs rgyas rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ snying kha'i yi dam a dang bcas par phog de rnams las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi nang dang sha skyi pags tshal thams cad la khyab bas sgo / gsum gyi sdig sgrib nyon mongs bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag par gyur/ — rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi skur lam gyis gyur/ rang gi ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas 'od zer phyir 'apos/ rigs drug so so'i gnas su song /dmyal ba'i tsha grang / yi dwags kyi bkres skom/ dud 'gro'i rmongs spyod/mi'i skye rga na 'chi/ lha min gyi 'thab rtsod/ lha'i 'chi 'pho ltung ba bsam —gzugs kyi 'du byed sduspu bsngal yongs 'gyur gyi sdug bsngal gyis mtshon pa'i sgrug bsngal dang / las dang nyon mongs pa/ snod gyi gdag pa'i dri ma dang bcas pa sbyangs/ snod thamasacad dag ba'i zhing khams bdi ba can lta bu dang / bcud kyi sems can thams cad thugs rje chen pho'i skur gyur ba snang ba sku'i khyer so/ rang gzhan thams cad kyis yig drug lhang lhang sgrogs pa sgra grag gsung gi khyer so/ rang sems zab gsal gnyis med kyi ngang las mi g.yo ba dran rtog thugasamikhyer so ste khyer so gsum gyi rnal 'byor tshang bar bya zhing / sbyi bo'i bla ma bla ma kun 'dus/ snying kha'i yi

— — — — ——— —— — — — — — — — sna/rta (1dam yi dam kun 'dus/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng snying bo kun 'dus te kun 'acas gsum gyi lam khyer tshang ba'i sgo nas gzungs sngags thams cad kyi rgyal bo/ snying po thams cad kyi gtso bo/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi srog sngags/ snying bo yi ge drug ma dmigs pa rtse gcig pa'i ngang nas brgya stong khri 'bum sogs tshul bzhin sabazla bar bya'o/ /dmigs pa dang bcas te yi ge drug ma brgya stong khri 'bum so gas bzla/ thun 'jog khar yi dam gyi bugs ka'i ñtsasnyi0las 'od zer 'phros/ snad rnams dag zhing du gsal ba la’pog de rnams 'od du tha ba bcud rnams phu thugs rje che na por gsal ba la thim/ de rnams 'od du zhu ba rang la thim/ spyi bo'i bla ma dang sangs rgyasarnams snying kha'i yi dam ma dang bcas par thim/ mchod rten 'ja' ltar yal/ rang snying kha'i pad gdan ma dang bcas pa la thim de rnyitha kha'i yi dgal/ de thugs ka'i sngags phreng la/ de dbus kyi sgyuḥ la/ de yang rim gyis mi dmigs par gyur/ju 'di bzhin rang gzhan 'khor 'das kyis rpāsdus4pa'i cho thams cad ming brnas phar banag pa tsam makartogs da lta rang re ṣṭha yulkokho raja gi ngos nas tshur grub pa snang ba 'di bden spub kyi snang lugs yin/ — 'di ltar grub pa la bden grub zer/ 'di ltar du grub dzil rigs lam na ltange.oṃpa la lta ba zer bakhani/ lab rje skal ldagorgya mtshos/ yu4gakhasashar gzhan dzim ltos phar/ ༈lam lam du 'char 'di dgag bya dngos/ /de ltang du med pa stong nyid de/ /blo de ltar nges la lta ba ther/ /zhes gsungs ba ltalgo yin/ des na bdag gzhan 9sogs rnang tsam btags stom lasarangangangos nasalhab dzisdul phra mo
