512 — —rsha nyid bdag gig ma byas te/ sdug bsngal de nyid kyis de nyid ma byas pa'i phyir te/ rang la rang gi byed pa mi 'jug pa'i phyir/ spyir chos can/sdug bsngal ngo bos gzhan gyis ma byas te/ gzhan de rang gi ngo bo nyid kyis ma grub pa'i phyir te/ de nyid rgyud gzhan la ltos pa'i gyir/ rtsa rtags gsum pa grub ste/ sdug bsngal chos can/ khyod padag sa/zhan gnyi ga tshogs pas ma byas te/ khyod bdag gzhan re res ngo bos byas pa bkag pa'i phyir/ sdug bsngal chos can/ rgyu med du mi 'gyur te/ res 'gar skye ba'i phyir/ phyi rol gyi dngos bo rnams kya/nga chos can/bdag byas sogs bzhi po gang du'ang med de/ nang gi nyer phung bdag byas sogs bzhi bo gang yang min pa'i rigs pa mtshungs pa'i phyir/ 'du byed rnams chos can/ rdzun pa yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'du byed yin na slu ba'i chos can dang slu ba yin na rdzun pa yin pas khyab par gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ 'du byed rnams chos can/ bden par med par thal/ rdzun pa yin te/ khyab ste/ bden pa yin na snang tshul dang gnas tshul mthun dgos/ rdzun pa yin na snang gnas mi mthun pa yin dgos pa'i phyir/ don byed nus pa'i dngos bo la skur ma btab par thal/ 'du byed thams cad rdzun pa slu ba'i chos can du 'dod pa'i phyir zer na/ spyir chos can/ dngos bo gang la'ang skur ba ma btab ste/ dngos bo rnams rang gi ngo bos med pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rang gi ngo bos yod pa la der med par bstan na skur ba btab par 'gro yi/ rang bzhin med pa la rang bzhin med par bstan pas skur ba btab par 'gro don med pa'i

573phyir/ lung des dngos bo rnams don byed nus pas stong par bstan par thal/ lung des 'du byed rnams rdzun par bstan pa'i phyir zer na/bcom ldan 'das chos can/ khyod kyis 'du byed rdzun par gsungs pa des dngos bo rnams don byed nus stong du bstan pa ma yin te/ dngos bo rnams rang ngos nas stong bzhin du snang ba'i rdzun par bstan pa yin pa'i phyir/dngos po rnams rang dus skad cig gnyis par mi sdod kyang sdod par snang ba rdzun pa'i don dang lung de'i brjod don gnyi ga yin te/ rang bzhin gyis mi skye yang rang bzhin gyis skye bar snang ba rdzun pa dang lung de'i don ma yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ dngos po rnams chos can/ rang gi ngo bos grub ste/ gzhan du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rang gi ngo bos med na gtan med yin dgos pas gzhan 'gyur mi 'thad pa'i phyir/ dngos bo rnams chos can/ rang gi ngo bos yod de/ rang gi stong nyid yod pa'i phyir/khyab ste/ rang gi ngo bos med na med dgos/ med pa la gnas lugs mi 'thad pa'i phyir zer/ dngos bo rnams chos can/ khyod gzhan du 'gyur ba mi rung bar thal/ khyod rang bzhin du yod pa'i phyir/ rtags song /khyab ste/ rang bzhin du yod na rgyus ma bcos pa dang / rgyu la ltos med yin dgos pas gzhan du 'gyur mi srid pa'i phyir/ dngos po rnams chos can/ rang bzhin du med de/ gzhan du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ spyir chos can/ sngar gyi gnas skabs/ de nyid la gzhan 'gyur rang bzhin gyis med de/ gzhon nu'i gnas skabs la rga ba rang bzhin gyis med pa'i phyir te/gzhon nu'i gnas skabs 'gag bzhin pa na rgas pa'i gnas skabs snye

574 bzhin pa rang bzhin gyis med pa'i phyir/ spyir chos can/ rgas pa nyid la'ang rga ba rang bzhin gyis med de/ rgas zin slar yang rgas mi dgos pa'i phyir/ gzhan 'gyur ngo bo nyid kyis yod de/ gzhon nu de nyid/gzhon nu'i gnas skabs de nyid na gzhan 'gyur ngo bos med de/ gzhon nu'i gnas skabs de nyid na rgas pa'i gnas skabs de nyid med pa'i phyir/khyab ste/ rang ngos nas grub na gnas skabs gnyis kyang dus mnyam dgos pa'i phyir/ gzhan rgas par 'gyur ba'i phyir zer na/ spyir chos can/ 'o mas rang gi gnas skabs ma btang par zhor 'gyur bar thal/ gzhon nu'i gnas skabs de nyid gzhan rgas par rang bzhin gyis 'gyur ba'i phyir/khyab ste/ de ltar na zho dang rgas pa skye ba la mngon du phyogs pa'i dus nyid na yang zho dang rgas pa yod dgos phas 'o ma dang gzhon nu'i gnas skabs nyid zho dang rgas pa'i gnas skabs nyid dgos pa'i phyir/ spyir chos can/'o mas rang gi gnas skabs btang nas kyang zhor rang bzhin gyis mi 'gyur te/ 'o zho rang bzhin gyis gzhan ma yin pa'i phyir/ spyir chos can/ stong nyid kyi rten dngos bo rang bzhin gyis yod de/ stong nyid yod pa'i phyir zer ba mi rigs te/ stong nyid rang bzhin gyis med pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/brten pa stong nyid ngo bos yod na rten dngos bo ngo bos yod pa 'thad kyang brten pa ngo bos med na rten ngo bos yod dorna mid pa'i byir/ rtags ma grub na/ stong nyid chos can/ khyod rang bzhin gyis med de/ chos yin pa'i phyir/— khyab ste/ rang bzhin gyis stong ba chos thams cad la spyi khyab tyā 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ spyir chos can/ stong nyid rang

— — ————— ——— — — /blo/rwa/////ngos nas med de/ bdag gis mi stong ba cung zad kyang med pa'i phyir te/bdag med ni chos thams cad kyi spyi mtshan du khas blangs pa de'i phyir/ spyir chos can/ rgyu rkyen tshogs pas 'bras bu ngo bos mi skyed de/ tshogs pa snga mas mi skyed/ dang po grub ste/ de dus mnyam pas kyang mi skyed/ de phyi mas sming mi skyed pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ des dngos su ngo bos mi snyed/ brgyud nas mi skyed pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ de la 'bras bu yod pa mi skyed med pa ngo bos mi skyed/ yang tshogs pas 'bras bu rang bzhin gyis mi skyed de/rang nyid mi skyed pa'i snyir/ zhes pa'i migs pa gnyis ni rtsa ba'i rigs pa'o/ /('di man gye ma phyi ma rnyed do) zhes pa 'di ni rigs pa'i nyi ma po yongs 'dzin parnyi ta blo bzang dpal ldan phyogs las rnam rgyal mchog gi zhul snga nas mdzad pa lags so// —

576 dku/ / sher phyin dbyangs can ma dkar mo la yon tan rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas dngos grub zhu tshul zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rang bzhin chos sku'i pho brang dang / /dri za dga' ba'i tshal yangs nas/ /rang mdun dpag bsam ljon pa'i rtser/ /sgra dbyangs lha mo brtse bas byon/ /phun tshogs zla ba'i dkyil 'khor brgya/ /rab rgyas lang tshos dman byas na/ /srid zhi'i khams na khyod nyid las/ /mdzes pa'i phul byung gzhan ci yod/ /'khril bag nyams brgya'i dri bzhon gyis/ /rgyal ba kun kyang cher g.yos na/ /yid la pad ma'i ge sar gyi/ /brtan pa tsam yang 'dzin nus su/ /gzhal med rin chen kun bsdus kyang / /phra mo'i rgyan la'ang ma snyoms pas/ /byed po skyengs nas rang mal na/ /bsam gtan rdzu la ci yang bsten/ /phyag sor rtsen pa'i dam bu ras/ /dri za'i dbyangs bdun zil mnan pas/ /thub gsung drug cu'i dbyangs gzhan yang / /khyod gsung snying bor bsdebs nas khrol/ /mkhyen brtse nyi zla khyod thugs kyi/ /mkha' dang 'tshams pa 'di lta bu/ /gzhan la

577yod med dpyang thag gis/ /kun yid bcings pa'i ri mo rgod/ /blo grosaciku mud rgyas pa la/ /khyod nyid 'dzum pa'i zla zer las/ /‘lhag pa shes bya'i dra ba na/ /yal phyir khyod la skyabs su 'dzin/ /ngag ge pad mtsho ngang mo dkar/ /rtsen las rdza rnga 'khrol ba na/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la phyogs rnams las/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal la dbang / /ro 'dzin tshal ni trīḥyig gi /sprin gyi sgra yis bzung gyur na/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i legs bshad mi/ /'byo la bum bzang bzhin du 'gyur/ /mi yi seng ge mtha' dag gi /sor rtog shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma gcig khyod la bdag dad pas/ /re ba'i dngos grub kun stsol cig /sngags bzla bar 'dod na/ spyoḥtrīḥtrīḥ /zhes dmigs pa dang bcas te gang mang bzla/ de nas/ thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab 'phel du gsol/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i blo gros rgyas su gsol/ /mchog dang mthun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /myur du khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes 'dod don zhusngo/ /sher phyin dbyangs can ma dkar mo la yon tan rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas dngos grub zhu tshul 'di ni lha 'di'i rnal 'byor ba/ mi pham mtsho byung ba'/da pa'i lang tshos sbyar pa'o//

/////rte/ji) — — — nga )༅/ / 'jam dbyangs dkar po la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bzhugs/rang gi spyi bor padma zla ba steng / /a las rgyal ba'i yab gcig mkhyen pa'i gter/ /sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin utpal ral gris mtshan/ /g.yon pa chos 'chad padma glegs bam can/ /rin chen rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' klubs/ /gnas gsum yi ge gsum ldan hūṃ 'od kyis/ /skyabs kun spyan drangs kun 'dus bdag nyid gyur/ /bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /྾ ྾ mobasngo/ zhes yan lag bdun pa bya/ maṇḍal rkyang 'bul/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /dran pa tsam gyis rmongs pa kun zhi nas/ /thabs dang shes rab bde blag stsol ba'i lha/ /mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gang mang dang / snying bo yig drug ci nus ba /mjug tu 'dod gsol gang shes dang / dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla mamo mogasol/ /tshe rabs kun tu rje bstson 'jam dbyangs kyis/ /theg mchog྾ mocis/ /ces sogs bsngo smon bya/ 'di yang dad gus sul phyin nor bu bsam 'phel gyi 'dod mos bzhin gris/

579rgyal lum sgrol ma'i 'dod gso—la/rgyal kun tshe dang ye shes ma lus pa/ /gajiganyatu bsdustse ba yid bgin 'khor lo'i nabs/ /dran pa yis kyang tshe dgal mchog stsol ma/ / khyod la snying narsā gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /bsod nams ye shos tshogam gnyis pha rol phyin/ /thugs bskyed smon lam rgya mtsho'i mthu grub cing / /bslu med bden tshig nam yang mi 'gyur na/ /bdag gi tshe dang shes rab mchog tu spel/ /'chi med dbang phyug brnyes ma'i yon tan dang / /'chi med rig pa 'dzin pa'i dngos grub dang / /'chi med tshethadapal dar ba'i 'dod don rnams/ /'chi med lha mo khyod kyis’da stsol cig /tshosrog mi 'gyur rdo rje'i srog shing tshugs/ /tshe thag mi nub chu rgyun ring dutsho spel/ /tshe bsod mi nyams dbyar gyi dpal yon 'phel/ /tshe dpal nyi zla'i rang mdangs rgyas par mdzod/ /mdor na 'phags ma arya tā re ma//khyod kyi sku tshe ye shes yon tan kun/ /ci 'dra de 'dra ( ༅nar bdag gyur nas/ /rang gzhan don sa/nyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shos/ /'di yang yig rigs rtser son dkon mchog grags pa'i 'dod mos ltar bris/

580 sgrol ma'i g.yang 'gugs/ rab 'byams 'phrin las kun gyi sgyu 'phrul ma/ /phongs pa kun sel arya tā re ma/ /khyod dang nor lha gter bdag 'khor bcas rnams//phyogs bcu'i phywa g.yang 'gug pa'i byed por byon/ /lha yi dpal dang stobs dang 'byor ba dang / /klu yi rin chen gser dngul bang mdzod dang / /mi yi longs spyod zas nor gos dar sogs/ /phun tshogs dpal 'byor thams cad g.yang du khug /rta nor lug gsum 'o zho 'phel ba'i g.yang / /zas gos 'bru rigs phun tshogs dar ba'i g.yang / /rigs rgyud snya na grags rlung rta rgyas pa'i g.yang / /phun tshogs dpal 'byor thams cad g.yang du khug /mi la tshe dpal stobs 'byor phun sum tshogs//byugs la phywa g.yang mnga' thang lhun du chags/ /khyim la bkra shis bde skyid dpal du 'bar/ /gang bsam yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel bar mdzod/ /ces pa 'de yang sbyin bdag a don gyi 'dod mos ltar/ 7yongs 'dzin ming can nas zis/ nor rgyun ma'i mngon rtoges/ stong ba'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis/ /gter bam snol ba'i ༄

— — 58༷/1—gdan la nor rgyun ma/ /sku mdog ser mo dogyes 'dzum nyams kyis bzhugs/ /phyag g.yas 'bras kyi snye ma thugs kar 'dzin/ /g.yon pas rin chen gter bam pas steng bsnams/ /dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis ri sgong sha ring 2 mdzes par klubs/ /yi ge gsum mtshan hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ /ye shes pa bkug dbyer med brtan par bzhugs/ /thugs kar zla steng 'khod pa'i sngags 'od kyis/ /'jin rten khams kyi dpal 'byor longs spyod kun/ /'dod dgu'i char du babs pas chos mthun gyi/ /dpal 'byor dbyar gyi mtsho ltar rgyas par gyur/ oṃ ba su dha ri ni hūṃ sā hā/ zhes gang mang ba /oṃ ba su dha ri asnya nas shalta'i bar gyis mchod/ gyigang zhig dran pa ྾phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khyod la rtse gcig gsol ba 'debs lags na/ /srid zhi'i brtan g.yo'i legs tshogs ma lus dang / /lha klu mi yi rin chen longs spyod kun/ /dbang du 'dus shing bsam don lhun grub mdzod/ /gsol 'debs bsam don skun grub ma bzhugs ṭā/skyabs rje kirti rin po che'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/rang gi spyi bor padma zla ba'i steng / /skyabs kun ngo bo drin can bla ma bzhugs/ /sku las 'od 'phros rkyen ngan thams cad bcom/ / gang bsam 'dod pa'i dngos grub ma lus stsol/ zhes bla ma gsol gdab/ nga ga gi daXbang phyuswā sdo bzaXng rgyal ba'i bstaXn/ /'dzin skyong spel la 'phrin las zla med ༷/ /skyabs mgon dam pa sku phreng rim byon gyis/ /gang tshe ring nas thugs bskyed bzhin du skyongs/ zhes nga ga 5 na

byo82gsol ba ci mang 'debs/ de nas/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma lhag 4pa'i lha/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ mi 'dod rkyen ngan blor chad kun zhi zhing / /bsam don lhun gyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan brgya stong sogs bathang bgin gsol ba sur tshug su btab na 'azal yun rang gnan 'de ji'i don gang zhus thams cad yid la bsam pa bzhin du 'gub nges yin pas 'ari las zab pa mid pa bla ma dam pa kun gyi nyams ‘nga yin/ mjug tu/ chos srid bsam don mtha' dag 'grub pa dang / /skye ba kun tu rgyal ba'i bstan pa la/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba legs byas nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces brjod/ 'di yang / sku dbon tshen po chos je rnam gnyis dang / ze chos rgyal dam pa sogs kyi ched du/ meyongs 'dzin blo bzang dpal bas zis pa dge'o//lhag lha rnam gsum gyi rna/ma 'byor chos nor dpal ster bzhugs so/ /rang gi spyi bor 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i klong / /'jam dpal dbyangs dang dbyangs can dkar mo'i zhabs/ /nor rgyun lha mo skyabs kun ngo bor zhugs/ /sa gzhi ma lta bus maṇḍal 'asnyel/ bla ma lhag pa'i lha mchog rnam gsum la/ /snying nas rtse gcig dad pas gaṭo/la ba 'debs/ /skye ba kun tu zla med shes rab dang / /mthun rkyen longs spyod bkra shis rab rgyas ཿ/dzod/ /ces gsol ba gdung shugam drag pos lan gang mang 'debs/ de nas/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes rol ba las/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes grags pa'i snyan pha can/ /gang zhig dran pa yis kyang skad cig la/ /shes rab snang ba sbyin la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gang zhig snying gi tshal du bkod tsam ma/sa// ngag gi dngos grub 'dod dgur stsol ba las/ /'chad rtsod rtsom 2 zla med

bhe rī rdzi — rtso — byu — 583mkhas pa'i dpal/ /bde blag sbyin pa'i lha/ mor phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mtshan tsam yisaji kyang dbul ba kum/ zhi nas/ /'dzad med 'dod dgu'i gter la dbang 'byor nas/ /'phra' yun bde ba'i dpal la rab 'god sprepa'i/ /ma gcig nor rgyun lha mor phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa 'di ni yig mkhan rtse dpon dge slong dbang sgrub rgyal mtshan nas rang gi yid ngang mthun par glegs bam mang du bzhengs nas rang yul du phebs khar khong ba'i band chos su/ yongs 'dzin blo bzang dpal bas sprel ba'o/ ca/ciṅga lo//

584 dpang bstod/ hūṃ/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dang / /nor ‘lha gter bdag yul lha gzhi bdag so sa/sa/ /phyogs bcu'i phywa g.yang 'gug pa'i byed por byon/ /lha yi dpal dang stobs dang 'byor ba dang / /klu yi rin chen gser dngul bang mdzod dang / /mi yi longs spyod zas nor gos dar sogs/ /phun tshogs dang la 'byor thams cad g.yang du khug /rta nor lug gsum 'o zho 'phel ba'i g.yang / /zas gos 'bru rigs phun tshogs dar ba'i g.yang //rigs rgyud snyan grags rlung rta rgyas pa'i g.yang / /phun tshogs dpal 'byor thams cad g.yang du khug /mi la tshe dpal stobs 'byor phun sum tshogs//nor la phywa g.yang mnga' thang lhun du chags/ /khyim la bkra shis bde skyid dpal du 'bar/ /gang bsam yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel bar mdzod/ /hūṃ/ de ring rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bka'/ /yi dam rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i lha yi bka'/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi bka'/ /mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dpa' mo yongs kyi bka'/ /bstan srung chos skyong chen po rnams kyi bka'/ /rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu yi bka'//srid pa'i lha chen dregs ldan kun gyi bka'/ /'brug sgra stong phrag cig char ldir ba bzhin/ /mngon sum bsgrags nas rnal 'byor bdag cag gis/ /yul 'di'i gzhi bdag gnyan po khyod 'bod na/ /gar bzhugs rdo rjo'i pho brang so so nas/ /myur mgyogs rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis 'dir

58byobyon cig /ces la na nyer gcig sogs bzlas te/ 'bod pa gtong / de nas/ gzhom gzhig bral ba rdo rje rin chen las/ /yongs grub lha yi sku mkhar rgya che ba//mtho la rgya khyon rab tu yangs pa 'di/ /de ring gzhi bdag gnyan po khyod la 'bul/ /rin chen bdun las grub pa'i pho brang mchog /khang ba khang brtsegs ba gam mngon mtho zhing / /gser gyi rgya phibs la sogs rgyan phreng can/ mo morin thang gzhal du med pa'i rin chen gyi/ /khri chen khri chung gzim chas sna tshogs dang / yid 'ong gos dang spyan gzan pags pa'i sa/dan/ ྾ mo ྾mkho dgu'i yo byad ma tshang med pa yi/ /yid 'phrog 'od 'bar ka ca sna tshogs pa/ /mi zad bkod legs phreng bar bsgrigs pa'i tshogs/ mo ྾gser dngul g.yu byur la sogs rin chen mdzod/ /gro nas 'bras sran la sogs 'bru yi mdzod/ /rgya zas za 'og la sogs gos kyi mdzod/ /྾stag pags gzig pags la sogs gya rigs dang / /sha thud phye mar la sogs bza' ba'i rigs/ /ja chang 'o zho la sogs btung ba'i rigs/ /mogaser gyi go khrab la sogs bgo ba'i rigs/ /mda' dang ru mtshon la sogs mtshon cha'i rigs/ /rta mchog glang chen la sogs bzhon pa'i rigs/ /྾stag gzig dom dred la sogs spyan gzan rigs/ /'bri g.yag ra lug la sogs phyugs kyi ris/sa/ /khyi nag bya khra la sogs yul srung rigs/ /྾mthon po ri la skyes pa'i nags tshal dang / /dma' mo thang la 'khyil ba'i mtsho rdzing dang / /ri klung kun tu rgyas pa'i me tog sogs/ /྾mdor na nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting radzim/ las/ /khyod nyid 'khor bcas dgyes pa skyed pa yi/ /phun tshogs 'dod

586rgu'i dngos po gang ma/lo ba/ /de ring ྾ ྾'bul/ zhes mnga' 'bul bya /de nas/ de ltar phun tshogs 'asnyor bas yongs gtams pa'i/ /go/nas mchog bkra shis dpal dang mngon ldan pa'i/ /rin chen gzhal med pho brang dam pa 'dir/ /lhod chags bag phebs tshul gyis brtan par bzhugs//brtan bzhugs mang du bya/ mabu dang gzi gyin bskyed na/ rang yi dam du sa/sal ba'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ /phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ bstan srung ye shes pa'i tshogs dang / snang srid kyi drogs pa mthu rtsal can rnams kyi mthu stobs nus pa thams cad rdo rje sogs phyag mtshan dang 'od zer rnam lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs gzhi bdag gnyan po 'khor dang bcas pa la thim pas rma thu dang nus pa/ stobs dang drag shul/ dpal dang sa/zi byin phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rab tu rgyas par gyur/ oṃ ma hā bā la pu ṣā ku ru oṃ/ brgya rtsa sogs babla/ rgyu/ dam tshig rdo rje 'bar ba gtsug la bzhag /dam tshig phyag rgya chen po mig la bstan/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i tha tshig rna bar bsgrags/ /rdo rje mna' chu lce la 'dud nas su/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis khyod la bka' bsgo na/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel tshul bzhin gus pas nyon/ /gnas 'dir bzhugs la gang bcol las kun sgrubs/ /bka' las ma 'da' badzra sa ma yaḥ zhes lan gsum du dam bsgrags bya/ de nas bsang sogs bsngo rjes su 'phrin las bzhi'i 'dod gsol logs su yod pa 'don/ yul phyogs dge ba'i bkra shis bya'o/ /rnam dpyod ldan pa'i mkhas pa la/ /rtsed mo'i tshul yang legs bshad kyi/ /ngo mtshar gsal ba'i me tog tu/ /bzhad na mkhardu/ la

rdzo 58spresus mi smon/ /zhes pa 'di yang yongs 'dzin grub pa'i dbang po don yod— rdo rje'i bka' bstsal ba'o/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan bshad pa la mtshan don/ 'gyur phyag gzhung don/mjug don bzhi/ de'i nang nas gzhung don pashad pa de la bshad pa la 'jug pa'i yan lag bshad pa nyid nye bar 'god pa/ bshad pa mthar phyin pa dang gsum/ de'i gnyis pa de la/ lus rnam bzha ga dang yan lag rgyas bshad gnyis yod par thal/ khas len snga ma de dag 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ yan lag rgyas bshad de la rnam mkhyirna nas chos sku'i bar rgyas par bshad pa brgyad yod par thal/ dngoyopo brgyad po re re nas rgyas par bshad pa brgyad yod par thal/ dngos po brgyad po re re nas bshad pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dang po rnam mkhyen rgyas par bshad pa la sems bskyed sogs mtshon byed kyi chos bcu so sor rgyas par bshad pa'i sgo nas bshad dgos par thal/ de rgyas phar bshad tshul zhig yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dang po sems bskyed la mtsharna nyid dang dbye ba gnyis med pa'i phyir/ ྾ mobargyad pa 'bras bus chos sku rgyas par bshad pa la yang ngo bo nyid sku sogs bzhi so sor rgyas par bshad— pa dgos par thal/ rnam mkhyen rgyas par bshad tshul de'i phyir/ 'dod rna/'bras bus chos sku mtshon byed kyi chos bzhi 'phrin las dang bcas pa bshad pa la 'phrin las kyi mtshan nyid dbye ba re re nas yod pa'i phyir/ ྾de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyis 'phrin las yin na/ gang gis srid pa ji srid bar mo

588rgyun mi chad par 'dod/ ces gsungs pa ltar gyi khyad chos dang ldan pas khyab pa 'dir/ de ltar rang cag rnams kyis legs byas kyi sgo 'phar yangs por phye ba 'di nyid kyis rmad du byung ba'i rten 'brel gye legs tshogs thams cad lhun gyis grub ste/ / 7skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa mthong ba don ldan nyid zhabs pad rdo rje'i khams ltar brtan par bzhugs shing lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan/ mkhas btsun bzang ba'i rnam thar/ bshad sgrub zung 'jug gi mdzad bzang / don gnyis lhun grub kyi 'phrin las rnams phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel/ tshul de la brten nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che bkur bsnyi dang bcas te phyogs thams cad du yun ring du rgyas par 'gyur ba dang / tshul des lhag par bshad sgrub kyi nyi 'od mkha' khyab tu rgyas/ bstan 'dzin gyi padmas legs bshad kyi dga' ston 'gyed/ 'jig rtenagakun tu bde skyid dbyar gyi lang tsho 'phel bar 'gyur ro4zhes tshul dang po de nyid ston pa la/ rje btsun bla ma sku tshe rab brtan cing ྾cig ces pa'i gzhung 'di byung / tshul gnyis pa de nyid ston pa la/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pumo ྾cis/ ces pa'i gzhung 'di byung / tshul gsum pa de nyid ston pa la/ mdor namo rgyal sa zin par shogamoces pa'i gzhung 'di byung ba yin la de ltar yin pa'i phyir/ /mchod yar/ sangs rgyas thar lam ston mdzad mchod/ /dam chos thar lam gsal mdzad mchod/ /dge 'dun thar lam sgrub mdzad mchod/ /chos skyong thar lam grogs mdzad mchod/ /bdag gis/ 'dir 'bad dge ba 'dis/ /gang gis rjes bzung skye bo la/ /kakhas— dang tsogrub pa'i dpal

— dzha — — ske (5/spresbyo/sbyin mkhas/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma mchod/ /stobs 'acu'i dpal mnga' shākya'i tog /bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad dus dgra'i dbang / /mi pham mgon dang 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /bslu med rin chen rnam gsum mchod/ /rgyan drug mchog gnyis zla ba'i khyo/bas/ /jo 'brom rgyal ba tsong kha pa/ /sras bcas skal ldan rgya mtsho'i sde/ /chos mthun sgrub pa'i grogs rnams mchod/ /myur mdzad mgon dang las gshin dang / /gur mgon lcam dral pu ṭa sogs/ /grogs mdzad chos skyong srung mar bcas/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba thams cad mchod/ mchod mchod/ tshig bkra/ de yang ji skad du/ thabs dang shes pa legs 'brel zhing / /stong nyid snying rje snying bo can/ /gang du legs par gnas gyur pa/ /de ni theg chen bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thabs rgya che ba sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa dang / shes ba dngos bstan zab mo'i lam gnyis zung du 'brel ba'i sgo nas/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid snying rje snying bo can brjod bya'i gtso bor byas nas ston pa/ theg pa chen po'i bltan pa nyi ma ltar gsal bar mdzad pa'i gzhung chen mo/ gsung rab kun gyi snying bo sher phyin gyi mdo sde rin po che gtso bor gyur pa'i rgyal ba'i gsung rab la drang nges 'byed pa'i legs bshad rmad du byung ba gang gi dus gsum rgyal ba mtha' dag gi rang sa/zugs/ skyabs mgon mthong ba don ldan/ dpal ldan chos kyi nyi ma chen po gang nyid/ 'dzam gling bstan 'gro yongs kyi rtsa lag dam par zhabs pad lhun chags tshe mtha' yas pa'i rang bzhin du brtan pa dang / rmad byung gsang ba gsum gyi mon tan mthe' dag phyogs

590 bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang mnyam par brdal ba/ rtsol med shugs 'byung gi 'phrin las mkha' khyab tu rgyas te/ bstan 'gro'i legs tshogs ma lus pa rdzo gsaldan gyi dpal ltar 'phel ba dang—/ chos sde chen po 'di nyid du ris rtsam bcas pa'i skal bzangamakhas pa'i tshogs rnams ngang gis 'dus te/lung rigs legs bshad myi sgra dbyangs rgyunaspar sgrogs pas bshad sgrub 'khor lo gsum mibya ba da byar—mtsho las kyang gong 'phel du 'gyur pa dang /bdagadkug gnyis kyang skye ba'i zang ba thams cad du theg pa mchog gi rigs can dbang po rnon po kho nasarten babeengabyuthob steglongs sardzogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyi zla lta bu tshul—bzhin du bsten/ sher phyin gyi gsung rab rin po che mtshon pas zab rgyas kyi gzhung las ldog tu med pa'i thos rpā4dzisgomakasum gyis zhugasate/ ji skad du/ mtha' dang bral ba'i lta ba dadzo/ /da pyad 'a jog cha mnyam sgom pa dang / /mdo sngags bshad sgrub 'ag la rnyed spyod/ /de ni bltan pa skyon med yim/ /zhes gsungasaupa lta bu'i skyon dang bral ba'i bltan pa dri ma med pa'i snying bo la 'dod dgur dbang bsgyur nas/ don gnyirtswagun sum tshogs4pa'i dga' char nam mkha' tsād du' beb6pa'i—rten 'byung lhun gyisi spub pa yin par tha ga de ltar yin rno zhes tshul dang so de nyid ston ba la:/ gyizhabs pad tshe ma tha'i ngo bor lhun gyis chags/ /gsung gsum rgyal ba kugadang mnyam par brdal/ /'brin las 'od snang nam mkha'i mthar song nas/ /bstan 'gro'i legs tshogs rdzogs ldan dpal las 'phel/ /tshe/sa pa'i gzhung 'di byung /tshu la gnyis pa de gyid ston pa la/ ri sa med skal bzang mkha' 'gro dkar

59 1po'i tshogs/ /ma bos ngang gis 'dus pa'i sde 'di na/ /lung rigs legs bshad sgrogs pa'i rdza rnga yis/ /'khor lo gsugagyi dpyid dpal —mgron du bsu/ /tshe/sa pa'i ga zhung 'di byung / tshul gsum pa de nyid ston pa la/ gting mtha' dpag dka' rgyal gsum chu gter cher/ /mi ldog thos bsayosgom pa'i gru sbyar te/ /zab don rin chen mdzod la dbang 'byor nas/ /'gro la don gnyis dga' char 'beeb rgyur cig /ces ripa'i gzhung 'di byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ /mchod yar/ bla ma sangs rgyas thar las ston pa mchod/ /dam chos thar lam gsal byed mchod/ /dge murtswan thar la.oṃ sgrub grogs mchod/ /chos skyong tharabyulam grogs mdzad ma chod/ / nu sa 'khor skabs kyi slob ma rjos 'dzin cho ga/ rang nyid hūṃ dang rdo rje las skye sa pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas sna tshogs yum la 'khyud ba/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs par gyur/ zhes skad cig dkrong bsnyed bya/ de nas las sgyum gyi bsangs zi dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥ zhes rigs drug gi sngags sa te bskub/ de nas rib mi rnams sas dang sbyag sgyun ngu btang nas 'astsod pa la mi tog paspre brna bya/ bgigs gartor mchod pa ba cas bsha saji)/ rangatshugirdo sgyu rnams layo'od zer 'phros/ khro bo'i tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drang sa/ zhes dang / bgigs gartor bsang skabs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ho ༷ lhami kṣa0 nes las bum gyi chus bsang / nga yi gnabasa' dir slob ma rjes 'dzin byed/ cis dang / khyad par du yang me long khro bo'i rgyal bo rdo rje shugs kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / zhis dang / so so'i gnas su song zhig oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ pho phaṭa/ oṃ sum bhā

'a //blo/19///shā// sa — la ni sogs kyis gegs spad bya/ de nas/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i zhabs drung du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi rim pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes brna spyor/ slob ma dag gis tshom bu dgu ma bdag gzhan ma mjug tu yi dam sogs rton rte 'bul/ de nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes bzlas mdzod/ skye ba mang po'i sdig pa ni/ /bsags pa rnam par 'jig byed pa/ /sdom pa so sor bzung bar bgyi/ /dpa' bo dus kyi 'khor lor mdzod/ /ces lan gsum rjes bzlas kyis gsol ba 'anabs/ de nas so shing dor sa'i sdod bshams te/ bla mas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥ/ badzra dan ta kā khri tsa tu ra ni mokṣa mu kha ni shud snya sā bhā waṃ kā ya wa 7/ tsitta dzñā na mu kha dan tā di ma lam ni sho snya ya bi sho snya ya sā hā/ zhes brjod de slob ma la ster/ de skal/ 'di'i rjes bzlas dang mnyam du so shing 'dor bar mdzod/ oṃ badzra ha sa ha/ nas pas so ging 'dor du 'jug bla ma dang / shar byang nub steng 'og ste bdun po gang du ba na pa la rim bzhin/mchog zhi rgyas da nga drag rig 'dzin sa 'og gi dngos gub gang 'grub rim bzhi brda sbyor/ de nas/slob ma khyed ra5 rnams kyi dpral bar zla ba la ā/ snying gar sgra sa/can la ā/ gtsug tor du thig le la ā/ lte bar dus me la ljo/ mgrin par nyi ma dzā/ gsang ba ye shes kyi 'khor lo la āḥste thabs shes kyi sku gsung thugs rigs drug gi lha lha mo'i ngo bor gyur ba rnams kyis srung bar gyur song snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod cig 'de rna sta gon gyi sa bcad gsum pa'i skabs ltar te/ dam pa 'ga' res sta gon sa bcad lnga ba'i skubs ltar rigs drug 'god pa gnang skabs kyang yod/ de ltar na slob ma rjes 'dzin grub zin pa yin pas gtang rag tu maṇḍal mdor bsdus 'bul bar zhu/ sa gzhi ma 'don/ bdag gis ji snyed྾ /tshe rabs

593kun tu/ chos kyi rgyal bo zhes gsungs/ kṣi/sa pa 'di yang sngags 'chang chen po dpal ldan don yod rdo rje'i gsung gi bdud rtsi lags/mngon byang gi baig bshad/ mo4rnam snang mngon byang gi thig 'dab tshul ni/ shar nub kyi tshangs thig drang por ba/dab/ de'i dbus btsal te shar nub tu/ dper na sor bcu gnyis re ltagyibu tshad mnyam gnyis bya/ de'i bar tshad mnyag gsum du bcad na re re sor brgyad re thob/ de'i sum cha gnyis la sor bcu drug sum cha gcig cha brgyad du byas pa'i cha gcig la sor gcig yod pas sor bcu drug po de'i tshad kyis lho byang gi bya rjes byas te tshangs thig gnyis gdab/ zur bzhi'i bya rjes blangs te zur thig gnyis gdab /dbus nas zur thig bzhi ga'i steng du sor bcu gcig dang cha gcig gi sum cha'i tshad du rtags bya/ de bsdams pa sor nyer gnyis dang sor gcig gi sum gnyis kyi tshad kyis zur bzhi'i steng slar yang lan bzhir rtags byas pa rtags lnga re yod pa'i steng nas thig gdab/ de ltar bcad pa la tshad mnyam re mig gya gcig 'byung ba lte ba'i gtso pad pa dang mnyam ste padma re re'i phyogs re na sor tshad bcu drug re yod pas bcu drug ma bcu drug bsdoms na padma re rer sor mo nyis brgya dang drug re yod/ de ltar na padma gya gcig la sor mo3༷73snyoyod/ de la gsum du bgos napo911 thob pa padma37re tshad de dkyil 'khor sasum po re re'i tshad yin / phyi ma la phyogs rer padma 'dab brgyud re yod pa bsdoms nakā3de re re'i kha nas

594sor mo gnyis re dang phyed re blangs na padma re'i steng sor bzhi bcu blangs pas sor118༷'byung ba padma lnga'i tshad yin / de bar gyi nyer bzhi'i steng bsnams pas padma nyer dgu'i tshad yod/ de gnyis nang ma'i nyer lnga'i steng du snon pa'i phyir/ bar kyi padma nyer bzhi po de'i phyogs re la cha bcu drug re yod ltabase padma nyer bzhi'i steng nas chu re dang sum cha re blangs na bsdoms sor513yod pa padma gnyis kyi tshad yin/ de dang lte ba'i gtso pad bcas na gagi nyer bzhi la bsnan la padma nyer bdun yod de dkyil 'khor gsum po tsād shin tu mnyam par padma nyer bdun re'i sor motsakha11'byung bas so//phyi thig dang de ltar bsnan pa'i mtshams nas thig re slar btab pa dkyil 'khophagasum gyi 'dab yab kyi thig yin/ rang rang gi nang cha phyogs re cha gsum du bcad pa'i phyi ma'i mtshams nas rang rang gi rtsa thig gdab/dkyil 'khor gsum gyi sgo tshad sor bcu drug dang nyi shu nyer bzhir 'gyur bas de ltar dbye/ mtshwams de'i rtsa thig nas 'dab yab bar rang cha brgyad re yod pa las rang cha bdun gyi bar la rtsig pa'i nang thig 'then te sbrel ba rtsig pa'i nang thig go /rtsa thig dang 'dab yab kyi bar gyi rang cha brgyad po de dbus nas phyed mar bgo /phyed ma dang po la dbus su rang cha do ru byas te/ de'i phyi nang la rang cha re'i mtshams su 'gram kanyis gdab/rtsig pa'i phyi thig dang rin po che'i nang thig yin / phyed ma gnyis pa phyed du bgos nas dra ba dra phyed kyi thig dang de'i phyi ma phyed du bgos pa shar bu'i gdab/ de ltar na rtsig pa'i phyi nang gi thig gnyis stegs bu rin po che dra ba shar bu 'dab thig bcas ngos sam 'phred thig bdun yod/ dkyil

595'khor dang po dang gnyis pa'i sgo 'i g.yas g.yo na du rang cha re re sa/cig pa'i go sar dor nas stegs bu dang rin po che'i thig gnyis kyi bar la stegs bu'i sar cha gnyis yod pa'i rtse sbrel/ yang stegs bu'i nang thitā las rtsig pa'i phyi thig 'dab thig bar 'then pa gsum kar 'dra ba las phyi ma la stegs bu'i thig las rtsig pa'i phyi thig nas dra ba dang dar dpyangs kyi thig re rin po che dang dra ba dang shar bu dang 'dab thig dngos su yod pa bzhi la reg par byed/ 'dab yab phyir lag len la — babs pad tshad dang de'i phyir rdo rje pad tshad ched du sor so gnyis dang —ge g.yas g.yon du pad tshad re byas te — babs kyi tshad de ka cha mnyam brgyad du bgos pa'i gsum pa dang bdun pa gnyis kyi phyi nas dang / lnga ba'i nang nas sum cha re'i gdab pas thig bcu gcig 'byung / tshangs thig nas ngos g.yas g.yon du sor dgu song mtshams nas snam bu dang po rang la sogs/ lnga dang ran chen phyi 'og thig ched du thig sor do lhag dgos pas sor bdun 'then/ gnyis pa rin chen dang gsum pa rta rmig gnyis ni g.yas g.yon du sor bcu re dor rma tshams nas sor drug re dang / bzhi ba gser sogs brgyad don mtshams nas sor drug dang lnga ba bdun dor nas rang gi ngos la bdun dang / sor drug dor nas drug pa rang go ngo la sor bcu dang /snam bu bdun pa brgyad pa dgu ba gsum la g.yas g.yon du sor bcu drug re 'then pas ngo bo sdo sor gnyis yod/ snam bu bcu ba dang bcu gcig pa gnyis la g.yas g.yon du rim bzhin sor bcu gcig dang bcu gnyis re 'then pas ngo bo la rim bzhin sor nyer brgyad dang nyer bzhi yod/ snam

596bu rnams sa/cig mthar gcig sor gyi tshul du kyog po gcig tu 'gyur zhing nang yang de bzhin la nang nas sor mo phyed nas kyog po snga ma las gzhan pa'i kyog po gcig kyang 'gro ming la glang rgyab zer/ — babs kyi 'dab yab las sor bcu drug song mtshams las rdo rje'i rtse'i 'bab ste rtse na sor brgyad yod/ ting ba g.yas g.yon du sor brgyad re byas pas sor sor bcu drug 'byung / tshangs thig dang 'dab yab 'phrad mtshams nas phyir brgyad de'i g.yas g.yon du sor brgyad song mtshams nus sor tshad bcu drug pas rang rang phyogs kyi phyi rwa bskor/ 'dab yab las brgyad song mtshams de nas g.yas g.yon sor re dor mtshams nas rwa thig nang ma bskor/ rdo rje'i rtse padma'i nang thig de brgyad nas padma/ yang brgyad rdo rwa / bcu drug nas 'od 'phreng bskor/ dbus nas sor mo phyed dang gsum nas lte ba dang / lte ba nas bdun song mtshams nas 'dab ma lte ba nas brgyad song mtshams nas re kha bskor bas lte ba la sor lnga/ 'dab ma la phyed dang lnga/ re kha la sor gcig yod/ snam bu bcu gcig ni dang po sngo rkyang / shar bu gnyis pa dang brgyad pa dmar po/ rin chen gsum pa bdun pa dgu ba ljang khu rta rmis/ bzhi ba drugapa bcu ba ser bo/ gser rno/ lnga ba sngo nag tsi pa dra/ bcu gcig pa padma dmar po/ dkyil 'khor phyi ma 'i rtsig pa dkar rkyang / gnyis pa'i rtsig pa phyi nas dkar dmar ser te gsum rim/ nang ma phyi nas dkar dmar ser ljang nag po lnga brtsegs so/ /zhes pa 'di tsam las 'phro can du gyur to//

597yang rgya rin po ches dris lan/yang rgya rin po che lags la/ zhu bya/ spyir reb gong la ngom chog pa'i paṇḍi ta la mi pham zla ba byung yang khong nas rtsis gzhung thugs rtsom ma gnang / brtsams shing dpar du bkod pa dang stong 'jug gi ming zhig gleng mkhan ni bde chen sprul skyo blo bzang chos 'phel rgya mtsho ba lags mod/ khong ba'i stong 'jug tutwe8dbang chu ri/ bug mtsho dus ri'i nyin zhag de//'byung mkha' phyogs bsgyur mkha' mig ri/ /baṃ3/kau0 mi mes thob tshupya mig lag /ces pa la mngon sum dang 'gal ba'i skyon yod de/ de ltar bgos na 22900 thob pa'i phyir dang / lhag kyang mi dag pa'i phyir dang / lhan thabs su bug mig lag pa thob ste dag ces pa'i lung 'gal yang yod pa'i phyir dang / lhan thabs las de nyid nam mkha' lag pa dang ri/lha9 ri dbang me dang yon tan 'char/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis khyer na ji bzhin thob cing lha ga med du dag pa'i phyir ro/ /des na lhan thabs su nyin zhug gi grangs de nyid nam mkha' sogs tho/nga du bshad pa zhes pa'i rdu nyidu ces pa'i tshig yar bcad de nges bzung byas pas 'khrul 'tshabs che ba byung bar snang /de bzhin du gza' lhag ma kun la'ang 'khor lo de nor 'dug pas rang gi

598 de nyid bstan par ma zad/ sa cha'i rna ba yang bcad 'dug go zhes gzhan nas smra ba byung na lan zhig dgos pas rtsis rams 'byams pa kun la mgon 'don mdzad de lan zhig khrigs khrigs mdzod ces7gong sar zhus yod/khyed gong gi grogs nang tshom bkrab pa 5na gshis rogs— rams la sgrims shig (mostong 'jug ri mo ma thebs pas lag len ma bgyis/ zer sgros zhig zlos kyang mu 'byor bas)sbyor ba skar sa/cig zer dgos pa lta bu mang / brag dgon pa'i11312'di yang min/ 'byung 'dod11135 drag po yin dgos/ 'di yang 'jam dbyangs bla— ma yongs 'a/na pazhi ta'i gsung gi cha shas so//

dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ 'jigs da bsagagrub/ mdun shog jus 'gorna pa/ pe rgyun/ sku / /blo bzang dpal ldan gyi ljags rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/(smad cha)blo bzang dpal ldan glis bcams/spung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe sgrun khang gis bskrun/mtsho sngon zhing chen zhin hwa dpe tshopa khang gis bkram/mtsho sngon mi rigs par khang gis sprur brgyab/1990lo'i zla10par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/1990lo'i zla10par par thengs dang po brgyab /1bya2smo7—80057—042—8(snu 25 deb spus legs rer sgor/ 9 80deb dkyus ma rer sgor/ 7 byi0
